rows.title: National Disruption Fusion Unit (NDFU) Insight Analyst

location.linkedinText: City Of London, England, United Kingdom

rows.descriptionText:
Job Introduction

Salary: £41,267.45 per annum with yearly increments based on performance

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: Any of the main Hubs: London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds or Cardiff. An additional London Allowance of £4,775.00 payable to London based candidates only.

Type of Working Arrangement: Blended approach of home and office-working is available

Hours: This is full-time role (37 hours per week)

British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. Our values are simply: We Care, We Do the Right Thing, We Strive to Be Better Every Day, We Are One BTP, and We Are Proud to Protect. Join us and help create an environment where we can all be our best every day.

The Opportunity

British Transport Police has an exciting opportunity for an NDFU Insight Analyst to join the National Disruption Fusion Unit (NDFU). 

As an NDFU Insight Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex data into meaningful insight that helps reduce disruption, improve safety, and support informed decision-making across the railway network. Working as a multi-disciplinary analytical specialist, you will combine intelligence analysis, performance analysis, and data science techniques to develop innovative tactical and strategic products for a wide range of stakeholders.

Using cutting-edge analytical methods and technologies, you will identify emerging trends, uncover opportunities for improvement, and provide evidence-based recommendations that help prevent major disruption events before they occur. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a nationally important function, working at the forefront of analytical innovation to help keep Britain's railways safe, efficient, and moving.

What You'll Be Doing

Designing and delivering innovative national insight products and reports that support decision-making across British Transport Police, Network Rail, and wider industry partners.Analysing complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that help reduce disruption, improve railway safety, and enhance network performance.Developing and maintaining interactive dashboards and reporting solutions, including Power BI products, to enable stakeholder self-service and increase automation.Producing high-quality analytical reports with clear findings, evidence-based recommendations, and practical solutions for operational and strategic challenges.Presenting analytical insights to senior leaders and industry stakeholders, translating complex information into concise, impactful briefings and recommendations.Monitoring emerging trends and conducting horizon scanning to identify potential future risks, support continuous improvement, and help prevent major disruption events before they occur.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Educated to degree level in a relevant discipline, or able to demonstrate equivalent professional experience.Proven experience conducting research and analysis, including interpreting complex information and producing insightful reports and recommendations.Experience managing and analysing large data sets, using analytical tools and Microsoft applications, particularly Excel and Power BI.Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, solve problems, and develop innovative evidence-based solutions.Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and accessible manner.Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs to demanding deadlines.

Additional Information

The NDFU are a national, pan-industry unit. Therefore, there is requirement to travel to both BTP and NR sites across the country on a regular basis.

Further information about this vacancy can be found in the attached job description.

What We Offer

28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days after 5 years.Family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave.Bespoke benefits platform and Blue Light Card access.Salary sacrifice options for cycles, home technology, gym membership, and electric vehicles.Interest-free annual rail season ticket loan after 6 months.Access to the Transport Benevolent Fund for health, welfare, and financial support.Development opportunities, including fully funded apprenticeships.Excellent Pension scheme: We offer the BTP GPP Police Staff Pension Scheme, administered by Royal London. This group personal pension plan is available to all police staff and is a defined contribution scheme. It provides the flexibility to vary your pension contributions from 4.4% to 12% of your salary. For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk. Note: If you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS, your pension will not be affected.

How To Apply

Applications will be via an up-to-date CV and online application form, as part of this application please outline how your skills and experience demonstrate your suitability for the role.

Completed applications must be submitted by 11.59pm, 7 October 2026

Vetting: Successful applicants will be required to pass Management Vetting (5 years minimum UK residency required), including a full background and financial disclosure. For more information and Top Tips, please see attached document.

Medical: We’ll ask for relevant health and medical history details to support employee wellbeing.

References: We'll ask for references to cover the past 5 years.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are committed to building a workforce where everyone feels they belong. 

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences. Diversity strengthens our teams, improves our services and helps us better represent and support the communities we serve.

We are proud to be an inclusive employer and strive to create a workplace that is fair, respectful and accessible to all. We actively work to challenge discrimination, remove barriers and ensure equity throughout our recruitment and employment practices.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or selection process, please let us know - we are happy to support you. Your talent, your potential, and your unique perspective matter here.

For more information on Inclusion or the Disability Confident Scheme, please click the links Inclusion & Diversity Disability Confident Scheme

Join Us

Ready to take the next step in your career? At BTP, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, make a real impact, and be part of something extraordinary.

Find out why BTP could be the perfect fit for you - About Us - British Transport Police

Curious about what life at BTP is really like? Hear directly from our people and discover what makes working here so rewarding. Explore real stories on our blog: Our Stories - British Transport Police

For further information, please contact our Resourcing Team -RecruitmentTeam@btp.police.uk.

AI can be a useful tool to spark ideas or help you organise your thoughts, but when it comes to your application, we want to hear from you, not an algorithm. What truly stands out to us are genuine stories, personal insights and the experiences that have shaped who you are. Authenticity matters - it helps us understand your motivations, your strengths and how you’ll contribute to our team. So, use AI if it helps you get started, but let your own voice lead the way.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Syntrace builds conversational knowledge for institutional investors. We capture, organize and synthesize private conversations into source-backed knowledge a firm can build on.
We are now hiring a Data Analyst, based in London.
You will turn our data into decisions. You will analyze how customers use the product, measure the quality of what our AI delivers and give product, sales and leadership the insights they need.
Our users trust us with the most sensitive conversations they have. That makes security part of the product, not a feature on top of it. We measure how the product is used, never what is said.
What you bring:
- A few years of experience in data analysis, or a strong academic background in a quantitative field.- Strong SQL, and experience with Python or a similar language for analysis.- The ability to turn a vague question into a clear answer, and explain it simply.
What you get:
- A founding role with real ownership.- A senior team that has scaled companies before.- The chance to shape how a company understands itself.
To apply, send a short note to careers@syntrace.com about yourself.
If you know someone who should read this, send it to them.

rows.title: Commercial Insight Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Role: Commercial Insight Analyst

Location: Hybrid - 3 days per week Clapham Junction

This is a genuine opportunity to work across the full breadth of a fast-moving consumer business - from gym trading performance and location strategy through to product and customer behaviour - and to produce analysis that directly shapes how The Gym Group grows. If you have around two years of analytics experience and you are ready to take on more ownership, work with senior stakeholders and build your commercial instincts, this role has a lot to offer.

Who We Are

We're not like any other gym company; we are The Gym Group, a place where you can #BeYouWithUs and perform to your absolute best. We are successful; by membership we're the 2nd largest gym business in the UK and the 4th largest in Europe. We hire people with real passion, positivity and enthusiasm which motivates and inspire those around them. We actively invest in our employees; it's so important to us that our people can thrive in our environment and can make the most of the flexibility and support we offer to all of our teams.

What You'll Be Doing

Analysing trading performance across our gym estate and surfacing insights that help the business act quickly and confidentlySupporting member acquisition and retention analysis, helping the business understand what drives membership growth and how to reduce churnWorking with our Property team to analyse location performance and inform decisions about where we open and investEvaluating product performance and member behaviour to help the Product team improve the experience we offerBuilding dashboards and reports that give stakeholders a clear view of performance in their areaAnswering ad hoc business questions end to end - from scoping the brief through to presenting findingsCommunicating insights clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues in a way that leads to action

What We're Looking For

Around 2 years of experience in a data insight role, ideally in a commercial environmentStrong, independent SQL skills - you should be comfortable writing and troubleshooting queries without supportConfidence using Excel for data analysis and manipulationA proven ability to communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholdersAn eye for presenting data clearly through analysis and visualisationStrong attention to detail and a proactive, curious approach to problem solving

Our commitment to inclusion

At The Gym Group, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and able to be themselves. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you are excited by this role but do not meet every requirement listed, we would still encourage you to apply - we care about potential and attitude as much as experience.

Need assistance?

If you have a disability or condition that makes it difficult for you to complete your application online please email your cv to recruitment@thegymgroup.com or alternatively call the TGG Recruitment team on 0203 319 4838 and someone will be more than happy to support you. We also want to put it out there that we actively encourage applications from a diverse demographic and we are passionate about your culture and value alignment. We want this to be a match that works for you as much as for us!

Please note that we may close the application window early if we receive high levels of interest. If you're interested in applying please do so asap!

Your application may be reviewed by an AI tool to help assess your suitability based on the information you provide. Automated decision-making is never used - every application is reviewed and all decisions, including whether to progress your application, are made exclusively by a member of our recruitment team. Your data will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and UK GDPR. If you have any questions about how your information is used, please contact recruitment@thegymgroup.com.

LI-CJ#1

rows.title: Product & Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About RG SciencesRG Sciences (RGS) is at the forefront of data and technology services, developing data and analytical tools that help investors and asset owners to understand their impact on society and the environment. Our RIFT framework quantifies companies’ positive and negative externalities in monetary terms across Customer, Employment, and Environmental impacts. We have over 5 years’ experience in developing impact data covering public and private companies. We are now adapting this company-level analysis into portfolio-level tools for pension funds and other institutional asset owners.
As an early-stage startup, RGS has a small, yet vibrant team dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive economy. We champion transparency in how decisions affect our planet and its inhabitants. 
Equal Opportunity EmployerAt RGS, we uphold the principles of equity and fairness across our operations. We do not engage in or condone discrimination based on gender, race, ethnicity, national origin, religion, political beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or physical ability.
The RoleWe are looking for a Product & Research Analyst to join our Product team. This is an early-career role suitable for a graduate or someone with approximately 0-3 years of relevant experience. You will work across impact research, data analysis, product development, and selected client projects. Your main area of ownership will be research projects relating to new and improved impact methodologies, competitor and market research, and specific company assessments. 
Responsibilities:Identify gaps in the RGS impact framework and research potential new impact measures (such as controversies, or expanded nutritional impacts) Review academic evidence on measuring and monetizing societal and environmental outcomesSupport interviews and product testing with pension funds, institutional investors and relevant expertsConduct user and competitor research, and produce structured product and methodology recommendationsReview data coverage, consistency and reliability, and investigate anomalies or missing informationDeliver relevant, actionable insights on companies to investors. Become a trusted go-to expert on core impact topicsPrepare reports and presentationsSupport the overall mission, vision, and goals of Richmond Global Sciences
Skills and Requirements:Analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills. Ability to interpret data, theorize, and make decisions based on dataSelf-starter who will excel in a start-up environment by taking ownership and initiativeConfidence working with Excel and structured datasetsPassionate about social impact and sustainability issues and the use of data to solve themExcitement with the latest productivity and AI tools A relevant degree or equivalent experience in a quantitatively rigorous discipline (such as economics, finance, engineering, physics, or related sustainability fields)Ability to communicate data insights to a non-analytical audienceApplicants need to be eligible to work in the UK 
Desirable Experience:The following would be useful but is not required:Relevant work experience, including designing and conducting quantitative research and analyzing data preferable. Relevant knowledge or experience on specific industries would be desirable and should be highlighted in the application.Relevant experience with:Financial statements and sustainability disclosuresImpact measurement or impact accountingCommercial datasets, customer research, or B2B product development
What are we offering?Competitive salary (based on experience)Holidays: 25 days of holiday + public bank holidaysFlexible working: 3-4 days per week in our London office, 1-2 days remoteEquity in the companyGenerous pension schemeA supportive team and working environment that values excellence and is motivated by making a positive impact on society and the environmentAn invaluable insight into the early stages of product development at a fast-growing SaaS startupNo corporate overhead, endless meetings, arbitrary goals, and pointless reviews
How to applyPlease submit your application using this application form: https://tally.so/r/LZl70v.You will be asked to upload your CV and answer a few questions about your experience, interests, and approach to research.
While considered use of LLMs such as ChatGPT and Claude is encouraged at RGS, please do not use them to answer the application questions. In our experience, authentic and unassisted answers will give us the clearest sense of your voice, thinking, and fit for the role. We may use AI tools to verify that responses have not been generated by LLMs.

rows.title: Business Data Analyst [AQ-19074]
rows.descriptionText:
Aquent is thrilled to partner with a leading global technology company that is revolutionizing how individuals and businesses manage their financial lives. This innovative organization is deeply committed to customer success, leveraging data-driven strategies and integrating AI into core workflows to enhance experiences and drive operational excellence across diverse international markets. Our partner is transforming how they generate insights and automate processes, setting new industry standards and we are seeking exceptional talent to join their team.

Are you ready to make a significant impact on customer journeys and operational efficiency across global markets? This pivotal role offers the opportunity to not just analyze data, but to be instrumental in shaping strategy, enabling actionable insights, and establishing robust, AI-ready data foundations that scale across multiple regions. You will be at the heart of improving how this company measures and delivers customer success, directly influencing Customer Experience, Digital Experience, Service Delivery, and Supportability, all while working with groundbreaking AI-native analytics. Your contributions will directly enhance how customers interact with products and services, driving tangible improvements across the entire customer lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Build robust data foundations by collaborating with engineering to develop pipelines, enhance data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for international markets.Develop data capabilities that function consistently across multiple regions and countries, while adapting to specific local requirements (e.g., regulatory, language, or workflow differences).Automate recurring reporting and validation processes to boost accuracy and efficiency, ensuring data structures and taxonomies are optimized for downstream AI consumption and model-readiness.Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide comprehensive visibility into key performance metrics, designing reporting that connects metrics across the entire customer journey rather than in isolated silos.Deliver deep-dive analytics by conducting root cause analysis to uncover drivers of customer pain points, digital adoption challenges, and operational inefficiencies.Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations that improve customer journeys, optimize staffing and routing decisions, and reduce escalations.Advance AI-native analytics by leveraging Generative AI tools to automate recurring insight generation, support AI-powered summarization and anomaly detection, and identify opportunities to replace manual workflows with intelligent automation.Enable experimentation and continuous improvement by supporting A/B testing and digital experience evaluations, analyzing performance outcomes, and quantifying customer and business impact.Provide baseline metrics, monitor results, and deliver insights to scale successful initiatives, including evaluating the performance and customer impact of AI-assisted and digital experiences.Influence strategy through compelling storytelling, communicating insights and trends clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure alignment on decisions that enhance customer experience, digital adoption, operational performance, and supportability.

Required Skills & Experience

Solid experience in Data Analytics or Data Science, with ideal exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains.Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development.Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Qlik, or similar).Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes.Proven ability to communicate analytical findings in clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic priorities and tactical execution.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.Proactive and growth-oriented mindset, consistently identifying opportunities for innovation.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support.Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing).Machine learning and Generative AI experience.A genuine enthusiasm for Generative AI and a growth mindset toward how emerging tools can accelerate analytical work, actively curious about how LLMs, AI-native workflows, and intelligent automation can enhance impact.Hands-on experience applying Generative AI to analytics workflows (e.g., automated insight generation, AI-assisted analysis, or LLM-enhanced data pipelines).Experience working with call center and/or digital support KPIs.BS or MS in an appropriate quantitative field.

About Aquent Talent

Aquent Talent connects the best talent in marketing, creative, and design with the world’s biggest brands.

Our eligible talent get access to amazing benefits like subsidized health, vision, and dental plans, paid sick leave, and retirement plans with a match. We also offer free online training through Aquent Gymnasium. More information on our awesome benefits!

Aquent is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. We’re about creating an inclusive environment-one where different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are valued, and everyone can contribute, grow their careers, and thrive.

Client Description

Our Client is a global technology platform that specialises in overcoming the world’s most important financial challenges. Their products and services are driven by artificial intelligence, and their accounting software is one of their most recognisable creations. Considered one of the top companies to work for, they are proud of their company culture and entrepreneurial spirit.

Aquent is dedicated to improving inclusivity & is proudly an equal opportunities employer. We encourage applications from under-represented groups & are committed to providing support to applicants with disabilities. We aim to provide reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, to those with a medical condition, disability or neurodivergence.

Other Requirements

This is a 10-month hybrid contract, offering up to £217.09 per day (PAYE). Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by COB Monday, 7th September. Due to the number of applications, we’re unable to get back to each candidate individually.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis is growing its Digital Insights & Experience (DI&E) consulting capability and is looking for Data Analysts who are curious, analytically minded, and motivated to help organisations make better decisions through data‑driven insight.

DI&E brings together data analytics, insight generation and experience‑informed decision‑making to enable confident transformation in secure and regulated environments. Our Data Analysts work at the intersection of data, technology and business context—helping clients understand performance, identify opportunities, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insight.

We are building a multi‑disciplinary team of people from diverse backgrounds. You might be a data analyst, reporting specialist, BI developer, or an analytically‑minded consultant looking to deepen your technical capability while working in a consulting environment. We welcome adaptable problem‑solvers who want to apply analytics to real‑world challenges and continue to grow their careers.

When it comes to living your life, we want your role at AtkinsRéalis to be a meaningful part of your personal journey. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive team culture where people support, mentor and challenge one another. We succeed together, and our flexible and hybrid working practices are designed to support different priorities and ways of working.

Your role

As a Data Analyst within our Digital Insights & Experience and Secure Government business, you will help clients understand, improve and optimise their performance through data‑driven insight. You will work on a wide variety of analytics and transformation programmes across public and private sector environments, often within secure, regulated or complex organisational contexts. Opportunities may include overseas working where appropriate.

AtkinsRéalis provides significant investment in training and development. We want to help you grow as a data professional, strengthen your consulting capability, and build a sustainable and rewarding career.

The Role As a Data Analyst Will Involve

Working alongside AtkinsRéalis Technical Directors, Principals and multi‑disciplinary delivery teams to design and deliver data analytics and visualisation solutions for our clients.Working with clients to integrate data analytics best practices into their processes and decision‑making.Working with stakeholders to identify, define and deliver self‑service analytics solutions, dashboards and actionable reports that support decision‑making.Handling, merging, cleaning and transforming multi‑source data to enable robust analysis and insight generation.Effectively applying statistical investigation, data analysis and visualisation techniques to bring business problems to life and clearly communicate the 'so what' in data.Designing and implementing intuitive, consistent and user‑focused data visualisations across environments and formats.Working in agile delivery environments, including requirements gathering, user stories, prototyping, demonstrations and iterative feedback with end users.Working on projects end‑to‑end, from requirements definition through implementation, testing, documentation, end‑user training and handover to client teams.Collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders across a range of experience and seniority levels.Contributing to decision‑making that supports successful project delivery and measurable client outcomes.Working with peers to develop new analytics capabilities, solutions and methodologies to deliver to clients.Communicating and 'selling' analytical insight and solutions to peers and clients to drive understanding and adoption.Supporting the development of junior colleagues through mentoring and being open to line management responsibilities where appropriate.Continuously developing your data analysis and visualisation skills through formal training, mentoring and hands‑on delivery experience.Participating in external and internal activities related to your specialism, including client engagement, conferences, research and thought leadership.

About You

Professional experience working in a data analytics or related role, with opportunities available across a range of experience levels.Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insight.Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate widely, and communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences.Experience working in a project environment, including requirements gathering with business users and involvement in testing cycles such as unit testing, system testing and integration testing.A consultative mindset and strong commercial acumen, with the ability to articulate the value of analytics, the services we offer and the outcomes we can deliver.Experience using data visualisation tools, preferably Microsoft Power BI (or alternatives such as Tableau, Qlik or Looker).Experience with data transformation and modelling tools such as SQL, Python, DAX, Power Query, NoSQL, Azure Data Factory or similar technologies.Proven experience owning or contributing to end‑to‑end analytics solutions, including roadmap definition, documentation, training and handover.Confidence working in agile or iterative delivery environments.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including report writing and presentation of insights.Experience contributing to bids, proposals, value propositions or analytics solution development is desirable.Experience working with a range of data types (e.g. operational, security, network, AI or large‑scale data) is desirable.Experience creating or adapting data visualisations for different audiences and contexts is desirable.Experience mentoring or line managing junior colleagues is desirable.Experience implementing or supporting cloud‑native analytics solutions at scale is desirable.An appreciation of user interface tools and techniques is desirable.Experience working in defence, government, security, infrastructure or other regulated sectors is desirable.Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft) are desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.

Your background

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience.2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role.Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets.Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense.Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes.Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership.Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.

The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

rows.title: Smart Meter Reporting and Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Summary:

As a Smart Meter Reporting and Data Analyst, you will play a central role in driving the success of our Smart Metering project and hitting our PCD targets.

rows.title: AI Accelerator for Drug Discovery - Talent Pool
rows.descriptionText:
The AI Accelerator is a brand-new, London-based hub, within @computationalinnovation, comprising computational biology, human genetics, data and AI expertise. 

The purpose of the AI Accelerator is to provision production-quality, versatile, foundational biomedical AI capabilities that can be adapted and deployed to improve and accelerate portfolio decision-making, furthering understanding of the biology driving patient outcomes and identifying mechanisms that increase probability of success. 

To achieve this purpose, the AI Accelerator is organised around three key capabilities - AI Systems, focussing on neural methods, AI Reasoning, focussing on causality and knowing why, and AI Enablement, powering AI Systems and AI Reasoning with big data provisioning, MLOps and AI infrastructure. 

AI Systems will exploit neural-based methods to integrate data and impute and infer across the biomedical landscape. It could be electronic health records and medical imaging to support patient segmentation. It could be ‘omics data to understand gene regulation and identify novel therapeutic concepts; it could be predicting transcriptional change for a given disease-causing variant
AI Reasoning will supplement AI Systems by focussing on developing approaches to identify cause and effect, predict the outcome of an intervention, provide a rationale for a model decision. It could be providing causal structure to multi-omics data; it could be providing orthogonal rationale to a black-box model generated hypothesis; it could be identifying features that are driving model predictions. 
AI Enablement will support AI Systems and AI Reasoning by provisioning harmonised multimodal data for distributed training, managing the model lifecycle and partnering with the IT organisation to ensure AI Systems, AI Reasoning and downstream beneficiaries have the necessary infrastructure and tooling to prototype, implement, adapt and deploy AI capabilities to advance the portfolio



None of the above can be achieved without people. We are looking for AI scientists, machine learning engineers, research engineers, data engineers, MLOps engineers and AI infrastructure engineers from senior up to senior staff level and people leaders in AI science and engineering.
If you are passionate about using your talents to build state-of-the-art AI approaches that will advance the portfolio and skilled in the required disciplines, please register your interest. 

Apply Now to register interest by joining our AI Accelerator talent pool.

Please note that this is a talent community, not a particular recruitment process. There will be no follow up communication on this application. By applying you agree to being contacted by us, should there be a new opening in the future, matching your professional profile and/or interest in a particular position stated by you in your application form. Our Company Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com. Why Boehringer Ingelheim? With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations. Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Personal Profile

Analytical curiosity and problem-solving: able to explore data, ask the right questions and break ambiguous problems into clear analytical steps.Strong communication and influencing skills: able to explain insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders and tailor recommendations to the audience.Collaborative working style: confident working with others, building credibility with stakeholders and valuing different perspectives.Creative and commercial thinking: brings new ideas, shows interest in technology and focuses on delivering meaningful business value.Ownership and prioritisation: able to manage time effectively, work independently and communicate delivery timelines clearly.Growth mindset: motivated to keep developing technical, commercial and business knowledge, including new tools and analytical approaches.

rows.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.

Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

About The Role

DeepL is at an inflection point in its growth, and this is an opportunity to directly shape how the world's most accurate AI translation company acquires and converts customers through paid media. As Senior Performance Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and hands-on execution of DeepL's paid social and paid search programmes globally, driving efficient, measurable customer acquisition across SMB and enterprise segments.

This role sits within DeepL's Performance Marketing & Campaigns function and reports to the Director of Performance Marketing & Campaigns. It will work with cross-functional partners across Field, Lifecycle Marketing, SDR, Product Marketing and Marketing Data Science to scale DeepL's paid channels, and partner effectively with stakeholders running ABM programmes.

What You'll Own

Paid Social & Paid Search

Own and scale DeepL's paid social programmes across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X and other emerging channels, tailoring strategy, audiences and creative to each platform's strengths.Own and scale DeepL's paid search programmes across Google, Bing and other search engines, managing keyword strategy, bidding, ad copy and landing page alignment to maximise efficiency.Define and manage channel-level budget allocation, shifting spend in response to real-time performance signals to hit CAC, pipeline and ARR targets.Champion a culture of experimentation: design and run structured A/B tests across creative, audience, bidding strategy and landing experience, translating results into scalable playbooks.Stay ahead of platform changes, betas and new ad formats across social and search, evaluating and piloting new channels where they offer efficient acquisition.

Campaign Strategy & Execution

Develop and execute global paid social marketing strategies aligned with business objectives across multiple regions and products.Plan, launch, manage and optimise paid marketing campaigns across the full funnel, including demand generation, account-based marketing (ABM), product launches, webinars, events, partner marketing and brand campaigns.Manage campaign budgets, forecasting, pacing and spend allocation, ensuring efficient investment and continuous optimisation based on performance.Monitor, analyse and report on campaign performance, pipeline contribution, attribution, ROI and other key marketing KPIs, providing actionable insights and recommendations.Work cross-functionally with key stakeholders (e.g., Product Marketing, Sales, Marketing Operations, Brand, Creative, Regional Marketing) to align priorities, coordinate campaign execution and support business objectives.Drive continuous improvement through testing, experimentation, process optimisation, adoption of new advertising capabilities, and AI-driven marketing automation.

ABM Partnership

Bring a strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) principles and mindset to partner effectively with Sales, SDR and the marketing stakeholders who own ABM strategy..Contribute paid social and paid search expertise to ABM initiatives, executing tailored channel strategies, audiences and creative for prioritised accounts and account tiers as defined by ABM stakeholders.Feed paid media performance data, account engagement, pipeline influence and conversion, back to ABM stakeholders to inform targeting and strategy decisions.

Measurement & Optimisation

Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to establish rigorous measurement frameworks across conversion rates, pipeline contribution and ARR impact, using these insights to drive continuous optimisation.Own reporting and forecasting for paid social and paid search, ensuring leadership has clear visibility into spend, efficiency and pipeline contribution.Use AI-enabled tools to improve audience segmentation, creative testing, bid optimisation and workflow automation across paid channels.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Campaign Managers, Product Marketing, Field Marketing and SDRs to align paid social and paid search activity with integrated campaign programmes and GTM priorities.Agency/media partner management with clear briefs, KPI accountability, and budget efficiency.Serve as the paid social and paid search subject matter expert within the Performance Marketing & Campaigns team, sharing best practice and mentoring junior team members.Represent paid channel performance and investment rationale in relevant leadership and planning forums.

What You'll Bring

4-6 years of experience in performance marketing, with hands-on ownership of paid social and paid search programmes, ideally within B2B SaaS.Demonstrated success managing paid social campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit and X (or a similar mix), with a strong understanding of each platform's targeting, bidding and creative requirements.Strong hands-on experience with paid search platforms, including Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing), across search, display and remarketing.Very good understanding of account-based marketing (ABM) principles and mindset — comfortable partnering with Sales and marketing stakeholders on account targeting, tiering and personalised campaign strategies, without needing to own or build the ABM programme itself.Comfort operating in both self-serve and enterprise-assisted sales environments, with an understanding of the B2B buying cycle.Strong analytical skills: comfortable defining KPIs, building dashboards, and using data to inform budget allocation and channel strategy.Experience leveraging AI tools to improve campaign efficiency — for example in audience segmentation, creative generation, bid optimisation or reporting automation.Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple channels and campaigns simultaneously without losing attention to detail.A proactive, test-and-learn mindset, with genuine enthusiasm for getting into the detail of platform mechanics and performance data.

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

rows.title: Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The One Nine Three GroupThe One Nine Three Group (193) is a boutique advisory firm that protects and strengthens the reputations of businesses and their leaders. Our clients include some of the world’s most recognised organisations across a variety of sectors. 193 is wholly owned by its founders, Zach Siegel and Matthew Freud.
Since our founding in 2019, 193 has earned recognition as a leading reputation management adviser, known for our expertise in corporate and financial communications. We're now entering our next phase of growth and building the right team to match our ambitions. 
193 sits within the Freuds Group building on Stephen Street in London, exposing our team to some of the world's most creative consumer, technology, sport, and lifestyle communications specialists, with an art collection to match, every day. Our New York office sits on Manhattan’s fabled Madison Avenue, surrounded by many of the world’s leading financial institutions, businesses and media organisations, some of whom we are proud to call our clients.
193 is part of Freuds Group, an affiliation of strategy, creative, and content agencies founded by Matthew Freud in 1985.
Position Summary193 recently launched an intelligence function that will be staffed by a newly created Analyst role. The Analyst determines what is moving markets and why, then turns that into potential opportunities and identified emerging risks for our clients. The new function will also support day-to-day client work, new business mapping, and analysis for the team.
Each Analyst will be responsible for a portfolio of target sectors and companies, and prepare briefings on what is likely to move markets and why, what is as actionable for clients, and where risks may be emerging . The remit will span financial markets, politics, regulation, and consumer and social trends, with the best Analysts able to connect the dots across them.
Training will be provided, making this role a natural first step for those coming from graduate programmes or master’s degrees. Responsibility will start from day one: what an Analyst identifies, and how they frame it, will directly inform the advice 193 gives some of the world's most recognised businesses and largest pools of private capital.
ResponsibilitiesResearch a portfolio of companies, sectors, competitors, and stakeholders relevant to client accounts and 193 activities.Monitor financial markets, business news, politics, regulation, and consumer and social trends, and identify what connects them for clients.Lead daily briefings for client teams covering what is moving the market and why, what qualifies as actionable intelligence for clients, and what looks like an emerging risk to clients.Build and maintain systems for tracking relevant news and information, using AI tools where appropriate.Use 193's data tools to assess corporate reputation and flag reputational and regulatory risks facing clients early.Produce peer analysis and other research to support investor relations assignments.Contribute research to new business pitches and other firmwide projects.
QualificationsExperience or education in analytics, business, politics, international affairs, languages, psychology, or a comparable field, with training provided to bridge into financial communications.A dynamic thinker who spots patterns as they emerge and turns them into intelligence our clients and our business can use.Knowledge of business, financial markets, politics, and current events, and a genuine interest in corporate affairs and business decision making.Strong research and analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication.Comfort using AI tools for research and analysis, and an appetite for learning new technologies and proprietary tools.Strong organisation and attention to detail across multiple accounts and deadlines.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

OUR IMPACT

Across Asset Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking, and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our direct-to-consumer business provides digital solutions that help customers save and invest. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data, and design.

Marcus by Goldman Sachs 

As the online consumer banking business of Goldman Sachs, Marcus operates as a digital bank, providing online savings products directly to individual consumers. Marcus combines Goldman Sachs' over 150 years of expertise with intuitive digital experiences, focusing on value, transparency, and simplicity for its millions of customers.

The Role

We’re seeking an enthusiastic, proactive and highly motivated Research Manager to join the research team in our London office. Reporting to the Research and Insights Lead, this role will manage a broad programme of market and consumer research across multiple markets, delivering high-quality insight that informs customer, product, brand and communications decisions. The successful candidate will combine strong qualitative and quantitative research expertise with excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills, translating evidence into clear, actionable recommendations for the business.

Responsibilities

Manage the NPS programme, reporting opportunities to improve the customer experiencesLead the brand tracking programme across relevant markets, monitoring performance over time and translating findings into clear implications for the business.Lead research supporting Consumer Duty requirements, including UX research, journey testing and communications testing to assess customer understanding and outcomes.Manage Marcus Community, the internal research panel, including participant recruitment and engagement, research activity design, fieldwork and analysis.Own and manage an evolving research calendar across multiple markets and concurrent projects, prioritising activity in line with business needs.Lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research, from scoping business questions and selecting appropriate methodologies & agencies through to fieldwork, analysis and reporting.Deliver a varied portfolio of research, including product concept testing, customer journey and UX research, proposition development, communications testing and marketing creative testing.Present clear, actionable insights and recommendations to key business stakeholders, ensuring the customer voice informs strategic and commercial decision-making.

Experience And Skills

At least five years’ experience in market or consumer research, with a strong understanding of qualitative and quantitative methodologies.Experience working within a research agency is preferable but not essential.Proven experience working with a broad range of senior and cross-functional stakeholders, with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions.Strong analytical skills and the ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative evidence into clear, commercially relevant insights and recommendations.Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to different audiences.Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Experience using survey platforms and analysing data in Excel or similar tools is desirable.

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.

Our TeamThe Marketing & Commercial Strategy (MACS) Team is the central commercial engine of MVF, bridging the gap between Sales, Marketing, and Technology teams to implement the overarching business strategy in real-time.
We take a data-led, collaborative, and solutions-focused approach to optimise portfolio performance, nurture customer acquisition, and maximise client satisfaction.
Our shared goal is to identify high-impact opportunities for commercial growth, support new product delivery, and spotlight long-term strategies that scale MVF and clients up efficiently and profitably.

rows.title: Associate Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
ClarusONE Sourcing Services, LLP, provides strategic generic pharmaceutical services for both Walmart Stores, Inc. and McKesson Corporation. Its’ mission is to enable access to affordable medicines, which it has successfully been doing since its inception in 2016.

ClarusONE is a joint venture between Walmart and McKesson, two of the top 10 biggest corporations in the USA, according to the Fortune 500 list. They have more than two decades of history working together to improve the quality and lower the cost of pharmaceutical care to patients. This partnership leverages McKesson’s demonstrated strength and expertise in global pharmaceutical sourcing in conjunction with Walmart’s strength and commitment to delivering leading health and wellness services to their customers.

ClarusONE Sourcing Services is headquartered in London and prides itself on its can-do attitude that has ensured millions of Americans pay less when buying generic pharmaceuticals every day.

About the Role: 

The Associate Pricing Analyst will support the Pricing & Commercial Operations Lead and act as a central analytical and commercial resource for pricing across the Sourcing organisation. The role will combine accurate execution of pricing activity with proactive identification, analysis and delivery of pricing opportunities across suppliers, products and sourcing programmes.

The Pricing Analyst will evaluate supplier pricing behaviour, market dynamics, pricing-rule adherence and member economics to identify commercial risks and value opportunities. The role will develop fact-based supplier negotiation strategies, lead defined pricing discussions within agreed authority levels, and support broader initiatives to strengthen pricing consistency, supplier accountability and commercial outcomes.

The position will also contribute to the continued development of ClarusONE’s pricing framework, analytics capabilities and supplier-management approach, helping ensure that pricing rules remain commercially effective, operationally practical and aligned with member objectives.

What You'll Do: 

Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders to support commercial objectives.Prepare negotiation strategies through analysis of historical pricing, market intelligence, supplier performance, and commercial benchmarks.Conduct detailed pricing, spend, and market analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities, commercial risks, and value creation initiatives.Monitor supplier pricing trends, market dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitive movements to support sourcing and procurement strategies.Develop analytical models and reporting to assess pricing performance, supplier behaviour, and category-level opportunities.Own or support cross-functional pricing projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, implementation and benefit tracking.Develop regular reporting that distinguishes submitted activity from value influenced or delivered by the pricing function.Produce regular reporting on pricing trends, savings delivery, supplier performance, and procurement initiatives.Measure and communicate the financial impact of projects, negotiations, and process improvements.Develop supplier scorecards and performance metrics to evaluate commercial performance, responsiveness, reliability, and compliance.Monitor supplier activity and identify indicators of commercial risk, value leakage, or performance concerns.


Basic Requirements:

Typically, minimum 0-2 years of relevant experience. May have degree or equivalent.Experience in pricing, commercial analytics, strategic sourcing, finance and/or supplier management.Demonstrated ability to convert complex datasets into commercial actions and recommendations.Experience preparing for or participating in supplier or customer negotiations.Experience assessing financial impact, constructing commercial scenarios and tracking realised value.Pharmaceutical, healthcare distribution, procurement or generic-drug market experience preferred.Experience delivering analytical or process-improvement projects across multiple function.


Preferred Skills/Experience: 

Strong commercial judgement and ability to recognise value opportunities beyond basic rule compliance.Advanced Excel capability and working knowledge of BI, dashboarding or analytical tools.Ability to analyse pricing at product, family, supplier and portfolio levels.Confident presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.Effective negotiation, influencing and challenge skills.Ability to operate within legal, contractual and confidentiality guardrails when providing supplier pricing guidance. Existing guidance materials specifically emphasise avoiding disclosure of one supplier’s pricing or how guidance was derived.Ability to balance member economics, sourcing strategy, supplier relationships, compliance and operational feasibility.Strong project management skills, including ownership of milestones, risks, benefits and stakeholder actions.


Physical Requirements: 

This is a Hybrid role in London, GBR. Candidate will be required to be onsite 2 days per week. This role is Fixed Term (12 months). 


McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com.

 Analyze financial data and trends to drive cost optimization and operational efficiency Develop financial reports, forecasts, and KPI dashboards to support strategic decision-making Perform financial assessments that inform business solutions and enhance customer value Implement process automation and data quality improvements Collaborate with stakeholders across teams while building your professional network

A day in the life

rows.title: Graduate data scientist
rows.descriptionText:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesDesign and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing Machine Learning & AI at Trainline 👋

Machine learning and AI are at the core of how Trainline is transforming travel, helping millions of customers make smarter, more sustainable journeys every day. Our ML models and AI solutions power critical aspects of our platform, including advanced search and recommendations across our mobile and web applications, pricing and routing optimisation, personalised experiences enhanced by agentic AI, data-driven marketing systems, and AI agents that improve customer support. Our machine learning teams own the complete delivery lifecycle from ideation to production, working closely with stakeholders across the business to expand the understanding and impact of machine learning and AI throughout Trainline.

We are looking for a Junior Machine Learning Engineer to join a high-performing, deeply technical community of Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists and Data Engineers who tackle complex problems by combining Trainline's rich datasets with cutting-edge algorithms. You will be supported to grow your skills through hands-on project work, close collaboration with more experienced colleagues, and a genuine culture of learning and development, while contributing to large-scale production systems that make a real difference to millions of customers.

In this role as the Junior Machine Learning Engineer, you will...🚄

Work within cross-functional teams alongside data scientists, software engineers, data engineers and product managersSupport the design and delivery of machine learning models and AI solutions that contribute to measurable impact for TrainlineGet involved across the machine learning delivery lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, model selection and evaluationCollaborate with stakeholders to help shape data products that make good use of Trainline's extensive datasetsContribute to the tools, frameworks and libraries that help accelerate our ML and AI delivery and improve our workflowsTake part in our AI and ML community, sharing learning and building your experimentation skills alongside others

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

A good working knowledge of Python, including open-source data libraries such as Pandas, NumPy or Scikit-learnA background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a similar quantitative discipline, whether through study or practical experienceSome exposure to building or supporting machine learning models or AI solutions, gained through study, projects or early career experienceAn interest in areas such as predictive modelling, classification, regression, optimisation, NLP or recommendation systemsA curious, collaborative approach and strong communication skills, with an eagerness to learn from othersIt would be helpful if you have had some exposure to Spark or similar data processing toolsYou may also have some familiarity with DevOps or MLOps tools such as Docker, Terraform or MLflowIdeally, you will have an interest in agile ways of working and CI/CD practices, though this is not essential

More Information

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our Values Represent The Things That Matter Most To Us And What We Live And Breathe Everyday, In Everything We Do

💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!
