rows.descriptionText:
Choose Wisely, Apply Confidently

To maximise your opportunities at securing an Industrial Placement with us this year, we strongly advise that you apply to no more than 3 adverts. (For clarity, multiple roles within a single advert are considered one application.)

We encourage you to concentrate your efforts on the roles that best align with your skills, interests and university experience, as this will strengthen your application and give you the best chance of success.

Roles Available in Locations: GSK HQ London

Education required: See individual roles for degree requirements

Please read the degree requirements for each role carefully before applying.

Other requirements: You will have completed a minimum of 2 years of your undergraduate degree but will not have graduated at the start of your placement. You must be enrolled at a UK (United Kingdom) or ROI (Republic of Ireland) University for the duration of your placement.

Pre-application activity: Before applying, you'll need to obtain an application code by completing a short activity in Connectr, our candidate engagement platform.

This activity is designed to encourage considered applications. Once completed, you'll receive your unique application code required to proceed with your application.

If you have already graduated with a Bachelor’s Degree and are currently studying a postgraduate Masters, you are not eligible for this programme.

Language requirement: Written and spoken fluency in English

Expected Start date: September 2027

Duration: 1 year (approximately)

Salary: A salary of £28,900 (London) plus a bonus.

Workplace Arrangements: Flexible working via performance with choice (office & home working may be available)

Application Closing: Roles are expected to close on 13/10/2026, however, candidates will be reviewed regularly, and the advert may close at any point. Please ensure you review and complete the application stages below.

Are you looking to gain valuable real world work experience and help positively impact the lives of others? 

A GSK internship offers you the opportunity to kickstart your career – to take on a real role with genuine impact. You’ll take on challenging tasks within live projects or assignments. You’ll also get to learn from others in your team and other parts of GSK whilst developing your skills and gaining valuable experience for wherever the future takes you.

What do we offer you? 

A competitive salary, with an annual bonus based on company performance.Employee recognition programs, which reward exceptional achievements.Access to our cutting-edge wellbeing platform: personalise your experience, help reduce stress, increase focus, build connections and resilience. You will also have access to a confidential helpline 24/7, mindfulness, health screenings and financial wellbeing support. Access to Private Healthcare Insurance, including 24-hour access to an online GP.Optional Support: Includes identity protection, long-term care insurance, home, auto, and pet insuranceOpportunities to work with Employee Resource Groups, providing opportunities to network, gain mentorship, and develop personally and professionally.Access to IPUnite which is a community of Early Careers programme participants offering development, networking and social connections to help you make the best of your programme. You will also be invited to join LinkedIn groups and pre-joining webinars, to enable you to connect and network with new students.2 volunteering days per year

Typical skills you can expect to learn on this placement will include:

Teamworking through working with multidisciplinary teamsCommunication (written & verbal)Time managementProblem-solvingNetworkingData analysis and managementTechnical skills (detailed within each role description)

The Roles (3 available)

This advert contains multiple roles. Please read each role carefully before proceeding as you will be asked to provide a preference later in the application process.

Role 1 – Biostatistics & Data Science -  GSK HQ London

Degree requirements: Mathematics / Statistics / Data Sciences BSc

Overview Of The Department

Respiratory, Immunology and Inflammation (RII) Biostatistics is part of the RII Research Unit (RIIRU), a department focused on developing innovative medicines for respiratory, immune and inflammatory diseases. RII statisticians play a key role throughout the research and development of the drug pipeline, working closely with scientists, clinicians in areas such as medicine discovery, clinical trial design and statistical analysis. We provide statistical expertise in the design of studies and clinical trials (e.g. sample size determination and randomisation strategies), as well as the performing analysis and providing interpretation of data.

Key Placement Activities

Support professional statisticians in the design of studies and clinical trials (e.g. sample size determination and randomisation).Work with professional statisticians in preparing statistical analysis plans, model development, output QC, and the communication of results.Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, clinicians).Develop statistical programming skills in R and other software.Develop an understanding of statistical methods used throughout drug development.Learn and apply statistical methods through project work and internal training on advanced topics e.g. Quantitative Decision Making, Bayesian Dynamic Borrowing, Dose Response Modelling, etc.

Role 2 - Clinical Programming and Business Excellence -  GSK HQ London

Degree requirements - Preferably Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a Science/Technology related discipline.

Overview of the Department

Clinical Programming play a critical role within the Biostatistics department. We support clinical research teams by performing programming and validation of datasets and outputs for the analysis and reporting of clinical trial data. Meanwhile ensuring data quality, accuracy and adherence to data standards and regulatory requirements. Clinical Programming collaborate closely with cross-functional teams such as Statistics, Data Management and Clinical teams to ensure data is fit for purpose and meets requirements for study analysis and reporting. This placement year will provide you with exposure to industry-standard tools, methodologies, and regulatory requirements while contributing to the advancement of life-changing therapies. You will gain an insight into cutting-edge clinical research and the development processes, with the opportunity to learn from and network with experienced professionals within GSK.

Key Placement Learnings

Collaborate with statisticians and fellow professional programmers as part of a study team to develop datasets, tables, listings and figures to aid clinical trial reporting.Participate in programming activities for clinical trial reporting using SAS and/or R programming languages, whilst adhering to data standards and regulatory requirements.Conduct quality control checks on clinical trial data and outputs, identifying and resolving discrepancies or issues where possible and flagging data issues to necessary stakeholders.Assist in the preparation of standard documentation, including dataset specifications and reviewer guides.Opportunities to be involved in and contribute to other non-project initiatives within GSK, contributing towards development of the Biostatistics department.

Role 3 - Quantitative Sciences Innovation – GSK HQ London

Degree requirements - Mathematics, Statistics, Data Sciences

Overview of the Department

This is an exciting opportunity to join GSK and gain exposure for innovation in the field of Statistics and Data Science to help transform the way in which we use data and quantitative thinking to drive decision-making in R&D. We are growing our cutting-edge statistical innovation and data science capabilities by expanding the Quantitative Sciences Innovation (QSI) group led by Nicky Best. QSI is a methodologically focused, solution-oriented functional group within GSK’s Biostatistics department.

Key Placement Learnings

Collaborate with your team to develop and explore novel methods for handling prediction problemsGain hands on coding experience developing Machine Learning and prediction modelling pipelinesUnderstand the background and statistical methods important for drug developmentProvide analysis, reporting and interpretation of modelling projectsWork in close consultation with professional methodologists and scientists working in medicine and vaccine developmentBecome proficient in R programming and Python. Leverage version control through GitHub to enable collaborationDevelop new skills working in an ‘agile’ way delivering on projects over short ‘sprints’Learn the theory of new statistical and machine learning methodologies and how to apply it by collaborating with highly skilled statisticians and attending training coursesExperience the role of a statistical consultant, working closely with cross-functional teams to translate scientific or clinical problems into statistical onesGain industry knowledge in potentially a wide range of therapeutic areas, overseeing short-term or long-term projects that cover multiple GSK drugs

Apply now!

These placement opportunities have the following recruitment stages – you must successfully pass each stage to be offered a placement year with GSK for 2027:

 Complete Connectr activity – obtain your personal code - please follow this link to complete Eligibility Form – enter your personal code GSK Digital Assessment Some technical roles may require a short technical assessment Virtual Assessment Centre or Virtual Interview

Note: Your Connectr application code is unique and must not be shared. Using someone else's code, or sharing your own, may result in your application being withdrawn.

You can find hints and tips on our recruitment process and get guidance from real GSK mentors on our Early Careers Hub here.

We’re 100% open to all talent. We want to recruit the right people for GSK from the widest possible backgrounds, so we can better serve the inclusion of our patients and because it’s the right thing to do. You can learn more about Inclusion at GSK here.

For more information about GSK and our careers please visit our website here.

Need help with your application? Please email us at UK.InternRecruitment@gsk.com or call us on 01582 692870 and let us know how we can help you.

#Internships #UKEarlyCareers #GSKIndustrialPlacements #GSKResearch&Development #GSKSTEMPlacements #GSKLondon

Applied Statistics, Data Analysis, Data Engineering, Data Science, Datasets, Drug Development, Drug Discovery Process, Drug Target Identification, Genetic Analysis, Genomic Analysis, Machine Learning (ML), Software Engineering

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law.

Role 1 - Business Performance & Operations

Workplace Arrangements - Flexible working via performance with choice (office & home working may be available)

Overview of the Department

The DGSC's mission is to transform data into decisive actions that shapes the future of patient care. To achieve this, DGSC focuses on four strategic objectives. First, Differentiate Asset Value (Evidence Generation) by producing timely and meaningful data that enable confident, high-impact decisions. Second, Strengthen Scientific Advocacy (Scientific Communications) through personalized engagement, leveraging data-driven and insight-rich narratives and content to enhance the impact of scientific communications. Third, Inspire Trust in Content (Medical Information and Content Approval) by building credibility and ensuring integrity through transparent and compliant content. Finally, Drive Medical Impact (Operations) by streamlining processes and adopting smart, tech-enabled ways of working to unlock efficiency and maximize impact. Together, these objectives ensure DGSC delivers on its mission to improve patient care through data-driven innovation.

Key Placement Learnings

Develop strategic materials, including the Data Generation and Scientific Communications (DGSC) objectives and performance targets.Support performance management and reporting demonstrating transformational progress and impact.Build and manage an internal communications and engagement plan to support DGSC delivering with impact and sustaining performance.Co-ordinate and/or deliver communications and engagement activities and events.Support operational excellence through streamlining processes including through smart, tech-enabled ways of working.Effective communication in a business context, including structuring materials that engage the audience and convey a compelling narrative.Translating strategy into action and performance.Matrix stakeholder management.

The Supported Studies department partners across therapy areas and functions to operationalize externally supported research as part of an integrated study team. Through close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, the team enables evidence generation that supports scientific understanding, informs future treatment approaches, and ultimately helps improve outcomes for patients.

The Industrial Placement Student will support medical content creation and review in Oncology/Specialty therapy area and strategic projects across Medical Information, Content Governance, Operational Excellence, and Digital Transformation while gaining exposure to a broad network of stakeholders across GSK.

Overview

AtkinsRéalis is growing its Digital Insights & Experience (DI&E) consulting capability and is looking for Data Analysts who are curious, analytically minded, and motivated to help organisations make better decisions through data‑driven insight.

DI&E brings together data analytics, insight generation and experience‑informed decision‑making to enable confident transformation in secure and regulated environments. Our Data Analysts work at the intersection of data, technology and business context—helping clients understand performance, identify opportunities, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insight.

We are building a multi‑disciplinary team of people from diverse backgrounds. You might be a data analyst, reporting specialist, BI developer, or an analytically‑minded consultant looking to deepen your technical capability while working in a consulting environment. We welcome adaptable problem‑solvers who want to apply analytics to real‑world challenges and continue to grow their careers.

When it comes to living your life, we want your role at AtkinsRéalis to be a meaningful part of your personal journey. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive team culture where people support, mentor and challenge one another. We succeed together, and our flexible and hybrid working practices are designed to support different priorities and ways of working.

Your role

As a Data Analyst within our Digital Insights & Experience and Secure Government business, you will help clients understand, improve and optimise their performance through data‑driven insight. You will work on a wide variety of analytics and transformation programmes across public and private sector environments, often within secure, regulated or complex organisational contexts. Opportunities may include overseas working where appropriate.

AtkinsRéalis provides significant investment in training and development. We want to help you grow as a data professional, strengthen your consulting capability, and build a sustainable and rewarding career.

The Role As a Data Analyst Will Involve

Working alongside AtkinsRéalis Technical Directors, Principals and multi‑disciplinary delivery teams to design and deliver data analytics and visualisation solutions for our clients.Working with clients to integrate data analytics best practices into their processes and decision‑making.Working with stakeholders to identify, define and deliver self‑service analytics solutions, dashboards and actionable reports that support decision‑making.Handling, merging, cleaning and transforming multi‑source data to enable robust analysis and insight generation.Effectively applying statistical investigation, data analysis and visualisation techniques to bring business problems to life and clearly communicate the 'so what' in data.Designing and implementing intuitive, consistent and user‑focused data visualisations across environments and formats.Working in agile delivery environments, including requirements gathering, user stories, prototyping, demonstrations and iterative feedback with end users.Working on projects end‑to‑end, from requirements definition through implementation, testing, documentation, end‑user training and handover to client teams.Collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders across a range of experience and seniority levels.Contributing to decision‑making that supports successful project delivery and measurable client outcomes.Working with peers to develop new analytics capabilities, solutions and methodologies to deliver to clients.Communicating and 'selling' analytical insight and solutions to peers and clients to drive understanding and adoption.Supporting the development of junior colleagues through mentoring and being open to line management responsibilities where appropriate.Continuously developing your data analysis and visualisation skills through formal training, mentoring and hands‑on delivery experience.Participating in external and internal activities related to your specialism, including client engagement, conferences, research and thought leadership.

About You

Professional experience working in a data analytics or related role, with opportunities available across a range of experience levels.Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insight.Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate widely, and communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences.Experience working in a project environment, including requirements gathering with business users and involvement in testing cycles such as unit testing, system testing and integration testing.A consultative mindset and strong commercial acumen, with the ability to articulate the value of analytics, the services we offer and the outcomes we can deliver.Experience using data visualisation tools, preferably Microsoft Power BI (or alternatives such as Tableau, Qlik or Looker).Experience with data transformation and modelling tools such as SQL, Python, DAX, Power Query, NoSQL, Azure Data Factory or similar technologies.Proven experience owning or contributing to end‑to‑end analytics solutions, including roadmap definition, documentation, training and handover.Confidence working in agile or iterative delivery environments.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including report writing and presentation of insights.Experience contributing to bids, proposals, value propositions or analytics solution development is desirable.Experience working with a range of data types (e.g. operational, security, network, AI or large‑scale data) is desirable.Experience creating or adapting data visualisations for different audiences and contexts is desirable.Experience mentoring or line managing junior colleagues is desirable.Experience implementing or supporting cloud‑native analytics solutions at scale is desirable.An appreciation of user interface tools and techniques is desirable.Experience working in defence, government, security, infrastructure or other regulated sectors is desirable.Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft) are desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability.

rows.title: AI & Data Strategy Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Lodha UK
Lodha UK established its London presence in 2013-2014 and has since become one of the capital's most active prime and super-prime residential developers, with a combined portfolio in excess of £2 billion of gross development value across Central London. Its landmark schemes include No. 1 Grosvenor Square in Mayfair, Lincoln Square on the edge of Covent Garden, and Holland Park Gate in Kensington. Lodha UK is known for collaborating with some of the world's most distinguished architects and designers - including Patricia Urquiola, Yabu Pushelberg and Piero Lissoni - and for pairing outstanding design with the bespoke residential services of its in-house hospitality group, Lodha Hospitality. Lodha UK is underway with its fourth development in Belgravia. The business operates an integrated, in-house model spanning land acquisition, planning, design, development management, construction oversight, procurement, and sales and marketing - creating exceptional homes in highly desirable locations, which Lodha then develops, manages and operates through its dedicated in-house teams. Lodha UK also operates Lodha Partners, a dedicated advisory arm serving ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) private clients, bringing the same rigour and discretion the Group applies to real estate into personal wealth, investment and lifestyle advisory services.
Role Purpose
Lodha UK spans both the development business and Lodha Partners, its UHNW advisory arm. Within the real estate business, the ambition is to become the most AI-adopted developer in the market - every person in the top 5% of their peer group for AI usage in their role. That means reimagining how workflows are done in the first place, not just layering AI onto them incrementally. A sales lead intelligence pilot is due to launch as an early initiative, with more to follow as further opportunities are identified. This is a deliberately early-stage, fast-moving programme, built and run directly by the COO, Lodha Partners and the Co-CEO, LDUK, rather than through a formal committee. The AI & Data Strategy Analyst will work closely with them across the programme - helping shape the approach as much as execute against it.
Key Responsibilities
AI Adoption & Programme DeliverySupport and drive AI adoption across Lodha UK, working closely with the COO, Lodha Partners and the Co-CEO, LDUK to ensure every person in Lodha UK is, in time, in the top 5% of their peer group for AI usage in their role.Identify opportunities to apply AI by reimagining workflows end-to-end, rather than applying AI incrementally to how things are done today.Support teams across the business in implementing those initiatives, from first pilot through to embedded, everyday use.Identify and introduce relevant AI tools.
Data Capture & StructuringContribute to the firm's data capture and structuring efforts, supporting the build of the internal meeting/voice-intelligence workflow.Organise captured data into a single, reliable source of truth (e.g. Notion).
Analysis & BriefingPrepare clear analysis, workflow documentation and briefing materials (shortlists, usage surveys, briefing papers) to support decisions by the COO, Lodha Partners, the Co-CEO, LDUK and senior leadership.
Candidate Profile
Essential: An MBA graduate (or final-year MBA candidate), or an early-career professional with a management consulting, strategy or Big 4 advisory background, with a genuine, hands-on curiosity about applying AI to real commercial workflows rather than a purely theoretical interest.Essential: A consulting-style toolkit - structuring ambiguous problems, synthesising messy inputs into crisp, decision-ready recommendations, and communicating confidently with senior stakeholders.Essential: Comfortable working hands-on with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and confident picking up new ones quickly.Essential: Strong analytical rigour and attention to detail, with the ability to work through messy, unstructured data (spreadsheets, mailboxes, CRM records) and distil it into clear, decision-ready outputs.Essential: Available to start at short notice and commit to a 6–9 month term, full-time in Central London.Essential: Discreet and comfortable handling sensitive, confidential UHNW client data with sound judgement.Essential: Intelligent, personable, proactive and comfortable working at pace across multiple, still-forming workstreams with a degree of ambiguity.Desirable: Some exposure to Excel-based data analysis and, ideally, basic scripting or API work (e.g. Python).

location.linkedinText: City Of London, England, United Kingdom

rows.descriptionText:
Job Introduction

Salary: £41,267.45 per annum with yearly increments based on performance

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: Any of the main Hubs: London, Birmingham, Manchester, Leeds or Cardiff. An additional London Allowance of £4,775.00 payable to London based candidates only.

Type of Working Arrangement: Blended approach of home and office-working is available

Hours: This is full-time role (37 hours per week)

British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. Our values are simply: We Care, We Do the Right Thing, We Strive to Be Better Every Day, We Are One BTP, and We Are Proud to Protect. Join us and help create an environment where we can all be our best every day.

The Opportunity

British Transport Police has an exciting opportunity for an NDFU Insight Analyst to join the National Disruption Fusion Unit (NDFU). 

As an NDFU Insight Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex data into meaningful insight that helps reduce disruption, improve safety, and support informed decision-making across the railway network. Working as a multi-disciplinary analytical specialist, you will combine intelligence analysis, performance analysis, and data science techniques to develop innovative tactical and strategic products for a wide range of stakeholders.

Using cutting-edge analytical methods and technologies, you will identify emerging trends, uncover opportunities for improvement, and provide evidence-based recommendations that help prevent major disruption events before they occur. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a nationally important function, working at the forefront of analytical innovation to help keep Britain's railways safe, efficient, and moving.

What You'll Be Doing

Designing and delivering innovative national insight products and reports that support decision-making across British Transport Police, Network Rail, and wider industry partners.Analysing complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that help reduce disruption, improve railway safety, and enhance network performance.Developing and maintaining interactive dashboards and reporting solutions, including Power BI products, to enable stakeholder self-service and increase automation.Producing high-quality analytical reports with clear findings, evidence-based recommendations, and practical solutions for operational and strategic challenges.Presenting analytical insights to senior leaders and industry stakeholders, translating complex information into concise, impactful briefings and recommendations.Monitoring emerging trends and conducting horizon scanning to identify potential future risks, support continuous improvement, and help prevent major disruption events before they occur.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Educated to degree level in a relevant discipline, or able to demonstrate equivalent professional experience.Proven experience conducting research and analysis, including interpreting complex information and producing insightful reports and recommendations.Experience managing and analysing large data sets, using analytical tools and Microsoft applications, particularly Excel and Power BI.Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, solve problems, and develop innovative evidence-based solutions.Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and accessible manner.Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs to demanding deadlines.

Additional Information

The NDFU are a national, pan-industry unit. Therefore, there is requirement to travel to both BTP and NR sites across the country on a regular basis.

Further information about this vacancy can be found in the attached job description.

What We Offer

28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days after 5 years.Family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave.Bespoke benefits platform and Blue Light Card access.Salary sacrifice options for cycles, home technology, gym membership, and electric vehicles.Interest-free annual rail season ticket loan after 6 months.Access to the Transport Benevolent Fund for health, welfare, and financial support.Development opportunities, including fully funded apprenticeships.Excellent Pension scheme: We offer the BTP GPP Police Staff Pension Scheme, administered by Royal London. This group personal pension plan is available to all police staff and is a defined contribution scheme. It provides the flexibility to vary your pension contributions from 4.4% to 12% of your salary. For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk. Note: If you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS, your pension will not be affected.

How To Apply

Applications will be via an up-to-date CV and online application form, as part of this application please outline how your skills and experience demonstrate your suitability for the role.

Completed applications must be submitted by 11.59pm, 7 October 2026

Vetting: Successful applicants will be required to pass Management Vetting (5 years minimum UK residency required), including a full background and financial disclosure. For more information and Top Tips, please see attached document.

Medical: We’ll ask for relevant health and medical history details to support employee wellbeing.

References: We'll ask for references to cover the past 5 years.

Inclusion & Diversity

We are committed to building a workforce where everyone feels they belong. 

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences. Diversity strengthens our teams, improves our services and helps us better represent and support the communities we serve.

We are proud to be an inclusive employer and strive to create a workplace that is fair, respectful and accessible to all. We actively work to challenge discrimination, remove barriers and ensure equity throughout our recruitment and employment practices.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or selection process, please let us know - we are happy to support you. Your talent, your potential, and your unique perspective matter here.

For more information on Inclusion or the Disability Confident Scheme, please click the links Inclusion & Diversity Disability Confident Scheme

Join Us

Ready to take the next step in your career? At BTP, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, make a real impact, and be part of something extraordinary.

Find out why BTP could be the perfect fit for you - About Us - British Transport Police

Curious about what life at BTP is really like? Hear directly from our people and discover what makes working here so rewarding. Explore real stories on our blog: Our Stories - British Transport Police

For further information, please contact our Resourcing Team -RecruitmentTeam@btp.police.uk.

AI can be a useful tool to spark ideas or help you organise your thoughts, but when it comes to your application, we want to hear from you, not an algorithm. What truly stands out to us are genuine stories, personal insights and the experiences that have shaped who you are. Authenticity matters - it helps us understand your motivations, your strengths and how you’ll contribute to our team. So, use AI if it helps you get started, but let your own voice lead the way.

rows.descriptionText:

Location: Hybrid - 3 days per week Clapham Junction

This is a genuine opportunity to work across the full breadth of a fast-moving consumer business - from gym trading performance and location strategy through to product and customer behaviour - and to produce analysis that directly shapes how The Gym Group grows. If you have around two years of analytics experience and you are ready to take on more ownership, work with senior stakeholders and build your commercial instincts, this role has a lot to offer.

Who We Are

We're not like any other gym company; we are The Gym Group, a place where you can #BeYouWithUs and perform to your absolute best. We are successful; by membership we're the 2nd largest gym business in the UK and the 4th largest in Europe. We hire people with real passion, positivity and enthusiasm which motivates and inspire those around them. We actively invest in our employees; it's so important to us that our people can thrive in our environment and can make the most of the flexibility and support we offer to all of our teams.

Analysing trading performance across our gym estate and surfacing insights that help the business act quickly and confidentlySupporting member acquisition and retention analysis, helping the business understand what drives membership growth and how to reduce churnWorking with our Property team to analyse location performance and inform decisions about where we open and investEvaluating product performance and member behaviour to help the Product team improve the experience we offerBuilding dashboards and reports that give stakeholders a clear view of performance in their areaAnswering ad hoc business questions end to end - from scoping the brief through to presenting findingsCommunicating insights clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues in a way that leads to action

rows.title: Digital Analytics Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Role: Digital Analytics Executive

Location: Hybrid - 3 days per week in Clapham Junction

If you enjoy getting to the bottom of why the numbers look the way they do - not just reporting them, but understanding where they come from and what they mean - this is a role worth reading about. You will join our data and analytics team in a hands-on position, working with GA4, dashboards and cross-functional stakeholders to help us make smarter decisions about how we grow our membership and improve the digital experience for our members.

Who We Are

We're not like any other gym company; we are The Gym Group, a place where you can #BeYouWithUs and perform to your absolute best. We are successful; by membership we're the 2nd largest gym business in the UK and the 4th largest in Europe. We hire people with real passion, positivity and enthusiasm which motivates and inspire those around them. We actively invest in our employees; it's so important to us that our people can thrive in our environment and can make the most of the flexibility and support we offer to all of our teams.

What You'll Be Doing

Analysing digital performance data in GA4 and translating findings into clear, actionable insights for teams across the business.Building and maintaining dashboards and recurring reports that stakeholders in Ecommerce, Marketing, Product and CRM rely on day to day.Monitoring data quality and integrity, investigating anomalies and helping to resolve tracking issues before they affect business decisions.Collaborating with our specialist analytics agency on new tracking requirements, platform improvements and implementation projects.Supporting cross-functional teams with data that helps improve website conversion, member acquisition and revenue from upgrades and add-ons.Helping to build a connected view of customer behaviour across our website and mobile app.Contributing ideas for how we collect, report and use digital data more effectively as our analytics capability grows.

What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to analyse digital performance - this is essential.A solid understanding of digital analytics concepts including events, conversions, attribution and user journeys.The ability to work with data, spot trends and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues.Strong attention to detail and a curious, investigative approach to data quality issues.Confidence managing multiple priorities and working at pace in a collaborative environment.Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets for data analysis and manipulation.

Our commitment to inclusion

At The Gym Group we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome, valued and able to be themselves. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. We believe a diverse team makes us stronger - and we want this to be a place where you can truly #BeYouWithUs.

Need assistance?

If you have a disability or condition that makes it difficult for you to complete your application online please email your cv to recruitment@thegymgroup.com or alternatively call the TGG Recruitment team on 0203 319 4838 and someone will be more than happy to support you. We also want to put it out there that we actively encourage applications from a diverse demographic and we are passionate about your culture and value alignment. We want this to be a match that works for you as much as for us!

Please note that we may close the application window early if we receive high levels of interest. If you're interested in applying please do so asap!

Your application may be reviewed by an AI tool to help assess your suitability based on the information you provide. Automated decision-making is never used - every application is reviewed and all decisions, including whether to progress your application, are made exclusively by a member of our recruitment team. Your data will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and UK GDPR. If you have any questions about how your information is used, please contact recruitment@thegymgroup.com.

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:

Opportunities may include overseas working where appropriate.

AtkinsRéalis provides significant investment in training and development. We want to help you grow as a data professional, strengthen your consulting capability, and build a sustainable and rewarding career.

clients to integrate data analytics best practices into their processes and decision‑making.Working with stakeholders to identify, define and deliver self‑service analytics solutions, dashboards and actionable reports that support decision‑making.Handling, merging, cleaning and transforming multi‑source data to enable robust analysis and insight generation.Effectively applying statistical investigation, data analysis and visualisation techniques to bring business problems to life and clearly communicate the 'so what' in data.Designing and implementing intuitive, consistent and user‑focused data visualisations across environments and formats.Working in agile delivery environments, including requirements gathering, user stories, prototyping, demonstrations and iterative feedback with end users.Working on projects end‑to‑end, from requirements definition through implementation, testing, documentation, end‑user training and handover to client teams.Collaborating client outcomes.Working with peers to develop new analytics capabilities, solutions and methodologies to deliver to clients.Communicating and 'selling' analytical insight and solutions to peers and clients to drive understanding and adoption.Supporting the development of junior colleagues through mentoring and being open to line management responsibilities where appropriate.Continuously developing your data analysis and visualisation skills through formal training, mentoring and hands‑on delivery experience.Participating in external and internal activities related to your specialism, including client engagement, conferences, research and thought leadership.

Professional experience working in a data analytics or related role, with opportunities available across a range of experience levels.Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insight.Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate widely, and communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences.Experience working in a project environment, including requirements gathering with business users and involvement in testing cycles such as unit testing, system testing and integration testing.A consultative mindset and strong commercial acumen, with the ability to articulate the value of analytics, the services we offer and the outcomes we can deliver.Experience using data visualisation tools, preferably Microsoft Power BI (or alternatives such as Tableau, Qlik or Looker).Experience with data transformation and modelling tools such as SQL, Python, DAX, Power Query, NoSQL, Azure Data Factory or similar technologies.Proven experience owning or contributing to end‑to‑end analytics solutions, including roadmap definition, documentation, training and handover.Confidence working in agile or iterative delivery environments.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including report writing and presentation of insights.Experience contributing to bids, proposals, value propositions or analytics solution development is desirable.Experience working with a range of data types (e.g. operational, security, network, AI or large‑scale data) is desirable.Experience creating or adapting data visualisations for different audiences and contexts is desirable.Experience mentoring or line managing junior colleagues is desirable.Experience implementing or supporting cloud‑native analytics solutions at scale is desirable.An appreciation of user interface tools and techniques is desirable.Experience working in defence, government, security, infrastructure or other regulated sectors is desirable.Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft) are desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. Be rewarded. Find out more.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

rows.title: AI & Data Strategy Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Lodha UK
Lodha UK established its London presence in 2013-2014 and has since become one of the capital's most active prime and super-prime residential developers, with a combined portfolio in excess of £2 billion of gross development value across Central London. Its landmark schemes include No. 1 Grosvenor Square in Mayfair, Lincoln Square on the edge of Covent Garden, and Holland Park Gate in Kensington. Lodha UK is known for collaborating with some of the world's most distinguished architects and designers - including Patricia Urquiola, Yabu Pushelberg and Piero Lissoni - and for pairing outstanding design with the bespoke residential services of its in-house hospitality group, Lodha Hospitality. Lodha UK is underway with its fourth development in Belgravia. The business operates an integrated, in-house model spanning land acquisition, planning, design, development management, construction oversight, procurement, and sales and marketing - creating exceptional homes in highly desirable locations, which Lodha then develops, manages and operates through its dedicated in-house teams. Lodha UK also operates Lodha Partners, a dedicated advisory arm serving ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) private clients, bringing the same rigour and discretion the Group applies to real estate into personal wealth, investment and lifestyle advisory services.
Role Purpose
Lodha UK spans both the development business and Lodha Partners, its UHNW advisory arm. Within the real estate business, the ambition is to become the most AI-adopted developer in the market - every person in the top 5% of their peer group for AI usage in their role. That means reimagining how workflows are done in the first place, not just layering AI onto them incrementally. A sales lead intelligence pilot is due to launch as an early initiative, with more to follow as further opportunities are identified. This is a deliberately early-stage, fast-moving programme, built and run directly by the COO, Lodha Partners and the Co-CEO, LDUK, rather than through a formal committee. The AI & Data Strategy Analyst will work closely with them across the programme - helping shape the approach as much as execute against it.
Key Responsibilities
AI Adoption & Programme DeliverySupport and drive AI adoption across Lodha UK, working closely with the COO, Lodha Partners and the Co-CEO, LDUK to ensure every person in Lodha UK is, in time, in the top 5% of their peer group for AI usage in their role.Identify opportunities to apply AI by reimagining workflows end-to-end, rather than applying AI incrementally to how things are done today.Support teams across the business in implementing those initiatives, from first pilot through to embedded, everyday use.Identify and introduce relevant AI tools.
Data Capture & StructuringContribute to the firm's data capture and structuring efforts, supporting the build of the internal meeting/voice-intelligence workflow.Organise captured data into a single, reliable source of truth (e.g. Notion).
Analysis & BriefingPrepare clear analysis, workflow documentation and briefing materials (shortlists, usage surveys, briefing papers) to support decisions by the COO, Lodha Partners, the Co-CEO, LDUK and senior leadership.
Candidate Profile
Essential: An MBA graduate (or final-year MBA candidate), or an early-career professional with a management consulting, strategy or Big 4 advisory background, with a genuine, hands-on curiosity about applying AI to real commercial workflows rather than a purely theoretical interest.Essential: A consulting-style toolkit - structuring ambiguous problems, synthesising messy inputs into crisp, decision-ready recommendations, and communicating confidently with senior stakeholders.Essential: Comfortable working hands-on with AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and confident picking up new ones quickly.Essential: Strong analytical rigour and attention to detail, with the ability to work through messy, unstructured data (spreadsheets, mailboxes, CRM records) and distil it into clear, decision-ready outputs.Essential: Available to start at short notice and commit to a 6–9 month term, full-time in Central London.Essential: Discreet and comfortable handling sensitive, confidential UHNW client data with sound judgement.Essential: Intelligent, personable, proactive and comfortable working at pace across multiple, still-forming workstreams with a degree of ambiguity.Desirable: Some exposure to Excel-based data analysis and, ideally, basic scripting or API work (e.g. Python).

Quantitative Analyst
We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity. We build smart strategies that win over time.

Job Summary

 JOB DESCRIPTION 

Are you fascinated by high-paced algorithmic trading, data science and complex engineering systems? The Execution Solutions team sits at the heart of our European Electronic Trading business, working closely with clients, Sales, Trading, Engineering and Quantitative Research to improve our platform’s performance. As an Analyst/Associate in our dynamic team, you will work directly with some of the most sophisticated investors in the world like asset managers, hedge funds and systematic quant funds, helping them understand and improve how their trading strategies perform. You will dig into large datasets, structured and unstructured, uncover hidden trends and turn them into actionable recommendations for clients to run live experiments on. Know the ins and outs of our algorithms, trading systems and proprietary trading signals to showcase the value of our product offering.  Improve and expand existing tooling for data analysis and trend detection as new needs and use cases arise, leveraging AI and our automation frameworks.  Research how liquidity and market structure evolve across European markets, and turn that into thought-leadership content clients can rely on. 

Required Qualifications And Skills

 A genuine interest in markets and equity electronic/algo trading – Europe a plus.  Strong analytical skills and ability to draw insights from large, raw datasets.  Hands-on coding experience – KDB/q, Python or SQL preferred, but strong ability in any programming language is welcome.  Ambitious, with excellent communication and team-working skills.  Familiarity with business intelligence software QlikView, Tableau or Power BI  Prior exposure to TCA, European market microstructure or other electronic execution concepts. Preferred Qualifications And Skills

 Familiarity with business intelligence software QlikView, Tableau or Power BI  Prior exposure to TCA, European market microstructure or other electronic execution concepts.  Backgrounds we welcome: finance, but also physics, maths, computer science or engineering.

rows.title: BDM Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Linklaters is a global law firm, providing legal services in 20 countries and through 30 offices.

Linklaters is a people business. Being best in class in the eyes of our clients means that our people must be exceptional.

We look not only for brilliant minds, but for people who will thrive in our environment: people who love working collaboratively and demonstrate the innovative, efficient, agile, entrepreneurial, and responsible mind-set we aim to bring to every interaction.

Ours is an environment of outperformance. We achieve this not with targets and incentives, but by fostering a positive, supportive, fair, and open atmosphere.

We respect and value difference but insist on inclusivity. We celebrate all aspects of diversity and challenge any form of bias. This is vital to our ability to work as one team, with a common goal.

The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to deliver data analytics and process mapping that supports the Business Development and Marketing (BDM) function on a 12 month fixed-term contract. In this role, you will collect, organise and analyse data from multiple sources to identify quick wins and enable data-driven action planning. You will also gather requirements for report development, identify data sources and design scalable solutions for reporting automation. Working within the BDM Planning and Operations team, you will play a key role in shaping strategic initiatives and improving internal processes in a collaborative, international environment.

Your Key Responsibilities

Collect, organise and manage data from a variety of sources to ensure accuracy and reliability for analysis. Collaborate with the BDM Operations and Planning team to understand data analytics and process mapping requirements.Analyse data to identify trends, insights and quick wins that support the BDM function.Work with internal teams and stakeholders to define data sources, reporting steps and transformation rules, ensuring scalable and repeatable report designs.Partner with the BDM Data Visualisation Designer and Data Analysts to clarify data sources and reporting needs for development.Share outputs of analysis with relevant stakeholders and conduct further analytics based on feedback.Stay informed on emerging data analytics tools and methodologies to continuously improve the quality and impact of analysis.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience in collecting, cleaning and managing data from multiple sources, including structured and unstructured datasets.Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices to ensure accuracy, reliability and integrity.Ability to map data and reporting workflows, perform data forensics and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements.Proficiency in data analysis and statistical techniques, with hands-on experience using tools such as Excel, SQL, Python or R, and visualisation platforms like Power BI or Tableau.Excellent documentation skills and the ability to present findings clearly to stakeholders, adapting analysis based on feedback.Familiarity with data visualisation principles and experience working alongside designers or dashboard developers.

What's On Offer

This role can be based in our London offices, with a hybrid working model available.

Benefits

Joining Team Linklaters will see you qualify for a range of benefits designed to reward the vital contribution you'll be making to our success. These include:

Health & Wellbeing

Private Medical InsuranceFree in-house fitness centre and subsidised health club membershipsFree onsite GP service and periodic health assessments

Finance

Pension and flexible savings optionsIncome protection and life assuranceMortgage advice and will-writing services.

Family & Lifestyle

Electric car and cycle to work schemes.Emergency family careAdditional holiday/birthday leave.Maternity/paternity/shared parental leave.Travel insurance and season ticket loanOption to join sports and social clubs, as well as our employee networks groups (such as our Gender Equality, With Pride, or Social Mobility Networks)

If you think this role would suit you, please click apply below. We look forward to hearing from you!

Technical Skills

Audience Targeting, Brand Marketing, Content Design, Content Development, Content Strategy Development, Data Analysis, Digital Marketing, Insight Generation, Marketing Strategies, Reputation Management, Social Media Management

This list of duties and responsibilities above is not exhaustive. It is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. As such, the role may also include the undertaking of additional tasks as required.

Application Policy

Applications and CVs (direct or via agency) are only accepted online via the portal. Queries related to our roles must be directed to the relevant recruitment team and not the partners, practices or stakeholders (lateralrecruitment@linklaters.com for legal roles or ukbtrecruitment@linklaters.com for business team roles).

rows.title: Commercial Insight Analyst

If you have around two years of analytics experience and you are ready to take on more ownership, work with senior stakeholders and build your commercial instincts, this role has a lot to offer.

We're not like any other gym company; we are The Gym Group, a place where you can #BeYouWithUs and perform to your absolute best. Analysing trading performance across our gym estate and surfacing insights that help the business act quickly and confidentlySupporting member acquisition and retention analysis, helping the business understand what drives membership growth and how to reduce churnWorking with our Property team to analyse location performance and inform decisions about where we open and investEvaluating product performance and member behaviour to help the Product team improve the experience we offerBuilding dashboards and reports that give stakeholders a clear view of performance in their areaAnswering ad hoc business questions end to end - from scoping the brief through to presenting findingsCommunicating insights clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues in a way that leads to action

Our commitment to inclusion

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst

We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.

Your background

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

rows.descriptionText:
Burford Capital is the leading global finance and asset management firm focused on law. Its businesses include litigation finance and risk management, asset recovery and a wide range of legal finance and advisory activities. Burford is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BUR) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE: BUR), and it works with companies and law firms around the world from its principal offices in New York, London, Chicago, Washington, Singapore, and Dubai.

Summary

The firm is seeking a Data Analyst to joint the Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team. The Data Analyst will be involved in a wide variety of areas within the Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team, with a particular focus on the development and operation of Burford Capital's Proprietary investment Modeling platform.

The role will report to a Senior Vice President and be based in Burford's London Office.

www.burfordcapital.com

Company Overview

Burford Capital is the largest and most experienced provider of commercial finance to the legal sector in the world, with a core expertise in identifying and optimizing the value of legal assets for companies and law firms. Since its founding in 2009, Burford has worked with hundreds of law firms and corporations, including 94 of the AmLaw 100 and 92 of the Global 100 largest law firms. Our team has grown from five people at the end of 2009 to over 170 people today, including over 45 lawyers.

Burford possesses the resources and expertise of a large company while retaining the flexibility and creativity of a startup. Team members are smart, creative, collaborative, curious, and confident. Everyone rolls up their sleeves to perform and engage collectively for the overall success of the business. Burford values rigorous thinking, clear communication, and efficient execution. Burford is an “always on” environment in which everyone needs to be accessible by email when outside the office, including during evenings and weekends.

Burford pays base salaries consistent with the financial services industry and favors incentive compensation to reward performance. Burford Capital is committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, whether or not they have a disability.

Position Description

Responsibilities

The Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team at Burford Capital is seeking a Data Analyst to support the operation and development of Burford’s proprietary investment modeling software. This role will sit at the intersection of quantitative finance, business analysis, and software development, helping convert investment and modeling needs into clear specifications, testing materials, and implementation guidance.

Responsibilities include:

Supporting the development and refinement of Burford’s proprietary investment modeling platform. Working with the business-facing team to understand model logic, analytical objectives, and enhancement priorities. Drafting functional and technical specifications for new features, platform improvements, and analytical tools. Preparing test packets and validation materials to confirm that functionality performs as intended. Coordinating with Project Management, Business Architecture, and Technology teams to support effective delivery of software changes. Identifying opportunities to improve the modeling systems and communicating recommendations to the wider Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team. Maintaining documentation of requirements, testing outcomes, platform functionality, and related development decisions. 

Professional Development

The Data Analyst will benefit from the following opportunities:

Formal training introducing litigation finance, financial modeling, and analysis. Hands-on exposure to quantitative investment processes, model development, and the software development lifecycle for analytical platforms. Personalized mentorship from members of the Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team. Opportunities to contribute meaningfully to platform development, model analysis, and high-impact projects supporting Burford’s investment decision-making processes. 

Skills Desired

Qualifications & Experience

Candidates should have an outstanding academic record. Candidates should be currently pursuing or have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a STEM field. 

Core Competencies & Skills

Candidates must be detail-oriented and have strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. A collaborative working style that enables them to interact with team members at all levels of the company. High energy, self-starter with an ability to comprehend and quickly learn new concepts. Strong Excel skills are required. Candidates should be able to review, troubleshoot, and validate spreadsheet-based analysis. Python experience is highly preferred. Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity and work quality, with a proactive mindset toward identifying new ways to use AI responsibly and effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication

rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis is growing its Digital Insights & Experience (DI&E) consulting capability and is looking for Data Analysts who are curious, analytically minded, and motivated to help organisations make better decisions through data‑driven insight.

DI&E brings together data analytics, insight generation and experience‑informed decision‑making to enable confident transformation in secure and regulated environments. Our Data Analysts work at the intersection of data, technology and business context—helping clients understand performance, identify opportunities, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insight.

We are building a multi‑disciplinary team of people from diverse backgrounds. You might be a data analyst, reporting specialist, BI developer, or an analytically‑minded consultant looking to deepen your technical capability while working in a consulting environment. We welcome adaptable problem‑solvers who want to apply analytics to real‑world challenges and continue to grow their careers.

When it comes to living your life, we want your role at AtkinsRéalis to be a meaningful part of your personal journey. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive team culture where people support, mentor and challenge one another. We succeed together, and our flexible and hybrid working practices are designed to support different priorities and ways of working.

Your role

As a Data Analyst within our Digital Insights & Experience and Secure Government business, you will help clients understand, improve and optimise their performance through data‑driven insight. You will work on a wide variety of analytics and transformation programmes across public and private sector environments, often within secure, regulated or complex organisational contexts. Opportunities may include overseas working where appropriate.

AtkinsRéalis provides significant investment in training and development. We want to help you grow as a data professional, strengthen your consulting capability, and build a sustainable and rewarding career.

The Role As a Data Analyst Will Involve

Working alongside AtkinsRéalis Technical Directors, Principals and multi‑disciplinary delivery teams to design and deliver data analytics and visualisation solutions for our clients.Working with clients to integrate data analytics best practices into their processes and decision‑making.Working with stakeholders to identify, define and deliver self‑service analytics solutions, dashboards and actionable reports that support decision‑making.Handling, merging, cleaning and transforming multi‑source data to enable robust analysis and insight generation.Effectively applying statistical investigation, data analysis and visualisation techniques to bring business problems to life and clearly communicate the 'so what' in data.Designing and implementing intuitive, consistent and user‑focused data visualisations across environments and formats.Working in agile delivery environments, including requirements gathering, user stories, prototyping, demonstrations and iterative feedback with end users.Working on projects end‑to‑end, from requirements definition through implementation, testing, documentation, end‑user training and handover to client teams.Collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders across a range of experience and seniority levels.Contributing to decision‑making that supports successful project delivery and measurable client outcomes.Working with peers to develop new analytics capabilities, solutions and methodologies to deliver to clients.Communicating and 'selling' analytical insight and solutions to peers and clients to drive understanding and adoption.Supporting the development of junior colleagues through mentoring and being open to line management responsibilities where appropriate.Continuously developing your data analysis and visualisation skills through formal training, mentoring and hands‑on delivery experience.Participating in external and internal activities related to your specialism, including client engagement, conferences, research and thought leadership.

About You

Professional experience working in a data analytics or related role, with opportunities available across a range of experience levels.Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insight.Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate widely, and communicate effectively with both technical and non‑technical audiences.Experience working in a project environment, including requirements gathering with business users and involvement in testing cycles such as unit testing, system testing and integration testing.A consultative mindset and strong commercial acumen, with the ability to articulate the value of analytics, the services we offer and the outcomes we can deliver.Experience using data visualisation tools, preferably Microsoft Power BI (or alternatives such as Tableau, Qlik or Looker).Experience with data transformation and modelling tools such as SQL, Python, DAX, Power Query, NoSQL, Azure Data Factory or similar technologies.Proven experience owning or contributing to end‑to‑end analytics solutions, including roadmap definition, documentation, training and handover.Confidence working in agile or iterative delivery environments.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including report writing and presentation of insights.Experience contributing to bids, proposals, value propositions or analytics solution development is desirable.Experience working with a range of data types (e.g. operational, security, network, AI or large‑scale data) is desirable.Experience creating or adapting data visualisations for different audiences and contexts is desirable.Experience mentoring or line managing junior colleagues is desirable.Experience implementing or supporting cloud‑native analytics solutions at scale is desirable.An appreciation of user interface tools and techniques is desirable.Experience working in defence, government, security, infrastructure or other regulated sectors is desirable.Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft) are desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional information

Security clearance

This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.

We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability.
