rows.title: 2027 Summer Intern - Client Solutions & Analytics Quantitative Research Analyst (MFE), London
rows.descriptionText:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.

Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.

2027 Summer Internship –  Client Solutions & Analytics Quantitative Research Analyst (MFE), London

Internship positions are located at PIMCO’s London Office.

You’re Eligible To Apply If You

Are pursuing a Master's degree in Financial Engineering or a closely related quantitative discipline Must be able to begin full time employment at a PIMCO office between January 2028– August 2028 Must be enrolled at a university during December 2027 – June 2028 Are business proficient in English Must be willing to work in London 

You’ll Excel As An Analyst If You Have

A strong interest in the financial markets, macroeconomics, investment management, and financial modelling Excellent foundations in statistics and econometrics; experience analysing large data sets preferred Proficiency in programming; Python required, with MATLAB a plus Strong interpersonal skills, ability to articulate ideas / strategies clearly, both verbally and in writing Fluency in English with another European language desirable Strong time management and organization skills The ability to work effectively and professionally with all levels of personnel both internally and externally Have demonstrated curiosity and experience in using new emerging technologies and AI tools in your work or school projects to solve problems and drive better outcomes 

See Yourself As An Analyst (MFE)

As a member of the Client Solutions and Analytics Team, you’ll have the opportunity to partner with clients and develop expertise across a wide range of multi-asset allocation topics. You will gain a strong understanding of portfolio construction and risk analyses applied across a wide spectrum of partners. Responsibilities can vary but may include some of the following:

Supporting the team in the delivery of asset allocation and risk management solutions to clients and prospects both in assets-only and in ALM space working closely with senior members in the team, Account Management, Product Management and Portfolio Management Use proprietary software and external data sources to run risk analytics, optimisations, economic scenario analyses and stress tests Develop and maintain complex quantitative models and proprietary analytical tools Perform risk management, attribution and other product analysis reports on a periodic basis as required Support senior Strategists and Quantitative Research Analysts to generate thought leadership and asset class insights Utilise AI-enabled tools to streamline processes, enhance insights, and support the more efficient and scalable delivery of client analyses and the development of quantitative models 

While our eligibility requirements are not flexible, we encourage you to apply even if you do not possess 100% of the desired skills outlined above. 

The PIMCO Internship Experience

The PIMCO Internship is a 10-week program that runs from early June to mid-August, with the expectation that you will be available for the full duration of the program During Week 1, you’ll participate in PIMCO Fundamentals Training, providing you with the skills, knowledge, and relationships that will prepare you for success Following the first week, you will join your team and work with them on a wide range of projects described in the “See yourself as an Analyst” section In addition to the day-to-day work, you will be asked to complete at least one capstone project over the course of the summer that you will present to the team Alongside your colleagues, participate in PIMCO's Global Month of Volunteering, developed to heighten the impact of our employees' worldwide volunteer efforts Join us for a variety of cross-divisional education, networking & social events! Your supervisor, peer mentor, senior leaders and team offer guidance and mentorship throughout the summer You will gain hands-on experience with AI-powered tools from day one, with training and resources that help build future ready skills and make an impact from the start You’ll receive feedback at mid- and end-of-summer as part of a formal review process to keep you on the path to meeting your summer goals Want to learn more? Hear about The PIMCO Internship Experience from past interns As a PIMCO intern, you’ll receive competitive compensation, along with a transition bonus to help with relocation to one of our office locations 

How You Should Apply

Applications open in September 2026. We review applications on a rolling basis and encourage you to apply by submitting your resume as soon as you are ready.

What To Expect During The Interview Process

After we receive your application, we will conduct an initial review of your resume If you are selected to move forward, you will be invited to complete a one-way video interview and assessment, giving you the opportunity to showcase your interests, skills, and personality as part of the next stage of the process Once you complete the assessment, you will have a final round of live interviews with us via video conference. These interviews typically include both behavioral and technical questions 

Applications for the internship program are reviewed in phases. Candidates are strongly encouraged to apply as early as possible to be considered in the initial review. Later applications received may still be considered; however, due to the high volume of interest, we cannot guarantee that all applications will be reviewed.

PIMCO is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive, cognitively diverse environment.

For more information on PIMCO and Career Opportunities, please visit www.pimco.com/careers/students

The company also prohibits discrimination on other basis such as medical condition, or marital status under applicable laws.

Applicants with Disabilities

PIMCO is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. rows.title: Occupational Health Technician - Stratford / East London
rows.descriptionText:
At Health Partners, we pride ourselves on being one of the UK’s leading providers of occupational health and wellbeing solutions. We partner with organisations across diverse industries, helping them to support the physical and mental health of their employees.
Please note that the closing date for this vacancy is subject to change and the advert may close earlier if sufficient applications are received. We encourage early applications to avoid disappointment.

REF JOB: JOB6294
Role Outline
Health Partners are seeking an Occupational Health Technician to deliver high-quality health surveillance services to our clients in Stratford and surrounding areas.
We welcome candidates with degrees in Sports Science or a related field, as well as those with transferable skills, such as experienced EMTs or individuals with a nursing background. Full training will be provided. A full UK driving licence is required.
In this role, you’ll play a key part in promoting workplace health and wellbeing, conducting health assessments, and ensuring our clients receive professional and reliable Occupational Health support. You’ll be responsible for carrying out health surveillance, drug and alcohol testing, venepuncture, and vaccinations (if trained). You’ll also manage equipment, and administrative tasks to keep everything running smoothly.
With regular travel and occasional overnight stays, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys working independently, is well-organised, and thrives in a dynamic environment. Whether you're a qualified nurse, an experienced Occupational Health Technician, or have transferable skills from a healthcare or sports science background, this is a fantastic opportunity to develop your career in Occupational Health.
If you’re proactive, adaptable, and ready for a new challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Undertake health surveillance/health promotion activities as required.Preparation of mobile vehicle including vehicle, equipment, stocks and supplies.Preparation of all paperwork, files and associated forms.Ensure that adequate stocks and supplies are kept, ordered and distributed as required.Checking of all equipment including ensuring calibration checks, PAT Testing as well as location and logistics logs are maintained.Maintaining cleanliness of all equipment and mobile vehicles to a high standard.Completing all required forms, databases, logs as directed.Maintaining a record of mileage and petrol usage.Maintaining accurate records of all expenses incurred.Completion of surveillance data and triaging for escalation to OHP.Maintaining and ensuring competence in use of all equipment used and testing required.Contribute to the development of policies, procedures and safe systems of work.Be geographically aware and plan routes, liaising with the Health Surveillance Manager regarding logistics.Ensure adequate fuel in vehicles at all times.Comply with the Health Partners Data Protection policy at all times.Perform administration duties as required.Identify improvements/enhancements to the service where necessary.Maintain personal and professional development, participate in and provide training as required, highlighting any area where further training is required.Undertake drug and alcohol testing.Undertake venepuncture as required and process samples in accordance with guidance.Administer vaccinations as required (Trained Nurses only)Undertake office based duties when not required to travel.Attend in-house Clinical Audit days and departmental meetings.
What we are looking for:
We welcome applications from candidates with degrees in Sports Science or a related field. Full training is provided.We will also look at training candidates with transferable skills such as experienced EMT’s or those with a nursing background.Candidates must have a full, clean UK drivers licence.General Nursing qualification or evidence of OH technician training/experience is desirable.Flexibility to travel all over UK including overnight stays when necessary.Employment with Health Partners is subject to the individual undergoing a DBS check and evidence of Right to Work in the UK.
Additional Information
Driving Requirements:Candidates must have a full, clean UK driver’s licence.All MU drivers will be provided with driver familiarisation training.All drivers are required to undergo a Drivers Medical.
Salary and Experience:Employment is subject to the individual undergoing a DBS check and evidence of Right to Work in the UK.Preference will be given to experienced OHT’s at a salary of £26,325 per annum exclusive of overtime which can take earnings up to 33K per annum (calculations based on 8 – 9 hrs OT per week).Inexperienced candidates who have suitable transferable skills would be; a degree in Sports Science, emergency medical technicians or those with a nursing background.Full training is provided to all candidates.

Peripatetic in Stratford (London) and surrounding areas
Hours:
37.5 hours per week

£26,325

Competitive annual salary dependent on qualifications and experienceContributory pension scheme up to 6%Life assuranceStarting on 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with length of serviceHave a day off for your Birthday (non-contractual benefit)Discounted gym membershipCycle to work schemeHealth cashback plan

rows.descriptionText:
Hours: 37.5 hrs. per Week, Shift Hours 4 x 4 , 2 days 07-19, 2 nights 19-07, 4 offLocation: Heathrow (HGR)Contract Type: PermanentClosing Date: Tuesday 6th October 2026
In a nutshell
At Virgin Atlantic Airways, we believe that everyone can take on the world. It’s our vision to become the most loved travel company, and as we continue our journey, we’re harnessing our spirit of entrepreneurship and innovation to challenge the status quo.
We operate one of the cleanest and greenest fleets in the sky, from Airbus A350s and A330neos to Boeing 787s. We are now looking for a Certifying Engineer (B1) to join our Engineering team. This is a key operational role, responsible for delivering safe, compliant, and high-quality maintenance while leading small teams and working closely with Technical Control and wider stakeholders.

Carry out allocated aircraft maintenance tasks in a safe, secure, and compliant manner, certifying work in line with Virgin Atlantic and regulatory requirements.Lead and supervise small maintenance teams to deliver the highest standards of safety, reliability, and on-time performance.Act as the focal point of communication between the maintenance team, Technical Control, and where required, third-party suppliers.Ensure accurate certification of all maintenance tasks and technical documentation.Drive compliance with Engineering safety, EASA regulations, and company procedures.
About you

British Transport Police has an exciting opportunity for an NDFU Insight Analyst to join the National Disruption Fusion Unit (NDFU). 

As an NDFU Insight Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in transforming complex data into meaningful insight that helps reduce disruption, improve safety, and support informed decision-making across the railway network. Working as a multi-disciplinary analytical specialist, you will combine intelligence analysis, performance analysis, and data science techniques to develop innovative tactical and strategic products for a wide range of stakeholders.

Using cutting-edge analytical methods and technologies, you will identify emerging trends, uncover opportunities for improvement, and provide evidence-based recommendations that help prevent major disruption events before they occur. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a nationally important function, working at the forefront of analytical innovation to help keep Britain's railways safe, efficient, and moving.

Designing and delivering innovative national insight products and reports that support decision-making across British Transport Police, Network Rail, and wider industry partners.Analysing complex data sets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that help reduce disruption, improve railway safety, and enhance network performance.Developing and maintaining interactive dashboards and reporting solutions, including Power BI products, to enable stakeholder self-service and increase automation.Producing high-quality analytical reports with clear findings, evidence-based recommendations, and practical solutions for operational and strategic challenges.Presenting analytical insights to senior leaders and industry stakeholders, translating complex information into concise, impactful briefings and recommendations.Monitoring emerging trends and conducting horizon scanning to identify potential future risks, support continuous improvement, and help prevent major disruption events before they occur.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Educated to degree level in a relevant discipline, or able to demonstrate equivalent professional experience.Proven experience conducting research and analysis, including interpreting complex information and producing insightful reports and recommendations.Experience managing and analysing large data sets, using analytical tools and Microsoft applications, particularly Excel and Power BI.Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, solve problems, and develop innovative evidence-based solutions.Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and accessible manner.Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads, work independently, and deliver high-quality outputs to demanding deadlines.

What We Offer

28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days after 5 years.Family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave.Bespoke benefits platform and Blue Light Card access.Salary sacrifice options for cycles, home technology, gym membership, and electric vehicles.Interest-free annual rail season ticket loan after 6 months.Access to the Transport Benevolent Fund for health, welfare, and financial support.Development opportunities, including fully funded apprenticeships.Excellent Pension scheme: We offer the BTP GPP Police Staff Pension Scheme, administered by Royal London. This group personal pension plan is available to all police staff and is a defined contribution scheme. It provides the flexibility to vary your pension contributions from 4.4% to 12% of your salary. For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk. Note: If you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS, your pension will not be affected.

How To Apply

Inclusion & Diversity

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences. Diversity strengthens our teams, improves our services and helps us better represent and support the communities we serve.

We are proud to be an inclusive employer and strive to create a workplace that is fair, respectful and accessible to all. We actively work to challenge discrimination, remove barriers and ensure equity throughout our recruitment and employment practices.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or selection process, please let us know - we are happy to support you. Your talent, your potential, and your unique perspective matter here.

For more information on Inclusion or the Disability Confident Scheme, please click the links Inclusion & Diversity Disability Confident Scheme

Join Us

Ready to take the next step in your career? At BTP, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, make a real impact, and be part of something extraordinary.

Find out why BTP could be the perfect fit for you - About Us - British Transport Police

Curious about what life at BTP is really like? Hear directly from our people and discover what makes working here so rewarding. Explore real stories on our blog: Our Stories - British Transport Police

AtkinsRéalis is growing its Digital Insights & Experience (DI&E) consulting capability and is looking for Data Analysts who are curious, analytically minded, and motivated to help organisations make better decisions through data‑driven insight.

Our Data Analysts work at the intersection of data, technology and business context—helping clients understand performance, identify opportunities, and translate analysis into clear, actionable insight.

You might be a data analyst, reporting specialist, BI developer, or an analytically‑minded consultant looking to deepen your technical capability while working in a consulting environment. We welcome adaptable problem‑solvers who want to apply analytics to real‑world challenges and continue to grow their careers.

When it comes to living your life, we want your role at AtkinsRéalis to be a meaningful part of your personal journey. You'll join a collaborative, inclusive team culture where people support, mentor and challenge one another. We succeed together, and our flexible and hybrid working practices are designed to support different priorities and ways of working.

Your role

You will work on a wide variety of analytics and transformation programmes across public and private sector environments, often within secure, regulated or complex organisational contexts. Opportunities may include overseas working where appropriate.

AtkinsRéalis provides significant investment in training and development. We want to help you grow as a data professional, strengthen your consulting capability, and build a sustainable and rewarding career.

The Role As a Data Analyst Will Involve

clients to integrate data analytics best practices into their processes and decision‑making.Working with stakeholders to identify, define and deliver self‑service analytics solutions, dashboards and actionable reports that support decision‑making.Handling, merging, cleaning and transforming multi‑source data to enable robust analysis and insight generation.Effectively applying statistical investigation, data analysis and visualisation techniques to bring business problems to life and clearly communicate the 'so what' in data.Designing and implementing intuitive, consistent and developing your data analysis and visualisation skills through formal training, mentoring and hands‑on delivery experience.Participating in external and internal activities related to your specialism, including client engagement, conferences, research and thought leadership.

translate complex data into clear, actionable insight.Strong communication skills, with the ability to build trust, collaborate widely, and communicate effectively with both technical and data visualisation tools, preferably Microsoft Power BI (or alternatives such as Tableau, Qlik or Looker).Experience with data transformation and modelling tools such as SQL, Python, DAX, Power Query, NoSQL, Azure Data Factory or similar technologies.Proven experience owning or contributing to end‑to‑end analytics solutions, including roadmap definition, documentation, training and handover.Confidence working in agile or iterative delivery environments.Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including report writing and presentation of insights.Experience contributing to bids, proposals, value propositions or analytics solution development is desirable.Experience working with a range of data types (e.g. operational, security, network, AI or large‑scale data) is desirable.Experience creating or adapting data visualisations for different audiences and contexts is desirable.Experience mentoring or line managing junior colleagues is desirable.Experience implementing or supporting cloud‑native analytics solutions at scale is desirable.An appreciation of user interface tools and techniques is desirable.Experience working in defence, government, security, infrastructure or other regulated sectors is desirable.Relevant certifications (e.g. Microsoft) are desirable.

Rewards & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights.Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement.Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions.Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs.Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems.Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use.Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities.

Your background

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

rows.title: BDM Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Linklaters is a global law firm, providing legal services in 20 countries and through 30 offices.

Linklaters is a people business. Being best in class in the eyes of our clients means that our people must be exceptional.

We look not only for brilliant minds, but for people who will thrive in our environment: people who love working collaboratively and demonstrate the innovative, efficient, agile, entrepreneurial, and responsible mind-set we aim to bring to every interaction.

Ours is an environment of outperformance. We achieve this not with targets and incentives, but by fostering a positive, supportive, fair, and open atmosphere.

We respect and value difference but insist on inclusivity. We celebrate all aspects of diversity and challenge any form of bias. This is vital to our ability to work as one team, with a common goal.

The Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst to deliver data analytics and process mapping that supports the Business Development and Marketing (BDM) function on a 12 month fixed-term contract. In this role, you will collect, organise and analyse data from multiple sources to identify quick wins and enable data-driven action planning. You will also gather requirements for report development, identify data sources and design scalable solutions for reporting automation. Working within the BDM Planning and Operations team, you will play a key role in shaping strategic initiatives and improving internal processes in a collaborative, international environment.

Your Key Responsibilities

Collect, organise and manage data from a variety of sources to ensure accuracy and reliability for analysis. Collaborate with the BDM Operations and Planning team to understand data analytics and process mapping requirements.Analyse data to identify trends, insights and quick wins that support the BDM function.Work with internal teams and stakeholders to define data sources, reporting steps and transformation rules, ensuring scalable and repeatable report designs.Partner with the BDM Data Visualisation Designer and Data Analysts to clarify data sources and reporting needs for development.Share outputs of analysis with relevant stakeholders and conduct further analytics based on feedback.Stay informed on emerging data analytics tools and methodologies to continuously improve the quality and impact of analysis.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience in collecting, cleaning and managing data from multiple sources, including structured and unstructured datasets.Strong understanding of data governance principles and best practices to ensure accuracy, reliability and integrity.Ability to map data and reporting workflows, perform data forensics and collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements.Proficiency in data analysis and statistical techniques, with hands-on experience using tools such as Excel, SQL, Python or R, and visualisation platforms like Power BI or Tableau.Excellent documentation skills and the ability to present findings clearly to stakeholders, adapting analysis based on feedback.Familiarity with data visualisation principles and experience working alongside designers or dashboard developers.

What's On Offer

This role can be based in our London offices, with a hybrid working model available.

Benefits

Joining Team Linklaters will see you qualify for a range of benefits designed to reward the vital contribution you'll be making to our success. These include:

Audience Targeting, Brand Marketing, Content Design, Content Development, Content Strategy Development, Data Analysis, Digital Marketing, Insight Generation, Marketing Strategies, Reputation Management, Social Media Management

rows.title: Commercial Graduate Scheme 2027
rows.descriptionText:
What to Expect

We are recruiting for Graduates to join our Commercial team at the McLaren Technology Centre in Woking, Surrey. As a Commercial Graduate, you will develop your skills and technical acumen in our sales, marketing, and aftersales environments while gaining hands-on experience with one of the world's most iconic automotive brands.

Over two years, you will move between four 6-month rotations, designed to accelerate your development and understanding of McLaren's global commercial operations and support your progression into a permanent role within the business.

This is an on-site role that will enable you to work closely with teams across our Commercial organisation and build relationships with colleagues from across the wider business.

What You'll Do

As a Commercial Graduate, you will be immersed in three core functions - Sales, Marketing, and Aftersales - through four 6-month placements. Your rotations will be drawn from a range of teams across the Commercial function, which may include Sales Reporting & Insight, Product & Pricing, Regional Operations, Marketing, Aftersales Business Development, MSO and Motorsport. These placements will enable you to build your commercial awareness, analytical capabilities and customer engagement skills, with real ownership from day one.

Sales:

Turn global sales, retailer and market data into the insights used by executives, shareholders and regional teams—including management dashboards in Power BI and the monthly commercial performance pack. Gain exposure to product and pricing strategy, competitor benchmarking, volume and market planning, and how McLaren products are positioned and commercialised around the world. Support our regional team across Europe, analysing retailer performance across Sales, Network Development and Aftersales, and seeing how central strategy is delivered to our retailer network. Experience the bespoke side of the business with McLaren Special Operations and Motorsport, supporting event delivery, commercial reporting and the progression of individually commissioned customer orders. 

Marketing:

Contribute to global campaign strategies across digital, experiential, and brand and lifestyle marketing. Support launch readiness, product positioning, and brand storytelling in line with McLaren's premium identity, coordinating content and stakeholder engagement across multiple projects. Gain practical experience with CRM activity, retailer marketing initiatives, and data-driven tools such as SEO/SEM and social media analytics. 

Aftersales:

Support the lifecycle of McLaren vehicles through our global aftersales strategy, focusing on customer satisfaction and retention. Help develop new digital customer solutions, such as the Direct Sales Portal and the McLaren App, alongside our Aftersales Business Development team. Work on strategic projects spanning service programme planning, parts logistics and ownership experience, collaborating cross-functionally with Commercial Operations, IT and external partners. 

Alongside your rotations, you will take part in structured learning, development workshops and innovation challenges. You will receive regular feedback and support throughout the programme, helping you build your leadership and problem-solving capabilities

What You'll Bring

What You’ll BringYou must have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a 2:1 or above in a relevant degree discipline, such as Business, Marketing, Economics, Engineering with Commercial focus, or related fields. Strong analytical thinking, communication, and organisational skills. A passion for the automotive industry and a desire to work in a fast-paced, high-performance environment. Some experience with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI) is advantageous. 
Personal Attributes

We’re looking for individuals who bring the mindset and behaviours needed to thrive in a fast-paced automotive environment. The most desirable attributes include:

Commercial curiosity – an interest in how performance automotive businesses operate, grow, and compete globally. Data-driven thinking – confidence in using sales and market data to support strategic decisions. Adaptability – comfortable navigating change in a fast-moving, innovation-led environment. Customer focus – an understanding of premium customer expectations and how to deliver an exceptional ownership experience. Collaboration – ability to work across commercial, technical, and operational teams. Initiative – proactive in identifying opportunities and taking ownership of outcomes. Resilience – able to maintain focus and energy under pressure and against tight deadlines. Attention to detail – precision in analysis, reporting, and communications. Clear communication – able to present insights and strategies with clarity and confidence.AI Proficiency – Comfortable using AI tools ethically and effectively to support learning, productivity, innovation, and problem-solving.Passion for automotive and innovation – enthusiasm for performance cars, mobility trends, and commercial impact.

What We'll Do for You

We offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

25 days’ holiday, plus bank holidays. Annual buy & sell up to five days Enhanced company pension scheme Discretionary annual bonus award Private medical insurance and health cash plan Life assurance 4x your basic salary Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping A range of wellbeing initiatives, such as employee assistance programme and free financial & mortgage advice Opportunities to experience our fantastic cars 

Qualifying criteria applies

Who Are We?

No restraints. No limitations. We don’t simply push boundaries. We completely rethink them. McLaren Automotive exists to create breath-taking performance road cars.

It takes a community to do what we do. A diverse group of people with many areas of expertise, united by their passion to deliver visionary products and set new benchmarks.

McLaren Automotive commits to equal opportunity for all. Diversity, Equality and Inclusion is at the heart of our impact, it drives our innovation and enables us to truly create something special. Join us on our journey.

rows.title: AI & Data Strategy Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About Lodha UK
Lodha UK established its London presence in 2013-2014 and has since become one of the capital's most active prime and super-prime residential developers, with a combined portfolio in excess of £2 billion of gross development value across Central London. Its landmark schemes include No. 1 Grosvenor Square in Mayfair, Lincoln Square on the edge of Covent Garden, and Holland Park Gate in Kensington. Lodha UK is known for collaborating with some of the world's most distinguished architects and designers - including Patricia Urquiola, Yabu Pushelberg and Piero Lissoni - and for pairing outstanding design with the bespoke residential services of its in-house hospitality group, Lodha Hospitality. Lodha UK is underway with its fourth development in Belgravia. The business operates an integrated, in-house model spanning land acquisition, planning, design, development management, construction oversight, procurement, and sales and marketing - creating exceptional homes in highly desirable locations, which Lodha then develops, manages and operates through its dedicated in-house teams. Lodha UK also operates Lodha Partners, a dedicated advisory arm serving ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) private clients, bringing the same rigour and discretion the Group applies to real estate into personal wealth, investment and lifestyle advisory services.
Role Purpose
Lodha UK spans both the development business and Lodha Partners, its UHNW advisory arm. Within the real estate business, the ambition is to become the most AI-adopted developer in the market - every person in the top 5% of their peer group for AI usage in their role. That means reimagining how workflows are done in the first place, not just layering AI onto them incrementally. A sales lead intelligence pilot is due to launch as an early initiative, with more to follow as further opportunities are identified. This is a deliberately early-stage, fast-moving programme, built and run directly by the COO, Lodha Partners and the Co-CEO, LDUK, rather than through a formal committee. The AI & Data Strategy Analyst will work closely with them across the programme - helping shape the approach as much as execute against it.
Key Responsibilities
AI Adoption & Programme DeliverySupport and drive AI adoption across Lodha UK, working closely with the COO, Lodha Partners and the Co-CEO, LDUK to ensure every person in Lodha UK is, in time, in the top 5% of their peer group for AI usage in their role.Identify opportunities to apply AI by reimagining workflows end-to-end, rather than applying AI incrementally to how things are done today.Support teams across the business in implementing those initiatives, from first pilot through to embedded, everyday use.Identify and introduce relevant AI tools.
Data Capture & StructuringContribute to the firm's data capture and structuring efforts, supporting the build of the internal meeting/voice-intelligence workflow.Organise captured data into a single, reliable source of truth (e.g. Notion).
Analysis & BriefingPrepare clear analysis, workflow documentation and briefing materials (shortlists, usage surveys, briefing papers) to support decisions by the COO, Lodha Partners, the Co-CEO, LDUK and senior leadership.

rows.title: Market Analyst - Power Trading Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed togetherTrusting – we choose to trust each otherCustomer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisionsFuture Focused – we accelerate changeCurious – we turn knowledge into action

The Role

We are seeking a full-time Power Market Analyst to join Wood Mackenzie’s Power & Renewables team, focusing on the development and application of advanced power market models across European electricity markets.

As a Power Market Analyst, you will play a key role in building, maintaining, and enhancing market optimization models used to analyse power systems, generation economics, transmission constraints, and market outcomes. You will apply linear programming (LP) and other optimization techniques to simulate market behaviour, assess investment and operational decisions, and provide actionable insights on power market dynamics, decarbonization pathways, and energy transition challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance optimization-based power market models for European electricity markets.Design and implement LP and mixed-integer optimization models to simulate generation dispatch, storage operation, cross-border trading, and market-clearing mechanisms.Analyse power market fundamentals, including supply-demand dynamics, renewable integration, fuel markets, emissions costs, and transmission constraints.Conduct scenario analysis to evaluate market outcomes, asset profitability, policy impacts, and energy transition pathways.Translate complex model outputs into clear market insights and recommendations for internal stakeholders and clients.Improve model methodologies, assumptions, and analytical frameworks to enhance model accuracy, transparency, and performance.Work with large datasets and develop efficient data workflows to support model development and analysis.Collaborate with experts across power markets, renewable energy, economics, and policy to deliver high-quality research and market intelligence.Monitor developments in European energy markets, regulatory frameworks, and market design, assessing their impact on market participants and investment decisions.Support client engagements through presentations, bespoke analyses, technical discussions, and thought leadership.

About You

We are looking for a highly analytical and intellectually curious individual with a strong foundation in optimization, quantitative modelling, and power market analysis. You enjoy solving complex problems, building robust models, and generating insights that support strategic decision-making.

Essential Skills And Qualifications

A degree in Operations Research, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.Experience in electricity market analysis, power system modeling, or energy economics.Strong knowledge of optimization techniques, particularly linear programming (LP) and mixed-integer programming (MIP).Experience developing and implementing mathematical models for power systems, generation portfolios, storage assets, or electricity markets.Proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages used for optimization and quantitative analysis.Experience with optimization frameworks and solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Xpress, Pyomo, or similar tools.Strong understanding of European power market fundamentals, market design, and price formation mechanisms.Ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and commercial audiences.Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Why Join Us?

At Wood Mackenzie, you will work on industry-leading power market models that help clients navigate rapidly changing energy markets and the transition to a low-carbon economy. You will collaborate with leading analysts, modelers, and industry experts to solve complex challenges facing power systems, renewable integration, energy storage, and electricity market design.

This role offers an opportunity to apply cutting-edge optimization techniques and market analysis to inform investment decisions, support policy evaluation, and shape the future of the energy sector.

Equal Opportunities

This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

2027 Summer Internship –  Client Solutions & Analytics Quantitative Research Analyst (MFE), London

You’re Eligible To Apply If You

Are pursuing a Master's degree in Financial Engineering or a closely related quantitative discipline Must be able to begin full time employment at a PIMCO office between January 2028– August 2028 Must be enrolled at a university during December 2027 – June 2028 Are business proficient in English Must be willing to work in London

Supporting the team in the delivery of asset allocation and risk management solutions to clients and prospects both in assets-only and in ALM space working closely with senior members in the team, Account Management, Product Management and Portfolio Management Use proprietary software and external data sources to run risk analytics, optimisations, economic scenario analyses and stress tests Develop and maintain complex quantitative models and proprietary analytical tools Perform risk management, attribution and other product analysis reports on a periodic basis as required Support senior Strategists and Quantitative Research Analysts to generate thought leadership and asset class insights Utilise AI-enabled tools to streamline processes, enhance insights, and support the more efficient and scalable delivery of client analyses and the development of quantitative models

rows.title: Business Graduate Programme (Data and Analytics)

location.linkedinText: City Of London, England, United Kingdom

rows.descriptionText:
Programme start date: September 2027

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. 

Our award-winning graduate programme provides the ideal springboard for an exciting and meaningful career in global financial markets.  

As a graduate, you will join the Data and Analytics Division. The division is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where instant reaction and long-term vision are equally important.  

Our Data & Analytics is one of the world’s largest providers of financial data and infrastructure. With over 40,000 customers and 400,000 end users, spanning over approximately 190 markets, Data & Analytics partners with the global financial community supplying extensive, quality data, news, information and analytics that inform investment decisions. 

We are the #1 supplier of real-time market data to the global financial and investor community, carrying up to 176 billion market messages, from over 150,000 data sources every day.  

This dynamic business offers graduates opportunities in London to join Data and Analytics and be aligned to Analytics or Data and Feeds. To allow us to place you in the right area we will get to know your skills and interest and how they align with the needs of the business.

To be eligible you must be a graduate who has completed your studies in 2026 or a final year undergraduate or Master’s student and have completed all the requirements of your course before summer 2027.

Highlights of the Graduate Programme  

Progress through a 12-month development journey aiming to build foundational skills that are key for your future success Build your foundational knowledge of LSEG, Financial Markets and the business during your global induction Divisional-led inductions to immerse graduates into the business through team-led overviews and introductions Participate in group projects which are aligned to LSEG goals Meet in person with your cohort at ‘Ignite’, the programme mid-point skills offsite. Explore key knowledge areas and skills Access opportunities to earn industry recognized qualifications, including 5 study days during programme Connect with global early careers community and opportunities and contribute to wider society via CSR initiatives and volunteering opportunities  

Our graduates join us on a permanent basis, and from day one you will be aligned to Data and Analytics, which will allow you to develop within a secure framework.

 

What we are looking for: 

We are passionate about recruiting people who have a genuine curiosity for Data, who want to understand the full breadth of our organisation, how it fits together, how it functions – and are interested in playing a part of our development, as it grows and diversifies. 

You should have a demonstrable interest in financial markets, which you’ve built through your studies, work experience or extracurricular activities.  A curiosity for data and an ability to analyse information to draw conclusions and propose solutions.  Customer centric and product led mindsetIndividuals who are able to connect the dots and think strategically.   The environment we work in is fast paced, you’ll need to demonstrate focus, resilience and the flexibility to adapt to changing demands.  People who can collaborate with others, using their strong communication skills in the process.  Ideal candidates will have the rights to work in the US without restrictions for the duration of the graduate programme and join us on a permanent basis.   

You will stand out to us if you can demonstrate and recognise that what you achieve is equally important as how you achieve it. 

 

Application close: 28 November, however we recommend an early application because we consider candidates on a rolling basis. Due to the volume of applications, we might close the applications earlier, so we recommend an early application.  

Recruitment Process:

The first stage of the recruitment process involves making an application and submitting your resume. The next stage of the application process is an untimed Immersive Online Assessment. The assessment is designed to give you an insight into what it’s like to work at LSEG. The second stage is a video interview where you will answer a series of questions using a strength-based-interview style The final stage is a half day assessment centre which involves several different types of exercises – further information is provided at the point of invite.  

  

Please review all the graduate programme opportunities and make one application. If you make more than one application, we will review your first application only.

Please note, all our assessment centres are held virtually.

 

At LSEG, we provide our employees with a comprehensive benefits portfolio as part of a competitive total rewards package. Our benefit plans are designed to supplement the financial, emotional and physical wellbeing of our employees and their families at all stages of their life. We encourage an appreciative, collaborative and inclusive culture that promotes employee and organisational wellbeing.  

We believe in remunerating our people with a variety of attractive benefits such as:  

Emotional Wellbeing: Annual wellness allowance; Employee assistance programme  Physical Wellbeing: Private Medical Insurance; Optional dental Insurance; Gym membership & discounts  Financial Wellbeing: Life Insurance; Income protection; Pension  Other benefits: MyOffers: access to a range of retail discounts  

We believe hybrid working makes more possible and recognise difference as a good thing. We want to set everyone up to bring their best self to work. Everyone will spend time with colleagues in the office (3 days), but you’ll be trusted to work flexibly, in a way that delivers excellence. 

Career Stage:

Associate

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

Start your career with a global, employee-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one.

Job Description
Help Shape Healthier Futures
At Mott MacDonald, we believe that better health outcomes create stronger communities, more resilient societies, and brighter futures for everyone. As a Graduate Health Consultant, you'll have the opportunity to work on projects that make a genuine difference to people's lives, helping healthcare organisations improve services, deliver transformational change, and achieve better outcomes for the populations they serve.

Whether supporting the delivery of major healthcare programmes, helping organisations develop future strategies, or improving the way health and care services are planned and delivered, you'll contribute to projects with a clear social purpose and lasting impact.

Joining our Healthcare Consulting team means becoming part of a collaborative, supportive, and diverse community of professionals who are passionate about improving health and care systems. You'll be encouraged to bring your ideas, learn from experienced colleagues, and develop the skills and confidence to become a trusted consultant of the future.

The Opportunity
As a Graduate Health Consultant, you'll work alongside experienced consultants, clinicians, public sector leaders, and multidisciplinary teams to help health and care organisations solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful change.

From your first day, you'll be involved in real projects that help improve healthcare services and patient outcomes. You'll gain valuable experience across a wide range of assignments while developing an understanding of the health and care sector, public policy, organisational transformation, and programme delivery.

With structured training, mentoring, and hands-on project experience, you'll build both your technical and professional skills in an environment that supports continuous learning and development.

What You'll Do
As part of our Healthcare Consulting team, you'll contribute to a variety of health and healthcare-focused projects and programmes. Your responsibilities may include:
Supporting healthcare organisations to design and deliver improvements that enhance outcomes for patients, service users, and communities.Carrying out research and analysis to help inform strategic decisions and evidence-based recommendations.Gathering, interpreting, and presenting data to identify insights, opportunities, and areas for improvement.Supporting stakeholder engagement activities, helping to bring together diverse perspectives and build consensus around shared goals.Assisting with workshops, presentations, and collaborative sessions with clients and project teams.Contributing to reports, business cases, strategies, and implementation plans that support positive change.Working with colleagues to develop innovative solutions that improve organisational performance and service delivery.Supporting the development of proposals and contributing to winning new opportunities that expand our impact within the health sector.Building your knowledge of healthcare systems, policy developments, and emerging trends affecting the future of health and care.Contributing to the day-to-day operations of the team and actively participating in team meetings, learning opportunities, and knowledge-sharing activities.

Why This Role Matters
Health and care organisations are facing increasing challenges, from changing population needs and workforce pressures to technological transformation and the drive for greater sustainability and efficiency.

As a Graduate Health Consultant, you'll help organisations navigate these challenges and create solutions that:
Improve patient experiences and health outcomes.Support more efficient and effective healthcare delivery.Enable healthcare organisations to adapt and innovate.Strengthen services for communities and future generations.Deliver positive social impact through meaningful and sustainable change.

Your work will contribute to projects that help improve lives and support healthier communities across the UK and beyond.

Candidate Specification
At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.

To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience (excluding placements) and have a bachelors degree (obtained no earlier than 2025) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines: 
Health ManagementHealthcare LeadershipPublic HealthHealth PolicySocial SciencesEconomicsGeographyPsychologyBusiness ManagementPoliticsLife SciencesOr a related discipline

This opportunity will require you to be eligible to achieve security clearance.  Security clearance is dictated by the types of projects we work on and normally requires you to be a UK British national or lived in the UK for five years or more.  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.

We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:
Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently. Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues. Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity. Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving. 

UK Immigration
Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024. 

Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.

We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

AI Usage
At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

Accessibility 
We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

About Your Development
A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

Our social side
Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in. 

From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.

It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.  
Agile working 
At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well-being, flexibility, and trust.

Equality, diversity, and inclusion 
We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels they can contribute.

We offer some fantastic benefits including:
Financial wellbeing
Biannual salary reviews: We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.We match employee pension contributions between 4.5% and 7%.Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long-term illness or injury.Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.

Employee Ownership
Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long-term impact and contribution.Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.

Health and wellbeing
Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.

Lifestyle

Enhanced family and carers leave
Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.

Learning and development

Networks, communities, and social outcomes

rows.title: Associate Pricing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
ClarusONE Sourcing Services, LLP, provides strategic generic pharmaceutical services for both Walmart Stores, Inc. and McKesson Corporation. Its’ mission is to enable access to affordable medicines, which it has successfully been doing since its inception in 2016.

ClarusONE is a joint venture between Walmart and McKesson, two of the top 10 biggest corporations in the USA, according to the Fortune 500 list. They have more than two decades of history working together to improve the quality and lower the cost of pharmaceutical care to patients. This partnership leverages McKesson’s demonstrated strength and expertise in global pharmaceutical sourcing in conjunction with Walmart’s strength and commitment to delivering leading health and wellness services to their customers.

ClarusONE Sourcing Services is headquartered in London and prides itself on its can-do attitude that has ensured millions of Americans pay less when buying generic pharmaceuticals every day.

About the Role: 

The Associate Pricing Analyst will support the Pricing & Commercial Operations Lead and act as a central analytical and commercial resource for pricing across the Sourcing organisation. The role will combine accurate execution of pricing activity with proactive identification, analysis and delivery of pricing opportunities across suppliers, products and sourcing programmes.

The Pricing Analyst will evaluate supplier pricing behaviour, market dynamics, pricing-rule adherence and member economics to identify commercial risks and value opportunities. The role will develop fact-based supplier negotiation strategies, lead defined pricing discussions within agreed authority levels, and support broader initiatives to strengthen pricing consistency, supplier accountability and commercial outcomes.

The position will also contribute to the continued development of ClarusONE’s pricing framework, analytics capabilities and supplier-management approach, helping ensure that pricing rules remain commercially effective, operationally practical and aligned with member objectives.

What You'll Do: 

Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers and key stakeholders to support commercial objectives.Prepare negotiation strategies through analysis of historical pricing, market intelligence, supplier performance, and commercial benchmarks.Conduct detailed pricing, spend, and market analysis to identify cost-saving opportunities, commercial risks, and value creation initiatives.Monitor supplier pricing trends, market dynamics, inflationary pressures, and competitive movements to support sourcing and procurement strategies.Develop analytical models and reporting to assess pricing performance, supplier behaviour, and category-level opportunities.Own or support cross-functional pricing projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, implementation and benefit tracking.Develop regular reporting that distinguishes submitted activity from value influenced or delivered by the pricing function.Produce regular reporting on pricing trends, savings delivery, supplier performance, and procurement initiatives.Measure and communicate the financial impact of projects, negotiations, and process improvements.Develop supplier scorecards and performance metrics to evaluate commercial performance, responsiveness, reliability, and compliance.Monitor supplier activity and identify indicators of commercial risk, value leakage, or performance concerns.


Basic Requirements:

Typically, minimum 0-2 years of relevant experience. May have degree or equivalent.Experience in pricing, commercial analytics, strategic sourcing, finance and/or supplier management.Demonstrated ability to convert complex datasets into commercial actions and recommendations.Experience preparing for or participating in supplier or customer negotiations.Experience assessing financial impact, constructing commercial scenarios and tracking realised value.Pharmaceutical, healthcare distribution, procurement or generic-drug market experience preferred.Experience delivering analytical or process-improvement projects across multiple function.


Preferred Skills/Experience: 

Strong commercial judgement and ability to recognise value opportunities beyond basic rule compliance.Advanced Excel capability and working knowledge of BI, dashboarding or analytical tools.Ability to analyse pricing at product, family, supplier and portfolio levels.Confident presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.Effective negotiation, influencing and challenge skills.Ability to operate within legal, contractual and confidentiality guardrails when providing supplier pricing guidance. Existing guidance materials specifically emphasise avoiding disclosure of one supplier’s pricing or how guidance was derived.Ability to balance member economics, sourcing strategy, supplier relationships, compliance and operational feasibility.Strong project management skills, including ownership of milestones, risks, benefits and stakeholder actions.


Physical Requirements: 

This is a Hybrid role in London, GBR. Candidate will be required to be onsite 2 days per week. This role is Fixed Term (12 months). 


McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson job postings are posted on our career site: careers.mckesson.com.

About The One Nine Three GroupThe One Nine Three Group (193) is a boutique advisory firm that protects and strengthens the reputations of businesses and their leaders. Our clients include some of the world’s most recognised organisations across a variety of sectors. 193 is wholly owned by its founders, Zach Siegel and Matthew Freud.
Since our founding in 2019, 193 has earned recognition as a leading reputation management adviser, known for our expertise in corporate and financial communications. We're now entering our next phase of growth and building the right team to match our ambitions. 
193 sits within the Freuds Group building on Stephen Street in London, exposing our team to some of the world's most creative consumer, technology, sport, and lifestyle communications specialists, with an art collection to match, every day. Our New York office sits on Manhattan’s fabled Madison Avenue, surrounded by many of the world’s leading financial institutions, businesses and media organisations, some of whom we are proud to call our clients.
193 is part of Freuds Group, an affiliation of strategy, creative, and content agencies founded by Matthew Freud in 1985.
Position Summary193 recently launched an intelligence function that will be staffed by a newly created Analyst role. The Analyst determines what is moving markets and why, then turns that into potential opportunities and identified emerging risks for our clients. The new function will also support day-to-day client work, new business mapping, and analysis for the team.
Each Analyst will be responsible for a portfolio of target sectors and companies, and prepare briefings on what is likely to move markets and why, what is as actionable for clients, and where risks may be emerging . The remit will span financial markets, politics, regulation, and consumer and social trends, with the best Analysts able to connect the dots across them.
Training will be provided, making this role a natural first step for those coming from graduate programmes or master’s degrees. Responsibility will start from day one: what an Analyst identifies, and how they frame it, will directly inform the advice 193 gives some of the world's most recognised businesses and largest pools of private capital.
ResponsibilitiesResearch a portfolio of companies, sectors, competitors, and stakeholders relevant to client accounts and 193 activities.Monitor financial markets, business news, politics, regulation, and consumer and social trends, and identify what connects them for clients.Lead daily briefings for client teams covering what is moving the market and why, what qualifies as actionable intelligence for clients, and what looks like an emerging risk to clients.Build and maintain systems for tracking relevant news and information, using AI tools where appropriate.Use 193's data tools to assess corporate reputation and flag reputational and regulatory risks facing clients early.Produce peer analysis and other research to support investor relations assignments.Contribute research to new business pitches and other firmwide projects.
QualificationsExperience or education in analytics, business, politics, international affairs, languages, psychology, or a comparable field, with training provided to bridge into financial communications.A dynamic thinker who spots patterns as they emerge and turns them into intelligence our clients and our business can use.Knowledge of business, financial markets, politics, and current events, and a genuine interest in corporate affairs and business decision making.Strong research and analytical skills, and clear written and verbal communication.Comfort using AI tools for research and analysis, and an appetite for learning new technologies and proprietary tools.Strong organisation and attention to detail across multiple accounts and deadlines.
