rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Stagwell is a global challenger network built to transform marketing through technology, creativity, data, and artificial intelligence.

Enterprise AI Solutions is a strategic growth initiative focused on helping organizations deploy and operationalize AI-powered solutions across marketing, customer experience, data, analytics, and business operations.

As organizations move from AI experimentation to enterprise-wide adoption, Stagwell helps customers integrate data, technology, workflows, and AI capabilities into scalable operating models that deliver measurable business impact.

Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly technical, customer-facing AI Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with organizations as they deploy and scale AI-powered solutions.

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer serves as a forward-deployed partner to enterprise customers, working directly with stakeholders to understand business challenges, design practical AI solutions, drive implementation, and ensure successful operational adoption.

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, solution architecture skills, business acumen, and a builder mentality. They enjoy solving complex problems, navigating ambiguity, and working directly with customers to turn AI concepts into deployed solutions that drive measurable outcomes.

Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to move beyond recommendations into execution. This is a highly hands-on individual contributor role that works closely with enterprise customers, internal sales teams, product teams, and delivery teams to help customers become successful with AI. The initial focus of this role will be supporting Stagwell's enterprise AI application suite, including Stagwell Agentic Targeting System (SATS) Powered by Palantir and Stagwell Pulse Powered by Palantir, working closely with customers to drive successful deployment, adoption, and business outcomes.

 Partner With Customers and Sales Teams 

 Work directly with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, data environments, and AI transformation priorities.  Partner closely with sales teams throughout the customer lifecycle, from discovery and demos through deployment and adoption.  Support customer meetings, technical discovery sessions, solution workshops, and executive presentations.  Help sales teams tell the AI story through customer-specific scenarios, demonstrations, and solution positioning.  Serve as a trusted advisor to both customer stakeholders and internal go-to-market teams.  Support customer onboarding, adoption efforts, and ongoing technical success initiatives. 

 Design & Deploy AI Solutions 

 Architect practical AI-powered solutions that address real business challenges.  Translate customer requirements into deployable solution designs.  Build customer-specific use cases, workflows, and AI-powered business scenarios.  Develop and validate proof-of-concepts, pilot programs, and production-ready solutions.  Configure, optimize, and operationalize AI solutions within customer environments.  Partner with technical teams to accelerate implementation and adoption.  Help customers establish repeatable AI-enabled workflows and operating models. 

 Lead Enterprise AI Deployments 

 Own implementation efforts from discovery through deployment.  Facilitate technical workshops, solution working sessions, and implementation planning.  Support customer onboarding, technical validation, testing, and rollout activities.  Navigate technical, operational, and organizational obstacles to ensure successful execution.  Drive cross-functional alignment between business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners.  Ensure successful transition from pilot programs to production deployments. 

 Work With Customer Data and Business Processes 

 Translate customer business requirements into data models, workflows, and AI-enabled use cases.  Help map customer processes, data flows, audience structures, and operational requirements.  Work through customer data requests, integrations, and implementation considerations.  Support Palantir Ontology development, workflow design, and solution mapping activities.  Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows through AI, automation, analytics, and data-driven decision making.  Collaborate with customer teams to operationalize solutions within existing business processes. 

 Solve Complex Problems 

 Work directly with customer stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value.  Rapidly evaluate new use cases and determine practical implementation approaches.  Troubleshoot solution gaps, workflow challenges, and adoption barriers.  Iterate quickly based on customer feedback and evolving business requirements.  Help customers move from experimentation to enterprise-scale adoption.  Balance technical constraints, business priorities, and customer goals to drive successful outcomes. 

 Shape the Future of Enterprise AI Solutions 

 Surface emerging customer needs, market trends, and solution opportunities.  Contribute to reusable frameworks, playbooks, demo environments, and implementation methodologies.  Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through direct customer engagement.  Help establish best practices for enterprise AI deployment across Stagwell.  Support the development of repeatable deployment and onboarding programs.  Share learnings that improve how Enterprise AI Solutions engages customers and scales delivery. 

What Success Looks Like

 Enterprise AI solutions successfully deployed within customer environments.  Customers achieve measurable operational and business outcomes through AI adoption.  AI use cases move from proof-of-concept to production implementation.  Sales teams are enabled with stronger demonstrations, customer scenarios, and technical support.  Customer data requirements and business processes are successfully translated into working solutions.  Strong executive and practitioner relationships are established across customer organizations.  Repeatable deployment methodologies and implementation frameworks are created and scaled.  Stagwell becomes a trusted partner for organizations navigating enterprise AI transformation. 

Qualifications

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with AI, machine learning, customer intelligence, marketing technology, customer data platforms, analytics, or enterprise software ecosystems. Familiarity with marketing technology workflows and processes is strongly preferred.  Experience supporting technical sales motions, customer demonstrations, onboarding programs, and solution adoption efforts.  Familiarity with Palantir Ontology concepts, customer data models, workflow mapping, audience activation, marketing measurement, and enterprise data architectures.  Experience supporting Fortune 1000 organizations and large-scale transformation initiatives.  Understanding of generative AI, agentic AI systems, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI deployment models.  Experience working with marketing, media, customer experience, analytics, or growth teams. 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in New York City for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This role includes commission-based incentive compensation.

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

rows.title: Data Engineer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About Qualitate

Qualitate is building the AI-native continuous intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI-moderated interviews and insight synthesis, replacing weeks of manual research with high output signal in hours.

Primary research remains slow and transactional for everyone involved. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling calls, and synthesizing fragmented insights. Experts face repetitive outreach, screener calls, schedule wrangling, and one-off engagements that offer them little control or lasting value.

Qualitate transforms this experience with an AI-native expert network platform that gives participants the flexibility to contribute on their own time while enabling research at unprecedented scale. Qualitate’s AI Moderator conducts thousands of conversations with experts each month, capturing forward-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real-time ROI signals. Our continuous intelligence platform then turns these conversations into quantified, time-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms.

The Role

Qualitate is building the primary research layer for investors and corporate strategy teams. Our AI interviews experts, turns those conversations into structured intelligence, and delivers it to the funds and companies acting on it. Next, we're turning that into an always-on intelligence platform. Customers will bring their own proprietary data alongside ours, and AI agents will run research workflows end to end.

All of that runs on data, and as our first dedicated Data Engineer, you'll own it. You'll build the pipelines that feed our AI moderator, the models that turn thousands of expert conversations into structured, searchable insights, and the systems that will let customers plug their own data into Qualitate. You'll work closely with Applied AI, Market Research, and Engineering, but the architecture decisions are yours. Our clients make investment decisions on this data, so accuracy isn't a feature. It's the product. You'll set that bar and shape how data works at Qualitate for years to come.

What You’ll Own

Build and maintain data pipelines. Design ETL/ELT processes that ingest unstructured data, quantitative metrics, 3rd party datasets into our core systems.Design data models and data systems. Build and evolve data models across relational and non-relational systems. You'll work with structured application data in relational databases alongside unstructured data stored in S3 and indexed in semantic search engines.Build AI-powered data enrichment pipelines. Use LLMs and other AI systems to extract structured information from unstructured data, classify and enrich records, and integrate AI-generated outputs into reliable production data workflows and evaluation systems.Own data quality end-to-end. Build automated QA checks, monitoring, and alerting to catch anomalies before they become client-facing problems.Partner cross-functionally. Work directly with Research, Applied AI, and Engineering to define schemas, data contracts, and reporting needs as new features are shipped.Document as you build. Maintain clear data lineage, schema documentation, and runbooks — you're building the systems, so you're setting the data foundation of the company.

Who This Role Is For

You're strong in SQL. You can write complex, performant queries against relational datasets and understand how to reason about data at scale.You're a capable software engineer. You have experience with either TypeScript or Python and can write production-quality code for automation, data pipelines, integrations, and internal tooling.You can build robust data integrations. You can work with APIs, databases, files, and other external data sources and build reliable ingestion processes around authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental extraction, retries, schema changes, and error handling.Research and integrate third-party datasets. Research and evaluate company identifiers, entity-matching strategies, corporate hierarchies, subsidiaries, acquisitions, and build reliable processes to map and reconcile these entities across different data sources.You can work across different types of data. You're comfortable with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and understand the tradeoffs between relational databases, object storage, search/indexing systems, and analytical data stores.You'll work with our current stack and help shape what comes next. You will help maintain our TypeScript pipelines running on scheduled jobs and Postgres-native queues, S3 for object storage, and AWS Bedrock for retrieval. Experience with a modern warehouse and transformation stack (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt, Airflow) is a plus.You're comfortable with ambiguity. Early-stage data infrastructure is messy — you're energized by building order out of that, not frustrated by it.

What Sets You Apart

Prior experience in data engineering for a technology startup, ideally in fintechYou've been early on the engineering team at a company and helped build the function from scratch — not just used tools others built.Exposure to LLM-driven data pipelines (labeling, moderation, quality scoring) is a strong plus.You've worked in market research, expert networks, or financial services and understand the data integrity bar those industries demand.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $170-200K depending on experience.Bonus: Eligible for cash bonus tied to individual and company performanceEquity: Meaningful early-stage grant with upside tied to company growth.Benefits: Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays.Location: Full-time, in-person in New York City.

What to Expect Working at Qualitate

Excellence. You'll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact.High velocity. Fast-paced work environment in terms of growth, decision making, and time to impact.High agency. Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out.Shared ambition. A small, early team disrupting the multi-billion dollar market research industry with AI.Joy. We work hard and genuinely enjoy working with each other. Dedication to our work is matched only by our passion for fostering an enjoyable, collaborative work environment.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Stagwell is a global challenger network built to transform marketing through technology, creativity, data, and artificial intelligence.

Enterprise AI Solutions is a strategic growth initiative focused on helping organizations deploy and operationalize AI-powered solutions across marketing, customer experience, data, analytics, and business operations.

As organizations move from AI experimentation to enterprise-wide adoption, Stagwell helps customers integrate data, technology, workflows, and AI capabilities into scalable operating models that deliver measurable business impact.

Responsibilities

We are seeking a highly technical, customer-facing AI Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with organizations as they deploy and scale AI-powered solutions.

The AI Forward Deployed Engineer serves as a forward-deployed partner to enterprise customers, working directly with stakeholders to understand business challenges, design practical AI solutions, drive implementation, and ensure successful operational adoption.

The ideal candidate combines technical expertise, solution architecture skills, business acumen, and a builder mentality. They enjoy solving complex problems, navigating ambiguity, and working directly with customers to turn AI concepts into deployed solutions that drive measurable outcomes.

Success in this role requires a strong sense of ownership and a willingness to move beyond recommendations into execution. This is a highly hands-on individual contributor role that works closely with enterprise customers, internal sales teams, product teams, and delivery teams to help customers become successful with AI. The initial focus of this role will be supporting Stagwell's enterprise AI application suite, including Stagwell Agentic Targeting System (SATS) Powered by Palantir and Stagwell Pulse Powered by Palantir, working closely with customers to drive successful deployment, adoption, and business outcomes.

 Partner With Customers and Sales Teams 

 Work directly with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, operational challenges, data environments, and AI transformation priorities.  Partner closely with sales teams throughout the customer lifecycle, from discovery and demos through deployment and adoption.  Support customer meetings, technical discovery sessions, solution workshops, and executive presentations.  Help sales teams tell the AI story through customer-specific scenarios, demonstrations, and solution positioning.  Serve as a trusted advisor to both customer stakeholders and internal go-to-market teams.  Support customer onboarding, adoption efforts, and ongoing technical success initiatives. 

 Design & Deploy AI Solutions 

 Architect practical AI-powered solutions that address real business challenges.  Translate customer requirements into deployable solution designs.  Build customer-specific use cases, workflows, and AI-powered business scenarios.  Develop and validate proof-of-concepts, pilot programs, and production-ready solutions.  Configure, optimize, and operationalize AI solutions within customer environments.  Partner with technical teams to accelerate implementation and adoption.  Help customers establish repeatable AI-enabled workflows and operating models. 

 Lead Enterprise AI Deployments 

 Own implementation efforts from discovery through deployment.  Facilitate technical workshops, solution working sessions, and implementation planning.  Support customer onboarding, technical validation, testing, and rollout activities.  Navigate technical, operational, and organizational obstacles to ensure successful execution.  Drive cross-functional alignment between business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners.  Ensure successful transition from pilot programs to production deployments. 

 Work With Customer Data and Business Processes 

 Translate customer business requirements into data models, workflows, and AI-enabled use cases.  Help map customer processes, data flows, audience structures, and operational requirements.  Work through customer data requests, integrations, and implementation considerations.  Support Palantir Ontology development, workflow design, and solution mapping activities.  Identify opportunities to improve customer workflows through AI, automation, analytics, and data-driven decision making.  Collaborate with customer teams to operationalize solutions within existing business processes. 

 Solve Complex Problems 

 Work directly with customer stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can create measurable business value.  Rapidly evaluate new use cases and determine practical implementation approaches.  Troubleshoot solution gaps, workflow challenges, and adoption barriers.  Iterate quickly based on customer feedback and evolving business requirements.  Help customers move from experimentation to enterprise-scale adoption.  Balance technical constraints, business priorities, and customer goals to drive successful outcomes. 

 Shape the Future of Enterprise AI Solutions 

 Surface emerging customer needs, market trends, and solution opportunities.  Contribute to reusable frameworks, playbooks, demo environments, and implementation methodologies.  Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through direct customer engagement.  Help establish best practices for enterprise AI deployment across Stagwell.  Support the development of repeatable deployment and onboarding programs.  Share learnings that improve how Enterprise AI Solutions engages customers and scales delivery. 

What Success Looks Like

 Enterprise AI solutions successfully deployed within customer environments.  Customers achieve measurable operational and business outcomes through AI adoption.  AI use cases move from proof-of-concept to production implementation.  Sales teams are enabled with stronger demonstrations, customer scenarios, and technical support.  Customer data requirements and business processes are successfully translated into working solutions.  Strong executive and practitioner relationships are established across customer organizations.  Repeatable deployment methodologies and implementation frameworks are created and scaled.  Stagwell becomes a trusted partner for organizations navigating enterprise AI transformation. 

Qualifications

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with AI, machine learning, customer intelligence, marketing technology, customer data platforms, analytics, or enterprise software ecosystems. Familiarity with marketing technology workflows and processes is strongly preferred.  Experience supporting technical sales motions, customer demonstrations, onboarding programs, and solution adoption efforts.  Familiarity with Palantir Ontology concepts, customer data models, workflow mapping, audience activation, marketing measurement, and enterprise data architectures.  Experience supporting Fortune 1000 organizations and large-scale transformation initiatives.  Understanding of generative AI, agentic AI systems, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI deployment models.  Experience working with marketing, media, customer experience, analytics, or growth teams. 

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in New York City for this role is $160,000 - $200,000. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This role includes commission-based incentive compensation.

In addition to medical, dental and vision coverage, we offer a generous PTO plan, 401k program, comprehensive family planning benefits (including paid parental leave), tuition reimbursement, and pre-tax commuter benefits. Benefits/perks may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Stagwell and the location where you work.

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
About the Company
OneTrack connects systems of record with places of action. We deploy AI for the companies that run the physical economy. Our platform, OneTrack AiOn, connects business systems, operational data, and company knowledge so teams can build applications, answer complex questions, and automate work across their organization. 
Today, we partner with some of the largest companies in logistics and manufacturing, including clients like Church & Dwight, Ecolab, The Wonderful Company, CJ Logistics, Ryder, GXO, and many others. Some clients deploy AiOn using their existing software and data. Others combine it with OneTrack’s sensors and computer vision to connect what happens on the floor with what lives in their systems.

About the Role
We’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with clients and turn that capability into everyday practice. You’ll work alongside frontline teams, operations leaders, analysts, and IT to understand how their business runs, identify valuable problems, and build solutions that become part of how they operate. You’ll own the path from an ambiguous business problem to a working deployment: understanding the workflow, connecting the data, validating the logic, shipping the solution, and helping people use it successfully.

Responsibilities
Embed with client teams. Spend time on site and in their working routines. Learn how decisions get made, where work gets stuck, and which problems are worth solving first. Turn those findings into a deployment plan with clear owners and measurable outcomes.Connect and make sense of their data. Work with client IT and data owners to bring together ERP, warehouse and labor management systems, data warehouses, APIs, spreadsheets, and documents. Resolve inconsistent identifiers, unclear definitions, and data quality issues.Teach AiOn how the business works. Capture the client's terminology, processes, relationships, and operating rules as reusable knowledge and skills. Translate agreed calculations into tested procedures so teams get consistent, trustworthy results.Build applications and automations. Use AiOn’s tools and write code where needed to deliver dashboards, operational apps, recurring analyses, alerts, and agent workflows. Carry solutions through testing, rollout, troubleshooting, and ongoing refinement.Deploy with and without sensors. Deliver value from existing business data alone. When a use case benefits from physical visibility, partner with OneTrack’s hardware and field teams to incorporate sensor events, telemetry, and vision insights.Establish permissions and ownership. Work with clients to define who can access data, approve actions, maintain business context, and own each workflow. Validate that the deployment behaves correctly for different users and sites.Build client capability. Run working sessions, train internal champions, and build the first use cases alongside the people who will own them. Help clients develop the confidence and skills to build the next ones themselves.Improve the product through field experience. Bring clear problem statements, reproducible issues, and reusable solutions back to engineering and product. Help turn successful deployments into patterns that work across clients.

Responsibilities - What you might work on
Combine warehouse and labor data into a daily performance workflow that highlights exceptions and gives supervisors a consistent basis for action.Connect ERP and transportation data to reconcile freight spend and investigate discrepancies.Turn a spreadsheet process into a shared application with validated calculations, permissions, and scheduled updates.Combine sensor observations with operational records to support safety coaching, investigate damage, or understand lost capacity.Help an analytics team build its first AiOn applications, then establish the knowledge and ownership needed to expand across departments.

Required Skills - What you bring
Experience delivering software, data systems, or technical implementations that people rely on in production.Strong Python and SQL skills, comfort working with APIs and data pipelines, and the ability to debug across unfamiliar systems.The ability to turn an open-ended business problem into a practical technical solution, explain the tradeoffs, and ship it.Strong client communication. You can work through a data issue with an engineer, understand a supervisor’s daily routine, and explain progress to an executive.Good judgment about data quality, access controls, testing, and reliability. You verify that calculations and AI outputs hold up against source data and actual business practice.Comfort building with AI tools and reviewing the code and outputs they produce.Ownership and persistence when requirements are incomplete, systems are messy, or adoption takes more work than expected.Willingness to travel and work alongside clients at their facilities.

Preferred Skills - Helpful experience
Logistics, warehousing, manufacturing, agriculture, transportation, or other physical operations.Enterprise implementations involving ERP, WMS, LMS, TMS, or business intelligence systems (PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, etc.) Building LLM applications, tool integrations, evaluations, or automated workflows.Frontend, backend, basic cloud infrastructure, or similar full-stack application development.IoT, computer vision, or operational telemetry.Training users and leading changes to established ways of working.

Pay range and compensation package
$100,000-$150,000PTO, healthcare, performance-based compensation, and other benefits
Frequent travel to clients across North America

Responsibilities - What success looks like
Clients use what you build in their daily work. They trust the numbers, understand the controls, and can point to improvements such as less manual reporting, faster investigations, fewer unresolved exceptions, or better use of operational capacity. Their internal champions can extend the deployment, and your field experience makes the next client implementation better. You’ll have direct ownership of meaningful client problems and a close connection to the engineers building the platform. The work will take you from a conversation on the warehouse floor to a data model, from a prototype to a production workflow, and from one successful use case to adoption across an organization.

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

About The Opportunities

Symbotic’s Robot Perception team is an accomplished group of engineers who are working on sophisticated algorithms in areas such as perception and computer vision.

Bot Perception interns will evaluate and propose new projects for replacing legacy tools with vision-based algorithms. These interns will scope projects from literature review, to dataset design and aggregation, training pipeline development, all the way through production deployment. Practical projects include vision-based collision avoidance. SLAM interns will develop and test algorithms for robust robot localization in complex, real-world environments, applying sensor fusion, state estimation, and probabilistic methods to solve SLAM challenges at scale.Industrial Vision interns will evaluate and enhance computer vision pipelines for accurate pose estimation of goods packaging in adapter cells using traditional and Machine Learning CV models.

What You’ll Do

Research and experiment with traditional computer vision methods and deep learning methods for object detection, classification, segmentation, pose estimation, anomaly detection on images or videos.Evaluate and benchmark computer vision methods on production data.Deploy software to production on robot hardware.Design data pre and post processing methods.Document designs, code, experiments, evaluations.Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics softwareAdapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems.Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms.Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues.

What You’ll Need

Pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.Proficiency in Python and/or C++, including experience writing code and working in Jupyter notebooks.Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Familiarity with computer vision and perception tools such as OpenCV, including image classification, object detection, segmentation, and camera calibration.Exposure to robotics perception concepts such as sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D pose representations, coordinate transforms, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian inference.Working knowledge of sensors, including RGB cameras, 3D sensors, and point cloud processing tools such as PCL.Experience working in Linux environments and using command-line tools.Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, REST APIs, and/or SQL-based data tools such as Snowflake.Exposure to deployment or optimization tools such as Docker, ROS/ROS 2, Jetson, ONNX, VLMs, or Vision-Language-Action models is a plus.

What’s Good To Have

Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) 

Our Environment 

Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.



About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information.

The base range for this position in the posted location is $32.00 - $44.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.

rows.descriptionText:
At Constant Contact, we are seriously awesome people who take ownership and make an impact by operating with the mindset, integrity and courage of a small business owner. There’s something so profoundly rewarding about knowing that your work is empowering people everywhere to pursue their dreams. Here, we all play an integral part in helping business owners, entrepreneurs, non-profits and individuals to succeed by giving them all the help and tools they need to grow online. We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

Revenue Operations Specialist

Our RevOps team is looking for a Specialist to join us in our Waltham or Boston office, and help support and scale operations across our Go-To-Market organization.

A successful Revenue Operations Specialist will combine strong analytical skills, systems knowledge, and operational problem-solving to make our revenue teams more efficient and effective. In this role, you will partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Enablement, and other GTM teams to improve processes, build scalable solutions, maintain high-quality data, and turn business needs into effective operational workflows. You will have the opportunity to grow your technical and analytical capabilities while contributing directly to initiatives that impact how our revenue organization operates.

What You'll Do:

Support cross-functional Revenue Operations initiatives by gathering requirements, analyzing existing processes, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping implement scalable solutions across the GTM organization.Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Enablement, and other stakeholders to translate business needs into clear operational and system requirements.Build and maintain Salesforce configurations, including flows, validation rules, assignment logic, reports, dashboards, and other enhancements across the Salesforce ecosystem.Support the implementation of new GTM processes and business requirements, ensuring solutions align with operational goals, established processes, and key performance indicators.Support solutions through testing, deployment, and post-launch validation to ensure new processes and system enhancements work as intended and deliver the expected business outcomes.Analyze GTM and customer lifecycle data to identify trends, surface opportunities, measure performance, and provide actionable insights to business stakeholders.Build and maintain reports and dashboards that provide visibility into sales performance, customer lifecycle metrics, productivity, and operational effectiveness.Improve data quality and integrity across revenue systems by maintaining consistent data definitions, reporting logic, documentation, and governance standards.Identify and implement AI-powered solutions that automate manual processes, accelerate analysis, improve productivity, and create efficiencies across Revenue Operations and GTM workflows.Troubleshoot system and process issues, investigate root causes, and support day-to-day operational requests through JIRA or similar ticketing and work management systems.Create and maintain clear technical and process documentation for workflows, system configurations, business requirements, and operational processes.Participate in agile operating processes, including backlog refinement, prioritization, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization of Revenue Operations solutions.

Who You Are:

1–3 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations, Marketing Operations, Business Operations, or a related function.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use data to investigate business problems, identify trends, and develop actionable recommendations.Experience building reports and dashboards and translating business data into clear insights for stakeholders. Familiarity with BI or analytics tools such as Tableau is a plus.Understanding of go-to-market processes, sales metrics, and the customer lifecycle, with an interest in developing deeper expertise across the revenue organization.You bring an AI-first mindset and experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar technologies to improve analysis, documentation, problem-solving, and operational workflows.Proficiency in Excel or similar analytical toolsStrong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to gather requirements, document processes, and translate between business and technical stakeholders.Organized and detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.Curious and proactive, with a desire to develop deeper technical, analytical, and operational expertise and take on increasing ownership over time.Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Analytics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

Hands-on experience with Salesforce configuration, administration, or business process automation.Salesforce Administrator or related Salesforce certification.Experience with Customer Success, sales engagement, marketing automation, or BI platforms.Experience with lead routing, lifecycle management, pipeline processes, customer segmentation, or other GTM operational workflows.Familiarity with SQL, SOQL, APIs, integrations, or advanced data analysis tools.Experience working in an agile environment or with ticketing and project management tools such as JIRA.Experience working in a SaaS or subscription-based business.

rows.title: Global Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
H&V is a global leader in filtration and energy storage solutions. Our advanced materials are used in nearly every industry and touch every aspect of modern life. Wherever you work, live or travel, chances are an H&V solution is close by, contributing to a cleaner, healthier, more sustainable world. H&V serves the world from 13 strategically located facilities. Our footprint in the Americas, Europe and Asia lets us meet the unique requirements of global and regional customers efficiently, accurately and cost effectively, while capturing supply chain efficiencies. These advantages help make H&V a valuable partner and a true worldwide leader. Our success comes from our ability to adapt, our values and the people of H&V. We act with integrity, and we treat customers, partners and each other with dignity and respect. We live these values every day and could not have prospered for more than 200 years without them.

Summary

The Global Product Analyst (GPA) is accountable for supporting the Global Product Managers in improving global product platform profitability. They will support the GPMs in developing product line strategies, management product lifecycles, and product pricing. The GPAs will work closely with Sales, Technology, and Operations on product line optimization and complexity reduction. GPAs will manage the day to day tasks associated with new product developments, produce improvements, pricing, manufacturing location changes, capacity management, product recommendations, product sales support, and product rationalization.

Essential Functions And Responsibilities

 Supports the Global Product Managers in maximizing the profitability of the product lines P&Ls Increase product platform profitability, establish minimum pricing guidelines by application. Actively manage product lifecycles from creation through obsolescence Work closely with Sales teams to drive sales and business development. Partner with Market Strategy teams to develop benchmarking data and clarify value propositions. Manage new product development efforts and engineering change requests. Coordinate with Marketing, Technology, and Operations for new product launches. Support the GPM in developing Multi-Generational Product Plan strategies for product lines. Support Operations in capacity management and strategic expansion projects. Maintain product literature (TDS, benchmarking, product presentations, product training content) and provide source data for marketing communications and tradeshows. Keep current with applicable regulations and standards.

Education/Experience

 1 to 3 years of experience in industrial marketing, sales, product management, and product development Minimum of a BA or a BS (preferably in a technical discipline) Experience in filtration/separation strongly preferred.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Licenses, Certifications, Etc

 Pricing, segmentation, product positioning, marketing communication, and strategy development Sales and negotiation skills Financial analytics and development of business cases for justification of investments Superior written & verbal communication and presentation skills Product costing and project management skills Proficient in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word Up to 15% travel Schedule flexibility for periodic calls with global team members in other

time zones

Core Competency Requirements

The person that assumes this role must possess the following personal attributes necessary for success within H&V to meet our business objectives:

 Critical thinking – The capability to think out-of-the-box, and to develop critical questions and to identify insights by asking “the 5 whys”. Creativity and Innovation – The capacity to originate new or radical alternatives to traditional methods, approaches, and products. Influence others without authority – The capability to encourage and motivate stakeholders to invest resource into this segment and gain alignment toward a common goal. Outside-in thinking – The capability to balance outside-in and inside-out thinking (market solutions vs. products) Take measured risks – The capability and comfort level to manage ambiguity, make quantified analysis, and take measured risk when needed. Focus on 1-2 critical items – The mentality to identify and focus on the top 1-2 priorities and push them forward amid distractions. Achievement Motivation – The drive and determination to truly “win, reject average performance and set challenging goals for self and others at H&V to achieve major breakthroughs.

Hollingsworth & Vose is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

Starting salary at $70,000

Hollingsworth & Vose is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

rows.title: Business Development Specialist - Entry Level!
rows.descriptionText:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Business Development Specialist to help build and scale our outbound motion at Steer. This role is focused on uncovering lucrative new business opportunities, facilitating product demos, and guiding customers through a streamlined sales process.

This is not a passive, inbound role. You will be expected to create opportunities from scratch, navigate organizations, and develop messaging that resonates with small business owners and operators in blue-collar industries. We are looking for someone who is no stranger to overcoming obstacles and strives to exceed expectations. Come join a team where skill cultivation, career advancement, and talent retention are core values.

This is a hybrid role that begins with a three-month onsite ramp-up period at our Waltham, MA office. Once performance metrics are met, you will become eligible for a hybrid work schedule.

Compensation: $85k OTE ($60,000 base salary + commission)

You Are

A Self-Starter: You are intrinsically motivated, results-oriented, and comfortable operating in a high-volume, outbound-heavy environment.Empathetic & Professional: You are approachable and professional, with a genuine desire to help business owners achieve their goals.Resilient & Persistent: You maintain a positive attitude in the face of rejection, using setbacks as opportunities for growth and learning.A Strong Communicator: You possess a growth mindset and are self-assured in your ability to build rapport and engage in compelling, effective communication.Organized & Disciplined: You are dependable and consistent in meeting deadlines and managing your pipeline activity.Coachable: You are enthusiastic, open to feedback, and committed to continuous improvement.

You Will

Drive Outbound Growth: Conduct a high volume of calls and outreach to identify and engage decision-makers and economic buyers.Master the Product: Develop a deep understanding of our SaaS product and its features to effectively communicate value during online product demos.Consultative Selling: Employ a consultative approach to understand prospects' needs and tailor presentations to their specific pain points.Pipeline Management: Maintain meticulous records of sales activities and customer interactions in our CRM to ensure accurate forecasting.Partner for Success: Qualify opportunities and collaborate closely with the broader sales team on strategy and deal progression.

You Have

Must Have

1+ years of sales experience, specifically in outbound prospecting or business development.Proven Track Record: A history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and activity metrics.Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with comfort in phone-based outreach.Presentation Skills: Experience performing product demonstrations and consultations.Presence: Ability to commute to the Waltham, MA office.

Nice To Have

rows.title: Senior Business Operations (Stations) Intern
rows.descriptionText:
At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best-in-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. MBTA’s core values are built around safety, service, equity, sustainability, culture, and accessibility, and each employee that works for the MBTA performs their roles based on our vision, mission, and values. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.

Job Summary

The Stations, Facilities, & Structures division oversees the inspections, operations, and maintenance of all MBTA facilities, from stations to office buildings. As a graduate intern, you will support the Stations, Facilities, & Structures division in maintaining continuous improvement, focusing on user-centered, efficient, and collaborative solutions.

Example Projects May Include

Turnover Processes: Modernize procedures related to when new properties are turned over from partner departments, such as Real Estate or Capital Delivery, to Stations, Facilities, & Structures to ensure smooth transitions and that the appropriate maintenance protocols are enacted.Office Space Reservation System: Streamline access protocols and procedures to enable employees to reserve space, improving user experience, clarifying access controls, and increasing space utilization.Field Audit Processes: Develop a field audit strategy to verify the compliance and performance of third-party service providers. 

As a graduate intern, you will receive mentorship from department leadership. Working in the Stations, Facilities, & Structures division will enable you to collaborate with teams and individuals tasked with redefining how the MBTA maintains its facilities to provide superior experience for both customers and employees. We are seeking a problem solver who enjoys diving deep into challenges and wants to drive innovation within the MBTA.

We are looking to hire one (1) intern, who will work onsite (40 hours per week) for at least three (3) months.

Duties & Responsibilities

Design and lead continuous improvement projects, enabling the department to reach its strategic goals.Develop robust working relationships with a diverse set of internal and external stakeholders.Work with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams to understand implications and interpretations of underlying data and to identify opportunities for improvement.Support the department through process development, data analytics, and strategic planning.Collect qualitative and quantitative information through data sets, observations, interviews, and other methods.Map key business processes and identify areas of improvement, simplification, and cost reduction.Provide data analysis using tools, such as Excel or Tableau, to support decision-making.Develop executive and project presentations, design artifacts like process maps or user personas, and develop materials such as project plans, standard operating procedures, or other project reports.Work with key stakeholders and cross-functional teams to implement new processes.Participate in team / staff meetings, organization events, fieldwork, project teams, or other duties as needed.Additional responsibilities may include focusing on one or more departments or locations. See applicable addendums or hiring manager for department or location specific functions. Provide internal and external customers with courteous and professional experience.Perform all other duties and projects that may be assigned.

* The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe the general nature and complexity of the work being performed by staff assigned to this job and do not represent an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities required of staff assigned to this position. The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here-in are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Minimum Requirements & Qualifications

Enrolled, for entire duration of employment, in the graduate / Master’s degree program of an accredited college / university Completed some coursework, on-the-job experience, or other experiences demonstrating an interest in public transportation.  At least one year of professional experience in planning, operations, policy, engineering, or project management.  At least one year of professional experience working with tools or data that support planning, such as GIS, database management, visualization software, graphic design, etc.  Desire to help improve public transportation, because you believe in making people’s lives better.  Ability to pass writing and/or spreadsheet assessment, demonstrating skills related to the position.  Above average ability to communicate effectively in English, both in written and oral forms.  Highly organized, motivated, and have great attention-to-detail.  Strong interest in public service, transit, or transportation and how it operates.  Above average ability to work effectively in diverse, collaborative, fast-paced environments as well as independently.  Ability to independently commute to assigned work locations in the Boston, MA metro area, as required by the role.  Authorized to work in the United States (international students in CPT, STEM, or OPT programs through a university are eligible to apply). The MBTA does not provide visa sponsorship, such as H1-B status.  The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and complexity of the work being performed by staff assigned to this job and do not represent an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities required.

Job Conditions

Ability to effectively read, comprehend, communicate, and respond to instructions, orders, signs, notices, inquiries, etc. in English.Be at least eighteen (18) years of age, except if participating in an approved high school internship / co-op program.Ability to commute to assigned work locations in the Boston, MA metro area, as required by the role.Ability to provide internal and external customers with courteous and professional experiences.Ability to work effectively, independently, and as part of a diverse workforce team (or supervise, if required).Ability to uphold the rights and interests of the MBTA while building and maintaining effective relationships with employees and co-workers.Ability to adhere to rules, regulations, collective bargaining agreements (if applicable), and policies of the MBTA, including the EEO, anti-discrimination, anti-harassment, and anti-retaliation policies.Have a satisfactory work record for the two (2) years immediately prior to the closing date of this posting (unless if current student or recent graduate), including overall employment, job performance, discipline, and safety records (infractions and/or offenses occurring after the closing of the posting and before the filling of a vacancy may preclude a candidate from consideration for selection).Ability to pass a Criminal Offender Record Information (CORI) check, comprehensive background screening, and / or medical Clinic screening, potentially including physical examination and drug and alcohol screenings.Ability to work all shifts and / or locations assigned, directed, or necessary for this position, including (for some transit / operations roles) up to twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week as necessary to accommodate severe weather conditions, emergencies, or any other circumstances that may potentially impact service or the safety of service.Intern / co-op staff must be enrolled full or part-time in an accredited educational program and maintain a cumulative GPA of at least 2.5 for the entire duration of the internship / co-op. Additionally, interns / co-ops must have valid work authorization and U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting pre-employment screenings / pre-boarding, working in their positions, and throughout the duration of their program.

Disclaimers And Definitions

 General Disclaimer: The statements contained in this job description are intended to describe a summary, general nature, and complexity of typical job functions and do not represent an exhaustive list of all duties, tasks, and responsibilities required of staff assigned to this position. Application Completion: It is each applicant’s responsibility to ensure application details are entered completely and correctly, including updated work and education histories (past and current). Incomplete applications may not be considered. Attachments do not substitute for application fields. The recruitment team does not have access to existing employee data / history. Application Deadlines: Applicants should apply as soon as possible, as the MBTA may stop considering applicants after a sufficiently large applicant pool is established. Work Environment: The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here-in are representative of those an employee may encounter while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations can be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. See job description for role-specific requirements. Work Eligibility: All employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States and on an unrestricted basis. The MBTA does not have an employer work sponsorship program. However, if you have unrestricted work authorization, or are sponsored by a separate entity, you are welcome to apply. Further, all persons hired will require a U.S. Social Security Number prior to starting the position and employees will be required to complete a Form I-9 to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the U.S. Interviews: Candidates should ensure they arrive on time, are prepared, can remain for the duration, and if remote, are in a quiet place without distraction, for the interview. Candidates who do not attend their interview without advance authorization, including an email confirmation of a rescheduled time/date from Human Resources, will be considered a no-show and disqualified from consideration for the position. Related to rescheduling, on a one-time basis, and due to something emergent, you may be allowed to reschedule the interview. In addition, Human Resources may require documentation supporting the request. However, should you need to reschedule, you will need to contact your Recruiter directly by email. Safety Sensitive Positions: Employees working in this classification will be subject to periodic physical examinations plus random drug and alcohol testing. On-call or 24/7 Positions: Employees working in this classification must be available to respond to page / text / call and report to work as determined by assigned department or the Authority. Essential / Emergency Staff: During declared "states of emergency," employees working in this classification are required to report to work for their assigned work hours or as directed by management. ADA Accommodations: The MBTA makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during this process, please contact the MBTA's ADA Unit at 617-222-5751 or hradaaa@mbta.com . Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: The MBTA is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer . For terms, descriptions, and definitions related to diversity, equity, inclusion, veteran status, and immediate family members that you may find on the application form, please visit mbta.com/careers-app-definitions . Intern / Co-Op Benefits: Employees taking part in an internship or co-op at the MBTA are eligible to receive accrued paid sick leave as well as a monthly transportation pass, based on the city from which the intern / co-op commutes to work, at no cost. However, no additional benefits are currently offered for interns or co-ops.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:Performs a comprehensive docket review of assigned domestic and foreign assigned IP docket-related tasks and applies a diverse range of deadlines based on review of incoming/outgoing worldwide PTO communications, matter intake and internal requests using various software and processes under the guidance of the IP Docket Manager.Performs a comprehensive docket review of assigned USPTO Office Actions and applies updates to system and firm docket and distributes by email to the mail recipient.Reviews and processes case status updates based on routine procedures or internal task requests.Adheres to and facilitates firm compliance of established docket policies, protocols, and practices to mitigate risk without direct oversight; and under the guidance of the manager, seeks clarification of requests do not conform and as appropriate returns requests for further review and action.Provides quality assurance and system checks of docketed eOffice Actions.Performs various levels of quality assurance and system checks to identify data discrepancies.Identifies and communicates data discrepancies to IP Docket Coordinator or Manager for further review and corrective action.Remains current on rules and requirements through listserv memberships, associate notice of rule changes, research, and information obtained through the MPEP, TMEP, USPTO, WIPO, and various foreign offices, including various training sessions as directed by manager.May provide docket coverage and support during firm closures as directed by manager.May participate in pilot groups and/or user acceptance testing of newly developed or enhanced firm applications to provide feedback as requested.Adheres to established hybrid/work schedule and exercises the required flexibility to satisfy essential responsibilities and workload demands.Performs additional duties as requested or assigned.

rows.descriptionText:

rows.title: IT Service Desk Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
H&V is a global leader in filtration and energy storage solutions. Our advanced materials are used in nearly every industry and touch every aspect of modern life. Wherever you work, live or travel, chances are an H&V solution is close by, contributing to a cleaner, healthier, more sustainable world. H&V serves the world from 13 strategically located facilities. Our footprint in the Americas, Europe and Asia lets us meet the unique requirements of global and regional customers efficiently, accurately and cost effectively, while capturing supply chain efficiencies. These advantages help make H&V a valuable partner and a true worldwide leader. Our success comes from our ability to adapt, our values and the people of H&V. We act with integrity, and we treat customers, partners and each other with dignity and respect. We live these values every day and could not have prospered for more than 200 years without them.

POSITION SUMMARY: The IT Support Analyst serves as the first point of contact for employees experiencing technical issues, providing Level 1 (L1) support across identity and access management, endpoint hardware, Microsoft 365, networking, and manufacturing site systems. This role is as much about customer experience as it is technical troubleshooting — for many employees, this Analyst is their only direct interaction with IT, shaping how the organization perceives and trusts the IT function. The Analyst triages and resolves incidents and requests via the service management platform, Teams, email, walk-ups, and phone, working within a follow-the-sun team model. Success in this role requires patience, clear communication, methodical troubleshooting, and consistent follow-through until issues are fully resolved.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Serve as the first point of contact for IT requests submitted via the service management platform, Teams, email, walk-ups, or phone.Listen to understand the customer's actual problem and its impact before proposing solutions; keep customers informed throughout the resolution process and follow up to confirm the fix worked.Escalate or hand off issues cleanly, ensuring customers know what to expect and nothing is dropped.Log tickets accurately with documentation sufficient for the next IT service member to understand the issue; balance speed with thoroughness and meet team service levels.Provide L1 support for identity and access management: password resets, account unlocks, MFA/Authenticator setup and recovery, basic Active Directory tasks (account verification, group membership checks, provisioning per documented procedures), and new hire onboarding/offboarding (laptop setup, account creation/deactivation, equipment collection).Provide L1 support for endpoint and hardware issues: Windows login failures, slow performance, application crashes; laptops, desktops, docking stations, monitors, printers, scanners, and peripherals; mobile device (iOS/Android) setup and troubleshooting; deployment of approved applications and licenses.Provide L1 support for Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint access/sync/permissions issues, and conference room A/V systems.Troubleshoot VPN, wireless, and wired network connectivity; verify endpoint security status (BitLocker, antivirus) and escalate potential security issues.Maintain accurate IT asset inventory records and follow procedures for equipment lifecycle management and decommissioning.Provide onsite support for shop floor environments (PCs, terminals, barcode scanners, label printers) and triage manufacturing application issues (ERP, MES), routing them to the applications team with clear documentation.Collaborate across shifts in a follow-the-sun model, communicate handoffs clearly, and contribute solutions to the team Knowledge Base.Serve as eyes and ears for network, security, and infrastructure teams by flagging issues and gathering information to speed resolution.

Required Education & Experience

1–3 years of experience in IT support or a customer-facing technical role.Foundational knowledge of Windows client operating systems, Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint), mobile device management (iOS/Android), Active Directory basics, multi-factor authentication, endpoint security fundamentals (antivirus, encryption), and basic networking (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi).Strong customer service orientation with the patience and communication skills to work effectively with frustrated or non-technical users.Ability to troubleshoot methodically, document work clearly, and know when to escalate or ask for help.Ability to work onsite during business hours, with on-call availability for emergencies.

Preferred Qualifications

Associate's degree in IT or equivalent experience.ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A+ certification.Familiarity with manufacturing or industrial environments.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & ENVIRONMENT: The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job.

Physical Demands: The employee must be able to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer or service desk. The employee is regularly required to crouch, kneel, bend, or reach under desks and into tight spaces to connect, disconnect, or troubleshoot cables, docking stations, and hardware. The employee must be able to lift and/or move equipment weighing up to 25–35 lbs (laptops, monitors, docking stations, printers) and occasionally push or maneuver carts of equipment. Close and distance vision is required to read screens, diagnose hardware issues, and read labels/serial numbers on equipment. Manual dexterity is required for keyboard use, cable management, and hardware assembly/disassembly.

Work Environment: This role operates in a combination of standard office environments and manufacturing/shop floor settings. Onsite work in manufacturing areas may expose the employee to moderate noise levels, moving machinery, and industrial equipment; appropriate PPE (e.g., safety glasses, hearing protection) may be required in designated areas. The employee may be required to travel between buildings or sites, including outdoor walking in varying weather conditions. On-call availability for after-hours emergencies may occasionally require responding outside standard business hours.

Pay Transparency: $50,000 - 80,000 USD Annually

Hollingsworth & Vose is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

rows.title: Tenant Experience Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Synergy, a leading Boston commercial real estate firm, seeks a Tenant Experience Coordinator to support the management of an assigned portfolio of properties. This individual will perform the administrative functions of the Property Management Team assuring a high level of professionalism in property issues, including timely response to and resolution of any tenant requests or concerns.

Apply today and become part of the SignalPET AI team.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Shape the Future of Veterinary AI
At SignalPET, we're transforming veterinary medicine through artificial intelligence. Our cutting-edge technology combines computer vision, machine learning, and large language models to help veterinarians diagnose patients faster, more accurately, and with greater confidence.Every day, our AI assists veterinary professionals around the world in making critical clinical decisions that improve patient care.
We're looking for an ambitious Data Scientist who is passionate about AI, thrives on solving complex problems, and wants to help build technology that truly makes a difference.Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, this is an opportunity to work alongside some of the brightest AI minds in the industry while contributing directly to products used by thousands of veterinary professionals.

You'll work on real-world AI challenges—not theoretical projects.

No two days are the same. You'll have the freedom to investigate problems, experiment with new technologies, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine through AI.
What You'll Do
As a Data Scientist, you'll play a key role throughout the AI development lifecycle by:
Analyzing large clinical, operational, textual, and medical imaging datasets to uncover meaningful insights.Building reports, dashboards, and visualizations that guide product, research, and medical decisions.Training, evaluating, and improving computer vision and large language models.Developing robust evaluation frameworks for AI models.Investigating model performance, including false positives, false negatives, hallucinations, bias, and failure patterns.Designing experiments to compare models, prompts, datasets, and training strategies.Developing and optimizing prompts for LLM-powered applications.Working on structured information extraction, summarization, classification, and medical text generation.Assisting with dataset creation, annotation strategies, quality validation, and data preparation.Supporting model training, fine-tuning, and continuous improvement.Building tools that improve AI development, testing, and deployment.Collaborating closely with engineers, researchers, product teams, and veterinary experts.Presenting findings, recommendations, and technical insights in a clear, actionable manner.Taking ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.Strong Python programming skills.Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.Understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.Ability to learn quickly and solve unfamiliar problems independently.Strong attention to detail.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Bonus Points If You Have Experience With
Master's degree in a related field.1–3 years of industry, research, internship, or personal project experience.Large Language Models (LLMs)Prompt EngineeringLLM EvaluationComputer VisionMedical ImagingMachine Learning using PyTorch or TensorFlowHealthcare, veterinary, or biomedical datasetsExperiment design and AI benchmarkingData visualization and analytics platforms
Who Will Thrive Here?
We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys learning, and isn't afraid to tackle challenging problems.
You don't need experience with every technology listed above.Instead, we're looking for someone who demonstrates:
Intellectual curiosityInitiative and ownershipStrong analytical thinkingCreativity in problem solvingAdaptabilityA passion for artificial intelligenceA desire to build technology that has real-world impact
If you're excited about AI, enjoy learning new technologies, and want to contribute to products used every day by veterinary professionals around the globe, we'd love to hear from you.

At SignalPET, you'll join a fast-growing company where your work has immediate impact.

Competitive salaryComprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits401(k) with company matchPaid Time Off and company holidaysCareer development and mentorshipExposure to cutting-edge AI technologiesA collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven cultureThe opportunity to help improve the lives of veterinarians, pets, and their owners around the world
Ready to Build the Future of AI?
If you're looking for more than just another data science job if you want to solve meaningful problems, work with cutting-edge AI, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and become part of the SignalPET AI team.

Wood Mackenzie
