rows.title: Associate Complex Systems Modeler
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE’s Complex Systems Department (L644) is seeking a motivated, creative Associate Complex Systems Modeler to apply their modeling, operational analysis, and applied research skills to bear on solving problems of critical national importance. MITRE’s diverse work program provides opportunities to apply your expertise and creative thinking in challenging domains such as national security, healthcare, and transportation. This position offers the opportunity to interact directly with government leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic atmosphere with the ability to make a difference and impact outcomes with solid analysis.

Our department uses an array of approaches from the fields of both data analysis and modeling & simulation to help our sponsors develop a deep, causal understanding of the dynamics of their problems and identify and evaluate potential interventions in rigorous, intuitive, and analytically defensible ways. Modeling approaches, when combined and grounded with data analysis, allow us to go beyond correlations and pattern identification in data and help us test and develop intuition, leading to successful actions taken by our sponsor more quickly and more defensibly. We specialize in building deployable tools that allow sponsors to interact directly with models to develop intuition and explore causality within their domains.

Our interdisciplinary department thrives on having a large toolbox to support data- and model-driven decision making and we value people who can bring diverse perspectives. Our employees are expected to work on multiple projects, cross-pollinate good ideas across the government and continuously learn. We work to solve modeling and analytic problems in the public interest, in partnership with the government. We also actively conduct independent research in areas of interest to our government partners. If you are passionate about applying your technical expertise, your skill sets align with our capabilities, and you like working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment, we want to hear from you!

Roles & Responsibilities:

To be successful you will:

Be passionate about formulating and developing models, simulations, and analytic tools of real world problems involving complex dynamic systems.Have an innate curiosity and interest in developing research questions and testing hypotheses with open ended tasking.Work with a spectrum of government sponsors to gain understanding of their challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and conduct insightful, actionable analyses.Support development and application of a variety of analytic models to sponsor challenges, with a willingness to adapt and learn in a fast-paced environment.Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all audiences, regardless of technical expertise.Remain current on open-source, industry, academia, and US Government techniques and tools for modeling, analysis, data science, visualization, and engineering.Take initiative in owning aspects of your work and be a collaborative teammate.

Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site.

Experience leading or conducting research in computational social/behavioral sciences, geospatial sciences, natural sciences, or economics.Demonstrated experience leading stakeholder/funder facing engagements and providing relevant day-to-day tasking for one or more junior staff or colleagues.

The Opportunity

Join the Business Analytics team at Workhuman, where we sit at the core of the organization, driving strategy and decision-making through data. As a Data Analyst, you will help shape the next generation of analytics at Workhuman—moving beyond manual data requests and traditional reporting toward intelligent, self-service, and conversational experiences for our internal stakeholders and customers.

You will start by becoming an expert in how we deliver customer data today, using that knowledge to automate manual workflows and turn recurring needs into scalable capabilities. From there, you will help build data models, data products, and AI-assisted experiences that fundamentally change how people discover, explore, and act on data.

The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, data-driven, technical, and business oriented. They will dive deep into our customer data, build production-grade analytical solutions, and actively experiment with emerging technologies. We are looking for someone excited not just to make analytics faster, but to rethink how analytics is experienced.

This is a hybrid position, with three days per week onsite in our Framingham office. 

What We Can Offer You

The opportunity to help shape the future of how Workhuman delivers analytics to internal stakeholders and customers Hands-on experience building AI-assisted, conversational, and self-service analytics experiences Ownership over transforming highly manual workflows into scalable analytical capabilities The freedom to experiment with modern data and AI technologies and help define how we use them

The Skills You Will Bring

Proficiency in querying, analyzing, and visualizing large datasets using SQL and data visualization tools Experience building production-grade data models; experience with dbt is a plus Strong analytical problem-solving skills and business intuition Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on use of generative AI, professionally or independently, to analyze data, write code, automate workflows, or build new capabilities Exposure to AI coding tools, AI-assisted analytics, conversational analytics, or similar emerging technologies is a plus Strong communication and project management skills and a highly collaborative approach to problem-solving 

Achievements

Built dashboards, data products, or self-service capabilities that changed how people access and use data Automated or materially reinvented recurring analytical workflows Built or experimented with an AI-enabled tool, workflow, or project, professionally or independently Translated ambiguous stakeholder or customer needs into scalable analytical solutions

 Critical thinking – The capability to think out-of-the-box, and to develop critical questions and to identify insights by asking “the 5 whys”. rows.title: Scientific Data & Technology Strategy Associate Consultant - Discovery
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

As a Scientific Data & Technology Strategy Associate Consultant in Discovery, you will apply your technical, data, and research technology expertise to help leading biotech and biopharma clients design and implement scalable solutions that improve and streamline drug discovery workflows.

ZS’s Discovery Venture partners with clients to develop and deploy in silico approaches that accelerate the discovery of safer, more effective therapeutics. We work closely with other ZS practices, bringing hands-on scientific expertise to enhance both technology and strategy initiatives. As a Venture within ZS, we continuously develop, test, and refine new approaches to maximize impact for our clients and the patients they serve. This unique position enables us to combine agility and innovation with the resources and knowledge of ZS’s 13,000+ global team. ZS is expanding the Discovery Venture and seeking driven, curious, and creative experts to help shape the practice area, collaborate across ZS’s R&D teams, and deliver excellent outcomes for clients.

What you’ll do:

Partner with scientists, business stakeholders, and IT teams to translate scientific workflows and research needs into technical designs and practical solutions. Define conceptual and logical data models, metadata standards, integration patterns, and system architecture components to support research data management and analytics. Lead defined implementation workstreams from design through deployment, ensuring solutions are aligned with business needs, scientific workflows, and enterprise technology standards. Apply hands-on experience with pharma datasets, cloud platforms, and cross-system integrations to improve research technology ecosystems. Support research IT strategy, SDLC, and roadmap development by contributing technical recommendations, solution options, and implementation planning. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including scientists, data engineers, architects, business partners, and project managers, to integrate research technology and analytics into broader project objectives. Translate scientific and business needs into structured technical requirements, solution designs, and roadmap inputs. Support the design and implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud-native data platforms, APIs, and cross-system integrations. Contribute to research data management initiatives, including data modeling, metadata strategy, FAIR data principles, and information architecture across biopharmaceutical research domains. Support client readouts with evidence-based presentations, clearly communicating technical findings, solution recommendations, and next steps. Mentor junior team members, share knowledge across teams, and contribute to a collaborative, high-quality delivery environment. 

What you’ll bring:

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree strongly preferred, ideally in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, or a life science-related field; Advanced degree, including MS or PhD, in a scientific discipline with data and/or technology exposure is a plus. At least 2.5 years of relevant professional experience in research technology, data platforms, pharma technology, consulting, biotech, pharma, or related environments. Hands-on experience with pharma datasets, cloud platforms, and cross-system integrations. Prior ownership of solution design components, including data models, integration patterns, technical requirements, or architecture documentation. Experience bridging scientific and IT stakeholders and translating scientific workflows into technical solutions. Experience with conceptual and logical data modeling, system architecture, metadata standards, and information architecture. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of RESTful APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cross-system integration design. Experience with lakehouse and cloud-native data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake. Understanding of research data management and FAIR principles. Knowledge of how to interpret and enforce enterprise architecture and engineering standards. Knowledge of research information management and analytics applications such as research LIMS systems, ELN platforms, Certara, Schrödinger, GeneData, Watson, or similar platforms is preferred. Knowledge and experience in scientific data modeling or information architecture engineering across a range of biopharmaceutical research domains. Evidence of strong commitment to quality and client satisfaction. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientific, business, and IT audiences. Passion, curiosity, and a growth mindset, coupled with a deep commitment to an open and collaborative working environment.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

Shape the Future of Veterinary AI
At SignalPET, we're transforming veterinary medicine through artificial intelligence. Our cutting-edge technology combines computer vision, machine learning, and large language models to help veterinarians diagnose patients faster, more accurately, and with greater confidence.Every day, our AI assists veterinary professionals around the world in making critical clinical decisions that improve patient care.
We're looking for an ambitious Data Scientist who is passionate about AI, thrives on solving complex problems, and wants to help build technology that truly makes a difference.Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, this is an opportunity to work alongside some of the brightest AI minds in the industry while contributing directly to products used by thousands of veterinary professionals.
Why Join SignalPET?
You'll work on real-world AI challenges—not theoretical projects.

Computer VisionLarge Language Models (LLMs)Machine LearningPrompt EngineeringAI Evaluation & BenchmarkingMedical ImagingData Science & AnalyticsModel Training & Fine-TuningAI Infrastructure & Tooling
No two days are the same. You'll have the freedom to investigate problems, experiment with new technologies, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine through AI.
What You'll Do
As a Data Scientist, you'll play a key role throughout the AI development lifecycle by:
Analyzing large clinical, operational, textual, and medical imaging datasets to uncover meaningful insights.Building reports, dashboards, and visualizations that guide product, research, and medical decisions.Training, evaluating, and improving computer vision and large language models.Developing robust evaluation frameworks for AI models.Investigating model performance, including false positives, false negatives, hallucinations, bias, and failure patterns.Designing experiments to compare models, prompts, datasets, and training strategies.Developing and optimizing prompts for LLM-powered applications.Working on structured information extraction, summarization, classification, and medical text generation.Assisting with dataset creation, annotation strategies, quality validation, and data preparation.Supporting model training, fine-tuning, and continuous improvement.Building tools that improve AI development, testing, and deployment.Collaborating closely with engineers, researchers, product teams, and veterinary experts.Presenting findings, recommendations, and technical insights in a clear, actionable manner.Taking ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.Strong Python programming skills.Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.Understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.Ability to learn quickly and solve unfamiliar problems independently.Strong attention to detail.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Bonus Points If You Have Experience With
Master's degree in a related field.1–3 years of industry, research, internship, or personal project experience.Large Language Models (LLMs)Prompt EngineeringLLM EvaluationComputer VisionMedical ImagingMachine Learning using PyTorch or TensorFlowHealthcare, veterinary, or biomedical datasetsExperiment design and AI benchmarkingData visualization and analytics platforms
Who Will Thrive Here?
We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys learning, and isn't afraid to tackle challenging problems.
You don't need experience with every technology listed above.Instead, we're looking for someone who demonstrates:
Intellectual curiosityInitiative and ownershipStrong analytical thinkingCreativity in problem solvingAdaptabilityA passion for artificial intelligenceA desire to build technology that has real-world impact
If you're excited about AI, enjoy learning new technologies, and want to contribute to products used every day by veterinary professionals around the globe, we'd love to hear from you.
Location: On site (in Office)

At SignalPET, you'll join a fast-growing company where your work has immediate impact.
We offer:
Competitive salaryComprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits401(k) with company matchPaid Time Off and company holidaysCareer development and mentorshipExposure to cutting-edge AI technologiesA collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven cultureThe opportunity to help improve the lives of veterinarians, pets, and their owners around the world
Ready to Build the Future of AI?
If you're looking for more than just another data science job if you want to solve meaningful problems, work with cutting-edge AI, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and become part of the SignalPET AI team.

rows.title: Associate Complex Systems Modeler
rows.descriptionText:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We’re a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies – collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation’s health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose — and help shape the future.

MITRE’s Complex Systems Department (L644) is seeking a motivated, creative Associate Complex Systems Modeler to apply their modeling, operational analysis, and applied research skills to bear on solving problems of critical national importance. MITRE’s diverse work program provides opportunities to apply your expertise and creative thinking in challenging domains such as national security, healthcare, and transportation. This position offers the opportunity to interact directly with government leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic atmosphere with the ability to make a difference and impact outcomes with solid analysis.

Our department uses an array of approaches from the fields of both data analysis and modeling & simulation to help our sponsors develop a deep, causal understanding of the dynamics of their problems and identify and evaluate potential interventions in rigorous, intuitive, and analytically defensible ways. Modeling approaches, when combined and grounded with data analysis, allow us to go beyond correlations and pattern identification in data and help us test and develop intuition, leading to successful actions taken by our sponsor more quickly and more defensibly. We specialize in building deployable tools that allow sponsors to interact directly with models to develop intuition and explore causality within their domains.

Our interdisciplinary department thrives on having a large toolbox to support data- and model-driven decision making and we value people who can bring diverse perspectives. Our employees are expected to work on multiple projects, cross-pollinate good ideas across the government and continuously learn. We work to solve modeling and analytic problems in the public interest, in partnership with the government. We also actively conduct independent research in areas of interest to our government partners. If you are passionate about applying your technical expertise, your skill sets align with our capabilities, and you like working in a collaborative, team-oriented environment, we want to hear from you!

Roles & Responsibilities:

To be successful you will:

Be passionate about formulating and developing models, simulations, and analytic tools of real world problems involving complex dynamic systems.Have an innate curiosity and interest in developing research questions and testing hypotheses with open ended tasking.Work with a spectrum of government sponsors to gain understanding of their challenges, evaluate possible solutions, and conduct insightful, actionable analyses.Support development and application of a variety of analytic models to sponsor challenges, with a willingness to adapt and learn in a fast-paced environment.Present results in an intuitive, actionable manner that can be understood by all audiences, regardless of technical expertise.Remain current on open-source, industry, academia, and US Government techniques and tools for modeling, analysis, data science, visualization, and engineering.Take initiative in owning aspects of your work and be a collaborative teammate.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field such as Data Science, Computational Social Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Geospatial Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Economics; OR Bachelor’s degree in social/behavioral sciences (sociology, psychology, political science, public health) paired with significant computational experience.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Demonstrated ability to apply, modify, and formulate rigorous models and processes to solve challenging problems.Applied expertise or academic experience in leveraging analytic methods towards solving interdisciplinary problems with structured and unstructured data.Experience manipulating large datasets with at least one modern programming language or business intelligence platform (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, Java, Julia, SAS, C++, JavaScript).Experience leveraging commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) tools or open-source libraries to visualize multi-dimensional data and conduct analysis, like Tableau, PowerBI, arcGIS, Neo4j, git, ggplot2, R Shiny, dash, Plotly, Jupyter, matplotlib, seaborn, leaflet, or D3.js.Comfort with modern AI tools (e.g., large language models) and their application, evaluation, and validation.Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S Government issued Security Clearance. Per the U.S. Government’s eligibility requirements, you must be a U.S Citizen to be considered for a security clearance.This position requires a minimum of 3 days a week on-site. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience leading or conducting research in computational social/behavioral sciences, geospatial sciences, natural sciences, or economics.Demonstrated experience leading stakeholder/funder facing engagements and providing relevant day-to-day tasking for one or more junior staff or colleagues.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Shape the Future of Veterinary AI
At SignalPET, we're transforming veterinary medicine through artificial intelligence. Our cutting-edge technology combines computer vision, machine learning, and large language models to help veterinarians diagnose patients faster, more accurately, and with greater confidence.Every day, our AI assists veterinary professionals around the world in making critical clinical decisions that improve patient care.
We're looking for an ambitious Data Scientist who is passionate about AI, thrives on solving complex problems, and wants to help build technology that truly makes a difference.Whether you're a recent graduate or have a few years of experience, this is an opportunity to work alongside some of the brightest AI minds in the industry while contributing directly to products used by thousands of veterinary professionals.
Why Join SignalPET?
You'll work on real-world AI challenges—not theoretical projects.
As part of our AI team, you'll collaborate directly with our Chief AI Architect and experienced researchers, engineers, and veterinary specialists on projects involving:
Computer VisionLarge Language Models (LLMs)Machine LearningPrompt EngineeringAI Evaluation & BenchmarkingMedical ImagingData Science & AnalyticsModel Training & Fine-TuningAI Infrastructure & Tooling
No two days are the same. You'll have the freedom to investigate problems, experiment with new technologies, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine through AI.
What You'll Do
As a Data Scientist, you'll play a key role throughout the AI development lifecycle by:
Analyzing large clinical, operational, textual, and medical imaging datasets to uncover meaningful insights.Building reports, dashboards, and visualizations that guide product, research, and medical decisions.Training, evaluating, and improving computer vision and large language models.Developing robust evaluation frameworks for AI models.Investigating model performance, including false positives, false negatives, hallucinations, bias, and failure patterns.Designing experiments to compare models, prompts, datasets, and training strategies.Developing and optimizing prompts for LLM-powered applications.Working on structured information extraction, summarization, classification, and medical text generation.Assisting with dataset creation, annotation strategies, quality validation, and data preparation.Supporting model training, fine-tuning, and continuous improvement.Building tools that improve AI development, testing, and deployment.Collaborating closely with engineers, researchers, product teams, and veterinary experts.Presenting findings, recommendations, and technical insights in a clear, actionable manner.Taking ownership of projects from concept through implementation.
What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.Strong Python programming skills.Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.Understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.Ability to learn quickly and solve unfamiliar problems independently.Strong attention to detail.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Bonus Points If You Have Experience With
Master's degree in a related field.1–3 years of industry, research, internship, or personal project experience.Large Language Models (LLMs)Prompt EngineeringLLM EvaluationComputer VisionMedical ImagingMachine Learning using PyTorch or TensorFlowHealthcare, veterinary, or biomedical datasetsExperiment design and AI benchmarkingData visualization and analytics platforms
Who Will Thrive Here?
We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys learning, and isn't afraid to tackle challenging problems.
You don't need experience with every technology listed above.Instead, we're looking for someone who demonstrates:
Intellectual curiosityInitiative and ownershipStrong analytical thinkingCreativity in problem solvingAdaptabilityA passion for artificial intelligenceA desire to build technology that has real-world impact
If you're excited about AI, enjoy learning new technologies, and want to contribute to products used every day by veterinary professionals around the globe, we'd love to hear from you.
Location: On site (in Office)
Why SignalPET?
At SignalPET, you'll join a fast-growing company where your work has immediate impact.
We offer:
Competitive salaryComprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits401(k) with company matchPaid Time Off and company holidaysCareer development and mentorshipExposure to cutting-edge AI technologiesA collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven cultureThe opportunity to help improve the lives of veterinarians, pets, and their owners around the world
Ready to Build the Future of AI?
If you're looking for more than just another data science job if you want to solve meaningful problems, work with cutting-edge AI, and help shape the future of veterinary medicine, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply today and become part of the SignalPET AI team.

In collaboration with and under the mentorship of the Principle Investigator (PI), a Research Fellow engages in activities that will further his or her professional development.

Job Description

Primary Responsibilities:

 Abides by the institutional policies of BIDMC relating to health and safety, equality of opportunity and data storage and management. (essential) As a member of the research team, actively pursues research under the supervision of a principal investigator while developing skills for independent work. (essential) Receives training in and performs duties contributing to the investigational work of the team including formulation of research questions and design, conduct of experiments, and evaluation of results. (essential) Prepares and publishes scientific manuscripts under direction of PI. (essential) Develops expertise in desired lab skills/informatics/ physics/clinical research. (essential) teaching skills and provide supervision of students and their projects when appropriate. (essential) Engages in collaborative meetings with other research groups. Attends and leads scientific seminars. (essential) Learns to identify, acknowledge and correct deficiencies in one's own performance. (essential) Under the direction of PI, pursues/secures independent funding near the end of the fellowship. (essential)

Required Qualifications

Doctoral Degree or M.D.0-1 year of postdoctoral research experience in academic or industrial lab setting, and/or teaching assistantship in a university setting, and/or residency, and/or clinical duties beyond that of the qualifying doctoral degree.

Competencies

Decision Making: Ability to make decisions that are guided by general instructions and practices requiring some interpretation. May make recommendations for solving problems of moderate complexity and importance.

Problem Solving: Ability to address problems that are varied, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation using direct observation, knowledge and skills based on general precedents.

Independence of Action: Ability to follow precedents and procedures. May set priorities and organize work within general guidelines. Seeks assistance when confronted with difficult and/or unpredictable situations. Work progress is monitored by supervisor/manager.

Oral Communications: Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge: Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force frequently to move objects. Some elements of the job are sedentary, but the employee will be required to stand for periods of time or move throughout the hospital campus.

rows.title: Co-op - Robot Perception
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Spring (Jan-May 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

About The Opportunities

Symbotic’s Robot Perception team is an accomplished group of engineers who are working on sophisticated algorithms in areas such as perception and computer vision.

Bot Perception interns will evaluate and propose new projects for replacing legacy tools with vision-based algorithms. These interns will scope projects from literature review, to dataset design and aggregation, training pipeline development, all the way through production deployment. Practical projects include vision-based collision avoidance. SLAM interns will develop and test algorithms for robust robot localization in complex, real-world environments, applying sensor fusion, state estimation, and probabilistic methods to solve SLAM challenges at scale.Industrial Vision interns will evaluate and enhance computer vision pipelines for accurate pose estimation of goods packaging in adapter cells using traditional and Machine Learning CV models.

What You’ll Do

Research and experiment with traditional computer vision methods and deep learning methods for object detection, classification, segmentation, pose estimation, anomaly detection on images or videos.Evaluate and benchmark computer vision methods on production data.Deploy software to production on robot hardware.Design data pre and post processing methods.Document designs, code, experiments, evaluations.Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics softwareAdapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems.Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms.Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues.

What You’ll Need

Pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.Proficiency in Python and/or C++, including experience writing code and working in Jupyter notebooks.Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Familiarity with computer vision and perception tools such as OpenCV, including image classification, object detection, segmentation, and camera calibration.Exposure to robotics perception concepts such as sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D pose representations, coordinate transforms, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian inference.Working knowledge of sensors, including RGB cameras, 3D sensors, and point cloud processing tools such as PCL.Experience working in Linux environments and using command-line tools.Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, REST APIs, and/or SQL-based data tools such as Snowflake.Exposure to deployment or optimization tools such as Docker, ROS/ROS 2, Jetson, ONNX, VLMs, or Vision-Language-Action models is a plus.

What’s Good To Have

Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) 

Our Environment 

Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.



About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

rows.title: Scientist, Translation Biology
rows.descriptionText:
Primary Talent Partners has a new contract opening for a Scientist, Translation Biology to join our pharmaceutical client in Cambridge, MA. This is a 12-month contract to start with the potential for extensions. 

Pay: $63.00 - $73.00/hr; W2 contract, no PTO, no Benefits. ACA-compliant supplemental package available for enrollment. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States and must be able to sit on Primary Talent Partners W2 without sponsorship.


Schedule: 100% Onsite

Description:This is a contract position supporting the discovery and development of in vivo CAR-T cell therapies for autoimmune indications and other malignancies within the Immunology & Translational Biology Research organization.This individual will design and execute a broad range of in vivo and ex vivo experimental workflows, interpret results to determine next steps, maintain rigorous digital and physical records, and contribute scientific judgment to the continuous improvement of assays and protocols.The successful candidate will be a technically skilled, highly organized, and intellectually curious scientist who can operate independently on complex problems while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams - balancing rigorous protocol adherence with sound scientific judgment and proactive cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities:In Vivo & Ex Vivo Studies: Execute mouse studies supporting in vivo CAR-T programs, including organ harvest, tissue dissociation, and downstream processing of mouse organs, cell line maintenance, human PBMCs, and NHP samples.Flow Cytometry: Design, optimize, and execute multiparameter (10+ color) flow cytometry panels for immunophenotyping and functional readouts; perform data analysis using FlowJo and present findings to project teams and cross-functional stakeholders.LNP Transfection: Design and perform lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-mediated transfection experiments to support in vivo delivery platform development; evaluate potency of formulated tLNPs using cell-based assays and propose protocol refinementsT & PBMC Cell Culture: Maintain and activate primary human T and PBMC cell cultures; design co-culture systems and functional assays to assess lymphocyte biology and targeted killing efficacy against specific targets.Functional Assays: Execute flow cytometry-based and Incucyte live-cell imaging functional assays to assess cell health, proliferation, cytotoxicity, and engagement.Digital Record-Keeping & Benchling: Maintain complete, contemporaneous, accurate, and audit-ready experimental records in Benchling, including ELNs, protocols, results, and reagent inventory.Protocol Adherence & Scientific Judgment: Follow established SOPs with strict attention to detail while proactively identifying discrepancies, deviations, or opportunities for optimization and escalating or resolving them appropriately.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Interface with partner teams (e.g., CMC) to coordinate experiments, share data, and provide technical support including hands-on training for flow cytometry or assay execution.Logistics & Planning: Manage scheduling of complex multi-step experiments, reagent ordering, biosample coordination, and equipment bookings to ensure uninterrupted research operations.

In a series of related experiments while demonstrating independence on complex, sometimes ambiguous problems.

rows.title: Scientific Data & Technology Strategy Associate Consultant - Discovery
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

As a Scientific Data & Technology Strategy Associate Consultant in Discovery, you will apply your technical, data, and research technology expertise to help leading biotech and biopharma clients design and implement scalable solutions that improve and streamline drug discovery workflows.

ZS’s Discovery Venture partners with clients to develop and deploy in silico approaches that accelerate the discovery of safer, more effective therapeutics. We work closely with other ZS practices, bringing hands-on scientific expertise to enhance both technology and strategy initiatives. As a Venture within ZS, we continuously develop, test, and refine new approaches to maximize impact for our clients and the patients they serve. This unique position enables us to combine agility and innovation with the resources and knowledge of ZS’s 13,000+ global team. ZS is expanding the Discovery Venture and seeking driven, curious, and creative experts to help shape the practice area, collaborate across ZS’s R&D teams, and deliver excellent outcomes for clients.

What you’ll do:

Partner with scientists, business stakeholders, and IT teams to translate scientific workflows and research needs into technical designs and practical solutions. Define conceptual and logical data models, metadata standards, integration patterns, and system architecture components to support research data management and analytics. Lead defined implementation workstreams from design through deployment, ensuring solutions are aligned with business needs, scientific workflows, and enterprise technology standards. Apply hands-on experience with pharma datasets, cloud platforms, and cross-system integrations to improve research technology ecosystems. Support research IT strategy, SDLC, and roadmap development by contributing technical recommendations, solution options, and implementation planning. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including scientists, data engineers, architects, business partners, and project managers, to integrate research technology and analytics into broader project objectives. Translate scientific and business needs into structured technical requirements, solution designs, and roadmap inputs. Support the design and implementation of ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud-native data platforms, APIs, and cross-system integrations. Contribute to research data management initiatives, including data modeling, metadata strategy, FAIR data principles, and information architecture across biopharmaceutical research domains. Support client readouts with evidence-based presentations, clearly communicating technical findings, solution recommendations, and next steps. Mentor junior team members, share knowledge across teams, and contribute to a collaborative, high-quality delivery environment. 

What you’ll bring:

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree strongly preferred, ideally in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, or a life science-related field; Advanced degree, including MS or PhD, in a scientific discipline with data and/or technology exposure is a plus. At least 2.5 years of relevant professional experience in research technology, data platforms, pharma technology, consulting, biotech, pharma, or related environments. Hands-on experience with pharma datasets, cloud platforms, and cross-system integrations. Prior ownership of solution design components, including data models, integration patterns, technical requirements, or architecture documentation. Experience bridging scientific and IT stakeholders and translating scientific workflows into technical solutions. Experience with conceptual and logical data modeling, system architecture, metadata standards, and information architecture. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Understanding of RESTful APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cross-system integration design. Experience with lakehouse and cloud-native data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake. Understanding of research data management and FAIR principles. Knowledge of how to interpret and enforce enterprise architecture and engineering standards. Knowledge of research information management and analytics applications such as research LIMS systems, ELN platforms, Certara, Schrödinger, GeneData, Watson, or similar platforms is preferred. Knowledge and experience in scientific data modeling or information architecture engineering across a range of biopharmaceutical research domains. Evidence of strong commitment to quality and client satisfaction. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientific, business, and IT audiences. Passion, curiosity, and a growth mindset, coupled with a deep commitment to an open and collaborative working environment.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Looking to launch your career at the cutting edge of healthcare? Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future focused team. rows.title: Co-op - Robot Perception
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility.

Timeframe{{:}} Spring (Jan-May 2027)

At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment.

Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements.

Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

About The Opportunities

Symbotic’s Robot Perception team is an accomplished group of engineers who are working on sophisticated algorithms in areas such as perception and computer vision.

Bot Perception interns will evaluate and propose new projects for replacing legacy tools with vision-based algorithms. These interns will scope projects from literature review, to dataset design and aggregation, training pipeline development, all the way through production deployment. Practical projects include vision-based collision avoidance. SLAM interns will develop and test algorithms for robust robot localization in complex, real-world environments, applying sensor fusion, state estimation, and probabilistic methods to solve SLAM challenges at scale.Industrial Vision interns will evaluate and enhance computer vision pipelines for accurate pose estimation of goods packaging in adapter cells using traditional and Machine Learning CV models.

What You’ll Do

Research and experiment with traditional computer vision methods and deep learning methods for object detection, classification, segmentation, pose estimation, anomaly detection on images or videos.Evaluate and benchmark computer vision methods on production data.Deploy software to production on robot hardware.Design data pre and post processing methods.Document designs, code, experiments, evaluations.Identify high-impact scenarios where AI Planning and machine learning can be applied to optimize the Symbotic robotics softwareAdapt state-of-the-art approaches or develop high-performance algorithms to solve real-world multi-robot problems.Conduct simulations and experiments to validate the performance of the multi-robot algorithms.Present results in verbal and written communications internally, and in top-tier academic venues.

What You’ll Need

Pursuing a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field.Proficiency in Python and/or C++, including experience writing code and working in Jupyter notebooks.Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.Familiarity with computer vision and perception tools such as OpenCV, including image classification, object detection, segmentation, and camera calibration.Exposure to robotics perception concepts such as sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D pose representations, coordinate transforms, probabilistic graphical models, and Bayesian inference.Working knowledge of sensors, including RGB cameras, 3D sensors, and point cloud processing tools such as PCL.Experience working in Linux environments and using command-line tools.Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, REST APIs, and/or SQL-based data tools such as Snowflake.Exposure to deployment or optimization tools such as Docker, ROS/ROS 2, Jetson, ONNX, VLMs, or Vision-Language-Action models is a plus.

What’s Good To Have

Publications at high-impact conferences/journals (e.g., CoRL, ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, RSS, ICRA, IROS, RAL, AAAI, ICAPS, IJCAI, JAIR, etc.) 

Our Environment 

Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis.



About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

rows.descriptionText:
Key Role Details

Full-time new hires for this role will start as a cohort in a rotational program in August 2027. This role is a full-time associate position within a two-year rotational program, designed as a career accelerator to foster the next generation of leading talent. Rotations occur at the one-year mark and allow for hands-on experience in two distinct roles. Associates who participate in this program may choose to remain in their final role placement upon completion of the program or explore other opportunities at Capital One. Participation in the program requires that you are located in the continental United States with in-person attendance at your assigned location, for the duration of your time in the Program in accordance with Capital One’s hybrid working model. 

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, F-1 CPT, J-1, TN, E-3, and O-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).

Basic Qualifications

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a Bachelor’s degree or higher with an expectation that you will complete your most recent full-time degree program by August 2027 or earlier

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated interest and experience in product management, software delivery, data science, software engineering, or leveraging software to solve customer and business problemsPreferred majors include Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or other related majors

Product Development Program Associate - 2027

In our 30 years as a founder-led public company, Capital One has grown from a pioneering credit card startup into a technology firm that has completely redefined its identity, outpacing the financial services industry by using technology to transform the way the world banks. At Capital One, we believe great products create value for customers, positively impact our bottom line, and are powered by cutting edge technology and great product managers. What motivates us every day is that we have both the opportunity and responsibility to help our customers with their financial lives - to save them time, money, and to inspire a sense of optimism about the future, every day.

If you’re interested in Capital One and a development program that enables you to create a strong foundation by building new products that are grounded in customer research, business strategy, data and tech best practices, then the Product Development Program is a great place to begin your career journey.

As part of the Product Development Program, you will:

Gain hands-on experience leveraging new technology while building product management skills in two distinct roles over two yearsDevelop leadership skills in the professional setting through meaningful interaction with product leadersLeverage data and customer insights to understand customer and business problems, make strategic business decisions, and lead high functioning tech teams to implement solutionsParticipate in Experiential education weeks focused on leadership development, challenging strategic problem-solving exercises, and extensive networking activities

As an Associate Product Manager at Capital One, you’ll be at the heart of shipping new products and driving innovation on platforms that delight and improve the experiences of our external and internal customers, expanding our reach into new spaces and impacting the bottom line on a daily basis. This role will challenge you to understand and manage tradeoffs between customer needs, business strategy, and technology. You will work closely with expert designers, developers, business analysts and data scientists in an agile, collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibilities, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

In your role, you might:

Partner with other product managers to ship, scale, and improve products that delight our customers and position our company for substantial growth. You will work alongside your product team and learn how to strategically influence product direction and prioritize features, actively manage a backlog, and clear impediments for the team. Own the success and life cycle of features for your product/platform, setting its strategy and driving prioritization decisions toward improvements. You will test and learn your way to something new while taking into account business strategy, market analysis, user feedback, analytics and technology best practices. Partner with experts to craft and drive long-term business strategy. You will strive to solve the right problems and steer away from the wrong ones by deeply understanding our business, developing customer empathy, and integrating multiple streams of data. Collaborate with internal partners. You will rally your team to deliver your vision while participating in relevant governance and risk forums and building strong relationships with diverse stakeholders. Engage with your network of developers, designers, analysts, data scientists, customers and other subject-matter experts and leverage them to build cutting-edge products. 

The Ideal Candidate Would Be:

Curious. You ask why, explore, and bring your unique perspective to the table. You’ll grow comfortable with ambiguity, fueled by a hunger to learn and constantly seeking new challenges. Action-Oriented & Committed. You aim to take action, try new things, and sometimes fail. Roadblocks won’t set you back, because you’ll stay focused on your goals. You’re organized, excited, juggle multiple deliverables, and prioritize your work while always utilizing data analysis, technology, and human centered design to understand how the product you are creating affects your customer. A Creative Problem Solver. Big, undefined complex problems will be exciting for you as you work to identify well-rounded solutions. Passionate About Technology. You are eager to learn about technology and partner closely with engineers to leverage cutting edge technology for our products. Customer Focused. You have the desire to connect with our customers, both internal and external, to deliver products that will have a meaningful impact. Innovative. You have an entrepreneurial spirit with an aptitude and interest in learning to build new products and platforms with tech solutions and want to understand how they work at an atomic level. Communicative. You always keep the people around you in the loop and are excited to communicate complex ideas clearly to make sure your co-workers understand the “why” behind their work and their key priorities. Inclusive. You consider and respect others’ opinions and experiences, and you proactively seek out ways to invite diverse perspectives to the table. Collaborative & Team-Oriented. You thrive in a collaborative team environment. As part of our crew, you will learn to energetically rally diverse groups in pursuit of a common goal.

rows.title: Marketing Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
PastryStar is more than a food manufacturer—it’s a team driven by passion, craftsmanship, and innovation. Founded by a French pastry chef and rooted in over 35 years of expertise, we create high-quality, clean-label ingredients that help professionals bring exceptional desserts to life. At PastryStar, we don’t just make products—we solve problems, elevate standards, and build something meaningful together.

About The Role

We are currently seeking a detail-oriented, creative, and highly organized Marketing Specialist to join our team. The Marketing Specialist will support the planning, execution, and tracking of marketing initiatives that strengthen PastryStar’s brand, promote our clean-label bakery and pastry ingredients, generate qualified leads, and support the sales team. This role is responsible for creating engaging content, maintaining digital marketing channels, supporting product launches, coordinating catalog and website updates, assisting with tradeshows and customer-facing events, and helping communicate PastryStar’s value to both prospective and current customers.

The ideal candidate is a strong writer and communicator with experience in digital marketing, content creation, social media, email marketing, SEO, marketing automation, and campaign support. This person should be comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, R&D, Customer Service, leadership, external vendors, and other departments to ensure marketing materials are accurate, professional, timely, and aligned with PastryStar’s brand.

What You'll Do

Develop, edit, and publish marketing content that promotes PastryStar’s products, brand story, clean-label ingredients, and value proposition. Create content for blogs, newsletters, email campaigns, product highlights, customer communications, social media, and sales-support materials. Maintain and update website content, including product pages, landing pages, images, application ideas, and marketing copy. Support SEO, digital advertising, email marketing, marketing automation, and lead-generation campaigns. Manage PastryStar’s social media presence by creating posts, scheduling content, monitoring engagement, and identifying opportunities to grow brand awareness. Work with the sales team to create flyers, brochures, presentations, product sheets, email templates, and customer follow-up materials. Coordinate updates to digital and printed catalogs, including product descriptions, images, specifications, and layout review. Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Customer Service, leadership, vendors, and outside partners to ensure marketing materials are accurate, professional, and on brand. Assist with product photography, image organization, and visual assets for the website, catalog, social media, and promotional materials. Help plan and support tradeshows, customer events, product demonstrations, and industry events, including booth materials, samples, signage, promotional items, and lead tracking. Track marketing project timelines, campaign results, website traffic, email engagement, social media activity, lead generation, and advertising performance. Prepare reports, summaries, and recommendations based on campaign performance and customer engagement trends. Maintain organized marketing files, brand assets, product images, campaign records, vendor information, calendars, and project documentation. Ensure all customer-facing materials are accurate, consistent with PastryStar branding, and aligned with company standards for quality and professionalism. Support internal communications, customer inquiries, marketing-related requests, special projects, and other duties as assigned. 

Qualifications

Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and communication skills, with the ability to create clear and engaging marketing content. Excellent attention to detail when reviewing product information, website content, catalogs, and customer-facing materials. Creative and organized, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Knowledge of digital marketing, including SEO, email marketing, social media, website content, lead generation, and campaign tracking. Ability to work independently while collaborating with Sales, R&D, Customer Service, leadership, vendors, and outside partners. Proficiency with Microsoft Office; experience with social media platforms, email marketing tools, CRM systems, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite preferred. Ability to review basic marketing data, identify trends, and recommend improvements. Professional judgment, confidentiality, and strong interpersonal skills when communicating with employees, customers, vendors, and industry contacts. Ability to learn PastryStar’s product lines, clean-label ingredients, customer base, and brand positioning. Willingness to travel as needed for tradeshows, customer events, vendor meetings, or other company-related marketing activities. Positive, team-oriented attitude with a willingness to support company goals and assist with other duties as assigned. 

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, Digital Media, or a related field required; equivalent related experience may be considered. Minimum of 2–4 years of marketing experience preferred, ideally in food manufacturing, bakery, pastry, foodservice, B2B marketing, consumer packaged goods, or a related industry. Experience creating marketing content, managing social media, supporting campaigns, updating websites, assisting with tradeshows, and coordinating marketing projects preferred. Experience working with sales teams, product teams, vendors, or cross-functional departments is preferred. Experience with product catalogs, product sheets, brochures, newsletters, website updates, or customer-facing marketing materials is a plus. Photography, video content, recipe content, product demonstration support, or food-related marketing experience is a plus. Job Type: Full-time Location: On-site Salary Range: $50,000-$60,000

Product Management at Capital One is a booming, vibrant craft that requires reimagining the status quo, finding value creation opportunities, and driving innovative and sustainable customer experiences through technology.

We believe our portfolio of businesses and investments in growth and transformation will result in a company with the scale, brand, capabilities, talent, and values to succeed as the digital revolution transforms our society and our industry.

Do you dream of well-designed and intuitive products and customer experiences? Do you want to be the one who introduces change to help tens of millions of customers make smarter financial choices? Do you want to change the way people manage their money? If you answered yes to all of these questions, then product management at Capital One may be a fit for you

About the Team:

In Card Intelligence, we’re using ML to build the future of how we engage and acquire our customers. As a key player on our Marketing & Acquisitions team, you’ll collaborate with talented data scientists and engineers to develop and deploy machine learning solutions to help support our customers. You’ll also work across teams to build products that enable seamless and scalable model development, influence strategic decisions, and contribute to building a thriving product practice in support of our overall Machine Learning capabilities.

In this role, you’ll learn the essentials of being a product manager, and we’ll invest in you to grow in four key areas:

Human CenteredYou’ll collaborate with tech teams to build comprehensive acceptance criteria, identifying and elevating any need for additional research to define future feature designYou'll breakdown business epics into features and further into user stories, driving your team towards lowest effort or Minimal Viable Product (MVP) for a valid feature test

Business FocusedDemonstrate a growth mindset, you’ll effectively use hypothesis-driven assessment of data to ensure your product or feature delivers on real business needsYou’ll own and prioritize feature development roadmaps, ensuring all necessary processes and procedures are followed to manage risk

You get a thrill from the journey of building and shipping products, and you have a desire and ability to connect with our external or internal customers to fully understand their needsLearner. You have an appetite to learn new things or new technologies all while exhibiting humbleness when the time comes to ask for helpTeam Player. You enjoy working with diverse people and driving the team toward a common goal. You have the ability to put the team before yourself and establish long-lasting relationships

rows.descriptionText:
Job Summary

This position is in the Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection. DLCP protects the health, safety, economic interests, and quality of life of residents, businesses, and visitors in the District of Columbia by ensuring code compliance and regulating business. DLCP is responsible for regulating business activity in the District of Columbia. The agency protects consumers, issues business and professional licenses, registers corporations, inspects weighing and measuring devices used for monetary profit, and issues special events permit. This position is within the Office of the Director.

Duties And Responsibilities

Reviews, verifies, and authenticates information to ensure accuracy, validity, and conformance with applicable standards. Develop and maintain data tracking systems, dashboards, and analytic tools to support compliance monitoring, reporting, and enforcement actions. Ensure regulated entities meet eligibility or qualification requirements outlined in applicable statutes, program guidelines, and licensing mandates.

Constructs, updates, and refines Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), compliance guides and data management protocols to support consistent agency practices. Collaborates with program managers, inspectors, enforcement staff, and external agencies to ensure accurate data collection and interpretation. Organizes and conducts compliance training, data interpretation sessions, and technical assistance workshops for internal staff and regulated entities. Produces quarterly, annual, and ad-hoc reports summarizing compliance trends, data quality issues, operational risks, and program performance indicators.Supports the Compliance Division in implementing new regulatory initiatives, program evaluations, and improvement processes.

rows.descriptionText:
Position Description

CGI Federal is looking for a Senior Pricing AI Analyst that will combine deep market expertise with the power of AI driven insights to deliver smarter, faster, and more profitable outcomes. Our culture thrives on curiosity, collaboration, and measurable impact. We believe pricing is both an art and a science, and we're committed to using the best tools available to stay ahead of the market.

This position is located in our Fairfax, VA office.

Your future duties and responsibilities

As our Senior Pricing AI Analyst, you'll use advanced analytics and AI powered tools to uncover patterns, forecast demand, and recommend optimal pricing strategies and will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that directly influence revenue, profitability, and competitive positioning.

 Use AI powered analytics platforms (e.g., Tableau AI, Power BI Copilot, or similar) to analyze large datasets and identify pricing trends, elasticity, and market opportunities. Apply predictive analytics to forecast demand, assess competitive pricing, and recommend adjustments. Collaborate with sales, finance, and product teams to align pricing strategies with business goals. Monitor market conditions and competitor activity using AI driven market intelligence tools. Create clear, compelling dashboards and reports to communicate insights to senior leadership. Continuously explore new AI features and tools to enhance pricing accuracy and speed and apply across the strategic pricing organization. Lead the Strategic Pricing organization in developing and applying AI driven models and tools to improve speed and accuracy for the organization.

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

 Bachelors degree and 5+ years of experience in pricing analysis. Proven ability to use AI powered analytics tools for decision making (no coding required). Strong skills in Excel, SQL, and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent). Understanding of pricing strategies, elasticity, and market segmentation. Excellent analytical thinking and the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Experience with or understanding of Federal Government related market intelligence tools (e.g., BGov, GovWin, SAM. Strong communication skills to influence stakeholders at all levels.

About The Team

The Analytics team is looking for experienced Data Scientists and Senior Data Scientists to guide measurement, strategy, and tactical decision-making across the company across a variety of teams and levels. Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into relevant recommendations, driving decisions for the entire organization. Analytics is integral to all operational areas at DoorDash.

Consumer & GrowthBusiness OperationsDasher & LogisticsCustomer Experience & IntegrityMerchant, Ads & SalesNew VerticalsInternational Data Science

About The Role

As a Data Scientist at DoorDash, you'll use your quantitative background to mentor other scientists and dive into large datasets to guide decision-making. We solve a multitude of exciting challenges including customer acquisition, fraud and support, marketing, balancing supply and demand, new city launches, marketplace efficiency, and more. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, and have experience using analytics to affect revenue, growth, operations or beyond, we're looking for someone like you!

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain2+ years of experience in data analytics, consulting, or related roleExperience working with funnel optimization, user segmentation, cohort analyses, time series analyses, regression models, etcExpertise of SQL queries, ETL, A/B Testing, and statistical analysis (e.g. hypothesis testing, experimentation, regressions) with statistical packages, such as Matlab, R, SAS or PythonProficiency in one or more analytics & visualization tools (e.g. Chartio, Looker, Tableau)The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way
