The Strategy & Digital Manager is the primary architect of the plant’s future-state operating model. This dual-purpose leadership role is responsible for orchestrating the site’s five-year strategic roadmap—aligning capacity, sourcing, and "Funding the Growth" initiatives with long-term business objectives—while simultaneously spearheading the plant’s Industry 4.0 transformation.

As the site’s central strategist and digital gatekeeper, you will bridge the gap between long-term operational planning and a digitally-enabled shop floor. By leveraging operational & advanced analytics, digital tools, and emerging technologies, you will drive a data-centric culture that optimizes production, minimizes waste, and builds future-ready technical capabilities across the entire workforce.

Your Day to Day and The Future

Plant Strategy & Operational Planning

Lead the five-year plant strategy process, ensuring a robust roadmap is in place to meet organizational growth and performance targets. Lead and coordinate short and long term capacity planning and road maps aligned with strategic sourcing and cost savings initiatives. Maintain factory capacity utilization models following the release of monthly forecasts. Partner with Division Network Operations to drive the timely and accurate collection of plant volume data for Budget and Latest Estimate (LE) reviews Develop and drive strategies for product and material portfolio simplification to improve plant performance and resilience. Lead and Coordinate the Funding The Growth Program to achieve savings targets (Coordinate Brainstorming Activities, Projects, go / no go decisions, benchmarking)

Digital Transformation

Develop and execute the plant-specific digital roadmap, aligning global/divisional/Plant initiatives to transition the plant from traditional to digital operations aligning with the key pillars of Industry 4.0. Act as the central gatekeeper for all plant-level digital requests and technology needs. Partner with plant functional leads to evaluate digital opportunities based on ROI, operational pain points, and technical feasibility. Drive the cultural shift toward digital ways of working through structured training, communication, and building a network of digital champions. Enforce an "Adopt-First" mindset, ensuring global or division tools are utilized before any local "self-service" development begins. Drive the utilization of both operational advanced analytics at all levels in the site to optimize production, minimize waste, and improve process efficiencies.

Bachelor’s Degree in a technical or analytical discipline. 8+ years of manufacturing, production, or operations experience. Experience using analytical skills and working knowledge of databases and spreadsheets. Experience in Manufacturing Operations, Logistics, Planning, Quality, Safety, or Finance.

Proven supply chain domain knowledge (process, systems, and data) with solid operational experience in demand or supply; end-to-end experience strongly preferred. Formal certifications (e.g., PMP, CSM or equivalent Agile certifications). Experience working in a global matrixed organization and/or with global functional roadmaps. ICQA Manager (Inventory Control & Quality Assurance)

Function: Supply Chain / Operations

Division: CPD

Who We Are

For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted its energy, innovation, and scientific excellence solely to one business: Beauty. Our goal is to offer each and every person around the world the best of beauty in terms of quality, efficacy, safety, sincerity, and responsibility to satisfy all beauty needs and desires in their infinite diversity.

At L'Oréal Operations, we create innovative, inclusive, and sustainable beauty together with our business partners by designing, developing, sourcing, manufacturing, and distributing over 6 billion products globally every year.

What You Will Do

The ICQA Manager is responsible for developing and leading the Inventory Control and Quality Assurance strategy for the distribution center. This role ensures inventory accuracy, process compliance, and product quality through the creation of sustainable mechanisms, proactive performance monitoring, and data-driven decision-making.

The ICQA Manager will build systems and routines that identify risks before they become operational issues, establish leading and lagging indicators, and drive rapid corrective actions to maintain world-class inventory accuracy and quality performance. This leader will develop and empower a high-performing team while partnering cross-functionally to continuously improve operational reliability, customer experience, and supply chain efficiency.

Success in this role is measured not only by inventory and quality results, but by the ability to develop talent, build scalable processes, and create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Key Job Accountabilities

Inventory Accuracy & Control StrategyDevelop and execute the site's Inventory Control strategy to achieve and sustain best-in-class inventory accuracy and location integrity. Design and implement proactive inventory management mechanisms that identify trends, risks, and process failures before they impact service, productivity, or financial performance. Establish leading and lagging KPI frameworks to monitor inventory health across receiving, storage, replenishment, picking, packing, and shipping processes. Drive systematic root cause analysis of inventory discrepancies and implement sustainable corrective actions that eliminate recurring defects. Lead cycle count, audit, and reconciliation programs while continuously improving inventory governance processes. Own inventory accuracy metrics, adjustment controls, shrink reduction initiatives, and inventory-related financial compliance requirements.

Data Analytics & Performance ManagementBuild and maintain KPI dashboards and visual management systems that provide real-time visibility into inventory, quality, and operational performance. Utilize WMS, ERP, and business intelligence tools to identify patterns, forecast risks, and prioritize opportunities for improvement. Create exception-based monitoring processes that trigger early-warning alerts and immediate action plans for inventory and quality issues. Present business insights, performance trends, and recommendations for improvement to site and regional leadership teams. Establish reporting routines that drive accountability and enable rapid decision-making.

People Leadership & Talent DevelopmentLead, coach, and develop ICQA leaders and associates to achieve operational excellence and individual career growth.Build a high-performance culture centered on safety, accountability, engagement, problem-solving, and continuous improvement. Develop succession plans and talent pipelines for critical roles within Inventory Control and Quality Assurance. Conduct regular talent reviews, development planning, and coaching sessions to strengthen leadership capabilities across the team. Create a learning environment that develops analytical thinking, operational expertise, and leadership effectiveness. Champion employee engagement initiatives that improve retention, performance, and organizational capability.

Continuous Improvement & Operational PartnershipPartner with Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, Engineering, Transportation, and Corporate teams to drive end-to-end process improvements. Lead cross-functional initiatives focused on inventory accuracy, quality performance, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and problem-solving methodologies to eliminate waste, reduce variability, and improve process capability. Support system implementations, automation initiatives, and technology enhancements designed to improve inventory visibility and operational control. Serve as the site subject matter expert for inventory governance, quality compliance, and control processes.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Engineering, Science, or a related field.Experience: Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in a distribution center, warehouse, or manufacturing environment, including at least 2–3 years in a people management or leadership capacity.Technical Expertise: Strong working knowledge of Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)—specifically Manhattan solutions—and ERP systems (such as SAP).Data & Analytics: Proficiency in data analysis tools and advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, macros, etc.).Core Skills: Strong organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to autonomously manage complex operational challenges.

Experience with Integrated Lean Six Sigma, cycle counting, and inventory reconciliation in high-volume operations.Familiarity with Power BI and automated distribution technologies.Proven success in driving change management and developing talent in a fast-paced environment.

rows.title: Planogram Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Summary

The Planogram Specialist partners with Category Leadership Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to influence, build, validate, and execute merchandising solutions that support category growth. The role co-owns planogram development, planogram specific reporting, database maintenance, and ad hoc category analytics while evolving toward stronger process leadership, standardized ways of working, and scalable tools that improve speed, quality, and consistency across divisions. The role also contributes to assortment and layout thinking by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf construct recommendations, planogram testing, heat mapping, and best-practice deployment.

Responsibilities

Planogram Development & Execution

 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as Circana, JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationships with Shopper MX and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Space Management and/or Category Management; CPG and/or food industry experience required, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrates a meticulous attention to detail when developing and validating planograms, ensuring accurate product placement, compliance with retailer requirements, and flawless execution of best-in-class merchandising recommendations Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–25% to include national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

You will oversee brand P&L management, financial forecasting, and trade spend controls while assessing risk and opportunity scenarios for cross-functional partners. Serve as a key financial advisor to cross-functional brand teams, effectively communicating business drivers, challenging assumptions, and aligning team strategy.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 8+ years of diversified financial experience, including direct P&L management experience. Systems proficiency in SAP or equivalent enterprise ERP software. Proficiency in Google Suite (Sheets, Slides, Docs) or Microsoft Office Suite.

Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) certification. At least 3 years of financial experience within the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry and U.S. Operations. Strong understanding of trade spend management, gross-to-net accounting, and consumer promotion analytics. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

As a member of the Accounting Operations function, the Senior Finance Analyst (Intragroup Accounting Operations) is responsible for overseeing onshore and offshore intragroup accounting activities and ensuring accurate and timely recording, reconciliation, settlement, elimination, and reporting of related-party transactions. Function: Digital Analytics

Through its hundreds of stores, national field sales force and sub-distribution network, SalonCentric promotes the finest professional beauty brands and educates stylists on the latest products and trends.

You will leverage your expertise to forecast promotional effectiveness, segment our audience for targeted engagement, and measure the impact of our strategies. If you possess a passion for data, a knack for predictive analysis, and a desire to shape the future of digital customer experiences in the beauty industry, we encourage you to apply.

Audience Segmentation & Targeting: Design, retrieve, and maintain audience segmentation strategies from our SQL databases to enable highly personalized and effective customer activation campaigns. Ensure data accuracy and integrity for all audience segments. Measurement & Optimization: Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and develop comprehensive measurement frameworks to evaluate the success and ROI of digital promotions and customer engagement initiatives. Analyze results, identify trends, and provide actionable insights for continuous improvement. Data Retrieval & Management: Be the primary owner for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) data from various sources, predominantly SQL databases, to support forecasting, segmentation, and reporting needs. Ensure data cleanliness and reliability. Collaboration: Partner closely with Loyalty, Digital Marketing, IT, and other cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of strategies and effective execution of customer engagement programs. What you’ll need to have:  

    At least 2-3 years of PPC experience within a similar role    Experience in a similar PPC role at either agency or in-house level (hands on experience with SA360, Google Analytics and Google Ads is desirable).     Proficiency in managing large scale marketing budgets and ensuring optimal deployment in-channel.      A passion for PPC and innovation in this space, with a performance-driven growth mindset, keen to make a huge difference across one of the ROI’s biggest healthcare retailer.     Strong attention to detail and analytical skills are essential as are the ability to craft a story from data.     A passion for the wider landscape of Digital Marketing with a hunger for developing your knowledge.  

Why Boots

At Boots, we foster a working environment where consideration and inclusivity help everyone to be themselves and reach their full potential. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, passionate about embracing the diversity of our colleagues and providing a positive and inclusive working environment for all. 

Our Benefits

    Boots Retirement Savings Plan    Discretionary annual bonus    Generous employee discounts    Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption leave pay and gift card for anyone expecting or adopting a child    Flexible benefits scheme including holiday buying, discounted gym membership, life assurance, activity passes and more.    Access to free, 24/7 counselling and support through TELUS Health, our Employee Assistance Programme.

We have a great range of benefits in addition to the above that offer flexibility to suit you - find out more at boots.jobs/rewards. (Please note, any salary estimates given on third-party sites are not provided or endorsed by Boots and may not be accurate)

What’s Next

 If your application is successful, our in-house recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an interview and to answer any initial questions you have. If you have not been successful on this occasion, you’ll be notified by email.  

Where a role is advertised as full-time, we are open to discussing part-time and job share options during the application process. If you require additional support as part of the application and interview process, we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments to help you to be at your best.

rows.title: Senior Data Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Technology at Primark 

Our technology team is actively shaping the next wave of advancements. Engaged with innovative initiatives, your expertise will propel our business into the future. Collaborating with a creative team of tech enthusiasts, you’ll contribute your unique skills to fuel our technological advancements.

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join Primark’s Data Platform & Engineering team, leading the design and delivery of scalable data solutions on our Databricks-based enterprise platform. You will build and optimise trusted data products that power reporting, analytics, AI and data science across the business. Working closely with engineering, analytics and business teams, you will provide technical leadership, mentor Data Engineers and drive engineering best practices. This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer with deep expertise in Databricks, dbt Cloud, Spark and SQL, who is passionate about delivering high-quality data solutions. You will play a key role in Primark’s migration from Teradata to Databricks and the ongoing evolution of our Data & Analytics capabilities.

What You'll Do

Data Engineering Delivery: Design, build and optimise scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows and data transformation solutions using Databricks, PySpark, SQL and dbt Cloud, delivering trusted, high-quality data products that support reporting, analytics, AI and data science. Data Architecture & Modelling: Develop and maintain robust lakehouse architectures and reusable data models, ensuring solutions are scalable, performant, secure and aligned with enterprise data standards. Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence: Lead engineering initiatives, establish best practices and drive high standards across development, testing, deployment, documentation and monitoring, while championing automation and CI/CD adoption. Code Quality & Team Mentorship: Provide technical guidance, conduct code reviews and mentor Data Engineers to strengthen engineering capability, promote knowledge sharing and foster a culture of continuous improvement. Platform Modernisation: Play a key role in Primark’s migration from Teradata to Databricks, supporting data remodelling, pipeline migration, performance optimisation and the ongoing evolution of the enterprise data platform. Data Product Delivery & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Analytics, Data Science, Governance and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions and reusable datasets that deliver measurable business value. Continuous Improvement & Strategic Contribution: Identify opportunities to improve platform performance, scalability and cost efficiency, while contributing to engineering standards, roadmap initiatives and the long-term growth of Primark’s Data & Analytics capabilities. 

What You'll Bring

Advanced Data Engineering Experience (5-8 Years): Strong hands-on experience designing, building and optimising enterprise-scale data pipelines and data platforms using Databricks, PySpark and advanced SQL. Cloud Data Platforms & Architecture: Proven experience working with Azure-based data technologies and designing scalable lakehouse architectures, data models and modern cloud data solutions. dbt & Engineering Best Practices: Experience with dbt Cloud or dbt Core, including model development, testing, documentation, lineage, deployment workflows, CI/CD and version control practices. Data Quality, Performance & Optimisation: Strong understanding of data quality, observability, operational monitoring and performance tuning, with a focus on delivering reliable, scalable and cost-efficient data solutions. Data Product Delivery & Commercial Value: Demonstrated success delivering data products that support analytics, reporting, AI and data science use cases, driving measurable business outcomes and value creation. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement: Ability to provide technical leadership, translate business requirements into scalable solutions and collaborate effectively across Engineering, Analytics, Governance, Architecture and business teams. Mentoring & Continuous Improvement: Experience coaching engineers, sharing best practices and driving continuous improvement across data engineering teams. 

About Primark

At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 440 stores in 17 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together.

rows.descriptionText:
Requirements

 Description & Requirements 

Technology Director | Global Sourcing Technology

Who we are

lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people.

About This Team

Global Supply Chain Technology delivers the platforms and capabilities that power lululemon’s supply chain—from raw material innovation and development, costing, sourcing, quality, sustainability and traceability, trade, logistics, and distribution technology. Our team works in close partnership with core business units to ensure that our supply chain remains agile, efficient, and responsive to ever-evolving market demands. By continuously innovating and refining our technological solutions, we enable best-in-class supply chain operations to service our Guests and our stores. This collaborative approach ensures we provide exceptional experiences and support lululemon’s growth in every community we serve.

The role

We are seeking a Technology Director to define and execute the multi year strategy for modernizing and transforming lululemon’s global sourcing technology ecosystem. This leader will shape the strategic roadmap, elevate costing and sourcing platform capabilities, advance AI driven decisioning, and ensure operational excellence across the systems that connect lululemon to its global vendor base.

You will own all aspects of technology for Global Sourcing—architecture, engineering, security, QA automation, operations, and delivery—and oversee a globally distributed team across North America and India. You will be accountable for the platforms that support approximately 300 raw material (RM) and finished goods (FG) vendors globally, and will partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on the technology evolution required to support enterprise initiatives. This role requires a seasoned leader with a proven record of developing a strong leadership bench, managing complex solutions, and thriving in complex, fast paced, and highly collaborative environments.

This Role Oversees Technology Solutions Supporting

Product costing and should-cost modelling (materials, labor, overhead, landed cost)Sourcing execution (quoting and RFQ, vendor award, capacity allocation and booking)Purchase order management and order lifecycle for raw material and finished goodsSupplier collaboration portals and vendor-facing self-servicePartner connectivity (vendors, mills, agents, service providers)Integration frameworks (EDI, APIs, event-driven architecture)Master data and data quality for costSourcing analytics, margin visibility, exception management, and operational dashboards

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Roadmap

Define and deliver a multi year global sourcing technology strategy that enhances scalability, reliability, and speed to market.Translate business needs into an actionable engineering roadmap incorporating modernization, cloud migration, supplier collaboration, and responsible AI adoption.Partner with business Directors, Sr. Directors, and VPs across Global Sourcing and Costing to define, deliver, and support the strategic roadmap.Enroll cross functional technology partners in the strategic vision for Global Sourcing, and lead the creation and expansion of new capabilities that align with our strategic goals.

Platform & Architecture Modernization

Modernize existing costing and sourcing platforms and integrate next generation capabilities (costing engines, sourcing execution suites, or equivalent).Drive transformation toward API-first, event-driven, and scalable integration architectures across the global vendor base.Lead design and implementation of secure, resilient, and responsible data management and governance frameworks for material, vendor, and cost master data.Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Engineering on technology evolution that supports enterprise initiatives.

Engineering Leadership

Lead globally distributed engineering, QA automation, delivery, and support teams; develop managers and future-ready technical leaders.Serve as the escalation point for Technology Managers to support delivery, making thoughtful decisions on the fly and constantly clearing roadblocks.Raise engineering standards around quality, observability, security, and system reliability.Build high performing, diverse teams with a culture of inclusion, transparency, and continuous improvement, and support career progression and stretch opportunities across the Global Sourcing technology area.

Operational Excellence

Oversee delivery, operations, and vendor/partner management across sourcing and costing systems, and own the relationship with key vendor partners.Manage budgets for strategic initiatives and baseline opex for Global Sourcing technology, ensuring clear ROI and optimization of total cost of ownership.Drive root cause analysis, systems reliability, service maturity, and measurable operational improvements.

Innovation & AI Enablement

Introduce AI-driven decision support for should-cost modelling, quote analysis, capacity allocation, vendor performance, and exception management.Champion ethical, transparent, and responsible use of AI in sourcing and vendor-facing operations.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or commensurate relative experience.15+ years of experience in technology, including 4+ years in a senior leadership position such as a Technology Manager or Technology Director.Experience leading large scale initiatives and modernization efforts for supply chain platforms, with highly valued experience in costing and sourcing areas.Proven success delivering transformations in areas such as product costing, sourcing execution, purchase order management, supplier collaboration, or vendor connectivity.Strong background in integration architectures (API platforms, EDI, message streaming, event-driven design).Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or Java and familiarity with data engineering patterns.Demonstrated ability to manage large budgets and deliver high-impact technology programs.Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive influencing skills.Continuous learning mindset that stays on the leading edge of sourcing and supply chain technology solutions that can bring value to the organization.Experience with AI/ML use cases in supply chain, sourcing, or costing.Understanding of apparel or consumer goods product development, raw materials, and global vendor management processes.Experience working with distributed teams across multiple time zones and a global vendor base.

Success Metrics

Improved cost accuracy, margin visibility, and speed of costing cycles.Reduced sourcing and purchase order cycle times, with fewer manual touches per order.Improved reliability, uptime, and SLA performance of sourcing and costing systems.Strong engagement scores and leadership development of global teams.

Must Haves

Acknowledges the presence of choice in every moment and takes personal responsibility for their life.Possesses an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovates to achieve great results.Communicates with honesty and kindness and creates the space for others to do the same.Leads with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure.Fosters connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships.Integrates fun and joy as a way of being and working, aka doesn’t take themselves too seriously.

additional notes

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time for this role.

Compensation And Benefits Package

lululemon’s compensation offerings are grounded in a pay-for-performance philosophy that recognizes exceptional individual and team performance. The typical hiring range for this position is from  $190,400 - $249,900  annually; the base pay offered is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards offering, permanent employees in this position may be eligible for our competitive annual bonus program and equity offerings, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

At Lululemon, Investing In Our People Is a Top Priority. We Believe That When Life Works, Work Works. We Strive To Be The Place Where Inclusive Leaders Come To Develop And Enable All To Be Well. Recognizing Our Teams For Their Performance And Dedication, Other Components Of Our Total Rewards Offerings Include Support Of Career Development, Wellbeing, And Personal Growth

Extended health and dental benefits, and mental health plans Paid time off Savings and retirement plan matching Generous employee discount Fitness & yoga classes Parenthood top-up Extensive catalog of development course offerings People networks, mentorship programs, and leadership series (to name a few) 

Note: The incentive programs, benefits, and perks have certain eligibility requirements. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice.

workplace arrangement

Hybrid

In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Work is performed onsite, minimum 4 days per week.

Authorization to work in the US is required for this role.

rows.title: International Marketing Director FTC
rows.descriptionText:
International Marketing Director – 12 month FTC 

We’re Pret: proud makers of freshly made food, organic coffee, and big ideas . Across 750+ shops and 20+ countries, our teams are shaping the future of Pret through innovation, inclusion, great customer service and a shared passion for doing the right thing . We’re growing fast on our mission to be the employer of choice in hospitality, everywhere we operate – so this an exciting time to hop on board.

 We Believe in Growing Good Things 

Growth i s at the heart of everything we do. From the freshly hand-made food we create every day, to supporting our teams, we help our people grow in confidence, skills and to pursue their unique paths. Pret is where passionate, hardworking, wonderful people (like you!) find what they need to shine. And the proof is in the pudding – over 80% of our managers started on the shop floor! So did 20% of our Support Centre teams, including our CEO, Pano . 

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for passionate team players to bring joy to our customers every day. As a n International Marketing Director – Global Marketing you’ll report into Pret’s Chief Marketing Officer as a key member of the Global Marketing team. The International Marketing Director is instrumental in driving the global brand vision for Pret measured via brand awareness and consideration, customer love and transactional growth in international markets. This person will be the voice of the customer across all equity and franchise markets outside of the UK and US. The Director will lead the strategic vision, oversight and direction to international franchise partners while leading internal talented team of Marketeers. This role will also have a dotted line into the International President and will sit on the International Leadership Team. Success will rely on being an effective and credible collaborator who will thrive in our matrix org structure and work together with franchise partners. This role represents an exceptional opportunity for a strategic, passionate, creative marketer to join a hugely successful and ambitious global business and make a significant impact on Pret’s growth trajectory and success.

Key Responsibilities

 Work with the Global Marketing team, International Sales team, and franchise partners to create marketing strategies for all international markets, ensuring the international markets achieving sales and transaction targets on a consistent basis.  Develop and drive comprehensive marketing calendar plans for each international market For equity markets, e.g., Hong Kong and France, manage and collate all marketing communications activities and supervise product development processes. For master franchisee markets, e.g., Singapore and South Africa, direct and influence all marketing communications activities and product development processes.  Build a best-in-class International Marketing team, from recruitment through to management and coaching.  Develop and optimise our product ranges, working with the Innovation team to deliver new, industry – leading food and drink offerings with core consumer relevance.  Create impactful ad campaigns that drive brand awareness and consideration and yield tangible results.  Work with the Analytical team to create clear ways to measure and drive ROI of all marketing activities. 

Experience And Skills Required

 In-depth marketing experience with consumer-facing brands within Quick Service Restaurants (QSR), Hospitality, Food Retail or related consumer-led industries .  Essential experience working within a franchised business environment , with the ability to balance commercial growth, brand standards and franchise partner relationships. International franchise experience is desirable but not essential.  Building and implementing annual calendars and media buying plans.  Developing marketing communications plans and leading multi-channel marketing campaigns from insight generation through to execution , including briefing agencies and developing campaigns based on consumer insights.  Conducting marketing analytics and performance analysis.  Understanding how best to measure marketing performance and ROI across a variety of channels.  Experience dealing with executive stakeholders, representing and articulating key topics and providing subject matter expertise.  Prior experience working on international teams or with brands across multiple regions and countries.  Gathering customer insights, developing research plans and implementing findings.  Product development, menu innovation and go-to-market planning.  Strong understanding of pricing, product laddering, menu architecture, ranging and commercial decision-making within a QSR, hospitality or retail environment.  Ability to operate effectively in complex, fast-paced and ambiguous environments, demonstrating resilience, adaptability and strong commercial judgement. 

About You

 Be kind, honest and generous: bring genuine warmth and your authentic self to work every day.  Bring your passion: share our passion for food and exceptional customer service.  Spread joy every day: small acts of kindness are a big part of what makes the Pret experience special. 

 We offer 

 Competitive Salary and bonus potential  Gold Card: We love making people’s day through our food and drinks. That goes for our teams too. That’s why everyone gets a Gold Card. When you’re in the office, your food and drinks are on us. And when you’re not, you can use your Gold Card to get up to 5 Barista-made drinks a day, and 50% off everything else (food, snacks, bottled drinks – the lot). 

 A few more perks 

 You’ll get 33 days of annual leave (including flexible Bank Holidays), increasing to 38 days the longer you’re with us.  Free private medical cover, with the option to add family or partner at an additional cost   4% of your pension contribution matched by Pret, rises to 5% after 5 years  Life assurance at 3x annual salary   Loyalty award for 5, 10, 15, 20 years’ service   Flexible Benefits Platform packed with lifestyle discounts  Season ticket loans   Healthcare cash plan    Financial wellbeing provisions   Free mortgage services   Sabbatical after 3 years   Opportunities to support our charity, The Pret Foundation 

 We also offer 

 Individual ways to grow - We offer lots of opportunities for learning, whether you join us for a short stint or the long game, you’re good to grow with us. Including fully funded professional qualifications, leadership development and mentoring.  Diversity and belonging - Everyone is welcome at Pret, we want you to feel confident and valued for who you are and to truly belong.  Pace and variety - Our work is fast paced with lots of variety, you’ll build a diverse skill set and learn a lot!  Community and purpose - We’re proud to make a difference through The Pret Foundation, from tackling homelessness to reducing food waste and creating positive change for people and communities. 

 Our values 

 Happy Teams Happy Customers  Amazing Standards Every day  Never Standing Still  Doing The Right Thing 

 The interview journey 

Every interview process at Pret begins with the same two stages. First, you’ll have a relaxed conversation with our recruitment team so we can get to know you and your experience. Next, you’ll be invited to a one-hour, in-person interview with the hiring manager at our Head Office in London Victoria.

Depending on the role and function, there may be additional stages. These could include time spent in one of our shops, completing a task, or meeting a senior leader.

 Before you apply 

This role is a 12 month Fixed Term Contract based at Pret’s Support Centre in London Victoria, where we work in a hybrid way - typically three days a week in the office. This role is expected to involve approximately  20–25% international travel  , including regular visits to key markets, regional teams and franchise partners to build relationships, drive alignment and support the successful delivery of growth initiatives.

We’d love to get to know you, not a robot, so please do not rely on AI to complete your application.

 Deadline to apply for this role: 7  th   October at midnight

VP I, AI & Machine Learning

 LD Modeling & Arch

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at www.circana.com.

Role Overview

The VP of AI & Machine Learning leads the design, development, and delivery of enterprise-scale data, analytics, and business intelligence solutions. This role is responsible for defining technology architecture, building scalable data platforms, and implementing analytical, multidimensional, and statistical models that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.

As a senior technical leader, the Vice President drives innovation in data architecture, advanced analytics, machine learning, and high-performance computing environments while ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

Job Responsibilities

Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-wide data, analytics, and business intelligence architectures. Develop scalable data models, frameworks, and architectures that support reporting, analytics, and advanced data science initiatives. Design and oversee the implementation of analytical, multidimensional, and statistical models to generate business insights and support strategic decision-making. Integrate and optimize diverse data sources across enterprise systems and platforms. Establish and maintain data governance, security, and data quality standards to ensure compliance and reliability. Develop automation frameworks and modeling methodologies that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability. Partner with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful solution delivery. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to data architects, engineers, and analytics professionals. Drive innovation across data platforms, cloud technologies, machine learning initiatives, and high-performance computing environments. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that enhance organizational data and analytics capabilities. 

Requirements

Extensive experience in Enterprise Data Architecture, Data Modeling, and Business Intelligence solution design and delivery. Deep knowledge of Big Data Platforms, Distributed Systems, and scalable data processing architectures. Strong understanding of Data Governance, Data Security, and enterprise data management best practices. Experience implementing and supporting Machine Learning, advanced analytics, and statistical modeling solutions. Proficiency with SQL and analytical database technologies. Strong programming experience in C/C++, Java, or related enterprise development languages. Experience working with Cloud Technologies and modern data platform ecosystems. Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale technology initiatives and influence technical strategy. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams. Proven leadership experience guiding and developing high-performing technical teams. 

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location: This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, United States

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $180,000 to $205,000 USD.

This job is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Qualitative Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

The salary range for this role is $66,000-77,000/year + bonus

Numerator Verified Voices combines verified purchase behavior with mobile surveys to unlock consumer and shopper insights that build stronger brands. Powered by the industry's largest and most diverse consumer purchase panel, our Research Consulting team delivers unmatched insight into consumer influencers, behaviors, and opinions, and we deliver actionable, decision-driving insights for some of the world's leading brands.

Numerator is seeking a Qualitative Analyst to join our dynamic Qualitative division. This role is responsible for contributing to qualitative project success, with a focus on executing research tasks and taking increasing ownership of the guide design and reporting phases. We are looking for an individual who can support and own phases of larger projects, ensuring timely completion and high-quality deliverables. You will play a crucial role in bringing consumer narratives to life while actively incorporating new technologies into our research processes.

Who You Are

Curious about things you don’t know or don’t understand. A believer of achieving optimal results through teamwork and collaboration. An individual with an analytical mindset and a penchant for strong data visualization and delivering actionable insights. A natural storyteller. Excited about the possibilities of intelligently-designed technology and AI in the world of Qualitative research. 

What You'll Do

Contribute to all phases of executing projects, from design to execution to analysis and delivery. Participate in ownership of the overall success of deliverables and projects, ensuring they are high quality, error-free, and on time. Analyze qualitative data and craft strategic, story-driven reports in Word and PowerPoint. Collaborate with Qualitative Consultants to deliver clear, actionable insights supported by compelling narratives. Create media driven outputs such as video reels and summary decks that bring qualitative findings to life. Integrate and leverage AI tools within the qualitative workflow to drive process efficiency, accelerate analysis, and enhance deliverable quality. Moderate qualitative research sessions primarily in asynchronous online platforms, guiding discussions that uncover deep consumer insights. Work on multiple qualitative projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, budgets, and client expectations are consistently met or exceeded. Manage your own capacity and proactively communicate availability to assist others or request support when needed. Provide constructive feedback for delegation to supporting operations teams as necessary. Actively participate in team discussions, fostering a positive team culture and contributing to survey initiatives.

A basic to solid understanding of qualitative research methodologies and working knowledge of consumer panels. Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Intermediate to advanced skills in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Demonstrated ability to work in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and tasks simultaneously. Ability to communicate clearly through both written and live settings. Can operate in an ever-changing environment and work within tight but reasonable deadlines.

Market competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs with senior Qualitative colleagues, leadership training, access to conferences and employee resources groups. rows.title: Head of CRM
rows.descriptionText:
Why Join DAZN?
At DAZN, we don't just broadcast sport — we amplify it. We're one of the world's leading sports streaming platforms, and we sit at the heart of two of the most passionate fan communities in global sport — football and boxing.
The Role
As Head of CRM for Global Football & Boxing, you'll be the architect of how we communicate with fans at every stage of their journey at a global scale. From discovery to becoming a passionate subscriber; catching all world title fights, you'll influence the infrastructure, lead strategy and optimise touch points for key DAZN sports.
Football on DAZN combines UEFA Champions League La Lega and Serie A, delivering fans live matches, documentaries, classic games, and original programming from across the football world.
DAZN Boxing is the world's leading boxing streaming destination, home to the biggest fights, the biggest names, and the most passionate fan base in combat sports. From world title fights to emerging talent, DAZN Boxing delivers premium boxing content to fans globally through both subscription and pay-per-view.
CRM sits at the heart of making both propositions sticky, personal and commercially successful.
What You'll Be Doing:
Define and own the global CRM strategy across football and boxing, covering the full customer lifecycle - acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and win-back.Build world-class lifecycle marketing automations for both sports that maximise fan engagement, reduce churn, and grow subscriber and pay-per-view lifetime value.Create integrated CRM calendars, identifying and activating cross-sport CRM opportunities — using data and behavioural insight to introduce football subscribers to boxing content and vice versa, growing overall engagement and reducing churn across the combined baseChampion a fan-first philosophy, driving a personalisation roadmap across platform pop-ups, email, push notification, in-app messaging, and SMS.Driving the team’s full utilisation of CRM tools to improve capability and efficiency in deliveryDevelop specific PPV-focused CRM journeys for boxing - including pre-event hype and awareness, purchase conversion, event-day experience, and post-event follow-up sequencesEnsure CRM communications are localised appropriately for key markets across both sports, working with regional teams and translation partners to maintain relevance and cultural sensitivityWork with regional marketing leads across DAZN's global offices to ensure CRM programmes are adapted and executed effectively at a local level across both sports and cross-sold where possible.
What You'll Bring:
A passion for Sport – we're all fans and so are our customers.Significant CRM leadership experience — ideally at Head of CRM or equivalent senior level — within a fast paced global consumer businessProven track record of building and scaling lifecycle marketing programmes that demonstrably improve retention, engagement, and customer lifetime valueExperience managing CRM across both subscription and transactional/pay-per-view or event-based commercial models — understanding the distinct dynamics of each and how to optimise CRM for bothDeep expertise across CRM channels — email, push, in-app, and SMS — including hands-on experience with enterprise-level CRM and marketing automation platformsStrong data and analytics capability — comfortable working with large datasets, building segmentation models, and interpreting complex performance dataExperience developing and executing personalisation strategies at scale, including working with data science and engineering teams on predictive modellingProven ability to manage complex, cross-functional stakeholder relationships in a global, matrixed organisationExperience working in or alongside a subscription-based, streaming, or content-led businessExcellent communication skills — able to translate complex CRM strategy and data into clear, compelling narratives for senior stakeholdersHappy to go “all in” – with football and boxing events at evenings and weekends you’ll need to be flexible with working hours.
Benefits
Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.
About DAZN
At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.
As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.
DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO: 
Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to Make It Happen. 
Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, Focusing On Impact. 
Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to Win As One. 
At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.
If you’d like to include a cover letter with your application, please feel free to. Please do not feel you need to apply with a photo or disclose any other information that is not related to your professional experience.
Our aim is to make our hiring processes as accessible for everyone as possible, including providing adjustments for interviews where we can.
We look forward to hearing from you.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded UI
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?This team spends most of its time working on customer focused features that improve the user experience, from content discovery and search to Roku pay and subscription to embedded software and firmware, and much more. Our product roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide. Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media. What is the role?As a Senior Software Engineer on the OS UI/SDK team, you will design, develop, and deliver engaging platform features — including screensavers, static and dynamic wallpapers, trivia, featured experiences, and AI-driven content initiatives — that reach millions of Roku users worldwide. You will leverage AI and machine learning technologies to develop new capabilities that enhance user experiences across the Roku platform. This role requires a proactive, ownership-driven approach where you will create proof-of-concept prototypes in a startup-minded environment and then adapt those prototypes for production-grade deployment. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in UI/UX design, product management, backend engineering, and business leadership to translate ideas into impactful solutions. You will investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain high-quality, commercially viable products. This is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming entertainment through innovation and a deep commitment to engineering excellence. How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. What are the responsibilities of the role?Design and develop features for new experiences on the Roku platform, including screensavers, wallpapers, trivia, and featured experiencesBuild proof-of-concept prototypes to validate ideas rapidly, working with a startup mindset to iterate quickly and deliver solutionsCollaborate with UI/UX design, backend engineering, and product management teams to create and implement new user experiencesAdapt proof-of-concept solutions into production-ready, scalable implementationsLeverage AI, machine learning, and large language model technologies to develop innovative platform featuresInvestigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain commercially viable solutionsContribute to API design decisions, understanding considerations and trade-offsWork across cloud development, content management, and UI development to deliver end-to-end feature solutions What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?Extensive experience in a software engineering environmentDemonstrated project work using AI/ML and LLM technologiesProficiency in scripting languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React Native, Python, BrightScript, or related technologiesExperience working in an embedded environmentExperience in productionising solutions, including content management, UI development, cloud development, and cloud backend integrationKnowledge of core OS concepts such as memory management and multi-threadingExperience in API design, with an understanding of considerations and trade-offsStrong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teamsConsumer electronics experience in media, content, or ad product development is a plusBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. rows.title: Senior Marketing Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Department: 77-893 - Subscription - Digital Acquisition MediaLocation: UK - Leeds 

Description

The Senior Marketing Analyst will act as the analytical backbone of the Central Marketing team, turning complex marketing and customer data into clear, actionable insight that shapes budget decisions, campaign strategy, and channel performance across DAZN's markets. This role owns the reporting infrastructure that stakeholders rely on to understand marketing effectiveness, working closely with performance marketing, brand, and data engineering teams to ensure decisions are grounded in reliable, well-modelled data. The successful candidate will combine deep technical fluency in modern data tooling with a strong commercial understanding of marketing metrics, acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders on what the numbers mean and what to do about them.

What You'll Be Doing:

Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting suites in Looker, ensuring marketing performance data is accurate, timely, and accessible to stakeholders across the businessWrite and optimise complex SQL queries in Snowflake to extract, transform, and model marketing and customer data from DAZN's data warehouseUse Deepnote (or similar notebook environments) for deeper ad-hoc analysis, exploratory data work, and building repeatable analytical workflowsQuery and interpret the GA4 export dataset in BigQuery, working directly with the raw event-level schema to support campaign measurement, attribution, and web/app behavioural analysisBuild and maintain Excel-based models and analyses where needed, including budget summaries, ad-hoc calculations, and stakeholder-ready outputsPartner with performance marketing, brand, and CRM teams to define and track key marketing metrics (e.g. CAC, ROAS, CPA, LTV, conversion rates)Translate business questions into structured analyses, presenting findings and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadershipSupport budget planning and allocation decisions with data-driven modelling across markets and channelsMaintain data governance standards for marketing datasets, including documentation of metric definitions and data lineageIdentify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and improve the efficiency of the analytics functionCollaborate with data engineering to influence the underlying data model where it affects marketing reporting needsMentor junior analysts on best practices in SQL, dashboarding, and analytical rigour

What You'll Bring:

Strong Looker skills, including familiarity with LookML (Looker's proprietary modeling language, not machine learning) — dashboard design and troubleshooting; full LookML fluency can be developed on the jobStrong Snowflake proficiency: writing efficient, well-structured SQL against large-scale datasets; understanding of warehouse performance and cost considerationsWorking knowledge of Deepnote (or comparable notebook tools such as Jupyter): comfortable using Python/SQL in a notebook environment for analysis beyond dashboardingConfident with Google Analytics and ExcelSolid grounding in marketing metrics and measurement frameworks across paid, owned, and earned channelsAbility to communicate technical findings to non-technical audiences, including senior stakeholdersExperience working in fast-paced, multi-market organisations is a plus, ideally within media, streaming, or sports/entertainmentComfortable balancing competing stakeholder priorities and managing ambiguity

Benefits

Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.

rows.title: Senior Workforce Strategist & HR Business Partner
rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

Audible's People & Places HRBP team is seeking a Senior Workforce Strategist & HRBP, a hybrid role centered on workforce planning expertise and strategic HR business partnership. You'll serve as a trusted advisor in driving end-to-end workforce planning: building models, running multi-scenario analyses, forecasting, and translating long-range business plans into actionable strategies. You will partner to translate business strategy into talent decisions, driving data informed planning that optimizes size, structure, location and capability.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You’ll drive shaping workforce planning strategies alongside Sr HRBPs and business leaders that ensure the right talent, in the right roles, at the right time. You’ll partner through org design, coaching and change management as a secondary function. You bring experience in workforce analytics, headcount modeling, scenario planning, and cross-functional collaboration. If you thrive at the intersection of people strategy, data, business insight, and people decisions in a fast-paced, creative environment, and want to be part of Audible's AI-forward strategy and navigate the people side of AI transformation, we'd like to speak with you.

As a Senior Workforce Strategist & HR Business Partner, you will...

 Drive end-to-end strategic workforce planning—headcount modelling, talent supply/demand analysis, scenario planning—to support multi-year business objectives Develop and execute 1- and 3-year workforce plans aligned to operational planning cycles, partnering with HR, Finance, and business leadership to ensure the right roles, levels, and locations to deliver on goals Drive location strategy decisions—geographic expansion, consolidation, and distributed team design. Leverage workforce planning analytics and behavioral insights to deliver data-informed recommendations that accelerate innovation and enhance customer experience at acceptable cost Design and implement organization structures that optimize for speed, efficiency, and scalability across tech and non-tech functions, including spans & layers analysis, role ratio optimization, and cost modelling Develop AI talent strategies and frameworks, forecasting AI skill needs Conduct organizational assessments to identify structural gaps, span of control considerations, talent distribution patterns, redundancies, and opportunities to streamline decision-making and improve overall org health; present recommendations to Audible's C-Suite leaders Define and track metrics that influence stakeholders, measure success, and surface workforce trends, informing strategic direction. Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders across tech and non-tech orgs, translating business strategy into people strategy that drives performance and sustainable growth Provide candid leadership coaching to help managers build high-performing, inclusive teams Lead org design and change management with empathy and rigor—finding creative paths forward when playbooks don't exist Anticipate challenges by staying close to the business, diagnosing root causes early, and delivering adaptive, lasting solutions Strengthen performance, engagement, and retention through lightweight, scalable processes aligned to how Audible operates Drive improvements to talent mechanisms—promotion, calibration, succession, and talent review—in partnership with HRBPs, COEs, and cross-functional leaders Partner on leading change management within AI transformation — helping teams embrace AI tools while maintaining a people-first approach Recognize when solutions require additional technical guidance and advocate for resources by influencing cross-functional teams.

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners' imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic Qualifications

 Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization, or experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects Experience with workforce planning 7+ years of progressive HR or workforce planning experience, including 3+ years independently driving strategic workforce planning (headcount modeling, scenario planning, talent supply/demand analysis) Experience supporting both technical and non-technical talent populations Analytical and data modeling skills, with demonstrated ability to build workforce models, interpret trends, and translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders Bachelor's degree or above in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development, Psychology, or a related field Certification in org design methodologies (e.g., Galbraith Star Model, McKinsey 7S) or workforce planning

Preferred Qualifications

 Master's degree in HR, MBA, or related advanced degree Experience supporting organizations of 500+ employees across 5+ countries Demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal direction in ambiguous environments HRBP Experience in high-growth media, entertainment, technology, or creative industry environments Coaching and consulting skills with the ability to influence at executive levels of the organization Ability to think big while also rolling up your sleeves—managing multiple priorities simultaneously while continually moving initiatives forward High integrity: known for discretion, fairness, and trustworthiness when the stakes are high
