rows.title: Integrator - Client Relationship Transformation
rows.descriptionText:
JOB TITLE: IntegratorLOCATION: LondonHOURS: Full-timeSALARY: Competitive Package
What you'll be doing:We're looking for a Lead Integrator to coordinate the dependencies and complex implementations that will bring AI-enabled Client Relationship capabilities to life for the Corporate & Institutional Bank (CIB) within Lloyds Banking Group. This is a multi-year transformation: replacing a fragmented Client facing Colleague journey - today spread across more than 60 disconnected systems - with a single Client Relationship Spine that gives colleagues a seamless, end-to-end view of client activity.
Sitting at platform level and covering both business and technology change, you'll establish the pivotal integration points across labs and platforms, sequence the work in step with lab leadership, and coordinate the internal and external parties - other platforms, CIB Leadership and third parties - needed to deliver safely and at pace. You'll take the lead on complex, high-risk implementations across shared infrastructure, removing blockers and keeping change moving over the line.
This is an emerging capability at the intersection of AI, data and enterprise change, and the role will evolve as those capabilities mature. You'll help land the colleague Interface, Digital Twin, agent-based Brain and the connection to a governed data Foundation that will define how CIB colleagues serve clients by 2030. We're looking for a commercially minded delivery and integration expert who understands CIB, works effectively across business and technology teams, and can turn strategy into safely delivered, interlocked capabilities.
Above all, we want someone who lives and breathes AI - genuinely energised by what these technologies can do, hands-on with the latest tools, and constantly experimenting to stay at the frontier. You'll bring that curiosity into the team every day, spotting where emerging AI capabilities can reshape how we deliver and integrate change.
Key ResponsibilitiesEstablish the pivotal integration points across labs and platforms, and communicate them clearly to relevant stakeholders.Develop the sequence for integration-related tasks in collaboration with lab leadership and aligned to the lab backlog.Catalogue and manage dependencies between the platform and other teams, working with stakeholders outside the platform to secure the interlock that lets the platform deliver at pace.Identify blockers to delivery and, where possible, mitigate or resolve them - raising to Product Owners or platform leadership where required.Manage complex and high-risk implementations requiring integration between multiple internal and external parties to ensure safe delivery.Coordinate the integration process and implementation events across shared infrastructure (e.g. mainframe upgrades), leading the SI process and coordinating parties to get the change over the line.Manage third-party suppliers and a portfolio of contracts - providing oversight, negotiating and monitoring service levels, and managing performance while reporting to senior colleagues.Provide expertise (not content) for governance activity owned by the Product Owner for change across multiple deliverables.Coordinate across multiple teams to develop medium- and long-term work and release schedules, uncovering emerging issues, causes, stakeholders and barriers, and developing innovative solutions from complex, diverse information.Manage output delivery for a substantial area by leading others - setting medium-term objectives, coaching colleagues, and acting as a senior source of professional expertise.
Why join us?If you think all banks are the same, you're wrong. We're a pioneering, fast-changing business that's shaping finance as a force for good. If you're after a role where you can have an impact and do the best work of your career, you've just found it.
What we're looking for?Strong Corporate & Institutional Banking or wider financial services knowledge.A genuine passion for AI and emerging technology - someone who lives and breathes it: hands-on with current tools, quick to learn new ones, and able to translate fast-moving AI capability into safe, deliverable integration.Experience of integrating or deploying AI/GenAI products, agents or tooling into enterprise environments.Demonstrable experience of leading complex, high-risk implementations and integration across multiple internal and external parties, with evidence of safe delivery at pace.Strong dependency, planning and delivery-management capability, coordinating interlock across teams, platforms and third parties in an agile or iterative environment.Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills - aligning business and technology perspectives, surfacing trade-offs and securing timely decisions.Leadership experience, including leading delivery through others, mentoring, and serving as a senior point of expertise and critical issue resolution.Experience and evidence of delivering change across complex, regulated Corporate or Institutional Banking environments and shared infrastructure.Digital transformation experience.Experience of Agile ways of working and the Product Operating Model.· It would be great if you also had:Supplier and contract management experience, including oversight of service levels and management of underperformance.Experience delivering AI and machine learning capabilities including managing the groups Responsible AI journey

And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. About This Opportunity

As Senior Manager, Data Privacy & Records Management, you'll play a key role in helping Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) protect personal data, manage records and enable the responsible use of data across a complex and highly regulated environment.

Operating within the CIB COO Data Office, you'll provide expertise on privacy and records management, support strategic decision-making and help enable the safe adoption of emerging technologies, including AI. You'll work across business, technology, risk, change and control teams to balance regulatory obligations with innovation and transformation across multiple jurisdictions and legal entities.

You'll join a highly visible team at the centre of CIB's data agenda within a business area that continues to receive significant investment. This is an opportunity to shape data practices, influence meaningful change and help deliver pragmatic solutions that support the responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. This is an exciting opportunity to use your technical expertise to collaborate with colleagues and build effortless, digital first customer experiencesYou’ll be simplifying the bank by developing innovative data driven solutions, using insight to be commercially successful, and keeping our customers’ and the bank’s data safe and secureParticipating actively in the data engineering community, you’ll deliver opportunities to support the bank’s strategic direction while building your network across the bank

rows.title: Staff Security Strategist GRC
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Uber's Engineering Security team works to ensure the security of information for our full set of users - riders, eaters, drivers and partners. Our ultimate goal is to ensure that every experience with Uber is simple, secure, and safe. We are seeking a talented Staff Security Strategist, GRC to join our Tech Risk and Assurance team within Engineering Security.

About The Role

The Staff Security Strategist, GRC partners with engineering, security, and cross-functional risk stakeholders to strengthen Uber's cybersecurity posture through scalable cyber risk management, risk governance, and control design programs. This role is responsible for driving and implementing security, compliance, and risk management programs on the ServiceNow eGRC platform at Uber, working with the engineering team to develop and enable technical solutions that satisfy a variety of risk and compliance processes.

This role operates at the intersection of technical security, process design, and risk governance. The successful candidate will translate control gaps, threat and business context, and compliance requirements into practical risk treatment plans that engineering teams can execute, while driving consistent risk analysis, decision-making, and follow-through. The role must be able to deliver work products required by Agile development methodologies for software development delivery as defined.

What You Will Do

 Own cyber risk intake, triage, and prioritization, ensuring clear accountability, well-formed risk statements, and timely treatment decisions.  Develop product strategy and lead project execution for multiple major components of Uber's Risk and Compliance technology solutions.  Manage different solutions on Uber's internal eGRC platform (ServiceNow) and collaborate with stakeholders to implement their program improvements.  Partner with engineering teams to define risk treatment plans, identify sustainable fixes, and drive mitigation or remediation to the last mile rather than stopping at documentation.  Gather business and functional requirements from partner teams and deliver a product/release that meets the needs presented. Develop technical specifications documentation.  Lead or materially contribute to control design reviews, risk assessments, and risk decisions that require judgment, stakeholder alignment, and tradeoff management.  Drive and evangelize vision for overall GRC strategy across engineering and security organizations.  Analyze and fully understand user stories and internal procedures in order to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows, and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the eGRC platform.  Work with developers to implement workflows from customer requirements including workflows, UI actions, client scripts, business rules, etc.  Load, manipulate, and maintain data between the eGRC platform and other systems as needed.  Build and maintain risk reporting for leaders and partner teams, including KRIs, exposure trends, risk acceptance aging, decision status, and escalation triggers.  Design and develop dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors, and reports as needed to support program requirements.  Improve the efficiency of risk workflows through automation, better tooling, clearer operating models, and reusable knowledge assets.  Perform system and integration testing with sample and live data.  Review product performance and provide a continuous improvement path through leveraging industry standard tools and capabilities as well as building new ones.  Serve as a bridge between cybersecurity, engineering, audit, privacy, and compliance stakeholders so that security risk becomes practical engineering action.  Mentor analysts and junior security partners on risk analysis, risk statement quality, treatment planning, stakeholder communication, and operational rigor. 

Basic Qualifications:

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.  10+ years of experience in security, cyber risk, GRC, assurance, security operations, or related technical risk roles.  Security certifications e.g. CISA, CISSP, CISM, or other relevant certifications.  Demonstrated success managing security risk programs, treatment decisions, and cross-functional execution end to end.  Strong understanding of security controls, risk treatment, and how to work with engineering on implementation details.  Experience operating across multiple stakeholders, handling ambiguity, and driving accountability.  Ability to effectively and autonomously accomplish outcomes across cross-functional teams in ambiguous situations with minimal supervision.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present risk, status, and decision points to leadership and technical audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications:

 CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or comparable additional certifications.  Hands-on experience with ServiceNow eGRC platform, including configuration, workflow development, and integration. About The Role And Team

As a Staff Software Engineer at Uber, you will be a technical anchor for the foundational systems that move the world - from building the next generation of orchestration platforms to architecting the stacks that power our global applications. You will navigate the "messy" reality of complex infrastructures spanning global data centers and multiple cloud providers, supporting a diverse variety of workloads. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information and own the outcomes of global architectural choices.

The Core Platform Foundations team owns defining, monitoring, and controlling operations for the infrastructure that supports Uber's virtual computing environments. We are the lowest software layer abstracting the underlying fleet of hosts whether on prem or on the cloud, and as such we are the guardians of quality and security of the production host. We support many Core Platform's dependencies to ensure we provision the Uber flavored base host quickly and reliably, as well as help architect the new standards as we increase support for cloud native infra use cases. The software that this team owns impacts all of Uber's production fleet - quality, security, and operational mindedness are highly valued, as well as compassion for the developer experience.

What You'll Do

 Driving initiatives and change between stakeholder platforms and cloud providers including the ingestion of new host and volume types, os/kernel upgrades, and improving availability and performance of vms and storage  Design and build end-to-end systems for orchestration, monitoring, or frameworks that stand the test of massive global scale, high availability, and resiliency against zonal disasters  Provide deep technical mentorship across the stack, ensuring architecture and implementations are robust, extensible, and secure.  Create best-in-class tools and frameworks that increase the velocity and quality of hundreds of internal engineering teams.  Lead and mentor engineers, reviewing code and designs while fostering a culture of continuous learning and humility.  Work cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Operations across the globe to drive large-scale projects and align technical investments with business value.

 8+ years of professional experience building scalable, fault-tolerant products or platforms, with a track record of solving strategically important problems. rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

We are looking for a hardware focused Senior Reliability Engineer to focus on sensor and hardware system reliability, owning the observability, alerting, and automation that ensures Uber's in-vehicle sensor data collection systems operate reliably at scale.

This role is centered on maximizing sensor uptime, data yield, and supply hours across a large, geographically distributed fleet. You will design systems that determine when to react to issues impacting data recording capability, whether caused by failing sensors, degraded onboard computers, software regressions, or systemic environmental factors.

As the technical owner for sensor reliability and observability, you will build the infrastructure that converts low-level signals into actionable intelligence and automated responses. This is a senior role requiring strong software engineering fundamentals, deep systems thinking, and the ability to drive cross-team technical direction without direct authority.

What You Will Do

 Architect Observability Systems: Design and scale an observability platform capable of ingesting and analyzing real-time health telemetry from thousands of distributed vehicle nodes.  Build for Edge Constraints: Develop systems that remain performant despite hardware diversity, intermittent connectivity, and rapid fleet scaling.  Define Criticality Models: Establish alerting strategies that distinguish transient anomalies from systemic issues impacting sensor uptime and data yield.  Detect Complex Failure Modes: Design detection logic for "silent" failures, such as sensor degradation, compute saturation, or recording pipeline stalls.  Scale Through Automation: Design automated detection, triage, and mitigation mechanisms to eliminate manual intervention as the fleet grows.  Partner on Mitigation: Collaborate with Operations and Engineering to build safe, automated responses to recurring hardware and software failure scenarios.  Drive Operational Efficiency: Build technical interfaces to help Operations surface issues and Engineering diagnose and deploy mitigations rapidly (TTD/TTM).  Lead Technical Strategy: Drive reliability-focused design reviews and translate operational pain points into concrete technical requirements and roadmaps.  Uncover Proactive Insights: Apply advanced data analytics to identify latent patterns in fleet telemetry, enabling the proactive detection of systemic regressions and hardware degradation before they impact operations. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 5+ years of relevant industry experience in software engineering, site reliability, or systems engineering  Distributed Systems: Experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) in edge, IoT, or hardware-integrated environments.  Language Proficiency: coding skills in one or more of Go, Python, or C++ , with experience building and operating production systems.  Systems Expertise: Proficiency in Linux internals and shell scripting for triaging and debugging edge devices or hardware-adjacent systems.  Engineering Fundamentals: Ability to debug across services, containers (Docker), and networking stacks.  Reliability Experience: Proven track record owning reliability, infrastructure, or platform systems for large-scale production workloads.  Observability Tooling: Experience designing and operating observability systems (metrics, logging, alerting, and dashboards).  Metrics-Driven: Experience defining and implementing SLIs and SLOs for system availability or data yield.  Networking Knowledge: Deep understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, gRPC, or MQTT) and data handling in bandwidth-constrained environments.  Leadership: Experience driving complex technical projects and architectural reviews across multiple teams from design through production. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) in edge, IoT, or hardware-integrated environments.  Knowledge of sensor data protocols (e.g., Camera, LiDAR, Radar) or hardware-to-cloud data ingestion pipelines.  Experience with "Grey Failure" detection and management in complex, distributed systems.  Proven track record in 'Fleet Health' for large-scale hardware deployments (e.g., cloud infrastructure, global server fleets, or industrial IoT) where automation was used to replace manual intervention.

About The Team

The Applied AI team collaborates with product teams across Uber to deliver innovative AI solutions for core business problems. We work closely with engineering, product and data science teams to understand core business problems and the potential for AI solutions, then deliver those AI solutions end-to-end. Key areas of expertise include Personalization, Generative AI, Computer Vision, ML Optimization, Geospatial AI.

About The Role

We are building AI-native discovery experiences across Mobility and Delivery. Search, recommendations, and conversational AI are central to how millions of users discover rides, restaurants, grocery items, and retail products every day. We are hiring a Senior Staff ML Engineer to define the multi-year technical vision and architecture for foundation models powering these experiences.

The Uber Foundation Model would serve as the common semantic backbone that enables Uber to understand users, places, merchants, items, and behavioral patterns in a unified way. By building a shared representation layer and continuously improving it with cross-LOB signals, Uber ensures that intelligence compounds rather than fragments. This foundation powers personalization, search, agents, automation, and decision systems across Mobility, Delivery, and future surfaces.

At this level, you will set the long-term technical direction for the organization, drive alignment on product and engineering strategy at the executive level, and deliver step-change measurable impact at global scale.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Define and champion the multi-year technical vision and architecture for foundation models across Search, Recommendations, and Conversational AI.  Set the architectural standard and drive system design for critical, high-leverage ML platforms across Mobility and Delivery.  Lead cross-team initiatives spanning Retrieval, Ranking, Personalization, and LLM-powered assistants, resolving complex technical trade-offs across organizational boundaries.  Define long-term investment areas (build vs fine-tune vs partner models) with clear business rationale and long-term viability.  Provide principal-level technical leadership, mentoring Staff and Senior Staff engineers, and setting the bar for technical excellence across the entire AI organization.

 Masters degree or Ph.D in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics  12+ years of ML experience, including significant work on large-scale deep learning systems. About The Role

The Compensation M&A team at Uber is seeking an experienced compensation professional to support compensation due diligence, harmonization modeling, and post-close integration for M&A transactions. This individual will play a critical role in evaluating compensation structures at target companies, assessing financial implications of harmonizing with Uber's compensation philosophy, and overseeing compensation program management for existing subsidiaries. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical rigor with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and deliver actionable insights in a fast-paced, deal-driven environment.

What You'll Do

 Compensation Harmonization Analysis 

 Model the financial impact of aligning target company roles and incumbents to Uber's job architecture, compensation ranges, and pay-for-performance frameworks  Conduct market benchmarking to determine appropriate compensation positioning for acquired employees across geographies and job functions  Build scenarios that quantify cost implications of harmonization decisions, including salary adjustments, bonus targets, equity transitions, and special retention programs  Provide clear, data-driven recommendations that balance competitiveness, consistency, cost management, and employee experience 

 Post-Close Integration & Subsidiary Compensation Management 

 Manage compensation programs for existing subsidiaries, supporting local HR teams with salary structures, job mapping, and governance processes  Ensure subsidiaries' compensation practices remain aligned with Uber's philosophy, ranges, policies, and compliance standards  Monitor compensation trends and identify integration risks or misalignments over time, proposing corrective actions as necessary 

 Analytics, Reporting & Governance 

 Build and maintain analytical models, dashboards, and templates used in M&A diligence and harmonization processes  Maintain documentation and repeatable processes to improve operational efficiency and scale compensation integration practices across transactions  Partner with Legal to ensure compliance with local labor regulations, pay equity requirements, and statutory obligations 

 Basic Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree in Finance, HR, Economics, Business, or related field  3+ years of experience in compensation, HR analytics, corporate finance, or consulting; experience supporting M&A transactions strongly preferred  Advanced proficiency in data modeling and analysis tools (Excel/Google Sheets required) 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with compensation market data sources (Radford, Mercer, WTW, etc.)  Experience with job architecture frameworks  Prior experience conducting compensation due diligence or supporting integrations in a corporate or consulting environment.  Strong understanding of compensation design principles, global market practices, and governance.  Ability to interpret complex compensation structures and synthesize them into concise, executive-ready insights.  Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly working cross-functionally with HR, Finance, Legal, and Corporate Development. A solutions-oriented approach and comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-paced deal environments with shifting priorities. About The Role

In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements.  Serve as the primary strategic partner to Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR, and business leaders on immigration solutions, workforce planning, talent retention, and organizational growth.  Define and drive the U.S. immigration strategy, policies, governance frameworks, and program roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, compliance, stakeholder experience, efficiency, and business outcomes.  Own immigration vendor governance, including strategic relationship management, performance accountability, compliance oversight, commercial stewardship, and executive business reviews.  Own governance of U.S. immigration escalations, providing senior decision-making for high-risk, high-visibility, and complex immigration matters, while leveraging escalation trends and root cause insights to drive continuous program improvement.  Monitor regulatory developments and emerging immigration trends, assessing business impact and proactively advising stakeholders on readiness and risk mitigation strategies.  Define immigration program success metrics, compliance outcomes, vendor governance expectations, and strategic KPIs, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement and measurable business impact.  Leverage technology, automation, AI, and analytics to drive strategic improvements, optimize program performance, and shape the future-state immigration technology roadmap in partnership with the GRI Experience Program Manager.  Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle. rows.title: Staff Security Strategist GRC
rows.descriptionText:
About The Team

Uber's Engineering Security team works to ensure the security of information for our full set of users - riders, eaters, drivers and partners. Our ultimate goal is to ensure that every experience with Uber is simple, secure, and safe. We are seeking a talented Staff Security Strategist, GRC to join our Tech Risk and Assurance team within Engineering Security.

About The Role

The Staff Security Strategist, GRC partners with engineering, security, and cross-functional risk stakeholders to strengthen Uber's cybersecurity posture through scalable cyber risk management, risk governance, and control design programs. This role is responsible for driving and implementing security, compliance, and risk management programs on the ServiceNow eGRC platform at Uber, working with the engineering team to develop and enable technical solutions that satisfy a variety of risk and compliance processes.

This role operates at the intersection of technical security, process design, and risk governance. The successful candidate will translate control gaps, threat and business context, and compliance requirements into practical risk treatment plans that engineering teams can execute, while driving consistent risk analysis, decision-making, and follow-through. The role must be able to deliver work products required by Agile development methodologies for software development delivery as defined.

What You Will Do

 Own cyber risk intake, triage, and prioritization, ensuring clear accountability, well-formed risk statements, and timely treatment decisions.  Develop product strategy and lead project execution for multiple major components of Uber's Risk and Compliance technology solutions.  Manage different solutions on Uber's internal eGRC platform (ServiceNow) and collaborate with stakeholders to implement their program improvements.  Partner with engineering teams to define risk treatment plans, identify sustainable fixes, and drive mitigation or remediation to the last mile rather than stopping at documentation.  Gather business and functional requirements from partner teams and deliver a product/release that meets the needs presented. Develop technical specifications documentation.  Lead or materially contribute to control design reviews, risk assessments, and risk decisions that require judgment, stakeholder alignment, and tradeoff management.  Drive and evangelize vision for overall GRC strategy across engineering and security organizations.  Analyze and fully understand user stories and internal procedures in order to improve system capabilities, automate process workflows, and address scheduling limitations throughout the development and delivery of the eGRC platform.  Work with developers to implement workflows from customer requirements including workflows, UI actions, client scripts, business rules, etc.  Load, manipulate, and maintain data between the eGRC platform and other systems as needed.  Build and maintain risk reporting for leaders and partner teams, including KRIs, exposure trends, risk acceptance aging, decision status, and escalation triggers.  Design and develop dashboards, home pages, performance analytics data collectors, and reports as needed to support program requirements.  Improve the efficiency of risk workflows through automation, better tooling, clearer operating models, and reusable knowledge assets.  Perform system and integration testing with sample and live data.  Review product performance and provide a continuous improvement path through leveraging industry standard tools and capabilities as well as building new ones.  Serve as a bridge between cybersecurity, engineering, audit, privacy, and compliance stakeholders so that security risk becomes practical engineering action.  Mentor analysts and junior security partners on risk analysis, risk statement quality, treatment planning, stakeholder communication, and operational rigor. 

Basic Qualifications:

 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.  10+ years of experience in security, cyber risk, GRC, assurance, security operations, or related technical risk roles.  Security certifications e.g. CISA, CISSP, CISM, or other relevant certifications.  Demonstrated success managing security risk programs, treatment decisions, and cross-functional execution end to end.  Strong understanding of security controls, risk treatment, and how to work with engineering on implementation details.  Experience operating across multiple stakeholders, handling ambiguity, and driving accountability.  Ability to effectively and autonomously accomplish outcomes across cross-functional teams in ambiguous situations with minimal supervision.  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present risk, status, and decision points to leadership and technical audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications:

 CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or comparable additional certifications.  Hands-on experience with ServiceNow eGRC platform, including configuration, workflow development, and integration.  Experience with other GRC/ERM tooling such as AuditBoard, Archer, OpenPages, or SAP GRC.  Big 4 accounting firm and/or internet/technology industry experience.  Process management experience, including process redesign and optimization.  Proven track record in driving security risk treatment to closure across multiple engineering teams.  Ability to leverage AI, data analytics, and workflow automation to improve risk program performance and reporting.  Experience with risk quantification methodologies and risk lifecycle tooling.  Strong knowledge of control frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, NIST RMF, SOC 2, and CIS.  Proficiency in Python, SQL, dashboards, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.  Ability to thrive in environments of uncertainty.

rows.title: Sr Product Manager - Enterprise Risk
rows.descriptionText:
Senior Product Manager, Enterprise & Payment Risk

About The Role

Uber's Risk team is critical to enabling trusted growth across our global marketplace by preventing fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Enterprise (B2B) accounts are a major and fast-growing part of that marketplace, and managing their risk is one of the most structurally complex domains in Payment Risk.

In this senior, high-impact individual contributor role, the Product Manager for Enterprise & Payment Risk will own the full risk lifecycle of B2B entities at scale - from onboarding and information acquisition, through manual review processes, to real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment. The role also owns the underlying account and billing infrastructure that enterprise risk decisions run on, and the recovery/verification experiences enterprise customers rely on when something goes wrong.

A defining challenge of this role is that the enterprise customer base spans many distinct cohorts, each with a different risk tolerance and a different sensitivity to friction and actioning. Success requires calibrating risk treatment differently across these cohorts rather than applying a single, one-size-fits-all policy - balancing fraud prevention against growth and satisfaction for legitimate business customers. This is the most stakeholder-intensive scope in the Payment Risk organization, requiring close, sustained partnership with business/BD leadership in addition to Engineering, Data Science, and platform teams.

This position is ideal for a senior product leader who thrives in ambiguous, high-stakes problem spaces, has strong command of B2B/enterprise payment or billing systems, and can drive outcomes through influence across a large and often-competing set of stakeholders and shared engineering capacity.

What The Candidate Will Do

Own the B2B entity risk lifecycle end-to-end at scale: onboarding and information acquisition, manual review workflows, and real-time risk decisioning at checkout and payment. Segment and calibrate risk policy across distinct enterprise customer cohorts, each with different risk tolerance and sensitivity to friction/actioning. Define the product requirements and roadmap for enterprise risk capabilities, including underlying account and billing infrastructure modernization and its associated cross-functional dependencies. Own recovery and verification experiences for enterprise customers, including fallback challenges, admin verification, and cross-party messaging. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to scope and land payment authorization and decisioning improvements against concrete loss-reduction targets. Triage, prioritize, and negotiate a high volume of cross-functional dependency requests against shared and constrained engineering capacity. Build and maintain trusted relationships with business/BD stakeholders, translating enterprise account needs into a risk product roadmap. Measure impact using well-defined KPIs (e.g., loss-rate reduction, authorization effectiveness, dispute/chargeback rates) and iterate based on learnings. Coordinate with Risk Operations, Risk Governance/Compliance, and payments platform teams to ensure solutions are practical, compliant, and operationally sound. 

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of product management experience delivering software products as an individual contributor in a technology company. Experience owning a complex, technically deep product domain (e.g., payments, billing, risk, or platform infrastructure) with significant stakeholder breadth. Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform decisions and measure impact. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex problems simply to both technical and business audiences. Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Business/BD, Design, and Operations, including negotiating priority against shared/constrained resources. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data/Analytics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent experience). 

Preferred Qualifications

Risk & Fraud Domain Expertise - Experience in risk, fraud, or trust & safety within a B2B/enterprise or multi-sided marketplace, particularly billing risk, checkout/payment decisioning, or auth-hold systems. B2B/Enterprise Product Ownership - Prior ownership of a product serving business or organizational accounts (rather than purely consumer-facing products), including billing configuration, credit management, or account administration. Business Acumen - Demonstrated ability to drive P&L improvements through loss reduction or account-health initiatives, with strong intuition for how risk interventions affect the broader business. Strategic Judgment - Strong product instincts for navigating ambiguous, structurally complex problem spaces and balancing competing constraints across risk, business, engineering capacity, and compliance. Advanced Business Education - MBA or equivalent business experience. 

Extra notes:

Prefer candidates with prior experience in engineering, data scientist, consulting, finance, or a B2B/enterprise SaaS product role before moving into PM, given the domain's billing/payments complexity.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Grocery & Retail is scaling into a daily-use, trust-based delivery platform. Fulfillment Optimization is at the center of that ambition.

As Senior Product Manager, Grocery Fulfillment Optimization, you will own the systems and decision logic that determine last-mile order fulfillment and how reliably, efficiently, and cost-effectively it happens when conditions are imperfect.

This role sits at the intersection of marketplace algorithms, real-world logistics, and customer trust. You will work deeply with Marketplace and Data Science to design matching, batching, and recovery systems that adapt dynamically to supply, demand, store readiness, and inevitable failure modes, without degrading the customer or earner experience.

The work spans both physical-world execution (stores, couriers, timing, constraints) and abstract optimization (matching, batching, objective functions, cost-per-trip). The outcome directly impacts reliability, unit economics, and long-term platform credibility.

This is a senior IC role. We expect you to own ambiguous, cross-cutting problem spaces end-to-end, set direction for modeling and experimentation across teams, and influence roadmaps and prioritization well beyond your immediate scope.

What The Candidate Will Do

You'll tackle some of Uber's most complex fulfillment problems, where software decisions meet the realities of grocery stores, couriers, and time-bound customer expectations. In this role, you will:

 Own the decision logic behind grocery fulfillment: how orders are matched, batched, planned, recovered, and completed when real-world conditions change.  Partner closely with Marketplace and Data Science to define matching, batching, and assignment logic that balances reliability, cost-per-trip, earner experience, and store readiness, making tradeoffs explicit and testable in code, not debated in meetings.  Design resilient fulfillment systems that treat recovery and graceful degradation as core product surfaces. Build backup fulfillment paths, partial-fulfillment recovery, and risk-based reassignment that materially reduce cancellations, missed deliveries, and partial fulfillment.  Translate operational complexity into product and modeling requirements, ensuring systems behave predictably across edge cases, degraded states, and at scale.  Shift fulfillment from reactive to proactive - build systems that anticipate risk (scheduled orders, supply variability, store performance) and adapt before customers feel the impact.  Set direction for modeling and experimentation, influencing the roadmaps of partner teams (Matching, Pricing & Incentives, Ops Tech) to move the system as a whole. 

This role offers a rare opportunity to work simultaneously on logistics systems and optimization models, with direct influence on customer trust and business performance.

Basic Qualifications

 7+ years of product management experience delivering successful, durable products, with clear ownership and outcomes you can point to. Your fingerprints are all over what shipped, what scaled, and what materially improved the business.  Strong technical and operational fluency. You've built complex systems directly or worked close enough to real-world operations - last mile supply chain and logistics networks - to understand how theory breaks in practice. You can reason comfortably from high-level system design (distributed systems, event-driven architectures, APIs) down to edge cases, data flows, and how software behaves under real operational constraints and failure modes.  Experience building algorithmic or ML-adjacent products in close partnership with Data Science. You understand how objective functions, constraints, experimentation, and model tradeoffs translate into real marketplace and fulfillment outcomes.  Hands-on data fluency. You get the data you need on your own - SQL, dashboards, instrumentation - and turn it into insight that drives decisions, not analysis paralysis.  Exceptional attention to detail. You obsess over how systems behave in the real world across customers, earners, merchants, and operations, and you notice the gaps, edge cases, and failure modes others miss.  Customer obsession. You take on messy, high-stakes problems and find elegant, simple solutions so customers and partners don't have to carry platform complexity.  A strong driver mindset. You are biased toward action, a great collaborator, a master disambiguator and simplifier, and relentless about pushing work to clarity and delivery.  Sound judgment under ambiguity. You can reason through multi-sided tradeoffs - reliability, cost, customer experience, earner experience, and merchant outcomes - and make principled decisions with imperfect information.  Influence without authority. You move multiple teams in the same direction by setting clear strategy, raising the bar on quality, and earning trust through judgment and execution.  A consistently high bar. For your own contributions and for the products you ship.  A never-ending desire to learn and grow. You seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously sharpen your craft. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Direct grocery, last-mile, or supply chain fulfillment experience at scale. Dispatch, matching, routing, picking, or sortation systems in production, ideally with both system ownership and operations-side exposure.  Ownership of decision systems, not just diagnostic or detection tooling, the logic that decides what the system actually does when the plan breaks.  Experience launching products side-by-side with Data Science on optimization models: co-designing objective functions, constraints, and experimentation strategy.  Experience building products from 0→1 in ambiguous problem spaces, especially in marketplaces or multi-sided platforms.  Experience in grocery, retail, CPG, or e-commerce, especially where physical-world execution and software optimization intersect.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Safety Risk Measurement & Insights Lead owns how Uber defines, measures, and reasons about safety risk on the platform. This role makes us smart about measurement itself - ensuring that our indicators of safety risk (both outcome metrics like Safety Incident Rate and the leading, input, and predictive signals that precede harm) are well-defined, governed, trusted, and continuously improved, and then translating them into clear, actionable insight for business leadership and external reporting.

This role sits at the center of Analytics, Operations, and cross-functional partners to unify metric definitions, strengthen data quality, accelerate insight generation, and improve how safety performance is understood and acted upon across the organization. This role will also help shape how Safety uses smarter tooling and AI-enabled workflows to scale measurement, analytics, and reporting.

What You'll Do

Metric Governance & Foundations:  Drive governance for Safety's most critical metrics, including Incident Rate and leading indicators of safety risk. Recommend durable definitions, inclusion/exclusion logic, auditability, lineage, and consistency over time. Ensure metric frameworks remain credible as the platform, product, and risk landscape evolve.

Data Quality & Measurement Integrity:  Serve as Safety's measurement steward - lead end-to-end accountability for the quality and reliability of safety data. Partner with DS / Eng / Ops to resolve issues, and establish clear monitoring and escalation mechanisms that improve trust in reported safety outcomes.

Analytical Investigation, Insight Generation & Business Translation: Lead deep dives into performance shifts, emerging risks, and measurement anomalies, combining quantitative analysis with operational context to identify what is happening, why it is happening, and what Safety should do next; then turn those insights into crisp, credible narratives that help leaders make decisions, prioritize investments, and communicate clearly to senior stakeholders.

AI-Enabled Insights & Scalable Workflows: Define and advance the future state of Safety analytics by identifying opportunities to automate recurring analysis, improve self-serve access, and use AI-enabled workflows to accelerate insight generation without compromising rigor

Safety Ops Enablement:  Enable Safety Operations and regional partners to use trusted safety metrics consistently and effectively. Build or shape dashboards, reporting tools, education materials, and analytical resources that improve understanding, speed up decision-making, and strengthen stakeholder influence.

Reporting & Decision Support:  Ensure executive- and external-facing reporting is rigorous, defensible, and efficient, with clear underlying methodology and a consistent measurement framework.

What You'll Need

 Analytical Leadership & Data Acumen: Strong analytical foundation with the ability to understand statistical concepts, challenge assumptions, partner credibly with Data Science, and turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.  Business Acumen & Strategic Thinking: Strong understanding of the broader business context and Safety's role within it, with the ability to frame trends, tradeoffs, and recommendations in a way that supports executive decision-making.  Influence & Communication: Excellent communicator and storyteller with a track record of building trust, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and driving alignment without direct authority.  Systems Thinking: Able to understand end-to-end processes, dependencies, and organizational dynamics to identify root causes and durable solutions.  AI & Analytical Innovation: Curious and practical user of AI, automation, or emerging analytical tools to accelerate insight generation, improve decision-making, and scale analytical work.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience at a technology platform, marketplace, gig economy, e-commerce, social media, dating, or similar trust-based ecosystem.  Experience defining, governing, or evolving critical business metrics used by senior leadership.  Experience building self-service analytics, measurement frameworks, or analytical products.  Track record of coaching, educating, or upskilling teams on analytical concepts and best practices.  Experience driving accountability and raising the quality bar for insight generation across an organization.  PHD in Economics, Engineering , Data science, Finance or technical field.

This role ensures Safety has the measurement foundations it needs to make good decisions, hold the right line on rigor, and communicate performance credibly inside and outside the company. It is both a governance role and an insight role: trusted numbers, better decisions, stronger execution.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Grocery & Retail is scaling into a daily-use, trust-based delivery platform. Fulfillment Optimization is at the center of that ambition.

As Senior Product Manager, Grocery Fulfillment Optimization, you will own the systems and decision logic that determine last-mile order fulfillment and how reliably, efficiently, and cost-effectively it happens when conditions are imperfect.

This role sits at the intersection of marketplace algorithms, real-world logistics, and customer trust. You will work deeply with Marketplace and Data Science to design matching, batching, and recovery systems that adapt dynamically to supply, demand, store readiness, and inevitable failure modes, without degrading the customer or earner experience.

The work spans both physical-world execution (stores, couriers, timing, constraints) and abstract optimization (matching, batching, objective functions, cost-per-trip). The outcome directly impacts reliability, unit economics, and long-term platform credibility.

This is a senior IC role. We expect you to own ambiguous, cross-cutting problem spaces end-to-end, set direction for modeling and experimentation across teams, and influence roadmaps and prioritization well beyond your immediate scope.

What The Candidate Will Do

You'll tackle some of Uber's most complex fulfillment problems, where software decisions meet the realities of grocery stores, couriers, and time-bound customer expectations. In this role, you will:

 Own the decision logic behind grocery fulfillment: how orders are matched, batched, planned, recovered, and completed when real-world conditions change.  Partner closely with Marketplace and Data Science to define matching, batching, and assignment logic that balances reliability, cost-per-trip, earner experience, and store readiness, making tradeoffs explicit and testable in code, not debated in meetings.  Design resilient fulfillment systems that treat recovery and graceful degradation as core product surfaces. Build backup fulfillment paths, partial-fulfillment recovery, and risk-based reassignment that materially reduce cancellations, missed deliveries, and partial fulfillment.  Translate operational complexity into product and modeling requirements, ensuring systems behave predictably across edge cases, degraded states, and at scale.  Shift fulfillment from reactive to proactive - build systems that anticipate risk (scheduled orders, supply variability, store performance) and adapt before customers feel the impact.  Set direction for modeling and experimentation, influencing the roadmaps of partner teams (Matching, Pricing & Incentives, Ops Tech) to move the system as a whole. 

This role offers a rare opportunity to work simultaneously on logistics systems and optimization models, with direct influence on customer trust and business performance.

Basic Qualifications

 7+ years of product management experience delivering successful, durable products, with clear ownership and outcomes you can point to. Your fingerprints are all over what shipped, what scaled, and what materially improved the business.  Strong technical and operational fluency. You've built complex systems directly or worked close enough to real-world operations - last mile supply chain and logistics networks - to understand how theory breaks in practice. You can reason comfortably from high-level system design (distributed systems, event-driven architectures, APIs) down to edge cases, data flows, and how software behaves under real operational constraints and failure modes.  Experience building algorithmic or ML-adjacent products in close partnership with Data Science. You understand how objective functions, constraints, experimentation, and model tradeoffs translate into real marketplace and fulfillment outcomes.  Hands-on data fluency. You get the data you need on your own - SQL, dashboards, instrumentation - and turn it into insight that drives decisions, not analysis paralysis.  Exceptional attention to detail. You obsess over how systems behave in the real world across customers, earners, merchants, and operations, and you notice the gaps, edge cases, and failure modes others miss.  Customer obsession. You take on messy, high-stakes problems and find elegant, simple solutions so customers and partners don't have to carry platform complexity.  A strong driver mindset. You are biased toward action, a great collaborator, a master disambiguator and simplifier, and relentless about pushing work to clarity and delivery.  Sound judgment under ambiguity. You can reason through multi-sided tradeoffs - reliability, cost, customer experience, earner experience, and merchant outcomes - and make principled decisions with imperfect information.  Influence without authority. You move multiple teams in the same direction by setting clear strategy, raising the bar on quality, and earning trust through judgment and execution.  A consistently high bar. For your own contributions and for the products you ship.  A never-ending desire to learn and grow. You seek feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously sharpen your craft. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Direct grocery, last-mile, or supply chain fulfillment experience at scale. Dispatch, matching, routing, picking, or sortation systems in production, ideally with both system ownership and operations-side exposure.  Ownership of decision systems, not just diagnostic or detection tooling, the logic that decides what the system actually does when the plan breaks.  Experience launching products side-by-side with Data Science on optimization models: co-designing objective functions, constraints, and experimentation strategy.  Experience building products from 0→1 in ambiguous problem spaces, especially in marketplaces or multi-sided platforms.  Experience in grocery, retail, CPG, or e-commerce, especially where physical-world execution and software optimization intersect.

You'll create intelligent, customer-first experiences that make waiting feel transparent, effortless, and trustworthy reimagining how customers experience delivery through AI, real-time intelligence, and thoughtful product innovation.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape one of Uber Eats' most engaged product experiences. You'll partner closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Product to bring bold new ideas from concept to launch, creating products that millions of customers rely on every day.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one of Uber Eats' most important consumer experiences.  Reimagine how customers experience the moments after checkout, creating products that build confidence, reduce uncertainty, and make waiting feel effortless.  Invent new ways to help customers feel informed, reassured, and in control throughout their delivery journey.  Shape the future of delivery through AI-powered and real-time customer experiences that anticipate needs before customers have to ask.  Bring new ideas from concept through launch, partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Research.  Use customer insights, experimentation, and product intuition to continuously improve one of Uber Eats' highest engagement experiences.  Influence product direction across teams and help define the future of the post-order experience. 

Basic Qualifications

 7+ years of product management experience, preferably in consumer technology, marketplace, logistics, fulfillment, or operationally complex products.  Bachelor's degree or equivalent.  Experience defining product strategy and driving execution across multiple cross-functional teams.  Strong analytical skills, including comfort with metric design, experimentation, funnel analysis, and root-cause diagnosis.  Proven ability to turn ambiguous, multi-sided problems into clear product priorities and roadmaps.  Experience working with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Operations, and business stakeholders.  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and align teams around a strategy.  Track record of shipping products or systems that improved customer experience, reliability, quality, or operational performance. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience working on marketplace quality, logistics, delivery, routing, dispatch, ETA, ranking, trust, support, or fulfillment systems.  Experience with prediction or risk-scoring systems that trigger product interventions.  Familiarity with consumer defect reduction, customer support reduction, NPS improvement, retention, or trust-building initiatives.  Experience managing tradeoffs between growth, quality, cost, fairness, and user experience.  Strong systems-thinking orientation, with the ability to reason across consumer, merchant, courier, and marketplace incentives.  Experience building products that use real-time signals, operational data, or machine-learning models to improve user outcomes.  Comfort operating in highly ambiguous spaces where ownership is distributed and success requires strong cross-functional leadership.  Prior experience in food delivery, grocery, e-commerce, mobility, logistics, or local commerce.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Job Summary

The Director - L&D Operations & Franchise Learning EMEA sets the strategic direction for continent learning operations and enables consistent, scalable and measurable learning across managed and franchised hotels. The role leads the operating model for learning platforms, reporting and analytics, operations for foundational and virtual learning and franchise learning engagement.

The Director is the EMEA learning lead for Power of M and owns the regional learning strategy, governance and readiness approach for this enterprise digital and technology transformation. The role aligns global strategy with regional execution, ensuring communities are prepared for cutover, learning risks are managed, adoption is measured and new ways of working are sustained.

The role also leads the EMEA AI Learning & Adoption strategy, working through cross-functional governance and external learning partnerships to build practical AI capability, coordinate adoption activity and integrate AI learning into the regional portfolio. The role leads a culturally diverse virtual team, advises senior stakeholders and uses insight to focus resources where they will have the greatest business impact.

 Power of M Learning Strategy, Governance and AdoptionDefine and lead the EMEA Power of M learning strategy, roadmap, governance and success measures, aligning global programme direction with regional and community requirements.Represent EMEA L&D in transformation governance and deployment forums, ensuring learning implications, dependencies, decisions and risks are visible and addressed.Oversee learning readiness for each community and deployment wave, including role-based assignments, resources, workshops, webinars, office hours, completion tracking and post-cutover sustainment.Partner with Global Learning, EMEA DTT Team, Change and Communications, deployment leads, Learning Technology, discipline SMEs and End User Councils to coordinate learning and change activity.Identify and resolve continent-specific needs, including content, communications, deployment tools, non-systems learning and localisation considerations.Provide executive-level reporting on readiness, adoption, risks, dependencies and decisions, intervening early where business readiness is at risk.Embed Power of M content, behaviours and resources into existing EMEA learning offerings and business-as-usual operations. Learning Operations and Digital Learning EcosystemSet the strategic direction and governance for Marriott learning platforms and digital learning operations across EMEA, ensuring a consistent user experience and effective support model.Act as senior continent escalation point for learning technology, DLZ engagement, virtual learning delivery and learning-related operational issues.Oversee foundational and non-foundational programme set-up, registration, delivery coordination and related controls, accountabilities and service standards. Data Intelligence, Impact and Executive InsightEstablish the EMEA learning measurement strategy and reporting framework, with indicators for readiness, participation, completion, adoption, effectiveness and operational impact.Drive dashboards and analysis that provide learning data into actionable insight for leaders, discipline, area teams and hotels.Oversee compliance and required-learning reporting, ensuring risks, gaps and accountabilities are visible and followed through against agreed deadlines.Measure learning effectiveness and application, using evaluation findings and stakeholder feedback to improve design, deployment and investment decisions.Promote disciplined use of data to prioritise resources, demonstrate value and inform strategy. rows.title: Product Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Dr. Martens is more than a brand - it’s a global icon with over 60 years of attitude, heritage, and cultural impact. We’re a thriving, values‑driven business powered by diverse thinkers, bold doers, and people who bring their whole selves to work. If you’re ready to make your mark, you’re in the right place.

At DM, our values guide everything we do: Be Yourself, Act Courageously, Show You Care. They’re not just words - they’re how we turn passion into progress.

WHERE YOU SIT

As our Product Analyst, you’ll be part of the Customer team working closely with brilliant people across the business and reporting into Head of Global Customer Product. You’ll be right at the heart of fast‑moving projects that shape how we show up for our consumers - today and tomorrow.

WHERE YOU CONTRIBUTE

This role is not a delivery role but a product analytical role.

The Product Analyst supports the Global Customer Product team by providing deep insight into customer behaviour, product performance, and journey effectiveness, enabling better product decisions across the end-to-end customer experience.

Working across all product domains (Search & Discovery, Commerce & Checkout, Delivery & Return, Loyalty & Sustainability), this role ensures product strategy and roadmap decisions are grounded in data, experimentation, and customer understanding.

Sitting at the intersection of product, data, and customer experience, this role plays a key part in helping the team identify friction, prioritise opportunities/roadmap items, and measure real impact.

Core Accountabilities

As our Product Analyst, you will be responsible for:

Defining and measuring product performance across the end-to-end customer journey, establishing and tracking KPIs across all journey stages. Analysing customer behaviour, funnels and interaction patterns across digital and omnichannel touchpoints to identify friction, drop-offs and opportunities. Translating complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform product strategy, prioritisation, business cases and roadmap decisions. Supporting experimentation and performance measurement, developing measurement frameworks, analysing test results, assessing impact and maintaining dashboards and reporting. Building and strengthening a connected, customer-focused view of performance by integrating multiple data sources, partnering with Data, Technology and Product teams, and using AI to accelerate analysis and generate deeper insights.

Analytical & Statistical Capability: Strong ability to analyse complex datasets, identify trends and apply appropriate analytical techniques to product and customer questions. Data & Product Fluency: Comfortable using dashboards, analytics and experimentation tools, with a strong understanding of digital product journeys and customer behaviour. Structured Thinking & Problem Solving: Able to frame ambiguous questions, develop robust analytical approaches and deliver clear, actionable outputs. Insight Communication: Skilled at translating complex data into concise, compelling insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. AI, Accuracy & Curiosity: Confident using AI tools to accelerate analysis and insight generation, with strong attention to data accuracy and a proactive mindset towards learning and improving analytical approaches.

rows.title: 2027 Sustainability & Responsible Business Placement
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

As a participant in our 12-month Corporate Placements Programme in the Sustainability Department at our Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Headquarters in Watford – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by contributing to the memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.

Here’s what you can look forward to as a programme participant:

Prepare for a career in hospitality: Embark on a 12-month transformative journey, encompassing a structured framework of learning and development opportunities, business support activities, and ownership of your own project-based initiatives.Gain hands-on operational experience: From day one, you’ll be fully integrated into Team Hilton. Connect with professionals across the business and gain insight into Sustainability. Take the opportunity to gain insight into at least one other business area, paving the way for valuable future relationships.Work on real-world projects: Apply your skills on the job through business-driven projects to reinforce your learning and gain hands-on experience.Develop your skills through world-class training and support: Access Hilton University’s e-learning modules and business library while building knowledge through business-driven projects.Grow with personalised guidance: Benefit from regular feedback and coaching to ensure your progress is supported at every stage of the programme.Hilton Perks: Including our Go Hilton Team Member Travel Program, which provides you with access to heavily reduced hotel room rates for you, your family & friends. Salary & Benefits: £27,500 gross per annum & private healthcare. Location: At our EMEA Headquarters in Watford, with some flexibility depending on team and business need. You will benefit from a subsidised restaurant, a games area and a free in-house gym.  

Our Placement Opportunity

You will directly contribute to the Travel with Purpose (TWP) performance across our 750+ hotels in Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA). The focus on sustainability and responsible business impact has grown significantly over the past 5 years, particularly in EMEA, with your work being an important contributor to Hilton remaining at the forefront of the hospitality industry, improving hotel performance through leveraging TWP, and increasing positive impact in the thousands of communities we are located in.

Some of the specific responsibilities you may be involved with are detailed as follows:

Support hotels through the TWP Pledges programme to help drive performance in EMEA.Develop monthly and quarterly communications that will be shared with the hotels, owners, and other key corporate partners.Coordinate hotel and corporate events within EMEA for enterprise-wide TWP initiatives, such as Earth Week and Travel with Purpose Week.Plan content for the quarterly EMEA TWP Champions Network updates.Undertake performance analytics and further develop EMEA PowerBI dashboards.Support with internal requests from EMEA stakeholders and, as necessary, work across the business to develop the solutions needed.Be flexible - the sustainability space is constantly changing and each day can bring new focuses and different opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking individuals who embody the Hilton Values in addition to the following criteria:

A strong sense of alignment to our culture and values.A current bachelor’s or master’s student completing a degree that includes a required 12-month year in industry placement.A current Bachelor's or Master's student studying a degree in or related to Environment Studies, Geography, Sustainability, Environmental Management, International Development, Sustainable Development, Climate Change/Systems, Earth Sciences or Hospitality.Availability to begin full-time employment on 5th July 2027, for a full-time 12-month placement.You must have the independent right to work in the UK for the full duration of the 12-month placement. Please note that this role is not eligible for visa sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route, so we are unable to consider applications from candidates who would require sponsorship. If you hold a visa or status that allows you to work in the UK full-time without sponsorship (e.g. Settled Status, Pre-Settled Status, where a 12-month work placement is a permitted, required & assessed part of your UK University degree, or other independent work permissions), you are welcome to apply.Fluency in English (spoken and written).An ability to demonstrate a significant passion for sustainability and social impact.A resilient mindset and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.An ability to work both independently and as part of a team.Excellent time management, organisation skills and the ability to prioritise.IT skills - Excel and PowerBi knowledge would be beneficial.The ability to analyse large data sets and take the initiative to identify priorities and make recommendations.Excellent communication skills, the ability to provide a simple explanation of sustainability and environmental matters to non-technical colleagues.

Click here to learn more about Hilton's Corporate Placements

Selection Process

Applications are now open—don’t miss your chance to apply! Submissions close on Sunday 1st November 2026.

Our selection process is designed to bring out your best and help us get to know you. It includes:

Online assessments.In-person or virtual interview.

While the process is rigorous, it’s also the first step in your personal growth journey with Hilton. If selected, you’ll begin developing the skills, connections, and confidence to thrive in your career.

To ensure every application receives fair consideration, invitations to final-stage interviews will be issued after applications have closed. Please complete each stage promptly and keep an eye on your inbox for updates.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process or to carry out the essential requirements of the role, please contact us.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team And The Role

At eBay, we are reinventing the future of commerce. To help power that vision, we are seeking a Finance Manager to join our world-class finance team! As part of our Global Marketplace Experience (GMX) finance team, you will play a meaningful role in supporting our GMX organization with responsibility for financial consolidation, strategic OPEX and resource management, and driving operational excellence. You will also serve as a strategic finance partner to the eBay Services organization, leveraging data driven insights to inform more accurate forecasting and hiring. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, excel at managing competing priorities, and have a passion for delivering meaningful business impact, this role is for you!

What You Will Accomplish

Lead end-to-end FP&A activities: Ownership of Commercial and Product financial budgeting, forecasting, consolidations, month-end close processes and ad-hoc analyses. Ensure accuracy, timeliness and efficiencies across deliverables, while finding opportunities to improve and optimize processes. Drive operational excellence and OPEX rigor: Implement AI into financial planning processes and refine financial planning tools, processes, and frameworks with a strong focus on operational efficiency. Deliver actionable insights: Develop, maintain, and deliver reporting packages and dashboards that provide senior leadership with clear, data-driven insights. Highlight trends, risks, and opportunities, enabling proactive decision-making and resource allocation. Be a trusted business partner: Collaborate closely with business, finance, and corporate stakeholders to agree on goals, integrate initiatives, and ensure consistency across functions. Provide financial guidance and challenge assumptions constructively to support business strategies. Streamline and simplify: Standardize financial planning and reporting processes to reduce duplication and non-value-added work. Consolidate multiple inputs and priorities into clear, actionable recommendations.


Required Skills

What you will bring: 

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Business, Finance, Economics, or Accounting 5+ years of finance experience with exposure to different areas (business analysis, accounting, FP&A, etc.) Experience with financial systems such as Anaplan, SAP 4 HANA, SAP BPC, SAP BW, etc. (preferred) Experience working with AI tools such as Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Glean and others to implement and enhance existing processes (preferred) Ability to demonstrate data and analytics driven points of view and impact decision making at all levels of the organization Strong interpersonal skills and a proven track record to partner effectively with all functions and levels within the organization Ability to perform in a matrixed organization supporting multiple partners across different geographies, working through a high degree of complexity and ambiguity The ideal candidate will have robust financial analysis capabilities, including building and maintaining financial models, with a strong technical ability in spreadsheets and presentations


Preferred Skills

Experience handling headcount and OPEX, including workforce planning, forecasting, and resource allocation in partnership with business leaders (preferred)

150,000-160,000

The base pay range for all other U.S. work locations is expected in the range below:

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The People Team

The People Team is responsible for shaping every aspect of the employee experience at eBay. We drive business performance through talent acquisition, learning and development, compensation, benefits, people operations, employee experience, and people technologies. We are committed to creating an environment where employees can thrive while enabling the business to achieve its strategic objectives globally.

eBay is seeking an accomplished and strategic Senior Director, Compensation to lead the vision, strategy, governance, design, communication, and execution of our global broad-based compensation programs.
