parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Join Deloitte's SAP practice and build a career at the forefront of business transformation, where innovation, industry insight, and leading technology come together to solve complex challenges. You'll work with dynamic teams and leading organizations to modernize core processes, enable digital transformation, and help clients unlock lasting value through SAP-enabled solutions.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026.

 Work you'll do 

As a Senior Consultant on the SAP team, you will support clients across the solution lifecycle, from business process assessment and design through build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

 Lead assigned SAP Concur workstreams across Expense, Travel, Invoice, and Request, managing the workplan, requirements, dependencies, risks, issues, and quality of deliverables; escalate scope, timeline, and resource concerns as appropriate.  Facilitate requirements, fit-to-standard, and solution design workshops with client stakeholders and project teams. Translate travel and expense, accounts payable, corporate card, and spend management requirements into practical SAP Concur solutions.  Own functional design for assigned scope and coordinate or perform configuration, integration requirements, data migration, testing, defect resolution, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization activities.  Analyze current-state processes and provide recommendations related to operating models, policy alignment, compliance controls, tax and value-added tax considerations, corporate card programs, and spend management improvements.  Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned client stakeholders, communicating progress, decisions, risks, and action items. Support training, change adoption, stakeholder communications, and post-go-live activities.  Contribute to estimates, proposals, reusable assets, and SAP Concur practice development. Mentor more junior team members and share knowledge, delivery methods, and functional expertise. 

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  Effective written and verbal communication skills  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  Ability to lead projects or workstreams  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  Ability to meet deadlines  Ability to provide clear guidance to others 

 The team 

Deloitte's SAP practice helps clients design, implement, and sustain SAP-enabled transformations across core business functions. Our teams combine industry knowledge, functional experience, and technology capabilities to support first-time implementations, business-led enhancements, and large-scale SAP S/4HANA programs.

Professionals in the practice work with leading organizations across industries to modernize operations, improve process performance, and unlock value through cloud, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

Qualifications

 Required 

 Bachelor's degree, or Associate's degree plus 6+ years of experience in SAP, enterprise resource planning (ERP), SAP Concur, travel and expense, accounts payable, spend management, or consulting  5+ years of SAP consulting experience supporting solution design and end-to-end delivery in a consulting firm, industry environment, or both  Experience supporting 2+ full-lifecycle enterprise implementations, including 1+ SAP Concur implementation  Configuration experience with SAP Concur Expense and at least one additional SAP Concur solution, such as Travel, Invoice, or Request  Experience supporting travel-and-expense, accounts-payable or invoice, corporate card, or broader spend management processes, including related policies, controls, and compliance considerations  Experience working with or supporting SAP S/4HANA environments  Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve 

Preferred

 Master's degree  2+ years of client service delivery experience in a consulting or professional services firm supporting large enterprise transformation engagements  SAP Concur certification  Experience with SAP Concur Request and extended solutions such as Concur Detect, Benefits Assurance, Budget, or Intelligence  Experience with global or multi-country SAP Concur implementations, including value-added tax, tax, and localization requirements  Experience with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP financial posting processes, or related enterprise finance capabilities  Experience with SAP Concur application programming interfaces (APIs), the SAP Concur App Center, reporting, analytics, or data integration capabilities 

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $1 10 , 7 00 to $2 18 , 3 00.

rows.title: Cyber Insider Risk Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Cyber Defense & Resilience - Senior Consultant

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte & Touche LLP could be the place for you. Traditional security and integrated risk programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure, automate and support technology innovation required by the business.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Insider Risk Senior Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

 Assisting in developing comprehensive strategies for insider risk programs, including program assessments and roadmaps, using Deloitte's Insider Risk capability framework and industry practices Assisting in the operation of client insider risk programs, including the triage, analysis, investigation, and remediation of insider risk-related inquiries Leading client workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs with cross-functional stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, and Security, to document business processes, goals, and program requirements Aligning insider risk indicator and policy development with business needs and industry-leading standards, frameworks, and practices, including the CERT Insider Threat Framework, National Insider Threat Task Force guidelines, and MITRE ATT&CK for Enterprise Designing and implementing insider risk detection use cases, monitoring processes, and escalation workflows using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention capabilities Evaluating insider risk scenarios, high-risk user groups, and crown jewel assets to help clients prioritize and deploy monitoring, detection, response, and program management capabilities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated business and cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs. We work across a variety of different risk and compliance programs that extend well beyond Cyber Risk. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory's Cyber Risk Services practice.

Qualifications

Required:

 3+ years of experience in insider risk, security operations, investigations, compliance, data protection, or enterprise risk management 1+ years of experience managing an insider risk program or conducting insider risk investigations and monitoring insider risk behaviors Experience using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention tools to support insider risk operations Experience developing insider risk procedures, playbooks, workflows, metrics, or governance models Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, Ethics, or Security Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience Experience in consulting or professional services Experience responding to and recovering from cybersecurity incidents Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing UEBA and/or User Activity Monitoring (UAM) platforms to support insider risk detection (e.g., Splunk UEBA, Proofpoint ITM, Microsoft Purview IRM, etc.) Hands-on experience with at least one Data Loss Prevention solution such as Microsoft Purview, Proofpoint DLP, or Zscaler DLP One or more of the following certifications: CERT Insider Threat Program Senior Consultant Certificate, CERT Insider Threat Analyst, CERT Insider Risk Measure Management Measures of Effectiveness, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional, Certified Information Security Senior Consultant, or Certified Information Systems Auditor

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. rows.title: Cyber - GCP Forward Deployed Security Engineer (FDE) - Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Join Deloitte's Cloud Cyber Security practice as a GCP Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Consultant and help organizations secure Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads at scale. In this hands-on role, you will work directly with client engineering teams to design, build, ship, and operate secure-by-default GCP environments and automated security controls across generative AI services, container and data platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and secure delivery pipelines. This role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex cloud security challenges, shipping working automation, and driving security outcomes in production environments.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a GCP Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Consultant on the Cloud Cyber Security team, you will be responsible for...

Embedding directly within client cloud, platform, and engineering teams to design, build, deploy, ship, and operate automated security controls across GCP environments, from initial design through production ownership, not only assessment and handoff.Designing, implementing, and hardening security controls for Google Cloud generative AI and machine learning services, including Gemini AI, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Model Garden, and Model Armor, as well as securing containerized and serverless workloads on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) through pod security standards, network policies, Workload Identity Federation (WIF), runtime protection, image scanning, and admission controls.Implementing data protection and data loss prevention capabilities using Google Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Key Management Service (KMS), tokenization and encryption patterns, Security Command Center, Organization Policies, Identity and Access Management (IAM) Policy Analyzer, and Cloud Logging to support continuous monitoring, posture management, automated remediation, and protection across storage, databases, and analytics platforms.Writing and maintaining Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, embedding security guardrails and policy-as-code, developing reusable secure landing zone modules, and engineering security scanning into live developer workflows, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, infrastructure-as-code scanning, and artifact integrity.Navigating client environments, including legacy projects, landing zone constraints, and production access requirements, while owning deployed security controls in production, tuning performance, responding to control-related issues, leading technical workstreams, and contributing reusable assets, proof of concepts, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to support future engagements and practice development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cloud Cyber Security team helps organizations pursue growth, innovation, and performance through proactive management of cyber risk. Our Forward Deployed Security Engineers work embedded directly inside client teams, combining cyber risk, regulatory, and engineering capabilities in the design, implementation, and operation of scalable GCP cloud security solutions. The team focuses on helping clients move from recommendations to implemented controls that support security outcomes in production environments.

Qualifications

Required:

5+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technology consulting.3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, or operating security solutions in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.2+ years of experience using Terraform to deploy infrastructure-as-code in production environments.Experience implementing policy-as-code and guardrail frameworks, including Google Cloud Organization Policies, Open Policy Agent, Checkov, or tfsec.Experience integrating security controls into continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, or infrastructure-as-code scanning, and developing automation using Python, Bash, or Go to build and ship automated remediation.Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience securing generative AI and machine learning workloads on Google Cloud services, including Gemini AI, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Model Garden, and Model Armor.Experience securing Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) environments, including workload identity, runtime protection, and admission controls.Experience implementing security controls aligned to International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-53 (NIST SP 800-53), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), or Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2).Experience delivering cloud security implementations in a forward-deployed, startup, or professional services delivery model.Google Cloud Professional Security Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable cloud security certification.

rows.title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, ServiceNow
rows.descriptionText:
At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead ServiceNow FDE, you will serve as the senior practitioner-leader embedded directly with our most strategic clients, leading forward-deployed engineering pods that develop and deploy GenAI solutions into production for Deloitte's most strategic clients. You'll set technical direction, remove delivery blockers, and stay hands-on; designing, reviewing, and debugging systems with the team. You'll translate engineering trade-offs into clear decisions for client leaders when needed. Your ability to influence decisions at the C-suite level, while maintaining hands-on technical credibility, is what sets you apart. Pods under your leadership may be deployed onshore with clients or in hybrid onshore/offshore configurations, leveraging Deloitte's global delivery capability to maximize speed and scale.

rows.title: Converge by Deloitte VP Sales Executive - Data Studio-C_MAT
rows.descriptionText:
As a VP Sales Executive for Deloitte's Converge for Healthcare portfolio, you will help create the market for the next evolution of our revenue cycle offering: the extension of Revenue Intellect™ - our established, in-market analytics product - into an agentic platform, powered by Data Studio, that enables full revenue cycle business process outsourcing (BPaaS). Revenue Intellect™ helps healthcare providers improve financial margin and revenue cycle performance through data-driven insights; the platform and BPaaS motion extends that value from insight to fully AI-enabled execution of the work itself.

Revenue Intellect™ has been in market for more than nine years and is used by some of the largest and most complex health systems in the country. It remains a product this role sells actively and out of the box, generating near-term revenue and reference clients. The larger opportunity - and the primary focus of this role - is to build the market for the agentic platform and BPaaS engagements that Revenue Intellect™ is evolving into: larger, multi-year, outcome-based deals in which Deloitte runs revenue cycle processes for clients on an AI-enabled platform.

This is a market-making role, not solely a closing role. rows.descriptionText:
Join Deloitte's Cloud Cyber Security practice as a GCP Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Consultant and help organizations secure Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads at scale. In this hands-on role, you will work directly with client engineering teams to design, build, ship, and operate secure-by-default GCP environments and automated security controls across generative AI services, container and data platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and secure delivery pipelines. Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

Our Forward Deployed Security Engineers work embedded directly inside client teams, combining cyber risk, regulatory, and engineering capabilities in the design, implementation, and operation of scalable GCP cloud security solutions. The team focuses on helping clients move from recommendations to implemented controls that support security outcomes in production environments.

Qualifications

Required:

5+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technology consulting.3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, or operating security solutions in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.2+ years of experience using Terraform to deploy infrastructure-as-code in production environments.Experience implementing policy-as-code and guardrail frameworks, including Google Cloud Organization Policies, Open Policy Agent, Checkov, or tfsec.Experience integrating security controls into continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, or infrastructure-as-code scanning, and developing automation using Python, Bash, or Go to build and ship automated remediation.Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

We work across a variety of different risk and compliance programs that extend well beyond Cyber Risk. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory's Cyber Risk Services practice.

 3+ years of experience in insider risk, security operations, investigations, compliance, data protection, or enterprise risk management 1+ years of experience managing an insider risk program or conducting insider risk investigations and monitoring insider risk behaviors Experience using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention tools to support insider risk operations Experience developing insider risk procedures, playbooks, workflows, metrics, or governance models Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, Ethics, or Security Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead ServiceNow FDE, you will serve as the senior practitioner-leader embedded directly with our most strategic clients, leading forward-deployed engineering pods that develop and deploy GenAI solutions into production for Deloitte's most strategic clients. You'll set technical direction, remove delivery blockers, and stay hands-on; designing, reviewing, and debugging systems with the team. You'll translate engineering trade-offs into clear decisions for client leaders when needed. Your ability to influence decisions at the C-suite level, while maintaining hands-on technical credibility, is what sets you apart. Pods under your leadership may be deployed onshore with clients or in hybrid onshore/offshore configurations, leveraging Deloitte's global delivery capability to maximize speed and scale.

Cross-Functional Pod Leadership & Program Governance

rows.descriptionText:
The Digital Media Buyer is a key member of the Digital Investment team of experts responsible for delivering smart, innovative and performance driven Digital campaigns for its clients. They take the lead in identifying and selecting media partners that achieve identified strategic and tactical objectives as laid out by the Connections Planning and Comms Planning teams. This is a contract role supporting a pharma account, which runs until the end of December.
They are the primary owners of the vendor relationships and are responsible for all negotiation and value creation with these vendors and for ensuring each plan is executed with excellence. They supply aggregated quantitative and qualitative information for group level reporting for rate and program negotiations. The team is expected to stay at the cutting edge of Digital innovation within the industry and educate the larger brand/client teams on relevant opportunities and challenges.

rows.title: Converge by Deloitte VP Sales Executive - Data Studio-C_MAT
rows.descriptionText:
As a VP Sales Executive for Deloitte's Converge for Healthcare portfolio, you will help create the market for the next evolution of our revenue cycle offering: the extension of Revenue Intellect™ - our established, in-market analytics product - into an agentic platform, powered by Data Studio, that enables full revenue cycle business process outsourcing (BPaaS). Revenue Intellect™ helps healthcare providers improve financial margin and revenue cycle performance through data-driven insights; the platform and BPaaS motion extends that value from insight to fully AI-enabled execution of the work itself.

Revenue Intellect™ has been in market for more than nine years and is used by some of the largest and most complex health systems in the country. It remains a product this role sells actively and out of the box, generating near-term revenue and reference clients. The larger opportunity - and the primary focus of this role - is to build the market for the agentic platform and BPaaS engagements that Revenue Intellect™ is evolving into: larger, multi-year, outcome-based deals in which Deloitte runs revenue cycle processes for clients on an AI-enabled platform.

This is a market-making role, not solely a closing role. You will bring your own senior relationships and your own approach to market outreach; source and originate qualified pipeline; shape the deals; and quarterback complex pursuits alongside the product, delivery, deal-desk, and account teams who carry deals to signature. You will also help shape the pricing, packaging, and commercial constructs for these newer offerings, informed by what you learn in market - an important but secondary part of the role, weighted behind being in market.

Your time is weighted toward the market-making mandate - originating and advancing the Data Studio platform and Rev Cycle BPaaS motion - with continued active selling of Revenue Intellect™ as the near-term, in-market anchor. Success is measured primarily by qualified pipeline sourced and total contract value (TCV) originated on the platform and BPaaS motion, with a secondary line for Revenue Intellect™ bookings.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/28/2026.

Work you'll do

As a VP Sales Executive on the Converge for Healthcare team, you will be responsible for:

Sell Revenue Intellect™ in market. Actively sell Revenue Intellect™ out of the box across mid-market health systems, regional IDNs, and multi-specialty groups (typically $250M-$2B in net patient revenue), landing near-term wins and reference clients that build credibility for the larger platform story.Make the market for the platform & BPaaS motion. Originate, shape, and quarterback the larger agentic-platform (Data Studio) and revenue-cycle BPaaS pursuits - larger, multi-year, outcome-based engagements - working shoulder-to-shoulder with product, delivery, and solutioning to define both what is sold and how it is delivered. You bring the outreach and the relationships; you are not solely responsible for closing.Pursuit orchestration and pipeline visibility. Partner with Converge for Healthcare leaders, Deloitte Industry account teams, deal desk, inside sales, and marketing to optimize targeting and lead-to-pipeline conversion and to move complex pursuits toward signature; provide structured visibility into qualified pipeline and TCV across the motion.New-logo origination through your own network. Activate your personal network of health system relationships to originate opportunities beyond Deloitte's existing accounts, and set the outreach approach for the segment. Where a Deloitte account relationship exists, you and the account team open doors together and the pursuit team helps carry deals to close.Executive engagement across business and technical buyers. Engage VP and C-suite buyers across revenue cycle, finance, and operations (CFO/COO) on the make-vs-buy decision for BPaaS, and across data, analytics, and IT (CDO/CIO/enterprise architecture) on the platform - advancing deals and building lasting relationships.Shape pricing, packaging, and commercial constructs (secondary). Feed market signal back into the pricing, packaging, and deal constructs for Data Studio and BPaaS - including consumption/capacity-based and outcome-based models - in partnership with the pricing and deal-desk workstream. A field-informed contribution, weighted behind being in market.

A Strong, Successful Candidate Will Possess These Skills

Deep fluency in healthcare revenue cycle operations, including denial management, charge capture, payer contracting, coding, and financial performance management, with the ability to translate domain complexity into clear product value for finance and operations executives.Demonstrated track record of building sales infrastructure in a new or early-stage product context-including playbooks, pipeline processes, and go-to-market frameworks-without significant pre-existing organizational support.Established personal network of senior decision makers across health systems, IDNs, and payer organizations that can be immediately leveraged for pipeline development.Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with proven experience presenting to CFO, CRO, COO, and VP-level audiences and structuring complex product value into clear business and ROI outcomes.Ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles spanning procurement, legal, IT security, and compliance, with the judgment to know when to bring in product, delivery, or solution support.Commercially driven, self-directed orientation - comfortable owning pipeline generation, origination, and forecast within an early, still-forming commercial motion, without heavy day-to-day management support.Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Deloitte account teams, product leadership, marketing, inside sales, and delivery in a matrixed environment.Practical familiarity with modern sales tooling and operating rhythms, including CRM hygiene, pipeline forecasting discipline, and structured account planning.Fluency with data platforms and agentic/AI capabilities in healthcare, and the ability to position a platform and its outcomes credibly with both technical buyers (data, analytics, IT) and business buyers (finance, operations).Comfort operating across multiple commercial models - subscription, consumption/capacity-based, and outcome/managed-service (BPaaS) - including deals where pricing and packaging are not yet fixed, with sensitivity to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal.Experience selling tech-enabled managed services, business process outsourcing (BPaaS), or outcome-based engagements - where the sale is inseparable from delivery capacity, transition, and client-side operating-model change.Awareness of the broader healthcare market context, including payer-provider dynamics, mid-market consolidation trends, and the competitive landscape across revenue cycle and financial analytics vendors.

The team

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, and works closely with Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering-, product-, and platform-oriented mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions, identifying and investing in areas of growth three, five, and ten years into the future.

Converge for Healthcare combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help health systems and payers improve financial performance, optimize revenue cycle operations, and drive sustainable margin improvement. Revenue Intellect™ is the flagship product within this portfolio, supported by full product, delivery, marketing, and inside sales teams. Business Development leaders in Converge for Healthcare operate at the intersection of product, industry, and client-partnering with Deloitte Partners, Market Makers, Product Leads, and Pursuit Teams to align offerings with priority client opportunities and growth agendas.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, platform, and/or tech-enabled managed-services sales, with at least 5 of those years selling to or working within healthcare organizations (health systems, IDNs, payers, or physician groups).5+ years originating and carrying complex, multi-stakeholder deals in software, platform, or managed-services sales, including multi-year agreements structured as subscription, consumption, or outcome-based constructs.Demonstrated record of sourcing qualified pipeline and originating multi-million-dollar total contract value (TCV), with experience being measured on pipeline and origination - not solely on individual closed bookings.Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

 Assisting in developing comprehensive strategies for insider risk programs, including program assessments and roadmaps, using Deloitte's Insider Risk capability framework and industry practices Assisting in the operation of client insider risk programs, including the triage, analysis, investigation, and remediation of insider risk-related inquiries Leading client workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs with cross-functional stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, and Security, to document business processes, goals, and program requirements Aligning insider risk indicator and policy development with business needs and industry-leading standards, frameworks, and practices, including the CERT Insider Threat Framework, National Insider Threat Task Force guidelines, and MITRE ATT&CK for Enterprise Designing and implementing insider risk detection use cases, monitoring processes, and escalation workflows using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention capabilities Evaluating insider risk scenarios, high-risk user groups, and crown jewel assets to help clients prioritize and deploy monitoring, detection, response, and program management capabilities

The team

Deloitte's Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated business and cyber risks. We work across a variety of different risk and compliance programs that extend well beyond Cyber Risk. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory's Cyber Risk Services practice.

 3+ years of experience in insider risk, security operations, investigations, compliance, data protection, or enterprise risk management 1+ years of experience managing an insider risk program or conducting insider risk investigations and monitoring insider risk behaviors Experience using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention tools to support insider risk operations Experience developing insider risk procedures, playbooks, workflows, metrics, or governance models Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, Ethics, or Security Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

rows.title: Cyber - GCP Forward Deployed Security Engineer (FDE) - Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Join Deloitte's Cloud Cyber Security practice as a GCP Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Consultant and help organizations secure Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud and artificial intelligence (AI) workloads at scale. In this hands-on role, you will work directly with client engineering teams to design, build, ship, and operate secure-by-default GCP environments and automated security controls across generative AI services, container and data platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and secure delivery pipelines. This role is suited for an engineer who enjoys solving complex cloud security challenges, shipping working automation, and driving security outcomes in production environments.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a GCP Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Consultant on the Cloud Cyber Security team, you will be responsible for...

Embedding directly within client cloud, platform, and engineering teams to design, build, deploy, ship, and operate automated security controls across GCP environments, from initial design through production ownership, not only assessment and handoff.Designing, implementing, and hardening security controls for Google Cloud generative AI and machine learning services, including Gemini AI, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Model Garden, and Model Armor, as well as securing containerized and serverless workloads on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) through pod security standards, network policies, Workload Identity Federation (WIF), runtime protection, image scanning, and admission controls.Implementing data protection and data loss prevention capabilities using Google Cloud Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Key Management Service (KMS), tokenization and encryption patterns, Security Command Center, Organization Policies, Identity and Access Management (IAM) Policy Analyzer, and Cloud Logging to support continuous monitoring, posture management, automated remediation, and protection across storage, databases, and analytics platforms.Writing and maintaining Terraform-based infrastructure-as-code, embedding security guardrails and policy-as-code, developing reusable secure landing zone modules, and engineering security scanning into live developer workflows, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, infrastructure-as-code scanning, and artifact integrity.Navigating client environments, including legacy projects, landing zone constraints, and production access requirements, while owning deployed security controls in production, tuning performance, responding to control-related issues, leading technical workstreams, and contributing reusable assets, proof of concepts, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to support future engagements and practice development.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a teamEffective written and verbal communication skillsMeticulous attention to detail and quality of work productAbility to build and sustain professional relationshipsAbility to lead projects or workstreamsAbility to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environmentStrong interpersonal skills and professional demeanorAbility to meet deadlinesAbility to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cloud Cyber Security team helps organizations pursue growth, innovation, and performance through proactive management of cyber risk. Our Forward Deployed Security Engineers work embedded directly inside client teams, combining cyber risk, regulatory, and engineering capabilities in the design, implementation, and operation of scalable GCP cloud security solutions. The team focuses on helping clients move from recommendations to implemented controls that support security outcomes in production environments.

Qualifications

Required:

5+ years of experience in cloud security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or technology consulting.3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, or operating security solutions in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments.2+ years of experience using Terraform to deploy infrastructure-as-code in production environments.Experience implementing policy-as-code and guardrail frameworks, including Google Cloud Organization Policies, Open Policy Agent, Checkov, or tfsec.Experience integrating security controls into continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines, including static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis, secrets scanning, or infrastructure-as-code scanning, and developing automation using Python, Bash, or Go to build and ship automated remediation.Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Experience securing generative AI and machine learning workloads on Google Cloud services, including Gemini AI, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Model Garden, and Model Armor.Experience securing Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) environments, including workload identity, runtime protection, and admission controls.Experience implementing security controls aligned to International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, National Institute of Standards and Technology Cybersecurity Framework (NIST CSF), National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-53 (NIST SP 800-53), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), or Service Organization Control 2 (SOC 2).Experience delivering cloud security implementations in a forward-deployed, startup, or professional services delivery model.Google Cloud Professional Security Engineer, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable cloud security certification.

As a Senior Product Specialist in Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce (AM&C) practice, you will operate far beyond the boundaries of traditional product management. You will play a key role in helping clients build, enhance, and launch new digital products, focusing on AI-first and AI-native approaches. Working closely with Deloitte's multidisciplinary teams-engineers, designers, strategists, and business leaders-you will own the end-to-end success of digital products that fuel our clients' biggest growth opportunities and enhance customer experiences.

The team

Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead-to-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth.

At Deloitte, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) don't just build AI solutions, they help clients turn AI ambition into enterprise-scale impact, pairing leading class engineering with pod-based delivery and vertical expertise. If you thrive at the intersection of product, engineering, problem-solving, and client impact, this role puts you at the forefront of AI transformations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a ServiceNow FDE, you will work side by side with senior functional and technical client team members to rapidly prototype and deliver high-impact GenAI-enabled solutions. This requires a highly motivated practitioner who moves with speed and precision, building working software, engaging confidently with senior stakeholders and engineers to bring measurable business impact from day one. Additional responsibilities include:

Client Engagement

Embed with clients to identify business needs and translate high-value GenAI use cases into solutions.Partner with leaders, product owners, architects, and engineers to align priorities and delivery.Lead working sessions to shape solutions and drive client outcomes.Prototype and deliver working AI solutions using industry expertise and emerging capabilities.Contribute independently within an FDE pod while mentoring newer team members.

Solution Engineering

Build AI-enabled solutions, agentic platforms, and workflows across enterprise AI platforms.Develop scalable AI engineering patterns, tool-use approaches, and human-in-the-loop controls.Apply architecture decisions that balance quality, safety, latency, cost, and model risk.Deliver production-quality code using strong practices in testing, CI/CD, logging, versioning, and documentation.Design extensible functionality, support sprint sizing, and align solutions with senior team members.Contribute reusable assets including code, prompt libraries, runbooks, and reference implementations.

The team

Our ServiceNow practice develops strategies and implements systems that help organizations build business value and improve performance. Drawing on deep experience solving complex IT and non-IT challenges globally, we guide clients through everything from system replacement to full Enterprise transformation. We partner with COOs, CHROs, CFOs/CPOs, CISOs, CIOs/CTOs, technology executives, and service owners across HR, IT, Customer, Field Service, and Project Portfolio Management to modernize technology delivery and operating models. By focusing on NextGen technologies and evolving service models, we help clients shift from foundational technology delivery to becoming the strategic business partner and catalyst for change that today's operational demands require.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science or Engineering.3+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, data science, or analytics engineering. 1+ years of hands-on experience building and deploying GenAI/LLM-powered solutions in client or production environments1+ years of experience leading project workstreams/engagements and translating business problems into AI solutions1+ years of experience building reliable, maintainable, and well-documented code Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serveLimited immigration sponsorship may be available4+ years of relevant ServiceNow IT consulting or industry experience3+ years of experience in large technology engagements2 full life cycle ServiceNow implementationsTeam lead experienceCertified Application Developer (CAD)Familiarity with ServiceNow GenAI capabilities such as Now Assist and AI AgentsHands-on ServiceNow development experience across Flow Designer, Integration Hub, Service Portal, App Engine, and the Now Platform APIs. ServiceNow SDK experience with Claude and/or GitHub is a plusCustom scripting experience across Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Actions, Client Scripts, and Scheduled Jobs, with attention to performance optimizationHands-on experience using Claude Code as a development accelerator, driving its agentic loop to plan, implement, test, and refactor ServiceNow codeFamiliarity with authoring CLAUDE.md project memory files and using Claude Code MCP integrations (e.g., GitHub, Jira) within IDE and terminal workflows

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud) and common platform services (storage, compute, IAM, networking)Demonstrated ability to work directly alongside client technical teams and program stakeholders in fast-paced, ambiguous delivery environments Data engineering experience with Spark, Airflow/dbt, streaming, data modeling or ML/data science background feature engineering, experimentation or model evaluationExperience with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, and prompt management Experience integrating LLM solutions with enterprise systems via APIs, microservices, or event-driven architectures Experience operating within hybrid onshore/offshore teams Familiarity with security, privacy, and compliance considerationsServiceNow certification in one or more areas (e.g., Certified System Administrator or Certified Implementation Specialist)An advanced degree in the area of specializationModule experience across CSM, Creator Workflow, ITxM, HRSD, IRM/GRC, and Source-to-Pay (S2P)Experience with GBS on Now, Now Assist, and Creator Workflow

rows.title: Cyber Insider Risk Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
Cyber Defense & Resilience - Senior Consultant

Are you interested in working in a dynamic environment that offers opportunities for professional growth and new responsibilities? If so, Deloitte & Touche LLP could be the place for you. Traditional security and integrated risk programs have often been unsuccessful in unifying the need to both secure, automate and support technology innovation required by the business.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Insider Risk Senior Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

 Assisting in developing comprehensive strategies for insider risk programs, including program assessments and roadmaps, using Deloitte's Insider Risk capability framework and industry practices Assisting in the operation of client insider risk programs, including the triage, analysis, investigation, and remediation of insider risk-related inquiries Leading client workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs with cross-functional stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, and Security, to document business processes, goals, and program requirements Aligning insider risk indicator and policy development with business needs and industry-leading standards, frameworks, and practices, including the CERT Insider Threat Framework, National Insider Threat Task Force guidelines, and MITRE ATT&CK for Enterprise Designing and implementing insider risk detection use cases, monitoring processes, and escalation workflows using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention capabilities Evaluating insider risk scenarios, high-risk user groups, and crown jewel assets to help clients prioritize and deploy monitoring, detection, response, and program management capabilities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team Effective written and verbal communication skills Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product Ability to build and sustain professional relationships Ability to lead projects or workstreams Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor Ability to meet deadlines Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Cyber team helps complex organizations more confidently pursue their growth, innovation and performance agendas through proactive management of the associated business and cyber risks. Our professionals provide advisory and implementation services that integrate risk, regulatory, and technology skills to help clients transform their legacy programs. We work across a variety of different risk and compliance programs that extend well beyond Cyber Risk. Learn more about Deloitte Advisory's Cyber Risk Services practice.

Qualifications

Required:

 3+ years of experience in insider risk, security operations, investigations, compliance, data protection, or enterprise risk management 1+ years of experience managing an insider risk program or conducting insider risk investigations and monitoring insider risk behaviors Experience using Security Information and Event Management, User and Entity Behavior Analytics, and Data Loss Prevention tools to support insider risk operations Experience developing insider risk procedures, playbooks, workflows, metrics, or governance models Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders such as Human Resources, Legal, Privacy, Ethics, or Security Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience Experience in consulting or professional services Experience responding to and recovering from cybersecurity incidents Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing UEBA and/or User Activity Monitoring (UAM) platforms to support insider risk detection (e.g., Splunk UEBA, Proofpoint ITM, Microsoft Purview IRM, etc.) Hands-on experience with at least one Data Loss Prevention solution such as Microsoft Purview, Proofpoint DLP, or Zscaler DLP One or more of the following certifications: CERT Insider Threat Program Senior Consultant Certificate, CERT Insider Threat Analyst, CERT Insider Risk Measure Management Measures of Effectiveness, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Certified Information Privacy Professional, Certified Information Security Senior Consultant, or Certified Information Systems Auditor

rows.title: Agentic / GenAI Consultant / Senior Consultant
rows.descriptionText:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

We’re looking for GenAI/Agentic Engineers who want to shape the future of Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI. You will be tasked with building and deploying intelligent systems that combine cutting-edge models, agentic frameworks, and full-stack engineering to solve real business problems. If you’re excited by rapid prototyping, scaling AI products into production, and using technology to make a tangible impact, this is your place to do it.

YOUR ROLE

In this position you will play a key part in:

Designing, developing, testing, and deploying both front-end and back-end components of applications within the data science and AI consulting team with a focus on GenAI and agentic solutions. Collaborating cloud architects, data scientists, product managers, and business consultants to bring ideas to production.Design agentic workflows with HITL gates, auditability, policy controls, and robust evaluation/monitoring suitable for regulated clientsTranslating business challenges into AI-powered solutions, leveraging Generative and Agentic AI, data science, and analytics to deliver innovation and results to meet client standards. Working effectively in a team, supporting your peers in delivering at pace and meeting our own high internal standards of output and delivery.

Role

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

Business Development – Using your full stack skillset to build AI Demonstrators to showcase to potential clients, contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, client pitch contribution, and client hosting at events.Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

We’d Love To Meet Someone With

Experience working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting mindset with a proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering solutions. Experience of working with client sponsors, both technical and non-technical, to collaboratively design requirements and build out solutions.Experience of designing and developing full-stack applications across the application lifecycle, from building early PoCs, through to developing MVPs and testing them, to finally deploying a secure and scalable production-grade solution.A proven track record of successfully delivering solutions using traditional Machine Learning models, Generative AI models and using Agentic AI frameworks in a client-facing environment, by buildingGenAI And Agentic solutions, including data engineering in cloud environments.The ability to demonstrate the potential that AI has to offer to unlock business value.

As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Join our Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) Financial Services team and be part of the future of AI consulting. We are redefining how organisations adopt and scale AI, moving beyond experimentation to embedding agentic systems, human-AI workflows and data products into every aspect of how they operate, compete, and create value.

We are looking for experienced Data & AI leaders who combine AI technical expertise and commercial acumen to shape enterprise-wide transformation. You will lead client engagements from strategy through to execution that combine modern data platforms, semantic architectures and agentic AI solutions to deliver measurable business value, whilst contributing to the growth of our EDA Financial Services practice.

YOUR ROLE

This role is for a programme leader with genuine technical depth - not a solution architect, and not a pure strategist. You will own complex, multi-workstream data and AI programmes for major Financial Services clients: the client relationship, the commercials, the delivery and the team. You will need enough hands-on background to challenge an architecture decision credibly, and enough consulting judgement to hold a boardroom. You will not be building the architecture yourself.

You will work across retail and commercial banking, insurance and capital markets, on problems where the value is clear and the constraints are real - credit decisioning, underwriting, claims, KYC and AML operations, complaints handling and trade surveillance, alongside the data foundations underneath them. You will be expected to operate fluently within the regulatory environment that shapes AI delivery in Financial Services.

We Make AI Useful. You will own the commercial and value agenda - making sure the AI we build is worth building.

 Acting as a trusted advisor to executive and C-suite stakeholders, shaping AI strategy, investment cases and roadmaps, and being the person the client escalates to when the programme is under pressure Owning the business case end to end: defining the value, agreeing the measurement approach with the client’s finance and risk functions, and being accountable for the benefits actually landing Making the difficult trade-off calls - build versus buy, platform choice, delivery sequencing, and where technical debt is acceptable and where it is not

We Make AI Usable. You will lead the human-centred design of AI solutions around the needs of users and the way organisations operate.

 Translating business and regulatory problems into AI-enabled products, agentic workflows and intelligent decision platforms, with defined user needs, business outcomes and success metrics Designing operating models that integrate people, AI agents and business processes - including role redesign, human-in-the-loop controls, and the change strategy that makes adoption stick Partnering with business, product and engineering leaders to embed AI into customer journeys, colleague experience and operational decision-making at enterprise scale

We Make AI Reliable. You will set the technical direction and hold the delivery to account, without designing it yourself.

 Directing the design of AI-ready data foundations, platforms and semantic layers that provide trusted business context and reliable access to enterprise information, and holding your architects to account on those decisions Assuring agentic architectures - interrogating how agents interact with enterprise systems and people, where they fail, how failure is detected, and what the cost curve looks like at scale Establishing the governance, security, responsible AI and operational practices required to run AI in production under regulatory scrutiny

As part of your role, you will be expected to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 Business Development - Leading proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitches and Thought leadership that positions the organization at the forefront of modern Data & AI consulting. Internal contribution - Supporting practice development through offering development, recruitment, campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, operational excellence and capability building across Data, AI and Agentic AI. Learning & Development - Continuously developing your own expertise in emerging data and AI technologies and consulting leadership through training, certifications and applied innovation, while fostering a culture of continuous learning across the practice.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a T-shaped leader: broad enough to run an enterprise programme end to end, and deep enough in data and AI to be a genuine peer to the engineers and architects you lead. What matters most is your ability to connect business problems, regulatory constraints and technology into outcomes clients can actually operate.

The essential criteria below are what we screen against, and we expect candidates to meet all of them. The desirable experience that follows is genuinely a bonus - strong candidates will have several, and nobody has all of them. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and unless stated otherwise these criteria can be evidenced in any sector.

Essential criteria

 Programme leadership at scale. You have led complex, multi-workstream data or AI programmes with teams, and have been personally accountable for the outcome - not for a workstream within someone else’s programme. AI delivered into production, not just piloted. You can describe at least one AI or advanced analytics capability you took from concept into live operational use, including what went wrong along the way and how you dealt with it. Financial Services experience. Experience delivering for banking, insurance or capital markets clients, with a solid working understanding of how these businesses operate, what regulation means for them and what actually drives value. You can translate business requirements into delivery that produces measurable outcomes. Technical credibility. Sufficient hands-on background in data engineering, data platforms, machine learning or Generative AI to be a genuine peer to your architects and engineers. You should be able to explain, without notes, how a RAG architecture fails in production and what you would do about it. Team leadership. Experience leading and coaching consultants, engineers or architects within your programme, and building an inclusive, high-performing team culture people want to stay in. Consulting and commercial track record. Experience in a consulting or senior client-facing environment advising executive stakeholders and presenting to client governance boards, with a demonstrable record of originating and selling work.

Desirable experience

 Hands-on delivery experience with one or more major cloud and data platforms - Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP or Snowflake - and familiarity with the wider AI ecosystem including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google Experience designing semantic layers, data products or knowledge platforms that serve both analytics and AI consumers Experience shaping agentic architectures - how AI agents interact securely with enterprise systems, data platforms, business processes and human decision-makers Practical experience of responsible AI in production: model evaluation, lineage, monitoring, bias testing, privacy and risk frameworks Published thought leadership, conference speaking or a visible market profile in Data and AI

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

As a Senior Manager, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI and analytics innovation, contributing to cutting-edge projects that shape industries. Your leadership will make a tangible impact on clients’ digital transformations while advancing your own career in a collaborative and inspiring environment.

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page

This is a pivotal role supporting our O+O (Online & Offline) strategy, to deliver trusted performance intelligence that enables better decision-making across our business. As a Senior Reporting Analyst, you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive the adoption of data driven activity and support profitable customer and commercial growth. Working closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams and decision-makers across multiple functions, you will provide reporting, analysis and performance recommendations that influence strategic priorities and business outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to shape how data is used to unlock value, improve performance and accelerate growth in a fast-paced international retail environment, that shapes how millions of customers experience our brands so we can put a smile on our customers’ faces today and tomorrow.

What You’ll Be Doing

Create and maintain trusted reporting and performance dashboards that provide a clear, consistent view of customer, commercial and business performance across the organisation. Analyse complex datasets to uncover trends, opportunities and risks, translating insight into clear recommendations that support better business decisions. Partner with stakeholders across Group and Business Units to define, measure and align key performance indicators, ensuring performance is understood and acted upon consistently. Drive the adoption of self-service reporting and analytics tools, enabling teams to independently access reliable insights and make data-led decisions with confidence. Develop innovative reporting solutions using automation, AI and advanced analytics techniques to improve efficiency, scalability and the speed of insight generation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business challenges, identify information gaps and deliver reporting that supports customer and commercial growth. Continuously enhance reporting capabilities, data quality and user experience to strengthen performance visibility and maximise business impact. 

What You’ll Bring

Proven experience in data analytics, ideally within eCommerce, digital or retail environments, with a minimum of three years’ experience turning complex data into actionable business insights. Advanced expertise in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), alongside strong SQL skills and experience developing scalable reporting solutions using Power BI, Looker and Excel. A strong understanding of KPI governance, performance measurement frameworks and reporting standardisation within complex, multi-stakeholder organisations. Commercially minded with the ability to identify trends, forecast performance and uncover opportunities that drive customer growth and business performance. Excellent storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling insights tailored to different audiences. Demonstrated experience influencing senior stakeholders, building strong relationships across functions and driving the adoption of data-led decision-making. A proactive and curious mindset, with experience delivering reporting transformation, automation or analytics innovation initiatives that improve efficiency and business outcomes. 

How You Will Make An Impact

Empower colleagues across the business with trusted, accessible insights that enable faster, more confident decision-making and improve understanding of performance. Drive a culture of data-led decision-making by increasing trust in reporting, strengthening KPI alignment and helping teams focus on what matters most. Identify emerging opportunities and risks early, enabling the business to take proactive action that improves customer, commercial and operational outcomes. Champion innovation by identifying new ways to leverage automation, analytics and AI to improve insight generation, efficiency and scalability. Build strong relationships across functions, bringing people together around a shared understanding of performance and creating alignment behind key business priorities. Simplify complexity by turning data challenges into practical solutions that improve reporting quality, accelerate decision-making and enhance organisational effectiveness. Contribute to profitable growth by ensuring customer and commercial intelligence is translated into meaningful actions that deliver measurable business value.

rows.title: Senior Consultant - Data & AI Architecture
rows.descriptionText:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. Join our Data & AI Strategy team and be part of the future of AI consulting, where we’re not just advising clients, we’re actively disrupting traditional consulting models by embedding AI into every aspect of how we work.

We’re looking for changemakers with recent, hands-on experience in AI development, people who not only understand the technology but can connect it to the bigger picture. You’ll help our clients build, scale and embed AI capabilities across their organisations, driving transformation from strategy through to execution.

YOUR ROLE

This role sits at the forefront of AI-driven transformation, blending strategy, innovation, and delivery for those passionate about solving complex challenges. From Agentic AI in risk governance and AI sovereignty in enterprise architecture to shaping the autonomous, AI-augmented workforce of the future, you will operate at the cutting edge of intelligent enterprise evolution.

We DESIGN intelligent, agent-ready platforms – Architect and deliver scalable, secure, and cost-efficient data, analytics, and AI ecosystems that support both human and autonomous agent workloads, leveraging leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

We ENABLE agentic and hybrid cloud transformation – Modernise legacy systems into AI-native, agent-enabled architectures, integrating hybrid data platforms that support orchestration of intelligent agents and real-time decisioning.

We OPTIMISE and SECURE AI ecosystems – Continuously assess and enhance cloud environments to support trusted AI, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and robust governance. Embed responsible AI, security, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2), including identity, access, encryption, and data protection.

We INNOVATE with agent-driven solutions – Develop Proof of Concepts and MVPs that incorporate autonomous agents, advanced analytics, and AI capabilities, aligned to enterprise outcomes and measurable business value.

We AUTOMATE through intelligent systems – Build and orchestrate self-optimising data pipelines, infrastructure, and deployments using DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, and AI-assisted automation.

We DEFINE AI-first enterprise data strategy – Shape strategic vision and architecture roadmaps for AI-enabled enterprises, embedding agentic workflows, data foundations, and governance models that drive adoption and scale.

We DELIVER through human + AI design excellence – Champion user-centric and agent-centric design, combining storytelling with frameworks (TOGAF, DAMA) to create scalable, compliant, and intuitive data and AI solutions.

We SUPERCHARGE delivery with AI and agents – Leverage AI copilots, autonomous agents, and intelligent automation to accelerate delivery, enhance research, and continuously innovate across client engagements and internal initiatives.

Broader Contribution & Growth

Beyond client work, you will contribute to a continuously evolving AI-led organisation through:

Business development – Shaping AI-led propositions, proposals, and client engagements

Internal innovation – Driving thought leadership, agentic AI experimentation, and practice development

Learning & growth – Advancing skills in AI, agent frameworks, certifications, and emerging technologies

YOUR PROFILE

This role is part of a forward-looking Data & AI Strategy team, focused on shaping the future of AI consulting. It seeks curious, growth-oriented problem solvers who are passionate about AI and can drive both technical delivery and strategic transformation.

Core Strengths Required

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to stakeholders

Solid understanding of data and AI technologies

A learning mindset with interest in emerging technologies

Key Experience

Extensive years in cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), including hybrid/multi-cloud

Expertise in cloud-native technologies (containers, Kubernetes, serverless)

Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD automation

Proven consulting and stakeholder management capabilities

Desirable

Experience in sectors like UK Public Sector/BFSI/Telecom/Retail.

Cloud certifications, cost optimisation knowledge, and Agile delivery

Involvement in commercial/project scoping and security clearance eligibility

SC Eligible

Overall, the role targets professionals who can combine technical depth, consulting skills, and AI-driven thinking to deliver impactful, data-led transformation.

Our team drives business transformation by architecting next-generation data and AI platforms that reimagine enterprise operating models, unlock new value streams and embed AI into the core of business strategy.

We work across a wide range of industries, delivering outcomes that matter to society. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, innovate, and shape your own career path, supported by mentorship from leading experts in data and AI.

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page.
