We are seeking a self-motivated candidate with strong project management and audit execution skills, and effective communication and presentation abilities when engaging with senior management. In addition, this person should be able to multitask, collaborate beyond their immediate department, and influence organizational objectives or support the achievement of organizational goals.

rows.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability Management

rows.descriptionText:
Meta protects billions of people, and at our scale, vulnerabilities can't be managed by hand. As a Security Engineer on the Scaling – Vulnerability Management team, you'll build ML-based systems that automate how vulnerabilities are identified, triaged, and remediated across Meta's codebase. You'll design autonomous remediation pipelines and AI agents (like Viper and FixieAI) that cut through noise, surface real risk, and patch issues at a scale manual review can't reach — while building the supply-chain defenses (package mirrors, metadata services, and orchestration via VMMC) that keep automated upgrades safe. It's a chance to turn vulnerability management from a reactive queue into a proactive, automated defense.

Security Engineer - Vulnerability Management Responsibilities:

Design and build AI-powered autonomous remediation pipelines that detect and patch third-party library vulnerabilities across Meta's codebase, scaling from thousands to hundreds of thousands of packages.Develop ML-driven triage and contextualization agents (e.g., Viper Assist, FixieAI) that autonomously assess, prioritize, and suppress vulnerability tasks with high precision — compressing remediation queues down to real, actionable risk.Architect supply-chain defense systems, including time-locked package mirrors, quarantine mechanisms, and package decoration services that enrich dependency metadata for safer automated upgrades.Drive cross-functional strategy across security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, defining processes that enable multiple teams to operate at scale with automation.Identify and solve ambiguous, open-ended problems where the solution is not initially known — owning technically complex workstreams while enabling others to execute.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or relevant field (or equivalent experience)5+ years work experience securing enterprise-scale infrastructure software and services3-5+ years programming experience with at least one of the following languages: Python, PHP, Ruby, or similar scripting languagesExperience remediating infrastructure security gaps across broad corporate boundaries using influence and relationshipsExperience with security control automation/monitoring or “compliance as code” implementationsExperience thinking critically and defending solutions with communication skills in a cross-functional setting to influence decision makers across all levels of technical backgroundExperience identifying, triaging, and remediating software security vulnerabilities - including third-party/open-source dependency vulnerabilities across a large-scale codebase

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The Internal Audit team plans and executes audit projects in accordance with the audit plan and risk assessments, evaluating the efficiency and effectiveness of current-state financial, compliance, and operational processes and controls. We advise business functions in addressing risks and control violations, developing sound solutions, and tracking and reporting on the progress of process and compliance improvements.

This position is designed for an individual with a strong understanding of business and financial processes and controls, sound knowledge of the audit process, good analytical skills, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. We are seeking a self-motivated candidate with strong project management and audit execution skills, and effective communication and presentation abilities when engaging with senior management. In addition, this person should be able to multitask, collaborate beyond their immediate department, and influence organizational objectives or support the achievement of organizational goals.

This person is required to travel regularly (up to 30%) as part of the role, supporting audit activities across key regions including North America, APAC, EMEA, and LATAM.

Responsibilities:
- Lead and execute all phases of the audit lifecycle independently - from planning and fieldwork to reporting and follow-up.
- Identify operational and financial risks, control gaps and opportunities for process optimization and cost savings.

- Prepare clear, concise, and well-structured audit reports to senior management with a focus on business impact.
- Conduct effective reviews of audits and provide value-added comments to team members.
- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure timely remediation of audit findings.
- Contribute to continuous improvement of audit methodologies, templates, and best practices to improve audit quality and efficiency.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present audit findings clearly and influence process improvements.
- Ability to work independently in a dynamic, rapidly evolving environment with competing priorities. Required 30%-40% international and domestic travel.

rows.title: Production Systems Engineer, AI Network
rows.descriptionText:
Meta is seeking a Systems Engineer to join our Release to Production New Product Introduction (RTP-NPI) team working on AI/ML initiatives supporting large-scale AI training and inference. Our servers and data centers are the foundation upon which our rapidly scaling infrastructure operates efficiently to deliver our innovative services. The RTP team is responsible for the end-to-end hardware lifecycle of all Meta servers, including prototyping of experimental HW, pre-production hands-on system and hardware debugging and stress testing, enabling production-ready system monitoring, automated provisioning, and automated remediation of issues, ultimately certifying new platforms for mass production for AI at datacenter scale.RTP Engineers have a large swath of cross-functional partners they work closely with, e.g., HW/SW co-design teams, hardware designers, networking teams, system manufacturers, component vendors, capacity engineering, production engineering, production services, and data center operations teams to enable new systems that will be deployed in our production data centers.We are looking for a candidate who can support scale up and scale out network technologies for Meta AI systems that are powering Meta’s tremendous leaps in the AI space. The candidate should be knowledgeable about network technologies (NICs, Switches, Optics, DACs, Protocols TCP/IP, RDMA) and has hands-on experience supporting them through at least a couple of hardware/software (firmware, driver) lifecycle phases: design and bring-up, server integration, system validation, supporting customer deployment, production issue triage, rolling out new features in FW/Driver.

rows.title: Director, Intelligence & Insights
rows.descriptionText:
Meta is looking for an experienced communications leader to lead the Intelligence & Insights (I&I) function within the Communications & Public Affairs organization. I&I’s work underpins how the entire Comms organization understands its environment and measures its impact.The Director of I&I leads a global, multi-disciplinary team with members based in North America, EMEA and APAC, covering priority markets worldwide and the full range of company priority issues. The team's remit spans Intelligence (real-time flagging, longitudinal narrative tracking and news cycle analysis), Research (deep examination of strategic topics to equip leadership with insight), Messaging (disciplined deployment of research-backed narratives with target audiences) and Insights (analyzing how campaigns perform in driving business impact).This is a builder's role as much as a reporting one. The team does not simply produce recurring reports — it designs the tools, systems and processes that make reporting faster, sharper and more scalable, and it applies AI throughout its own workflows to compress turnaround times and create capacity for higher-judgment analytical work. We are looking for a leader who is energized by improving how the work gets done, not only by delivering the work itself.The role operates at the center of a demanding, high-tempo environment. The Director partners directly with senior company leadership and cross-functional partners across Communications, Public Affairs, Policy, Marketing, Legal and Data Science, and must be able to influence effectively upward, laterally and downward. Strong operational discipline is essential: much of the role is orchestrating a complex portfolio of recurring and ad hoc deliverables across time zones, sequencing competing requests, negotiating scope and timelines with senior stakeholders, and protecting the team's ability to do sustainable, high-quality work.

Director, Intelligence & Insights Responsibilities:

Lead and develop a global team of regional leads and analysts across North America, EMEA and APAC, spanning intelligence, research, messaging and insights.Own the strategic intelligence program for the Communications & Public Affairs organization, ensuring leadership has the intelligence it needs to make decisions.Direct the monitoring and reporting of coverage trends and narrative shifts across business priority areas and major company news cycles.Build new tools, systems and processes that advance the state of the practice in comms reporting and intelligence reporting — treating reporting infrastructure as a product to be improved, not a fixed set of deliverables.Embed AI into the team's workflows to accelerate production, expand analytical coverage and free capacity for higher-judgment workset the standard for responsible, well-reviewed use of AI outputs.Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and cross-functional partners, translating complex and often ambiguous information into clear, actionable recommendations.Manage the operational rhythm of a high-volume portfolio: intake and triage of requests, prioritization across competing demands, allocation of work across regions and time zones, and clear communication when scope or timelines need to change.Negotiate and set realistic expectations with senior stakeholders, including pushing back constructively on deadlines and scope where necessary to protect quality and team sustainability.Establish team norms, workload management practices and operating cadences that support strong morale, resilience and retention on a globally distributed team working across demanding news cycles.Represent I&I in cross-pillar and cross-functional planning, and partner with peer pillar leads on shared standards, measurement and roadmap priorities.

Minimum Qualifications:

5+ years of experience directly managing teams, including experience managing managers or regional leadsExperience building and running complex, insights-driven teams or functionsExperience leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zonesDemonstrated experience developing strategy or campaigns in the corporate, political or public affairs sectorWorking knowledge of a range of qualitative and quantitative research methodologiesExperience deploying and experimenting with technology and tooling for media tracking, monitoring, measurement and analysis, including AI-based toolsDemonstrated experience influencing and advising senior executive stakeholders, and working effectively across functions without direct authorityExperience managing a high-volume portfolio of deliverables with competing priorities, including prioritization, intake management and stakeholder negotiationProven written and verbal communication and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience building new measurement frameworks, reporting systems or internal tools from the ground upExperience applying AI or automation to redesign existing workflows, with demonstrable gains in speed, coverage or qualityExperience operating in a fast-moving, high-scrutiny environment such as a global technology company, major political campaign, or crisis communications settingExperience across more than one of intelligence, research, messaging and insights disciplinesExperience partnering with data science, engineering or analytics functions to build shared data and reporting infrastructureRegional or international market experience in EMEA and/or APAC

rows.title: Director, Intelligence & Insights

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Meta is looking for an experienced communications leader to lead the Intelligence & Insights (I&I) function within the Communications & Public Affairs organization. I&I’s work underpins how the entire Comms organization understands its environment and measures its impact.The Director of I&I leads a global, multi-disciplinary team with members based in North America, EMEA and APAC, covering priority markets worldwide and the full range of company priority issues. The team's remit spans Intelligence (real-time flagging, longitudinal narrative tracking and news cycle analysis), Research (deep examination of strategic topics to equip leadership with insight), Messaging (disciplined deployment of research-backed narratives with target audiences) and Insights (analyzing how campaigns perform in driving business impact).This is a builder's role as much as a reporting one. The team does not simply produce recurring reports — it designs the tools, systems and processes that make reporting faster, sharper and more scalable, and it applies AI throughout its own workflows to compress turnaround times and create capacity for higher-judgment analytical work. We are looking for a leader who is energized by improving how the work gets done, not only by delivering the work itself.The role operates at the center of a demanding, high-tempo environment. The Director partners directly with senior company leadership and cross-functional partners across Communications, Public Affairs, Policy, Marketing, Legal and Data Science, and must be able to influence effectively upward, laterally and downward. Strong operational discipline is essential: much of the role is orchestrating a complex portfolio of recurring and ad hoc deliverables across time zones, sequencing competing requests, negotiating scope and timelines with senior stakeholders, and protecting the team's ability to do sustainable, high-quality work.

Director, Intelligence & Insights Responsibilities:

Lead and develop a global team of regional leads and analysts across North America, EMEA and APAC, spanning intelligence, research, messaging and insights.Own the strategic intelligence program for the Communications & Public Affairs organization, ensuring leadership has the intelligence it needs to make decisions.Direct the monitoring and reporting of coverage trends and narrative shifts across business priority areas and major company news cycles.Build new tools, systems and processes that advance the state of the practice in comms reporting and intelligence reporting — treating reporting infrastructure as a product to be improved, not a fixed set of deliverables.Embed AI into the team's workflows to accelerate production, expand analytical coverage and free capacity for higher-judgment workset the standard for responsible, well-reviewed use of AI outputs.Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives and cross-functional partners, translating complex and often ambiguous information into clear, actionable recommendations.Manage the operational rhythm of a high-volume portfolio: intake and triage of requests, prioritization across competing demands, allocation of work across regions and time zones, and clear communication when scope or timelines need to change.Negotiate and set realistic expectations with senior stakeholders, including pushing back constructively on deadlines and scope where necessary to protect quality and team sustainability.Establish team norms, workload management practices and operating cadences that support strong morale, resilience and retention on a globally distributed team working across demanding news cycles.Represent I&I in cross-pillar and cross-functional planning, and partner with peer pillar leads on shared standards, measurement and roadmap priorities.

5+ years of experience directly managing teams, including experience managing managers or regional leadsExperience building and running complex, insights-driven teams or functionsExperience leading globally distributed teams across multiple regions and time zonesDemonstrated experience developing strategy or campaigns in the corporate, political or public affairs sectorWorking knowledge of a range of qualitative and quantitative research methodologiesExperience deploying and experimenting with technology and tooling for media tracking, monitoring, measurement and analysis, including AI-based toolsDemonstrated experience influencing and advising senior executive stakeholders, and working effectively across functions without direct authorityExperience managing a high-volume portfolio of deliverables with competing priorities, including prioritization, intake management and stakeholder negotiationProven written and verbal communication and presentation skills

rows.title: Content Moderation Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

The Review Operations team — a group within Snap’s Platform Integrity and Operations organization — focuses on moderating publicly facing content on Snapchat. It’s our job to keep each Snapchatter’s experience safe, whether that is engaging with a Snap on Spotlight, a creator on Discover or an advertisement served between friends Stories. Our team assesses broadly distributed content against our Recommendation Guidelines, Terms of Service, and Product-specific policies. Together, with our Product and Engineering counterparts, our Moderation team reinforces our Recommendation Guidelines across content types, every day. This team empowers Snapchatters to have safe, relevant and engaging experiences with content on Snapchat.

What you’ll do: Knowledge, skills and abilities:

Review content submissions to ensure they abide by our recommendation guidelines, community guidelines, and other product based requirementsDrive quality management activities and conduct regular quality auditsUse data and analytical tools/skills to identify and help drive solutions for new issues, trends and drive decision-making and management reportingDrive the development of policy guidance, tool/product updates, escalations pathways, operations improvement and quality controlProject manage key moderation and product initiatives with tight deadlines and shifting prioritiesServe as a consultative partner with vendor team on policy, quality and operational matters Advise Snap teams on current and trending content while taking into account the cultural and regional nuances

Excellent writing and verbal communication skillsGreat judgment and ability to problem-solve, both independently and with peersExperience with policy enforcement with a meticulous attention to detailExperience managing multiple projects and cross-functional stakeholdersExcellent data analytics skills to drive problem-solving, decision-making and reportingAbility to prioritize tasks and work independently with minimal oversightPassion for Snapchat, content, and online safety

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

rows.descriptionText:
Meta's Global Energy Team is seeking an energy professional to manage wholesale energy and capacity contracts throughout the transaction lifecycle—from execution through settlement and ongoing operational compliance. This role is critical to ensuring Meta's wholesale supply portfolio is actively managed, commercially optimized, and aligned with the company's growth, cost, and reliability objectives.In this role, you will be a key contributor on the Energy Portfolio Management team under Meta's Energy Infrastructure Strategy and Investments. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of wholesale energy and capacity agreements including: contract compliance and administration, financial and operational performance monitoring, settlement tracking, counterparty management, and coordination with Meta's market-participating affiliate and/or third-party portfolio managers. Minimum Qualifications:

rows.title: Security Engineer - Vulnerability Management
rows.descriptionText:
Meta protects billions of people, and at our scale, vulnerabilities can't be managed by hand. As a Security Engineer on the Scaling – Vulnerability Management team, you'll build ML-based systems that automate how vulnerabilities are identified, triaged, and remediated across Meta's codebase. You'll design autonomous remediation pipelines and AI agents (like Viper and FixieAI) that cut through noise, surface real risk, and patch issues at a scale manual review can't reach — while building the supply-chain defenses (package mirrors, metadata services, and orchestration via VMMC) that keep automated upgrades safe. It's a chance to turn vulnerability management from a reactive queue into a proactive, automated defense.

Security Engineer - Vulnerability Management Responsibilities:

Design and build AI-powered autonomous remediation pipelines that detect and patch third-party library vulnerabilities across Meta's codebase, scaling from thousands to hundreds of thousands of packages.Develop ML-driven triage and contextualization agents (e.g., Viper Assist, FixieAI) that autonomously assess, prioritize, and suppress vulnerability tasks with high precision — compressing remediation queues down to real, actionable risk.Architect supply-chain defense systems, including time-locked package mirrors, quarantine mechanisms, and package decoration services that enrich dependency metadata for safer automated upgrades.Drive cross-functional strategy across security, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, defining processes that enable multiple teams to operate at scale with automation.Identify and solve ambiguous, open-ended problems where the solution is not initially known — owning technically complex workstreams while enabling others to execute.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or relevant field (or equivalent experience)5+ years work experience securing enterprise-scale infrastructure software and services3-5+ years programming experience with at least one of the following languages: Python, PHP, Ruby, or similar scripting languagesExperience remediating infrastructure security gaps across broad corporate boundaries using influence and relationshipsExperience with security control automation/monitoring or “compliance as code” implementationsExperience thinking critically and defending solutions with communication skills in a cross-functional setting to influence decision makers across all levels of technical backgroundExperience identifying, triaging, and remediating software security vulnerabilities - including third-party/open-source dependency vulnerabilities across a large-scale codebase

Preferred Qualifications:

rows.title: GTM Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Marqeta is looking for a GTM Engineer to build and operate the systems that power our go-to-market motion. This is a hands-on, builder-first role centered on Clay, where you'll architect enrichment, scoring, and signal pipelines, then extend them with AI tooling and connect them into Apollo, Marketo, Salesforce, Demandbase, Gong, and the rest of our marketing technology stack.

Sitting within Marketing Operations, you'll work at the intersection of Marketing, Demand Generation, Sales, and RevOps turning GTM strategy into working infrastructure that helps our teams find, prioritize, and engage the right accounts faster, and continuously iterating on that infrastructure as our roadmap evolves. The ultimate goal is to find the most efficient and scalable methods for delivering pipeline to Marqeta.

We work Flexible First. This role can be performed remotely only in one of our National locations, which you can review here.

The Impact You'll Have

Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales, Demand Gen, Analytics, and RevOps to translate GTM strategy and campaign requests into scoped, buildable technical requirements, and troubleshoot issues as they ariseDesign and maintain multi-step Clay tables and workflows for lead and account enrichment, waterfall data sourcing, intent signals, scoring, and list buildingBuild agents that trigger sales and marketing actions off of signals, such as funding events, hiring changes, tech stack changes, intent data, and Gong call insightsBuild and maintain GTM workflows across PPC and ad platforms (LinkedIn, Demandbase Ads, Reddit, etc.), using Clay as an orchestration layer that moves accounts between platforms as they progress through funnel stages, optimizing spend and performance rather than treating enrichment and scoring as standalone stepsRun and continuously refine ABM motions against a defined target account list, including how those accounts are identified, scored, and targeted over timeOwn the ongoing health of existing workflows: monitor and QA for data quality and deliverability, improve process efficiency, and maintain documentation and version control (naming conventions, change logs, table architecture notes)Track outbound and sequence performance (reach, response, and pipeline influence) and use that data to iterate on scoring, targeting, and messaging logicEvaluate new AI tools and enrichment providers, and pilot integrations that improve the speed or accuracy of existing workflows

Who You Are

4+ years of experience in a GTM Engineer, RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Growth Engineering roleHands-on experience building in Clay, including Audience builds, Clay Ads, enrichment providers, formulas, and multi-step/chained workflowsPractical AI fluency: experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration and evaluation loops, with a track record of shipping AI-powered workflows for enrichment, research, and personalization at scaleExperience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce (or similar) and marketing automation platforms such as Marketo (or similar)Comfort with APIs, webhooks, and basic scripting or data transformation (JavaScript, Python, or JSON) to extend automations beyond native integrationsStrong data hygiene instincts and a systems-thinking mindset, able to spot a manual, repetitive GTM process and design an automated, end-to-end replacementStrong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams such as Analytics, Web, and Demand GenerationHands-on experience with intent data and signal-based / ABM go-to-market motions

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience with sales/GTM tools such as Apollo, Demandbase, Gong, or ChilipiperAnalytics or attribution tool experience (e.g., Looker, Tableau, or similar)Experience in fintech, payments, embedded finance, SaaS, or financial servicesExperience working in global markets (North America / Europe)

Compensation And Benefits

Marqeta calibrates pay to a competitive value according to working location. Compensation is aligned according to three tiers within the United States:

National: A baseline tier that applies to most of the geographic territory of the United States.Premium: Slightly elevated from the National tier, and oriented toward a narrower set of higher cost-of-living areas, such as Los Angeles CA and Seattle WAPremium Plus: A tier for the most expensive working areas, like the San Francisco Bay area and New York City.

Visit this page or consult with a recruiter to determine which tier would be applicable to you.

When determining salaries, we consider several factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior experience, and work location. The new-hire base salary range for this full-time position is:

National: $108,200 - $135,200

We also believe in recognizing the contributions of our people. That's why we award annual bonuses to eligible employees, rewarding both individual performance and the success of the entire company.

Along with monetary compensation, Marqeta currently offers

Multiple health insurance optionsFlexible time off – take what you needRetirement savings program with company contribution and after tax contributionsEquity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase ProgramFamily-forming benefits, fertility support and generous parental leave base salary top-upFree therapy sessions, financial and professional coaching, and legal adviceMonthly stipend to support our remote work modelAnnual “development dollars” to support our people growth and development

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

– Do What's Right: Knowing businesses and livelihoods depend on us, we pursue solutions that disrupt responsibly and deliver high-quality results that our customers count on. We own our work from start to finish.

– Simplify and Innovate: We approach challenges with curiosity and take smart risks. Innovation comes from finding better, simpler ways to achieve extraordinary outcomes.

– Win as a Team: We succeed together by embracing diverse perspectives and pushing each other to raise the bar. We lead with humility and set aside hierarchy to work as a team.

– Make it Count: We drive forward with focus and agility. With a sense of urgency and purpose, we get the job done, and done right.

Equal Employment Opportunity, Accommodations and Privacy

Marqeta is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), veteran status or uniformed service member status, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, genetic information (including testing or characteristics) or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please submit this form with your specific accommodation request.

rows.title: Senior Data Scientist, Home Lending
rows.descriptionText:
The Wealthfront Data Science Team utilizes our rich financial and behavioral data to influence key product and marketing decisions, as well as to safeguard our client’s information and assets. The team draws from backgrounds in Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, and Natural Sciences. We value analytical rigor, clear communication, and proactivity. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere and encourage Data Scientists to pursue self-directed explorations in search of business value. 
The Data Scientist in this role will be primarily embedded within Wealthfront’s new and quickly-growing Home Lending area. The vision of this area is to enable our clients to grow their wealth through leveraged home ownership.

Responsibilities

Build predictive models for potential purchasers or refinancers in our client base to enable efficient and targeted outreach

Analyze user behavior in web-based home lending tools and flows to identify patterns and optimize these experiences


Interpret and contextualize statistical results for business stakeholders and help translate numbers into recommendations



Expectations


Demonstrate a high degree of independence, proactivity, and curiosity - be the first to identify opportunities


Formulate project plans with clear rationale, candidate approaches and milestones


Communicate clearly and effectively with partners both within and outside the home lending area, through written documents, presentations, and in-person or video meetings


Identify key initiatives for the Home Lending area and champion the role of Data Science within these initiatives


Employ a high degree of mathematical rigor and best practices for software development.


Enhance overall Data Science team execution through hands-on help, design feedback and peer review




Depending on experience and interest, management of more junior Data Science team members.



Requirements


A Master's or a PhD degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics or Natural Sciences, with 6+ years of prior experience in a Data Science role. Exceptions to these requirements may be considered on a case-by-case basis. 


Strong communication and collaboration skills and a record of partnering across organizations to sharpen project requirements. Sometimes this includes re-framing the original request to solve a more general problem with similar effort. 


Hands-on mathematical and software engineering skills to execute on complex projects.


Proficiency in Python and SQL.


Desire and ability to mentor junior Data Scientists within the team by exemplifying math, engineering and technical communication skills.





Estimated annual salary range: $185,000 - $211,000 USD plus equity and a discretionary bonus.
 
Benefits include medical, vision, dental, 401K plan, generous time off, parental leave, wellness reimbursements, professional development, employee investing discount, and more!

About Wealthfront
 
Here at Wealthfront, our mission is to create a financial system that favors people, not institutions. We do this by leveraging technology to build powerful, low-cost, and easy-to-use financial products that help modern investors grow and manage their money.
 
We started with the ambition to transform the investment advisory business. rows.title: Director, Category Management, Hims
rows.descriptionText:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About The Role

We’re looking for a Director, Category Management to own the initiatives that decide whether a Hims category wins — the biggest levers on the P&L across acquisition, retention, and new-treatment launches. You’ll be the strategic lead on these end-to-end, with growth and ops partners behind you and a clear runway to grow into a GM running your own category.

Hims isn’t a set of one-time transactions; it’s a healthcare platform where value compounds through retention and cross-category adoption. You’ll be measured on the long-term, multi-specialty value your customers generate on platform — not just on acquisition – and your ability to prioritize initiatives across all roadmaps.

You’ll lead across clinical, pharmacy, regulatory, product, growth, analytics, and operations, bringing the rigor to defend every decision on the numbers and the speed to ship, learn, and iterate. Reports to the General Manager, Hims. Partners with the GMs and Directors across the Hims & Hers portfolio, and is supported by the Sr. Managers on Category Strategy & Analysis.

You Will

Own the Category’s Biggest Levers

Take end-to-end ownership of the initiatives that move the P&L most — across acquisition, retention, conversion, and new-treatment launches — from strategy through execution to results.Own the unit economics behind them: CAC, LTV, ARPU, submit-to-subscriber (S2S), and contribution margin.Run your initiatives as a portfolio — frame the opportunity, score trade-offs (impact vs. effort, must-have vs. nice-to-have), sequence the roadmap, and bring a clear recommendation on what gets built and when.

Drive Growth & Retention

Partner with growth and lifecycle teams to lift acquisition, S2S conversion, and retention across the funnel.Shape the tech product roadmap with product and engineering — prioritize the funnel, personalization, and experience investments that move conversion and retention, and hold the roadmap accountable to category outcomes.Turn single-treatment buyers into multi-specialty members through cross-sell and long-term engagement.Build pricing, bundling, and merchandising strategies that protect margin and LTV.

Launch & Scale New Treatments

Own the treatment development roadmap for your categories — identify, prioritize, and sequence new treatments, SKUs, form factors, and programs, from business case to forecast to go-live.Work with clinical, pharmacy, and regulatory teams to bring therapies to market safely and fast.Build repeatable launch playbooks, not one-off fixes.

Own The Customer Experience

Deliver an end-to-end experience that is premium, empathetic, and destigmatizing — clinical rigor without clinical coldness, in categories where stigma is often the biggest barrier to care.Pressure-test the journey as a customer would, from first touch through fulfillment and ongoing care.Pair qualitative insight with hard data to close experience gaps.

Lead Cross-Functional Execution

Be the go-to leader for your initiatives, aligning clinical, regulatory, product, growth, analytics, pharmacy, and operations.Keep the product and treatment roadmaps reconciled in one prioritized plan; set clear priorities and success criteria, and keep partners moving even when they don’t fully agree.Direct the growth-ops and analytics resources behind you; act as a thought partner to the Sr. Managers supporting your work.

Manage Performance

Own the scorecard for your initiatives — revenue, contribution margin, retention/churn, S2S, ARPU, treatment adoption.Set KPIs and success criteria for everything you run; report performance in business reviews.

You Have

7+ years in category management, strategy & operations, general management, or a related role with real business accountability — ideally in a high-growth, cross-functional environment.A track record of owning high-stakes initiatives or a P&L and driving them to measurable revenue, margin, or retention outcomes.Demonstrated success launching and scaling new products or programs, 0-to-1 and at scale.Experience managing a portfolio and roadmap — prioritizing across competing bets, sequencing investment against a clear thesis, and saying no with a rationale.Sharp analytical and financial fluency — you build and defend models, and you make the call when data is thin.Cross-functional leadership that aligns clinical, product, growth, and operations behind one plan.Bias to action: MVP, learn, iterate — over over-engineering.The ambition and range to grow into a GM role owning a category outright.Bachelor’s degree. MBA, management consulting, or top-tier tech (marketplace, on-demand, consumer platform) background preferred.

Bonus If You Have

DTC, telehealth, or consumer health experience — men’s health a plus.Regulated healthcare products, pharmacy operations, or compounding.People management.Looker / Amplitude fluency.

Why This Role Matters

Hims is where this company started — and Sexual Health, Testosterone, and Hair remain some of its biggest engines. That value is created across categories — through retention and cross-sell — and it comes down to a handful of initiatives being run exceptionally well, on roadmaps that hold up. You’ll own those initiatives, move the P&L, and prove you can build. For the right person, this is the on-ramp to GM: master the biggest levers in a category, then go run one of your own.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time rolesUnlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health daysComprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leaveEmployee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)401k benefits with employer matching contributionOffsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we’ve tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly has moved $100B+ helping families send money across borders. That built a world-class payout network, rails, licenses, and trust at consumer scale. Remitly Business puts all of it to work for the millions of small businesses paying contractors, suppliers, and staff internationally & and we're hiring the Principal Product Manager who'll own the core of it.

Businesses run real payables through us every cycle, and the acquisition motion works. This role owns depth: whether they come back, what share of their payables moves through us, and how much of the finance workflow they do elsewhere we take over. Revenue and profit per business customer is how that lands on the P&L. You'll carry it.

The workflow layer is where the next several years of this product get built — batch, scheduled, and recurring payments, recipient management, approvals, reconciliation, export, and the integrations into the tools businesses already use to move money.

The hard part isn't building workflows. It's that "small business" isn't one customer. A twelve-person construction firm paying subcontractors and a forty-person agency paying overseas designers have different cycles, different approval chains, and different reasons to trust you with a payment. Depth arrives in layers, and the workflow that retains one segment barely registers for another. You'll decide which layers generalize, which are segment-specific, and which aren't ours to build.

You'll report to the VP/GM of Remitly Business and work with them daily; your strategy will be read and questioned by the CEO. It's an individual contributor role with no direct reports and unusual scope - a self-contained team with the distribution, balance sheet, and payout network of a public company behind it. Like every leader here, you'll raise the bar around you.

We're looking for builders who find the problem before anyone hands it to them: your own customer relationships, your own data cuts, your own opportunities, and accountability long after launch.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3+ days per week in the Remitly Seattle headquarters.

You Will:

Own retention and depth for Remitly Business. You'll be accountable for whether businesses come back, what share of their payables runs through us, and how much of their finance workflow we take over — and you'll carry revenue per business customer.Hold a point of view on what actually deepens customer behavior, and refresh it as the product matures. You'll sharpen it with your own customer texture, your own data, and your own read of the market.Own the payment workflows businesses run every cycle: batch, scheduled, and recurring payments, recipient management, approvals, reconciliation, and export.Own the trust layer. Sending money to a supplier abroad is a moment of real exposure for a business owner, and you'll decide what we build to make confidence visible at exactly those moments.Open new surfaces. Identify the adjacencies worth entering — including integrations into the tools businesses already use to move money — size them honestly against the core, and either kill them early or take them to launch.Pull your own data, with a team of analytics experts alongside you. Analytics is a partner here, not a dependency you wait on.Design inside risk, compliance, and regulatory constraints rather than around them. You'll sit with Legal, Risk, and Compliance early and come out with a product that ships.

Twelve months in, success looks like a materially higher share of each customer's payables moving through Remitly, better retention in the cohorts you chose to go after, and new workflow surfaces live and adopted.

You Have:

Required

8+ years in product management, including at least 3 years owning a product area from strategy through launch and through whatever happened after.A retention, repeat, or expansion number you've moved yourself, and the detail to back it up. We'll ask what you cut and what you got wrong, not only what you shipped.Experience building a new product surface inside a working business. Not only a zero-to-one launch, and not only optimizing something mature — you've had real customers and real revenue on one side of you and an undefined product area on the other, and you shipped into that.Evidence that you can find the problem before anyone hands it to you. You've gone and talked to customers no one asked you to talk to, cut the data yourself, and come back with an opportunity the team hadn't seen.Real data fluency. You don't need to write SQL, but you build your own funnel and cohort cuts — with AI tooling or otherwise — and you can tell the difference between a signal and an artifact of how the cohort was defined.Experience shipping inside regulatory or risk constraints, in fintech, payments, or something comparable. You know how to keep velocity in a risk-based environment.

Preferred

Experience building for small businesses that pay people — payments, AP, payroll, contractor payments, invoicing, banking, or expense. This is the fastest ramp, and we weigh it.A consumer product run at scale, if you're deliberately moving to B2B. We're interested, provided you're genuinely curious about how a twelve-person business actually operates.Experience with products serving a heterogeneous customer base, where the same feature lands differently across segments and the roadmap has to account for that.

This Role Isn't For You If:

You need the problem defined before you'll commit to a direction, or you measure yourself by what shipped rather than what moved. It's also not for you if you want the clean version of a zero-to-one — this one comes with existing customers, existing revenue, and a working motion you can't break while you build. And if "small business" is one persona rather than a dozen, the layered nature of this problem will not interest you.

In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

Flexible paid time offHealth, dental, and vision + 401k plan with company matchingPaid parental, medical, military and family care leaveMental Health & Family Forming BenefitsEmployee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)Continuing education benefits

rows.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Strava

Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the growing AI and Machine Learning team at Strava. This team is responsible for sophisticated machine learning models and systems which provide value to Strava athletes including personalization, recommendations, search, and trust and safety. The team also maintains the ML platform and infrastructure that enables our team to iterate on models quickly and deploy them reliably at scale.

This is an important role in the ML team and across Product teams designing, roadmapping, and implementing innovative machine learning algorithms. We value full stack ML engineers who are able to work on all parts of an ML pipeline from model building, evaluation, optimizing performance, and ensuring the scalability and reliability of these production models. We also seek those who can improve the systems and tools behind the ML pipeline to further empower the team.

We follow a flexible hybrid model that translates to more than half your time on-site in our San Francisco Office — three days per week.

What You’ll Do:

Build for a Well Loved Consumer Product: Work at the intersection of AI and fitness to launch and optimize product experiences that will be used by tens of millions of active people worldwideOwn End to End AI Systems: Drive key projects powered by ML on the Strava platform end-to-end, from initial model prototyping to shipping production code to scaling and optimizing inference and deploymentShape AI at Strava: Be a strong voice on a highly collaborative team with a range of experience levels. Work across teams to deploy ML solutions in multiple surfaces and build out our technical ML capabilities. Innovate in AI for Fitness: Design and develop novel models and methodologies to take on novel problems that improve athlete experience, including recommendation systems, activity prediction, and personalized insights. Build from a rich dataset: Explore and use Strava’s extensive unique fitness and geo datasets from millions of users to extract actionable insights, inform product decisions, and optimize existing features

You Will Be Successful Here By:

Driving innovation with Product in mind: Stay up-to-date with the latest research in machine learning, AI, and related fields. Experiment, advocate and get buy-in for innovative techniques to improve existing products or explore new features that result in step function changes to how we build AI at Strava. Leading as an Owner: Owning your work end-to-end and being accountable for the outcomes in the projects you drive and landing impact for the business. Ensure the end-to-end system delivers as expected through collaboration with partners. Analyzing the Data: Work closely with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to find opportunities for applying machine learning to drive business impact and enhance Strava’s features and measure impact. Collaborating in and across teams: Build relationships, advocate, and communicate with cross-functional partners and product verticals to identify opportunities and bring your technical vision to life. Raising the ML standard: Help work towards best practices for model development, deployment, and maintenance. Being passionate about the work you are doing and contributing positively to Strava’s inclusive and collaborative team culture and values

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

Have worked on numerous machine learning problems and broken them down into incremental tasks. Have demonstrated solid interpersonal and communication skills, and collaborative approach to drive business impact across teams. Have experience building, shipping, and supporting ML models in production at scale. Have experience with exploratory data analysis and model prototyping, using languages such as Python or R and tools like Scikit learn, Pandas, Numpy, Pytorch, Tensorflow, and Sagemaker. Have built and worked on data pipelines using large scale data technologies (like Spark, Hadoop, EMR, SQL, and Snowflake). Are experienced and interested in production ML model operational excellence and best practices, like automated model retraining, performance monitoring, feature logging, and A/B testing. Have built backend production services on cloud environments like AWS, using languages like (but not limited to) Python, Ruby, Java, Scala, and Go. 

For information on benefits, please click here.

Why Join Us?

Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.

Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.

When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.

Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together.

Our scope spans the high-value send experience, customer growth, and new product workstreams such as wealth building. We partner closely with Core Transfer Experience and shared platform teams to turn complex financial journeys into clear, dependable experiences.

The Role

As Principal Engineer for High Value Senders, you will own technology strategy and architecture across the HVS domain. You will partner with engineering, product, design, marketing and analytics to define how we earn customer trust on their most consequential transfers. You will solve the domain’s hardest technical problems, shape how systems are divided and owned across teams, and align decisions with Remitly’s long-term architecture and business goals.

This full-stack role spans customer-facing web and mobile experiences, backend systems, and deep partnership with foundational teams across identity and trust, money movement, pricing, and Core Transfer Experience. You will turn ambiguous, greenfield opportunities into new products while evolving shared systems safely. You will remain hands-on through system analysis, meaningful code contributions, and reviews, applying your expertise where it most increases the organization’s impact. Your success will include stronger technical leaders, more autonomous teams, and durable improvements in customer trust and engineering effectiveness.

Help customers move money for life’s most significant moments. Build new products and the technical foundations that make every high-value transfer feel clear, dependable, and worthy of their trust.

Build New Products and Lead AI Adoption

Create new HVS propositions. Enable teams to test and launch 0-to-1 experiences with measurable customer outcomes, extensible foundations and safe rollout controls.Operate AI-natively and evaluate emerging capabilities for step-change improvements in customer experience and software delivery. Turn effective approaches into repeatable domain practices and reflect demonstrated gains in delivery and capacity planning.Establish domain-level AI accountability: appropriate use boundaries, evaluation methods, and review standards for correctness, security, and maintainability. Build these practices into technical design, code, testing, and delivery workflows.

Set Technical Vision and Strategy for High Value Senders

Own HVS technology strategy and architecture, connecting core experiences, customer growth, and emerging propositions. Use customer signals, product judgment, and data to guide investments and technical decisions.Connect technical strategy to business outcomes, including transfer success, conversion, retention, and cost to serve. Advise leadership on roadmap priorities, technical risks, talent needs, and investment trade-offs.Lead domain-level design reviews that align with Remitly’s long-term architecture. Make expected business value, ownership, dependencies, and critical trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical leaders.

Build the Foundations for High Value Transfers

Define architecture across web, mobile, and backend services for high-value transfer journeys. Segment systems and ownership so teams can build independently while delivering a coherent customer experience.Partner with identity and trust, money movement, pricing, and Core Transfer Experience teams to resolve shared architecture and ownership questions. Decide where to extend existing foundations and where new capabilities are needed.Solve the domain’s hardest architectural problems, including persistent bottlenecks, excessive dependencies, and scaling limits. Balance speed, maintainability, and technology viability through incremental launches and migrations.

Make Customer Trust an Engineering Standard

Establish and refine reliability, security, privacy, and quality standards with functional experts. Drive consistent testing, observability, deployment, and maintenance practices across HVS, supported by clear availability and latency SLOs.Design resilient integrations and recovery paths for asynchronous financial workflows. Make transaction state, retries, and failure handling explicit so customers and support teams can understand what happens next.Make clear pricing, accurate status, and secure handling of customer data architectural requirements. Address root causes of operational failures and mitigate risks to systems’ ability to scale and support new business needs.

Multiply the Engineering Organization

Proactively mentor staff and senior engineers and raise the quality of technical leadership across HVS. Advise on team boundaries and ownership models that improve autonomy and productivity.Stay close to the code through deep system analysis, meaningful reviews, prototypes, and production contributions. Apply hands-on expertise where it resolves critical needs and sets direction for the domain.Build relationships across engineering and product leadership to resolve cross-org problems. Recognize stalled decisions, surface competing constraints, and drive timely alignment and delivery.

You Have:

12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time designing and operating large-scale, customer-facing distributed systems.Deep backend expertise in languages such as Java, Kotlin, Go, or Python, plus experience shaping customer-facing web and mobile systems with technologies such as TypeScript, React, or native mobile frameworks.Advanced distributed-systems design expertise, including cloud infrastructure, safe architecture evolution, and resolving root causes of scaling, latency, data-quality, or dependency problems in production.A track record of setting domain-level technical strategy, leading large-system design reviews, and segmenting architecture and ownership to enable autonomous teams. Experience informing organizational design and growing technical leaders.Experience establishing engineering and operational standards across teams, with sound judgment about reliability, security, privacy, maintainability, and the business risks of technical decisions.Strong customer and product judgment. Proven ability to resolve ambiguous cross-org problems, influence roadmaps and investment decisions, and connect technical proposals to business outcomes for technical and non-technical leaders.Hands-on use of AI in software delivery and experience scaling effective practices beyond your own work, including validation, review standards, and evaluating gains in speed, quality, or efficiency.

rows.title: Senior Financial Analyst, Ops Finance
rows.descriptionText:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About The Role

Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Senior Financial Analyst supporting Operations. This role will be the primary finance partner for pharmaceutical manufacturing costs, packaging, and R&D. They will work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, and R&D leadership to drive cost transparency, margin insights, and disciplined investment decisions. The business is scaling rapidly, creating constant opportunities to improve processes and rethink how work gets done. This is not a purely reporting-focused FP&A role, many of the problems this role will tackle will not have predefined frameworks or clean data. The right candidate is extremely curious, learns fast, collaborates well, and is energized by problem solving and driving decisions in a fast-moving environment. rows.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager - Remitly Business
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

At Remitly, we believe everyone deserves the freedom to access, move, and manage their money wherever life takes them. Since 2011, we've tirelessly delivered on our promise to customers sending money globally, providing secure, simple, and reliable ways to manage their money, ensuring true peace of mind. Whether it's supporting loved ones back home, growing a business across continents, or pursuing new opportunities abroad, we're not just here to move money— we're here to move our global customers forward.

We're looking for builders, reimaginers, and global thinkers who want to work at the intersection of technology, trust, and transformation. If that's you and you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career—we invite you to join over 2,800 passionate Remitlians worldwide who are united by our vision to transform lives with trusted financial services that transcend borders.

About the Role:

Remitly has moved $100B+ helping families send money across borders. Now we're doing the same for small and medium-sized businesses, and that starts with winning new customers, one signup at a time. That's where you come in: you'll own the two numbers that make it happen, Paid NCAs and CAC. We need someone who has built and scaled paid media engines before, and who's at home in a high-velocity, data-driven, digital marketing ecosystem.

You won't just set the strategy and step back — you'll decide where and how we invest, plan the campaigns, and run point on the results. You'll report to the Head of Marketing as the senior marketing leader managing $XX million in paid budget, deploying campaigns across the US, Canada, UK, and EU. If you want the authority and the mandate to build paid end to end, this is it.

What matters most isn't where you've worked — it's how you operate: with the rigor and platform depth to run multiple high-stakes accounts, and the instinct to own the outcome rather than hand it off. You'll carry the number, not the client.

This is a hybrid role requiring 3+ days per week in the Remitly Seattle headquarters.

You Will:

Own the Paid new customer acquisition (NCA) outcomes and target for Remitly Business. The paid NCA number is the business's primary acquisition metric.Own the budget and spend decisions impacting Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC). Manage CAC efficiency across channels with full budget authority and reallocation rights.Own the agency relationship end to end: briefing, weekly paid marketing metrics reviews, monthly and quarterly planning, roadmap alignment, and contract accountability. Hold the agency to output standards, not effort.Run campaigns hands-on across Meta and Google Ads with agency support: campaign architecture, bid strategy, audience segmentation, creative testing, and optimization.Expand into incremental channels (LinkedIn, programmatic, affiliate, influencer-led performance) based on CAC signals, not speculation.Drive experimentation: brief the creative team, run structured A/B tests, and feed winning signals back into production.Own the adtech roadmap for Remitly Business. Work directly with engineers and PMs to scope and ship integrations. Define and maintain the measurement infrastructure: pixel implementation, conversion tracking, UTM governance, and data pipeline integrity. You are the last line of defense on attribution accuracy.Lead incrementality testing, match market testing, and mixed media modeling with the Analytics team. Have the judgment and experience to make high-quality investment decisions, even when attribution is imperfect.

You Have:

8+ years in performance or growth marketing, with at least 3 years hands-on managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns at meaningful scale.An acquisition target and CAC number you've directly owned, with the data to back up how you moved it at scale.Experience owning an ongoing agency metrics and performance review — you've set the agenda, held the agency to outcomes, and made the call when the relationship needed to change.Deep fluency with paid social and paid search bidding strategies: Smart Bidding, Advantage+, custom audiences, lookalikes, exclusion logic, and the tradeoffs between automation and control.Hands-on experience with measurement infrastructure: conversion tracking, attribution modeling, incrementality testing, and the ability to QA your own data pipeline.Direct adtech experience — evaluating, onboarding, and managing vendors (DSPs, CDPs, creative intelligence platforms). You know what earns a place in the stack and what doesn't.

Compensation Details. The starting base salary range for this position is typically $152,000-$190,000. In the U.S., Remitly employees are shareholders in our Company and equity is part of our total compensation plan. Your recruiter can share more information about medical benefits offered, as well as other financial benefits and total compensation components offered with this role.

At Remitly, we believe that true innovation sparks when we come together. Our Connected Work Culture fosters dynamic in-person collaboration, where ideas ignite and challenging problems find solutions faster.

rows.title: Senior Edge Signal Processing Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Senior Edge Signal Processing Engineer to join the Sensor Intelligence Group (SIG), a cross-functional team collaborating across WHOOP Labs, Firmware, and Machine Learning and Research. This role is central to developing next-generation sensor processing to enable foundational health features at WHOOP. You’ll develop the edge signal processing underpinning WHOOP physiological insights and coaching, ultimately delivering meaningful and personalized feedback to millions of members.

Responsibilities

Lead the design and development of real-time signal processing and edge inference for consumer productsOwn the full development lifecycle, from prototyping and validation through productization and continuous improvementEvaluate commercial solutions, develop prototypes and demos, and inform build/buy decisionsCollaborate cross-functionally with hardware, software, and product teams to bring algorithms to WHOOP membersMentor junior engineers and contribute to a high-performance, research-to-production culture

Qualifications

B.S. in Electrical Engineering or related field, M.S. or PhD preferred5+ years of experience developing and deploying real-time sensor signal processing algorithms (physiological, audio, motion, or related modalities)Strong foundation in signal processing fundamentals (e.g., filtering, spectral analysis, time-frequency methods)Demonstrated experience integrating signal-processing components into end-to-end embedded systemsAbility to implement and optimize signal-processing algorithms for constrained compute, memory, latency, and power budgetsExperience integrating third-party libraries, frameworks, or algorithm IPProficiency in Python or MATLAB for algorithm prototyping and with C/C++ for deployment to embedded product platformsExcellent communication skills, including the ability to present technical results to a diverse audienceDemonstrated creativity, adaptability, and a strong interest in translating prototypes into products

Additional Desired Experience

Experience deploying signal processing algorithms to battery-powered consumer product platformsFamiliarity with adaptive signal processing, multi-sensor processing, signal enhancement, detection, or classification techniquesExperience developing and evaluating hybrid DSP/ML systemsFamiliarity with embedded firmware, RTOS environments, and real-time processing pipelinesExperience using optimized MCU/DSP libraries and acceleration frameworks (e.g., CMSIS-DSP, CMSIS-NN, or vendor-specific libraries)Experience with fixed-point implementation, quantization, or other numerical optimization techniques for embedded signal processing
