rows.title: Assistant General Counsel, Litigation
rows.descriptionText:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

The WHOOP legal team plays a critical role in supporting that mission by enabling the business to move quickly and responsibly around the world. We are rigorous but pragmatic, risk-aware rather than risk-averse, calm under pressure, excellent communicators, and deeply committed to being trusted partners to the business.

WHOOP is hiring an Assistant General Counsel, Litigation to oversee and manage litigation and regulatory enforcement matters. In this role, you will report to the Chief Legal Officer (CLO) and, in conjunction with the CLO, be responsible for developing and implementing litigation and regulatory enforcement strategy. The successful candidate must be comfortable managing all manner of litigation, including commercial disputes, consumer class actions, intellectual property matters, employment disputes, and investigations by federal, state, and international regulatory bodies.

WHOOP is a rapidly scaling, global business built upon a dynamic consumer brand that involves hardware, software, and healthcare. Accordingly, this role will be engaged with an extraordinarily broad array of legal areas. The successful candidate will be a seasoned litigator who possesses the first-hand experience and judgment necessary to assess litigation and regulatory risks and opportunities, hire and manage the outside counsel representing WHOOP, and ensure WHOOP receives the highest quality representation from its law firm partners.

In addition to managing the litigation docket, you will serve as a strategic counselor to all business and corporate functions regarding legal risk and opportunity. The successful candidate will be more than an experienced litigator. They will be a business-minded litigation leader who knows when to fight, when to settle, and when litigation risk should drive changes in the business.

Responsibilities

Own the Company's litigation portfolio, with responsibility for the strategy, oversight, and resolution of lawsuits, arbitrations, pre-litigation disputes, and other contested matters involving the Company, independently driving matters while exercising sound judgment as to when legal, business, or reputational risks warrant escalation.Develop litigation strategy for significant matters, including evaluating claims and defenses, determining strategic objectives, identifying key decision points, and recommending litigation and settlement positions.Provide senior leadership with clear and actionable assessments of litigation risk, including exposure, ranges of potential outcomes, strategic alternatives, costs, business implications, and recommended courses of action.Select, retain, and manage outside counsel, establishing clear expectations regarding strategy, staffing, budgets, work product, responsiveness, and outcomes, and independently pressure-testing outside counsel’s strategic recommendations throughout the entire litigation life-cycle.Exercise rigorous oversight of litigation spending, including reviewing budgets and forecasts, scrutinizing staffing and billing practices, identifying opportunities for alternative fee arrangements, and ensuring that legal spending is proportionate to the Company's exposure and strategic objectives.Develop settlement strategies and lead significant settlement negotiations, balancing legal exposure, litigation costs, business considerations, precedent risk, reputational considerations, and operational impacts.Partner closely with Finance and Accounting regarding litigation reserves, contingent liabilities, insurance recoveries, settlement accounting, budgeting and forecasting, and other financial implications of litigation.Partner closely with the People Team regarding employment disputes.Manage litigation-related insurance matters, including providing timely notice of claims, coordinating with insurers and brokers, pursuing available coverage, and managing coverage disputes where necessary.Oversee discovery and evidence-preservation obligations, including litigation holds, document collection and review, information governance, e-discovery strategy, privilege issues, and the use of technology and outside vendors to manage discovery efficiently.Conduct and oversee sensitive internal investigations where appropriate and coordinate with employment, compliance, privacy, security, or other specialists depending on the subject matter.Establish and continuously improve litigation playbooks, processes, and technology, enabling the Legal team to manage a growing litigation portfolio efficiently and consistently as the Company scales.Promote appropriate use of data and technology in litigation management, including e-discovery tools, matter-management systems, litigation analytics, and emerging AI-enabled legal technologies.

Qualifications

J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar.7+ years of relevant legal experience, including experience at a nationally recognized law firm and/or an in-house legal department managing litigation.Experience as the lead or managing attorney on complex litigation. Strong command of litigation strategy and procedure, including discovery, dispositive motions, expert practice, mediation, trial preparation, settlement negotiations, and appeals.Demonstrated ability to balance legal risk with practical business considerations and deliver actionable advice in a fast-paced environment.Ability to translate complicated legal issues into concise, practical advice for senior executives and business leaders.Experience in building and improving legal processes, playbooks, and operational infrastructure to support a scaling business.Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across cross-functional teams.Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.Experience supporting technology, consumer products, healthcare, or subscription-based businesses is strongly preferred.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office.

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $220,000 to $250,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training.

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

rows.title: Market Analyst - Power Trading Analytics
rows.descriptionText:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.

For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.

Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.

By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

WoodMac.com

Wood Mackenzie Brand Video

Wood Mackenzie Values

Inclusive – we succeed togetherTrusting – we choose to trust each otherCustomer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisionsFuture Focused – we accelerate changeCurious – we turn knowledge into action

The Role

We are seeking a full-time Power Market Analyst to join Wood Mackenzie’s Power & Renewables team, focusing on the development and application of advanced power market models across European electricity markets.

As a Power Market Analyst, you will play a key role in building, maintaining, and enhancing market optimization models used to analyse power systems, generation economics, transmission constraints, and market outcomes. You will apply linear programming (LP) and other optimization techniques to simulate market behaviour, assess investment and operational decisions, and provide actionable insights on power market dynamics, decarbonization pathways, and energy transition challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and enhance optimization-based power market models for European electricity markets.Design and implement LP and mixed-integer optimization models to simulate generation dispatch, storage operation, cross-border trading, and market-clearing mechanisms.Analyse power market fundamentals, including supply-demand dynamics, renewable integration, fuel markets, emissions costs, and transmission constraints.Conduct scenario analysis to evaluate market outcomes, asset profitability, policy impacts, and energy transition pathways.Translate complex model outputs into clear market insights and recommendations for internal stakeholders and clients.Improve model methodologies, assumptions, and analytical frameworks to enhance model accuracy, transparency, and performance.Work with large datasets and develop efficient data workflows to support model development and analysis.Collaborate with experts across power markets, renewable energy, economics, and policy to deliver high-quality research and market intelligence.Monitor developments in European energy markets, regulatory frameworks, and market design, assessing their impact on market participants and investment decisions.Support client engagements through presentations, bespoke analyses, technical discussions, and thought leadership.

About You

We are looking for a highly analytical and intellectually curious individual with a strong foundation in optimization, quantitative modelling, and power market analysis. You enjoy solving complex problems, building robust models, and generating insights that support strategic decision-making.

Essential Skills And Qualifications

A degree in Operations Research, Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Economics, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.Experience in electricity market analysis, power system modeling, or energy economics.Strong knowledge of optimization techniques, particularly linear programming (LP) and mixed-integer programming (MIP).Experience developing and implementing mathematical models for power systems, generation portfolios, storage assets, or electricity markets.Proficiency in Python and/or other programming languages used for optimization and quantitative analysis.Experience with optimization frameworks and solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX, Xpress, Pyomo, or similar tools.Strong understanding of European power market fundamentals, market design, and price formation mechanisms.Ability to analyze complex datasets and communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and commercial audiences.Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Why Join Us?

At Wood Mackenzie, you will work on industry-leading power market models that help clients navigate rapidly changing energy markets and the transition to a low-carbon economy. You will collaborate with leading analysts, modelers, and industry experts to solve complex challenges facing power systems, renewable integration, energy storage, and electricity market design.

This role offers an opportunity to apply cutting-edge optimization techniques and market analysis to inform investment decisions, support policy evaluation, and shape the future of the energy sector.

Equal Opportunities

We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

rows.title: Senior HR Business Partner
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Stats Perform is the market leader in sports tech.  We provide the most trusted sports data to some of the world's biggest organizations, across sports, media, and broadcasting.  

Through the latest AI technologies and machine learning, we combine decades' worth of data with the latest in-game happenings. We then offer coaches, teams, professional bodies, and media channels around the world, access to the very best data, content, and insights.  In turn, improving how sports fans interact with their favorite sports teams and competitions.

How do we add value?

Media outlets add a little magic to their coverage with our stats and graphics packages.Sports books can offer better predictions and more accurate odds.The world's top coaches are known to use our data to make critical team decisions.Sports commentators can engage with fans on a deeper level, using our stories and insights.

Anywhere you find sport, Stats Perform is there.  However, data and tech are only half of the package. We need great people to fuel the engine.

We succeeded thanks to a team of amazing people. They spend their days collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data from a wide range of live sporting events. If you combine this real-time data with our 40-year-old archives, elite journalists, camera operators, copywriters, the latest in AI wizardry, and a host of 'behind the scenes' support staff, you've got all the ingredients to make it a magical experience!

Position Overview

We are seeking a strategic and commercially-minded Senior Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) to join our team in the Paddington office. In this critical role, you will partner closely with senior leadership to align our HR initiatives with business objectives. You will act as a trusted advisor on all people-related matters, driving talent strategy, fostering a high-performance culture, and ensuring we continue to attract, retain, and develop top talent in the competitive sports tech landscape

Responsibilities

Strategic Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, providing strategic HR guidance and coaching to support the achievement of business goals. Talent Management & Succession Planning: Lead talent reviews, identify high-potential employees, and develop robust succession plans to build bench strength across the organization.Organizational Development: Partner with business leaders to design and implement organizational structures that optimize efficiency, agility, and performance. Employee Relations: Handle complex employee relations issues with empathy, fairness, and a deep understanding of UK employment law, mitigating risk while maintaining a positive work environment. Performance Management: Champion our continuous performance management processes, empowering managers to provide meaningful feedback, set clear goals, and address underperformance effectively. Engagement & Culture: Drive initiatives that enhance employee engagement, promote diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI), and reinforce our core values within the Paddington office and beyond. Data-Driven Insights: Utilize HR metrics and analytics to identify trends, inform decision making, and measure the impact of HR programs on business outcomes. Change Management: Guide leaders and teams through organizational changes, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years operating as a Senior HRBP or in a similar strategic role.Previous experience in the technology, data analytics, or sports industry is highly desirable. Subject Matter ExpertiseDeep understanding of UK employment law and best practices in employee relations, performance management, and talent development. Commercial AcumenStrong business acumen with the ability to connect HR strategies to commercial outcomes. Communication SkillsExceptional communication, influencing, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to challenge and advise senior leaders. Analytical SkillsProficiency in using HR data to tell a story and drive actionable insights. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business

Why work at Stats Perform?

We love sports, but we love diverse thinking more!

We know that diversity brings creativity, so we invite people from all backgrounds to join us.  At Stats Perform you can make a difference, by using your skills and experience every day, you'll feel valued and respected for your contribution.  

We take care of our colleagues

We like happy and healthy colleagues. You will benefit from things like Mental Health Days Off, ‘No Meeting Fridays,’ and flexible working schedules.

We pull together to build a better workplace and world for all.

We encourage employees to take part in charitable activities, utilize their 2 days of Volunteering Time Off, support our environmental efforts, and be actively involved in Employee Resource Groups.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Stats Perform

By joining Stats Perform, you'll be part of a team that celebrates diversity. A team that is dedicated to creating an inclusive atmosphere where everyone feels valued and welcome. All employees are collectively responsible for developing and maintaining an inclusive environment. That is why our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals underpin our core values.

With increased diversity comes increased innovation and creativity. Ensuring we're best placed to serve our clients and communities. Stats Perform is committed to seeking diversity, equity, and inclusion in all we do.

rows.title: Marketing Business Operations Intern, 2027 Summer U.S.
rows.descriptionText:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians have the flexibility to work where they can collaborate most effectively with their team, whether at home, one of our global offices, or both.

As a distributed-first company, all interviews are conducted virtually. We hire in any country where we have a legal entity. Learn how we work at go.atlassian.com/distributed .

Responsibilities

Your Future Org

Atlassian’s Intern program combines hands-on technical training, professional growth opportunities, dedicated mentorship, and strong social connections. This holistic approach empowers students to hit the ground running and sets them up for a successful and impactful career at Atlassian!

This position is not eligible for F-1 and J-1 students. It is not available for any work sponsorship.

Our paid internship program runs for 12 weeks between May/June 2027 – August/September 2027.

Your Future Team

The Office of the CMO is looking for an intern to help build the OCMO Insight Engine—an AI-powered solution that turns marketing performance data into concise, decision-ready insights for senior leaders.

In this role, you’ll use Atlassian tools, Rovo, and responsible AI practices to develop agents that analyze monthly OKR results, business reviews, and historical trends. The solution will help identify meaningful changes, surface areas requiring marketing leadership attention, and produce an executive report that highlights the decisions that matter most.

This is a hands-on opportunity to work at the intersection of artificial intelligence, business operations, data storytelling, and executive communications.

Responsibilities

Partner with the Office of the CMO to understand how marketing business reviews (and selected reports) are prepared and used.

Design and build Rovo-based agents that:Ingest current- and prior-month Atlassian Goals scores and owner commentary.Detect significant changes in key results and overall progress month over month.Draft concise executive-summary bullets explaining the likely drivers of those changes.Flag key results scoring low and generate questions for leadership follow-up.Rebuild a month-over-month trend view without relying on a single reporting surface.Produce a one-screen CMO pre-read (or dashboard) that distills multiple objectives and key results into the most important decision points.Establish a human-in-the-loop review process to validate AI-generated outputs before they are shared with leadership.Test outputs for accuracy, clarity, appropriate executive tone, and usefulness.Document the solution and create a reusable workflow that the OCMO team can operate after the internship.Measure the impact of the solution, including time saved, adoption, read-time, and the quality of decisions surfaced.

Explore Related Automation Opportunities, Such As:

Reminding owners to submit updates.Triage and organization of Marketing Values Awards nominations.Refreshing recurring monthly or quarterly templates (CMO/Marketing Updates).Auditing recurring pages and linked resources for stale information.


What Success Looks Like

By the end of the internship, you will have:

Built a working multi-source insight and trend-detection workflow.Generated executive-summary bullets for material changes in key results.Created automated low-performing-key-result flags with recommended discussion prompts.Delivered a self-rebuilding month-over-month trend view.Produced a concise CMO pre-read focused on decision-worthy issues.Demonstrated the solution in at least two consecutive monthly review cycles, with only light human editing.Documented a quality-assurance process and packaged the workflow for continued use by the OCMO team.Quantified the time and effort saved compared with the existing process.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s degree program in computer science, data science, information systems, business, marketing, communications, or a related field and returning to the program after completing the internship, graduating by June 2028.Interest in artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, or business operations.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.Ability to work with structured and unstructured information.Clear written and verbal communication skills.Comfort learning new tools and working with stakeholders to understand business needs.Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, trustworthy work.Ability to commit to a full-time internship (40 hours/week). Please note: At this time, we are only open to entry-level candidates with less than a year of professional experience (excluding internships and co-ops).

To support this goal, the baseline of our range is higher than that of the typical market range, but in turn we expect to hire most candidates near this baseline. Base pay within the range is ultimately determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, or experience.

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

Join the Zynga Poker Analytics Team

Zynga Poker is seeking a Principal Data Analyst to help drive decisions that impact millions of players worldwide. At Zynga, Principal is the next step above Senior; a great fit for analysts ready to take on broader ownership and scope. As part of our analytics team, you'll play a crucial role in shaping the future of our game through data-driven insights.

Product Strategy: Analyze long and short-term trends to deliver insights that influence product directionExperimentation: Design, conduct, and analyze statistically sound experiments that drive measurable impactBusiness Intelligence: Maintain comprehensive dashboards and ETL pipelines to keep the organization informed on game performanceGame Integrity: Enhance fraud detection and bad actor models to maintain a healthy gaming ecosystem

Join us if you love solving analytical puzzles that impact millions!

What You'll Do

Collaborate with the Product team to enhance revenue, retention, and engagement metrics. This includes conducting A/B testing, performing insights analysis, and developing dashboards.Analyze player behavior to understand motivations and preferences, partnering with game design and consumer insights teams to translate findings into actionable experience improvements.Design and maintain ETL pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from multiple sources, ensuring source of truth for analyses and business intelligence.Participate in and contribute to the Analytics Org’s AI initiative, which is doing significant strides in improving analytics workflows through AIDesign game telemetry to capture meaningful player interaction data to improve the game experience.Design and maintain a suite of highly visible dashboards used by game leadership and game designers to make strategic decisions for Zynga PokerSupport the economy team in tuning the different features in the game to optimize for long term game and feature healthPlay a leading role in the design and continuous improvement of our fraud and bad actor modelsActively play and engage with our games to maintain first-hand understanding of player experience, game mechanics, and potential pain points.Monitor and maintain the integrity of a wide range of tools and models used to streamline workflows and personalize the player experience, in collaboration with other data analysts and scientists on the team.Continuously learn about analytics best practices, and actively share and promote these practices across various games and teams.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. Advanced degrees (Masters or PhD) are a plus.Minimum of 8 years in data science or analytics roles, preferably with 6 years in a Product Data Science or Gaming Analytics teamDemonstrated experience guiding product teams through complex decisions and analyses and dealing with ambiguous dataProficiency in Python and SQL. Demonstrated experience in data mining, data visualization, statistical analysis, and machine learning. Familiarity with Business Intelligence (BI) tools like Tableau and version control systems such as Git is advantageous.Strong ability in both written and oral communication.Experience/ Demonstrated interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.Highly self-motivated with a keen interest in problem-solving.Willingness to take ownership of challenges.Proven ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.Strong communication skills - you can explain complex data in simple, actionable termsFamiliarity with AI/ML concepts or experience in automating recurring analytics workflows is a plus

Bonus Points

Experience/ Interest in improving analytics team's processes and work efficiency using LLMs.Familiarity with poker gameplay and terminologyFamiliarity with social casino economies

What We Offer You

Zynga offers a world-class benefits package that helps support and balance the needs of our teams. To find out more about our benefits, visit the Zynga Benefits site
